Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/031: ...I didn't realize you were so worried./15d/nThen I'll take this opportunity to go and look for her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/032: It seems Zephyr Falcon recently destroyed the church your father founded in Nicosia.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/034: Darling.../15d He's the man who raised me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/035: Another rebellion.../15d/nEven I think your father has been pushing the common people too hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/036: Even if your father insists, that's asking too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/037: I'm sorry./15d/nI'll always be grateful to your father, if only for bringing you into my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/038: Still, those Zephyr Falcon rebels have been running wild lately. It's time someone taught them a lesson.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s01/040: I'll travel around, deal with those Zephyr Falcon rebels, and ask after Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/004: Hah.../15d Hah.../20d I'm glad... I can say farewell to you... before I die...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/005: [Deimos]/nDon't give up. You aren't going to die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/007: [Deimos]/nI'll give you the last strength remaining in my soul.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/009: [Deimos]/nI gave all my power to the Black Prince long ago. This body is little more than an empty shell, but a last spark of strength remains in my soul.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/011: [Deimos]/nThat should be enough to save your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/012: You can't.../40d/nNo, Deimos... You are... a god...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/013: [Deimos]/nDon't say that./nThrough all those years of helplessness/15d and agonizing solitude,/15d you alone became my friend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/014: [Deimos]/nYou inherited my blood and my knowledge. You're as dear to me as my own son.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/015: [Deimos]/nI've created countless lives, but only two can I call my sons./30d/nThe Black Prince, Steiner... and you, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/016: [Deimos]/nI passed my power to Steiner,/20d and now I pass my soul to you, Cyrano./20d Find the power Steiner left behind, and claim it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/017: But.../20d I can't accept your life.../20d just to preserve this worthless life of mine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/018: Please.../15d Don't say that.../20d Bless my soul's release... from this hell...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/019: [Deimos]/nPut those thoughts aside and listen to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/020: [Deimos]/nThe world needs that power./20d But where and how you use it is yours to decide.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/023: [Deimos]/nMy soul will always be with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/024: The power the Black Prince Steiner left behind lies buried on Storm Island, off the continent's southern tip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s08/025: Asura, on Storm Island!/15d Don't forget Asura!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/002: Leave the center, where Christina is, untouched! Attack the parts it's using to strike at us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/003: We did it!! We've destroyed every part it can attack with!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nWith my own life, I beg you... Awaken, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/011: [Cyrano]/nHow... How could you do something so foolish...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy... Why are you apologizing to me, Mercedes...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/020: Even at the end... all I do... is stand... in your way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/023: Cyrano!! The God of Destruction is moving again!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s04/025: Your sacrifice won't be in vain, Esmeralda!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/001: All right, let's rescue the villagers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/004: ...You look like mercenaries hired by that fox of Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/005: Why did you abduct the villagers?/nAnd why are Bifrost troops in the imperial territories?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/006: Mere mercenaries, prying into things that don't concern you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/007: You seem to have some skill...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/008: What do you say?/nI'll pay you twice as much. Why not work for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/009: Enough of your tricks./nWe're Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/011: Hmph... Esther Dodd... What a fool./nBringing Zephyr Falcon into this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/014: We can't let them leave here alive. Do it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/016: Good./nWe've dealt with the lord. Now let's find the captive villagers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat20/017: That's right. I'm the lord here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw06/000: The forest is currently sealed off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw06/001: Outskirts of the Demon Sword Forest
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/000: Th... This is the God of Destruction...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/002: Leave the center, where Christina is, untouched! Attack the parts it's using to strike at us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/003: We did it!! We've destroyed every part it can attack with!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nWith my own life, I beg you... Awaken, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr98/000: They say the basement was sealed off after the last incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr98/001: Come on, let's hurry and rescue Esmeralda.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/000: Well, well... Why is the guest of honor wandering around a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/001: Treat Mercedes well./15d Heh... Every young gentleman of standing in Geysir must have dreamed of her at least once... You're a lucky man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/002: If you ever make her cry, you'll answer to me. Understand?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/003: Ah, Cyrano. I'm quite intrigued by that kidnapping at your house, involving the boy called Sid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/004: Why did the kidnappers hold him for three days, then do nothing more? And why did they drug him so badly that he's still unconscious?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/005: The whole affair is a mystery. Most puzzling of all is the motive. Why...? There's something behind it, but I can't work out what.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/007: Around the corner, waiting still,/nA new road and a secret door./nThough I have often passed them by,/nOne day, when the time has come,/nWest of the moon, east of the sun,/nI'll walk that hidden path.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/008: /nA Elbereth Gilthoniel!/nSilivren penna miriel/nO menel aglar elenath!/nGilthoniel, A! Elbereth!/nWe remember,/nThough we dwell far away beneath the trees,/nThe starlight upon the western sea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/009: Sid... Was he reading this book?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/000_3: Well, well... Why is the guest of honor wandering around a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/001_3: Treat Mercedes well. Heh... Every young gentleman of standing in Geysir must have dreamed of her at least once... You're a lucky man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/002_3: If you dare make her cry, you'll answer to me. Do you hear?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/006_3: There's a book on the shelf I haven't seen before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/007_3: /nAround the corner, waiting still,/nA new road and a secret door./nThough I have often passed them by,/nOne day, when the time has come,/nWest of the moon, east of the sun,/nI'll walk that hidden path.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/008_3: /nA Elbereth Gilthoniel!/nSilivren penna miriel/nO menel aglar elenath!/nGilthoniel, A! Elbereth!/nWe remember,/nThough we dwell far away beneath the trees,/nThe starlight upon the western sea./n/nBy Frodo Baggins, from "The War of the Ring"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber08/009_3: Was this the book Sid was reading...? I've never seen this poetry collection before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx04/000: Libreville lies north of Caracas Forest, which is east of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwri11/002: We need to meet the lord of Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga05/000: Is this the garden from all those years ago...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/000: At last, we're back in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/001: What are you going to do next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/002: I'll need to find out how things have changed in the empire since I left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/003: If I remember correctly, this is the Caracas region...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/005: Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for you, Kana Milanovich!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/006: A Zephyr Falcon unit commander! A bigger catch than I'd expected!/30d Now surrender without a fight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/007: Damn, so it was a trap after all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/008: But this is the only road to the duke's lands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/009: Hey! Over here, over here! Hit them in the flank!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/010: What?! More of them over there!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/011: Good! Don't let them escape either! We'll wipe them all out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/012: What's that girl playing at?!/20d Dragging innocent bystanders into this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/013: Heh. That girl certainly takes risks.../20d But if the soldiers are blocking our way, there's no reason to avoid a fight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/014: I'm sorry for dragging you into this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/015: Hmph, you might as well stab someone first and then say sorry!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/016: Is that all the soldiers dealt with, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/017: Thank you so much for your help, but I'm in a hurry. I have to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/020: Well, I'll take it as a welcome home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/021: Now, there should be a small village nearby./30d Let's stay there tonight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s01/023: Tsk! They were lying in ambush!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst12/000: Coming this far should be enough training.../10d Perhaps I should go back for the fifth stage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/000: Th... That magic machine... Isn't it Arondight...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/002: What about the war with the Tuer?! How could they send Arondight here?! Rashid!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/003: It seems the recent rumors were true.../30d That the Tuer Empire and Pendragon had agreed to a temporary truce...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/004: Now, of all times?/30d No... It's too soon!/30d We haven't even united the imperial territories yet!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/005: Your Eminence, this is no time for that. With Pendragon involved, your plans.../40d We must leave at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/006: No, there's still a way... As long as I live, I will unite the empire with my own hands!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/007: Abandon these vain ambitions, Cardinal Cesare. A man must know when to give up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/008: Grandfather... I can't let you keep killing innocent people for your ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/009: Please... I beg you to surrender.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/010: I cannot. Do you think I would ever give up?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/011: Give up, Christina. He's no longer your grandfather. He's a devil!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/012: Who dares call me a devil?! Me!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/017: I'm glad I could give Grandfather true peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/018: Now... Father and Mother can rest in peace, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/020: Come to think of it, where's that fellow Machiavelli?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/021: I'm here. Don't worry, I won't run.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/023: You've got some nerve. Were you watching the whole time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/024: I was the one who let him go, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/026: Who are you, really?/30d Is Clausewitz even your real name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/029: I do have much to explain to you all. But my grandfather is waiting for us. Please come with me for now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/030: He only wishes to leave his judgment of Cesare and ourselves to posterity through his ideas. Nothing more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/031: No, I don't care what happens to him anymore. What concerns me is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21c/002_3: Pendragon has intervened.../40d/nWhat about the war with the Tuer?! How could they send Arondight here?! Rashid!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s3t/000: [Iscariot]/nThis is the great power of Grima, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/000: Damn... We've ended up in a strange place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/001: Damn... That sulfur stench burns my nose.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/002: Be careful... This is Inferno's graveyard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/003: Be careful... This is Inferno's graveyard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/004: Prisoners who die in the cells are thrown down here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/005: But what should I be careful of?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/007: ...I never expected a monster like that down here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/008: That's not all. Inferno's sulfur caves are teeming with monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/009: More to the point, where's the exit?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/010: We have no choice but to go through the sulfur caves.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/012: You'd best be careful in the sulfur caves.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf2f/013: And stay out of the fighting. It's too dangerous for you./nI'll handle everything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst01/002: Is Lee Joo Hwan an idiot?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst01/005: I should have explored enough by now.../15d I'd better return for the second stage of training before going any further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/000: /2cAnd Meditch... Was that his name?/20d Without his help, I would still be wandering through that hell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/002: /2cAnd now I had begun my journey to claim the power Deimos had spoken of.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/003: /2cWhen I awoke in my cell, it felt as though I were dreaming.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/004: /2cThe pain that had tormented me for years had vanished. Even the sulfur fumes seemed to stir my body and give me strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s09/005: /2cKnowing that Deimos' soul would watch over me wherever I went, whatever I did, gave me strength of spirit as well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro04b/000: We have to get out of here, quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga10a/001: Memphis, one of our targets, is nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmfre04/000: There's no path down from here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/001: Heh heh... So that's the fellow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/002: That's him. The fool who was betrayed by his sweetheart and dragged in here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/003: Didn't she marry another man less than a month later?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/004: And Lord Frederick, no less! Heh heh... That woman's quite something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/005: Shh! Watch how you speak of her./nShe's His Eminence's daughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/007: Our dear devil-worshipping priest doesn't seem to know a thing. Heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/008: We're saying Miss Mercedes has already married Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/009: She threw her fiance in prison, then proposed to another man less than a week later.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/010: I hear Lord Frederick's so handsome you'd fall for him at first sight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/012: Anyway, they're sending this fellow to the sulfur caves, aren't they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/013: You'd be better off biting out your tongue and ending it here than going to that hell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/014: No one's lasted more than five years down there... Heh heh.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/015: Come on, there's no time for this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/017: Think carefully about my advice. Heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/019: Heh heh... So that's the fellow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/020: That's him. The fool betrayed by his sweetheart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/021: Didn't she marry another man less than a month later?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/022: And Lord Frederick, no less! Heh heh... That woman's quite something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/023: Shh! Watch how you speak of her./nShe's His Eminence's daughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/025: Our dear devil-worshipping priest doesn't seem to know a thing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/026: We're saying Miss Mercedes, the cardinal's daughter, has already married Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/027: She threw her fiance in prison, then proposed to another man less than a week later.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/028: And I hear Frederick has immense wealth and power...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/029: Even the cardinal's daughter is no different, eh? Tsk, tsk, tsk.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/031: Anyway, they're sending this fellow to the sulfur caves, aren't they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/032: So I hear./nYou'd be better off biting out your tongue and ending it here than going to that hell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/034: Come on, there's no time for this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/035: Oh, is it time to assemble already?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/040: This... There must be some mistake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/041: Mercedes.../10d.../10d She.../10d.../10d She couldn't do this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s01/043: [Cyrano]/nSomeone, please tell me it isn't true!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/000: Did you enjoy your meal? I hope the food was to your liking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/001: How could it be otherwise, with you as our host? It was wonderful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/002: I'm so glad I could give you some small pleasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/003: I understand the situation is urgent. I'd like to dispense with the pleasantries and hear what this is about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/008: Cyrano may have caught you off guard, but we only wish to help you as soon as possible, Lady Esther Dodd. Please, tell us freely what troubles you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/009: No, he startled me a little, but Cyrano is right.../nIn fact, hearing you say that puts me at ease.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/010: Then I'll explain the problem that brought you here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/012: Though I hesitate to boast, Libreville is considered the second best place to live in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/013: Of course! No, I'd call it the very best!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/016: The previous lord and our people cleared the mountain lands and cut roads through the barren terrain. In time, Libreville became a hub for trade with Bifrost and Curtis to the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/017: This land is the fruit of our blood, sweat, and toil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/018: But... It was about a year ago, I think.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/019: East of town is the road to Curtis./nThe plateau just north of it was made a separate territory, and a new village was built there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/020: Surely you don't mean you're troubled by the division of your lands?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/021: I don't mind that. The problem is that this little village has openly seized the road as though it belonged to them and begun charging tolls. That road is Libreville's lifeline.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/023: But disputes like that are common throughout the imperial territories. Surely you haven't asked for our help over that alone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/024: She hasn't finished yet, Isabele. Let's hear her out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/025: Yes. If it were only a matter of tolls, I'd have settled it between us lords. But their lord never appears in public, and our letters go unanswered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/028: Then, one by one, people who traveled that road for work stopped returning to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/031: Are you suggesting they were abducted?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/032: I didn't want to believe that, either. But I couldn't stand by while our people disappeared.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/033: Then why not fight them yourselves? Libreville is larger and more developed, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/034: Well... Our lack of strength is part of it, but there's something unnatural about that village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/036: Ah.../30d Yes... And not only that... They're using monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/037: Monsters... There is certainly more to this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/038: A lord who hides his face and uses monsters to abduct people.../40d He must be very fond of novels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/039: What do you want us to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/040: Obviously she wants me to cut him down with this spear!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/041: Zephyr Falcon won't stand by while innocent people suffer. Even without your request, my lady, we'd have acted if we'd known of this sooner!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/043: Wait. Surely you don't expect our help without offering any payment?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/044: Rest assured, I haven't come empty-handed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/045: What are you saying? We can't impose on our host...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/046: They say one should never refuse a generous offer. What have you prepared, Lady Esther Dodd?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/047: It's nothing grand, but I wish to offer a token of my gratitude. To be specific...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/048: I promise an annual grant of one million Eld, free use of my mansion, and protection for Zephyr Falcon's officers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/050: Such generosity befits a truly great ruler./nWe gratefully accept.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/051: It isn't only because of this trouble. I've long admired Zephyr Falcon's pursuit of justice. If I can help, I'll do all I can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/052: I'll give you five hundred thousand as an advance right away. Please put it to good use.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/053: Thank you very much, Lady Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/054: Please call me Esther from now on, Captain Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s05/056: It's nothing grand, but please accept it as a token of my gratitude.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst24/000: I think I've learned a fair amount of swordsmanship now. Time for my final lesson.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/000: I never thought you'd make it this far...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/001: Heh heh heh... I hired Tuer mercenaries especially for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/002: Get them! Teach those fools a lesson!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/003: H... How can this be...? My mercenaries...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr113/006: I'll give you one hour. Release the prisoners immediately and leave this territory!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka02a/000: North - Caracas Village/nEast - Trisis Desert/nSouth - Paro Region/nWest - Pretoria Region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka02a/001: Pretoria is a long way off./nLet's restock our weapons and supplies in nearby Caracas before we set out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/001: Heh... Not a trace of the old bookworm left. You've grown quite strong,/nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/002: I never thought you could defeat General Irus, who was once one of the Four Heavenly Kings...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/003: Ruben... It's been a long time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/004: Cyrano, I knew this day would come. I've felt it ever since fifteen years ago...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/005: Why?/nWe were like brothers. Why did you betray me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/006: Brothers... Heh. If you hadn't been my own older brother, I'd never have betrayed you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/008: I'm sorry, but don't we have something to do first,/nCyrano Bernstein?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/009: I've prepared a few toys especially for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/010: Ever heard of a machine gun?/nIt came from the east. Quite a powerful thing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/012: Let's see the strength that slew the Dark God.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/013: How did you know Irus was the Dark God...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/014: Oh dear, you really did underestimate me... How disappointing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/015: Well, well... Our introduction has gone on longer than I expected./nBe careful. This toy is more dangerous than you think.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/016: Enough to tear even an immortal body to pieces!!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/019: This.../5d is the path I chose.../5d Fifteen years ago.../5d I began waiting for this day.../5d Ever since I betrayed my own brother...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/021: Heh.../3d So you didn't know.../nWe're half-brothers.../3d We both carry the blood of our father, Luke Bernstein...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/022: And Father... died because of me./nAll these years.../4d I've been so lonely, in so much pain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/023: Still, I'm happy at the end./10d To die at my brother's hand.../4d At least...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/025: Brother, beware of Cesare.../5d He was the one who trapped you./10d/nIscariot and I were both his...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/026: ...Cesare./15d/nSo he was involved in this as well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s03/027: Cesare Borgia.../10d/nThis bloody bond between us.../10d I'll end it with my own hands.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/002: It's been a long time, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/003: My daughter.../15d Christina has caused you a great deal of trouble, hasn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/005: It was... a long time ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/009: She has every quality a ruler needs./nSwordsmanship... Eloquence... Leadership...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/011: Everything she knows.../10d He taught her. From beginning to end...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/014: What right have you to speak his name, Cyrano Bernstein?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/017: Such a good man.../10d And you so cruelly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/019: You.../15d You're no longer the Cyrano I knew.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/020: It isn't only your appearance that's changed.../10d You're a beast consumed by the madness of revenge.../10d/nYou're not human!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/021: I.../5d I'm afraid of you./15d So very afraid...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/022: I thought.../10d that you, at least, would believe me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/023: Give him back.../15d Give Frederick back to me... Sob...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/032: Heh heh heh... How pathetic you are, Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/033: Did I wait fifteen years... just to drink this poisoned wine...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/034: Well... So be it./10d If this is my fate...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/039: Everything... Everything that's happened.../10d was orchestrated by your father, Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/042: Who... told you Frederick was dead?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/043: Who... gave you the poisoned wine?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/044: Who told you I killed Frederick?!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/049: May this... bring forgiveness for all I've done...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/050: Mercedes... Don't tell me your glass is poisoned, too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/053: [Mercedes]/nI'm sorry... But this is the only way left to me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/054: [Mercedes]/nFor fifteen years... I thought only of you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/055: [Mercedes]/nThat's why.../15d/nI was so... so glad to see you again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/058: [Mercedes]/nBut... When I heard you'd killed him... Frederick...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/059: [Mercedes]/nCyrano... Frederick was such a good man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/060: [Mercedes]/nHe truly loved me... even while I waited only for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/061: [Mercedes]/nI'm sorry... I was so lonely, all those fifteen years. And now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/062: [Mercedes]/nI, too.../10d came to love him with all my heart...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/070: [Mercedes]/nAh... How could I have been so foolish...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/072: [Mercedes]/nFifteen years ago, on the day of your execution...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s01/074: [Mercedes]/nI did as Father told me... and decided to marry Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx18/000: Frequent rebel activity. Civilians are forbidden to pass./n/nBy order of the Lord of Pretoria
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn32/000: So I have to press this switch, then step on it to activate it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/001: /2cHe helped me understand why I had been framed, and taught me history, logical reasoning, and much else besides.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/002: /2cDeimos' presence,/15d and/10d my obsession with Mercedes./20d Those were the two things that kept me alive in that hell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/003: /2cBut one day, a year after I met Deimos,/20d my body could endure no more. Death was near.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/005: No.../5d I can't.../10d fall.../10d not.../5d here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/011: [Guard]/nTough bastard. He lasted four whole years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/012: [Guard]/nOpen the cell and get rid of the body. Quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/014: [Guard]/nThis fellow... He's still breathing.../10d/nWhat should we do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/015: [Guard]/nWhat do you think? Just get rid of him. It's too much trouble./nYou know that pit the earthquake opened last year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s07/016: [Guard]/nWell... Makes no difference to me./n/10dGive me a hand, then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx14/000: What sets humanity above other beings/nis our ability to sacrifice ourselves for others./nEven if today's choice costs you everything, do not grieve or regret it./nWe live by making sacrifices for one another./nThough I may vanish today, does not another life remain?/nA father's will lives on through his son, and a mother's love never changes./nThrough sacrifice and love, humanity may endure forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/001: [Maid]/nPlease... You're putting me in a difficult position.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/002: What? A senator wishes to see the Grand Duke, and you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/003: What right have you to bar my way?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/007: Grand Duke! We need to speak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/013: Grand Duke, what do you take our Senate for?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/014: You've bypassed the Senate and increased military spending again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/015: Do you understand your responsibilities as Grand Duke or not?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/017: I believe I've explained this fully already./10d/nThe reason for the increase is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/018: Enough! Are you going to parrot the same excuse again?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/019: The real reason is that you've let that woman manipulate you, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/024: Drag these two old men out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/027: You insolent fools.../15d Do you know who I am?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/028: Leave, or we will open fire./nThis is your final warning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/030: Grand Duke!/nYou're making a grave mistake!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/032: Those useless old men in the Senate...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s01/033: I should take this opportunity to abolish the Senate altogether.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/001: And who are you, to be making such a commotion in the lord's mansion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/002: We're looking for Esmeralda. Viscount Ramon has taken her prisoner.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/003: This is Sharn Hoiste, a thief who makes life miserable for corrupt lords./20d We've met a few times before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/004: To keep this brief, why don't we help one another while we're in this mansion?/30d We seem to be in much the same position.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/006: I've opened the door, so let's head down./nViscount Ramon's torture chamber is just below us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/007: Wait.../20d Could you be Sharn Hoiste...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/008: Aren't you making rather a lot of noise?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp108/009: Ah, Kana Milanovich of Zephyr Falcon!/30d A pleasure to see you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/002: Why is Deimos, leader of the Dark Gods, beneath Inferno...?/10d/nCould a human have cast a dark barrier strong enough to seal his power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/003: ...A human?/10d/15d/nNo... Perhaps it wasn't a human.../15d/nCome to think of it, didn't a god survive the Creation War.../15d?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/005: Tsk, I can't remember any more./15d/nAt least the guards know nothing of him./15d That's a relief.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/006: I must find another chance to see him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/009: Damn... I don't think I have much time left./15d I must find some way out of here.../10d Ugh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s05/010: Tomorrow.../10d I'll go back to him tomorrow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri03/000: The road lies beneath your feet./n       Largo, adventurer
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/001: .../15d We've removed much of the poison, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/002: It's a dreadful poison./nI'm afraid his body will suffer for it in the days ahead.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/003: Oh.../10d How did it come to this...?/15d/nBack then.../5d I should have stopped him, whatever it took...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/004: I think we've shaken off all our pursuers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/005: I'm sorry... about what happened earlier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s04/011: .../15d So you still won't answer me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/001: Well.../10d/nI'm not sure twenty thousand men can hold off a hundred and thirty thousand...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/002: Your task is only to keep them in check./nAvoid a direct engagement at all costs. Use Inferno's terrain to delay their advance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/003: All right!/nThat much, I can manage somehow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/004: Timing is vital. Coordinate your attacks with Cyrano to throw the enemy into confusion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/005: Tsk... Everyone else gets to fight, while I'm stuck watching from the rear...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/006: That's not so. If our supply lines are cut, the situation will turn sharply against us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/007: Remember, Rhidelhard, your role is the most important in this operation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/009: We'll call this operation Dragon Strike.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/010: The empire's survival rests on this operation. I ask you all to give it your utmost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/011: I'll brief each of you on the details later.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/012: Impressive, Clausewitz./nTo come up with a plan like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/013: ...?/nIsabele, you seem to have something to say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/014: You flatter me./nI merely adapted the Black Prince's oblique formation after studying it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s02/016: General Frederick, everything is ready for your speech.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/001: The rumors about strange goods being sold in this rebel village aren't true.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/002: You can't go in. Mother's having a baby... My little brother or sister!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/003: What should I do for the baby...? Braid their hair, give them flower hairpins...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/004: We were driven out of our village, but thanks to Zephyr Falcon, we can still sell our goods here. Welcome!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/005: Hello! Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/010: I may not look like much, but I've plenty of fine goods. Take your time browsing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/012: Take care. Come and see me again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/013: Oh... Welcome! We've got everything, except what we haven't got!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/014: Thank you very much. Good luck on your travels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/015: May blessings accompany you on your journey...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/016: This is an unusual place: a rebel village that sprang up on its own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro10/017: As you can see, it's small enough to escape notice... Neither Zephyr Falcon nor the lords pay it much attention.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/001: This court convenes to investigate and pass judgment on the charge of devil worship against Cyrano Bernstein. It is eight o'clock. The trial will now begin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/002: I declare the court in session.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/003: The Church has received an anonymous accusation that you worship the devil./nDo you admit the charge?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/005: You are accused of studying a forbidden demonic text on a certain day last month. Do you admit it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/006: A forbidden demonic text? I know nothing of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/008: Calm yourself./30d/nThe accused may not even know what he has done wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/009: Are you familiar with the book "Secret Records of the Creation War"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/010: Yes, I am./30d/nI've been studying it recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/011: Good heavens... To do such a thing...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/012: "Secret Records of the Creation War" was written by Gishne, that demon of the old empire who called himself a sage!/30d/nSo the accused has indeed been studying demons!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/015: That book.../15d.../15d.../15d.../15d is not demonic...!/20d It's the work of the sage Gishne...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/016: Then the accused must have sought to embrace demonic teachings!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/020: Reading a forbidden book is a grave offense, but that alone does not prove devil worship.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/021: However, we have a witness who can establish the accused's devil worship.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/023: Permission is requested to call the witness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/027: He recommended the book,/20d urging me to learn more about demons...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s11/029: You seem to know the accused well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/000: Well... The time has come to part.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/001: Meditch is on time for once, and now the people we're here to see off are late.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/002: I couldn't be late on a day like this./30d It might be the last time I see them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/005: Are you setting off now, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/006: Yes, I was about to leave.../30d I think farewells are best kept short.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/008: I'll miss you, Kana. For all our quarrels, we've grown fond of one another.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/009: You're not going anywhere without us, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/010: Surely you weren't planning to leave me behind as well, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/011: I'm grateful to you all,/30d but I mean to settle somewhere new, where no one knows me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/012: Perhaps in the east of this continent, perhaps on some remote island... Perhaps even on the eastern continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/013: At last, you're about to reap the rewards of your efforts. To give all that up and follow me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/014: If I'd wanted a peaceful life, I'd never have followed you in the first place./30d You give my life meaning, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/015: I've never thought about anything so grand as the meaning of life. I want to follow you simply because I care for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/016: I'm no longer in Zephyr Falcon, either. So you've no excuse to leave me behind, have you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/017: We'll all go together, Cyrano./30d To a strange land where no one knows us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/018: Then let's leave together./30d We'll bury the unhappy past here, carry the good memories in our hearts, and leave this land.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl24_s01/021: Everything I've worked for was for you, Cyrano./30d I've never sought a peaceful life for myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr01/001: Clausewitz's treasure map reads: North - Southeast - South - Northeast - North - North - Northwest - North - Northeast.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/000: Your Majesty, I trust you have been well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/001: Indeed, it's been a long time./30d And you too, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/003: Our leader? The leader of Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/004: Our leader? His Majesty? What is going on?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/005: This is my grandfather, Rashid Pendragon I: leader of Zephyr Falcon and King of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/007: Our leader is Rashid, the legendary Holy King?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/009: Forgive me for concealing my identity. My true name is Rashid Clausewitz Pendragon III, son of Pendragon's First Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/010: Good heavens, then you're one of Pendragon's...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/011: Clausewitz, Sharn Hoiste, and now Rashid III... Which one is the real you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/013: Rashid, you've managed things better than I'd expected, but you took too many risks./30d This business with Arondight, for instance. What would you have done if our war had lasted longer than expected?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/014: And to all of you in Zephyr Falcon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/016: You may resent learning that your leader is another country's king. Even so, you've led Zephyr Falcon admirably on your own initiative.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/018: ...Forgive my impertinence,/30d but why would the king of the continent's strongest nation form an unofficial group to interfere in another country's affairs?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/019: Ho ho... You're as spirited as I've heard. But it's a perfectly reasonable question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/020: The royal airship Lin Amadeo III is waiting nearby. Let us travel to Pendragon together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/021: The answer goes back a very long way. Why not hear it as we travel to Pendragon Palace?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/000_3: [Clausewitz]/nYour Majesty, I trust you have been well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/005_3: [Clausewitz]/nThis is my grandfather, Rashid Pendragon I: leader of Zephyr Falcon and King of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/013_3: Rashid, you've managed things better than I'd expected, but you took too many risks./30d This business with Arondight, for instance. What would you have done if our war hadn't reached a truce?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/018_3: ...Forgive my impertinence,/30d but why would the king of the continent's strongest nation form an unofficial group to interfere in another country's affairs?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21e/019_3: Ho ho... You're as spirited as I've heard. But it's a perfectly reasonable question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/000: Ron's greatest pride is undoubtedly the army under Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/001: Ron is the finest city in the old imperial territories. A mighty army, a strong economy! We'll be the heart of the new empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/003: Men are just overgrown children. Forever whining and throwing tantrums.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/005: My husband gambles every day and never gives a thought to minding the shop!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/009: I once saw Lord Frederick draw his sword of light. Just once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/010: I couldn't sleep that night! He was so dashing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/012: Just who is that thief, Sharn Hoiste? I hear he's been seen around here recently...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/013: Here and Libreville are about the only decent places left to live. The imperial territories as a whole are in a terrible state.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/015: But my wife is forever at my throat! How's a man supposed to live?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/016: Don't you agree? A husband like me would be a catch anywhere!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/017: Just wait till I catch him! I'll cure him of that habit this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/018: Ho ho ho... A quarrel between husband and wife soon blows over. Such things can't be helped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/019: Couples quarreling like that always remind me of my younger days... My wife was lovely back then, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/020: Heh. For a military town, this place has remarkably strong-willed women. Most men don't dare stand up to them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/023: Hee hee... They do have their sweet moments. Why else would we live with them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/027: Ugh... He makes me so angry! Just who does he think he is?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/028: Where's he gone now? Aah! Why did I ever get married?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/029: Unless you keep soothing them, they sulk. Such troublesome creatures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/030: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome! Our store stocks the best firearms in the country!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/032: Thank you for choosing Phaethon, the finest name in firearms. Do come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/033: [Mrs. Harold]/nWelcome! We sell fine swords as well as guns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/035: Thank you for choosing Phaethon, the pride of Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/036: We carry such fine guns that even Lord Frederick visits from time to time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/037: Father collects firearms himself, so he keeps some fine pieces aside that aren't usually for sale.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/038: [Miss Ellen]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/040: Thank you for shopping at August. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/041: My father went into the forest not long ago, but strangely, he has not come back since.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/042: Mother keeps asking after Father, but he still hasn't returned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/043: Welcome to the Explosive Tavern, one of Ron's finest establishments!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/044: Our pride and joy is Rud, the strongest liquor in all Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/045: The Rud here is potent stuff. Care to try some?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/046: All the men of Ron serve in Frederick's army. We're elite soldiers, each worth a hundred ordinary men.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/047: Forget Libreville. Ron's the finest place to live in the world!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/048: Have you tried the arena here? We judge courage by how long someone can last in it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/049: Cowards are a disgrace to Ron. We are all soldiers ready to die on the battlefield.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/050: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome to our proud city of Ron! A night at our inn costs 110 Eld. Will you stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/051: Thank you. Sleep well, and may God watch over you tonight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/052: Do visit us again when you have the chance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/053: Thank you for your custom. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/054: I'm a mercenary, but I've had enough of wandering. I've come here to settle down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/055: I thought Ron's mighty army would let me put my mercenary skills to good use.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/056: Libreville and Ron are the two best places to live, aren't they? I've come to settle here myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/057: Geysir City? Its dangers are less obvious. It's more dangerous than the other towns, if anything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/058: Our arena is full of tough, powerful instructors. Come in and try your strength!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/059: For a man, nothing prepares you for real combat like training in our arena. Nothing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/060: [Winnie]/nWelcome! My parents have gone out after another quarrel, but they'll be back soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/062: My parents aren't here, and I don't really know the prices. I'm sorry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/063: Train for real combat if you want to do your duty as a citizen!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/064: I'm sorry. You mustn't come in that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/065: I'm sorry. You can't enter that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/066: Please, you mustn't go in there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/067: I'm sorry. You mustn't come in that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/068: Hey, try to catch me! If you can, I'll give you something good!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/069: Hmph! Think you can catch me that easily?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/072: You have a membership card. Go on in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/073: Of all the battlefields, the one where Al was stationed had seen the fiercest fighting. Awen was filled with foreboding.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/074: When Awen reached Al's unit, he was absent from the warm welcome she received. "Where's Al?" she asked. One of his comrades replied, "He was taken prisoner in the last battle."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/075: After that, strange gems never seen before were sometimes found in the lake. Those were Chaos Cubes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/076: When Awen heard that Al was in the hands of a cruel enemy, she couldn't wait a moment longer. She slipped into their castle and began searching for him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/077: Awen learned that the prisoners had been left hanging from the cliffs of Mount Creon until they died. She rushed to the foot of the cliffs and defeated the guards, but they had destroyed the ladder leading up. Reinforcements soon poured toward the cliffs, and she had no way to climb them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/078: The story is nearly at its end... Someone in the west will tell you the next part.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/079: My grandfather died in the war against the Silver Arrow Alliance. They say he served directly under the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/080: When I grow up, I'll be a brave soldier, too. I'll teach anyone who looks down on our empire a lesson! You'll see.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/081: The empire must unite. With the Silver Arrow Alliance weakened by its war with the Tuer Empire, now is the perfect time to restore our former glory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/082: And unless we unite, our lands will be the next to suffer if the Tuer Empire destroys the Silver Arrow Alliance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/083: Naturally, Ron must be at the heart of that union. We're the empire's true strength, aren't we?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/084: Welcome! Your first time in our tavern, is it...? We have Rud, the strongest liquor in the imperial territories. Care to try some?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/089: Ugh... This is strong.../20d My head...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/090: W... Where am I...? Did that drink make me pass out?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/095: I'm you. Another you, deep inside. But... Haven't you been pushing things too far lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/096: What? Too far in what way?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/097: What drives you to rush about so frantically? What's more important than me? Can't you rest a little?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/098: Let the world go its own way. Let us rest, shall we? Somewhere warm as a dream, comforting as a mother's arms... Still as death, in eternal peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/099: What should I do...? Isn't this my own voice...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/100: Follow the voice's advice and rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/101: No! There's still so much I have to do!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/102: For a man, training comes first... and second! Never neglect your fitness! My relative serving in Geysir City is an expert runner!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/103: Ron City. Prices are somewhat high. A stable city ruled by the renowned military lord Frederick. Its symmetrical layout reflects its military discipline, and its bridges and moats form the strongest defenses in the imperial territories. Its soldiers are reputed to be the empire's finest. Fine firearms can be purchased here. The northern exit leads to Bordeaux through the Demon Sword Forest, where a magic sword is said to lie hidden. Another legendary sword is rumored to rest in a cave on nearby Mount Ron./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/104: To survive in battle, acquire as many fine weapons and pieces of equipment as you can. You get what you pay for: a truth recognized in every land and age. The finest equipment and the strength of a great warrior are your best means of surviving these troubled times./n- Tactical Research Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/105: You are about to enter a time of war. The rush of your fate will leave you no leisure to reflect on yourself. Now, while you still have the chance, prepare thoroughly for what lies ahead./n- Last words left to someone by an elderly prophetess of Ron -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/106: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nDungeons are so dangerous that our society has never explored them. To survive in those unknown depths, you must make a map as you go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/107: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nSurely you know the timeless rule: keep to the edges and you'll encounter fewer enemies. If you map a dungeon, give us a copy for posterity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/108: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nNever forget that travelers throughout Geysir depend on you for their safety! Address it to "Director of Cartography, Geographical Research Society, Geysir Imperial Academy, 23 Steiner Street, Geysir City, Geysir Territory."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/109: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nYou...! You've been to Thunder Nightmare Cave near Libreville! That perilous cave has claimed so many of our members' lives. You made a map, surely? Please, please tell me its layout!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/110: The cave's layout...? It's been so long since I went there. My memory is rather hazy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/111: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nEven a rough idea will do. Please, tell me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/112: What should I do? Help him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/113: Take the time to help draw a map.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/115: All right. I'll help you draw a map from what I remember.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/116: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you! Thank you so much!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/117: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you very much! Every member of our society will remember your kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/118: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nPlease... Please show me the cave's layout. I'll reward you generously.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/120: What should I do? He's even given me a Silver Gem. Should I tell him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/121: Take the time to draw a map.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/123: After all that pleading... I should help him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/124: Thank you, thank you! Your name will live forever in the history of the Imperial Geographical Society!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/125: Well, well... Inferno collapsed, and now we're all out of work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/126: At least I've found some part-time work in the arena. I wonder what's become of the others...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/127: Heh heh heh... Care to try a bout with me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/128: Ron City. Prices are somewhat high. A stable city ruled by the renowned military lord Frederick. Its symmetrical layout reflects its military discipline, and its bridges and moats form the strongest defenses in the imperial territories. Its soldiers are reputed to be the empire's finest. Fine firearms can be purchased here. The northern exit leads to Bordeaux through the Demon Sword Forest, where a magic sword is said to lie hidden. Another legendary sword is rumored to rest in a cave on nearby Mount Ron./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/129: -- Ron City Guide --/nWeapons    Accessories/nInn        Tavern/nItems      Arena/nGeysir Academy branch: eastern district
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/037_3: Father collects firearms himself, so he keeps some fine pieces aside that aren't usually for sale.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/050_3: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome to our proud city of Ron! A night at our inn costs 110 Gold. Will you stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/051_3: Thank you. Have a good night's sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/053_3: Thank you for your custom. Do stay with us again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/058_3: Our arena is full of lively monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01/062_3: My parents aren't here, so I didn't know the prices. I'm sorry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/000: Could appearances be blinding you to the truth, just as that passage warns? People curse the Church, but the truth is different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/001: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/002: The ruins of the Bernstein estate next door have stood empty for ten years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/003: Learn to see everything from several perspectives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/005: A strange cloud hangs over your head.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/006: Oh, that man looks just like someone I saw ten years ago!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/010: A whole family was slaughtered there. Who would dare set foot inside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/011: They say strange swords lie embedded in the woods and mountains near Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/013: A little way south of Geysir, you'll reach Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer has quieted down lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/015: The Church has always held great power in Nicosia.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/016: I am on a secret mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/017: Since a recent blow to the head, I've somehow gained the ability to remember things from ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/019: The people there suffer terribly, yet they still follow the Church with remarkable devotion. Why, I wonder?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/024: All that glitters is not gold. It's a line from my favorite book.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/026: My engagement was broken off recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/027: Simply because a relative of mine had been accused of witchcraft.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/029: The Church seems to make a fortune without doing a thing. What does it actually produce?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/030: A relative of mine lives in Caracas. I hear life there is very hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/031: No one sees the truth clearly. Each of us sees only our own version of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/032: Geysir City, the heart of the Church's lands, seems peaceful. People are even fairly free to criticize the Church... But is that the whole truth?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/033: There's such unease, such a sense of foreboding... What could be coming...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/034: Let me tell you something. Even here in Geysir City, the Church has watchful eyes everywhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/035: It may seem free at first glance, but you must be careful here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/036: That singer Sharon seems very popular.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/037: My son's a fan of hers. I saw her nearby not long ago. She seemed to be heading south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/038: Sharon, Sharon! Oh, she's my idol!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/039: Just seeing her the other day was enough to make me... Sob...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/041: People don't realize the Church has already taken control here, behind the scenes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/042: Not long ago, a friend of mine suddenly disappeared.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/043: He was always speaking out against the Church...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/044: Mother once told me about Cardinal Cesare's wife.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/045: I think she said the woman died unjustly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/046: My mother and Cardinal Cesare were once very close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/047: They seemed to have known each other for years, but Mother never told me the details.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/048: I know I was ordered to kill someone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/049: But since I hurt my head in that accident, I can't remember who.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/050: Who was it?! Could it be you?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/051: Welcome! This is Geysir's finest tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/052: I pulled that odd assassin out of the river a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/054: For that to happen, surely Lord Cesare must take power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/055: But Lord Frederick of Ron has a troublesome attitude...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/056: Sob... My friend stole my boyfriend from me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/057: I'll have my revenge. I swear it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/058: Hmph... He chose me because he likes me. That's all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/059: It's ridiculous to say I stole my friend's boyfriend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/060: Please... Don't mention those two women. They give me a headache.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/061: Each insists I belong to her... I can't get a moment's peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/062: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/063: Bernstein Mansion - Once the home of Geysir City's ruling family, this mansion combines old-world elegance with modern design. Its splendor and grandeur typify a lord's residence. It now stands empty. Though worthy of protection as a historic site, it has never been granted that status because of the accusations of devil worship made when the Bernstein family was destroyed. No effort has been made to preserve it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/064: Wanted: Kana Milanovich/nBounty: 10,000 Eld - Cardinal Cesare
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/065: The son was punished for alleged devil worship, and the father died in a duel with Lord Frederick... A tragic end for the Bernsteins.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/066: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nPay close attention to your enemies' strengths and weaknesses, especially when using elemental weapons or magic. Study their appearance, remember their affinities from past encounters, and choose your attacks accordingly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga02/067: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen you meet an unfamiliar monster, learn its characteristics. It will make your progress through the game much easier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/001: [Zephyr Falcon Marksman]/nI've checked the way ahead.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/003: Good. We're inside. Split into groups here, as planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/004: Louis and Bors, come with me. The rest of you, head upstairs and plant the explosives at the assigned locations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/005: Then I hope to see you all safe at the rendezvous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/007: They say our comrades are in the underground cells.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/008: Come on! Let's take control of this place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/010: I never expected Bifrost to have occupied Inferno...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/011: [Commander]/nThe reason is simple. Inferno links Bifrost to the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/012: [Commander]/nThe Grand Duke intends to use Inferno as a forward base for invading the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/013: [Commander]/nNow, I hear you're stronger than Catalina, captain of the Valkyries?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/014: [Commander]/nYou seem skilled with a sword. But how will you fare against magic?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/018: ...Now all that remains is to deal with the surviving enemies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/020: I wonder if the other teams... have finished safely, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/022: All teams have succeeded./nInferno is now held by Zephyr Falcon and Frederick's army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmsd18/023: Good. Now we need only wait for Catalina's army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/000: Is this... the fire dragon...?/nIt's sealed away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/001: Swordlight shakes heaven and earth,/nDragonfire purifies the soul./n/nHere Kars sealed the dragon./nYear 1205 of the Esghar calendar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/002: And.../10d Who put up a stone monument in a place like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr18/006: The fire dragon is sealed here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme04/001: Leave now, while I'm still asking nicely!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/000: Did you call for me, Father?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/002: It's time to announce your engagement./15d/nAre you both ready?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/003: Where has Ruben gone at a time like this?/nHe should be here helping you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/007: Seeing you like this reminds me of your mother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/009: You aren't even married yet, and already I feel such emptiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/010: Ho ho... I really must be getting old.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/013: By order of the Church!/20d Cyrano Bernstein, you stand accused of devil worship. You are hereby summoned to accompany us to the court at once!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/015: Sir, what did you say? Who has been accused of devil worship?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s10/016: Duke Bernstein, your son has been charged with devil worship. The Church has issued a summons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold00/000: Hee hee! Let's go and find the treasure!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmat01/001: Our information says Machiavelli plans to pass through Antananarivo and cross Mount Mantigoa.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst15/000: I don't know whether coming this far is enough training./15d But I'd better return for the third stage before going any further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/000: How much longer are we going to put up with this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/002: I mean, how long are we going to keep a murderer like that in Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/003: Surely... You don't mean Cyrano, Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/004: Who else? Is there another murderer among us?/20d If we let him keep running wild, he'll drag Zephyr Falcon's name through the mud!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/005: The accusation that Cyrano killed a lord and his wife beloved by the people is certainly harming us, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/006: You know he's been framed. Do you still mean to hold him responsible, Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/007: What do I care whether he's been framed?!/20d I won't have Zephyr Falcon's reputation ruined.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/008: Meditch.../10d Since when did you care about such things?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/009: And.../30d Cyrano.../25d He's even lost Silver.../30d Yet.../20d You would...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/013: I understand Meditch's concern. I can no longer remain in Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/014: I have little time left./40d Before it runs out, I want to settle everything between Cesare and myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/015: This time, I will face him and bring it all to an end.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/016: Meditch, I'll lead our troops to Geysir Cathedral in support of Cyrano./50d What will you do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/018: .../20d I'm staying here./30d I'd sooner leave Zephyr Falcon than act alongside a man like him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/019: I'm sorry to hear that, Meditch./20d I can only hope you won't regret those words.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/021: What are you saying, Kana?/20d Didn't Cyrano bring Captain Silver's death upon himself?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/022: Cyrano is our comrade./20d Is your reputation more important than a comrade, Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/024: You too, Clausewitz.../20d You're only so desperate to keep Cyrano because of his strength, aren't you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/025: How can you be so calculating?/20d What right do people like you have to criticize Meditch?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s01/032: Meditch.../20d You won't leave, will you...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/001: We must rescue Esmeralda from the dungeon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/003: Is this Ramon's mansion?/n/15d What a strange layout.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcph1/004: Come on, let's find Esmeralda quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/001: Chris... I mean, Christina has succeeded General Frederick as supreme commander, and...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/003: ...has just declared war on Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/004: They plan to deploy Ascalon, the first-class magic machine they recently excavated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/006: As you know, Frederick's army is the empire's strongest elite force.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/007: And few people know Zephyr Falcon as well as Christina does.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/008: Hmm... So Christina could crush Zephyr Falcon easily if she chose to.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/009: That is why I intend to attack Geysir City, stronghold of the Church backing Christina.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/011: If we seize their strongholds, the Imperial Academy and the cathedral, we can deal a severe blow to both the Church and Christina's forces.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/012: An offensive rather than a defense...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/013: Then please make your way to Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/014: Everyone, this may be Zephyr Falcon's final operation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/015: Its outcome will decide the fate of Bifrost, the Church's allied forces, and Zephyr Falcon itself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/016: Give this fight everything you have.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/017: General Frederick's death has transformed the course of the war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/019: The message is simple./n"Surrender unconditionally, or face annihilation."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/024: I'm curious. Forgive me, but I'll take a quick look.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/032: He seems to keep something precious in there.../10d/nI can't just open it while he's away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/035: ...Something isn't right./10d/nCould someone... have stirred Christina up?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/036: I never thought we'd end up fighting Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/037: The Imperial Academy has all sorts of fascinating records.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/038: I don't want to fight a woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s00/040: Kana looked terribly upset as she rushed out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/001: Then, Cyrano, please go to Antananarivo and investigate the lord's mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/002: Have the others gone somewhere?/20d I haven't seen any of them all morning...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/003: Ah, Rhidelhard and Isabele have gone to scout the eastern road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/004: Kana says she's unwell and won't leave her room./30d I offered to examine her, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/005: Is she frightened of that monster-using lord?/20d What's this nonsense about being ill?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/008: Clausewitz, did you say that strange lord's lands lie on the plateau beyond the mountains to the northeast?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/009: Yes. A village northeast of here, almost on the Bifrost border./20d Our destination is Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s07/010: From what I've learned, the entire territory is fortified. We'll need to take great care.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000: This is Dakama, trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/001: Foreigners like you probably won't be allowed inside the city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/002: I hope we avoid pirates and storms on this voyage...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/004: I hear I can take a ship to Dakama from here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/006: [Captain]/nYou can. But the route to Dakama is very dangerous these days, so we've postponed sailing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/008: [Captain]/nThat's right. Even we don't know when we'll be able to leave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000_2: This is Dakama, trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda01/000_3: This is Dakama, trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/001: Helping Zephyr Falcon. That's what got him into trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/002: Damn them! They can't defeat Zephyr Falcon, so they're taking it out on us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/003: Shh! What if someone hears you?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/004: Sigh... If only Zephyr Falcon would come to our village...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/006: Zephyr Falcon.../30d A rebel group that's been active in the imperial territories for a few years. They've become rather well known lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/007: I think I've heard of them somewhere...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/012: All right, Silver. We break through head-on!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/014: Foolish wretch, worshipping devils and siding with rebels...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/015: Such treason cannot be forgiven. Execution will teach them to fear the law!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/016: Everything is ready for the burning, Duke Ruben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/017: Now, Silver! We break through head-on!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/018: Not yet./30d Wait until the burning begins and he lets his guard down completely.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/019: He won't be easy to deal with.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/022: Duke Ruben, corrupt lord who torments the innocent!/10d/nZephyr Falcon has come to bring you to justice!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/026: What are you waiting for?!! Stop them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s03/028: Ruben may escape if we're not careful. Let's catch him, quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/000: It wasn't long ago that a frog came to our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/001: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/002: Ho ho ho... I've been to Geysir before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/003: Keep tormenting frogs, and you'll be punished.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/005: I went to a friend's wedding.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/006: Strange sounds sometimes come from the nearby woods.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/010: Geysir was as beautiful as you'd expect of the old capital. Yet its people seemed somehow oppressed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/011: Have you/10d heard of the sword General Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/013: Someone says they've seen a strange sword in the woods near our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer has quieted down lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/015: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince's death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/017: It's a humming sound from the nearby woods... Like wind rustling through grass.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/019: I remember it being very different from Ron... A strange place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/021: A friend and I went to where the sound came from in the woods. Strangely, there was nothing there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/024: Most people in our village are devout followers of the Church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/026: Welcome to the Bordeaux Inn. A night's stay costs 100 Eld. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/027: Thank you very much. Rest well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/029: Thank you very much. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/030: Lucia's family? They're an odd lot. How can people in one family be so distant?/20d Something isn't right...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/031: People are divided over Lucia's family./20d Some say they simply don't get along; others say they aren't really a family at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/032: I don't think they're really a family. For one thing, I've never seen the couple holding hands!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/033: Is there no one in the empire who can take the old royal family's place?! How can the empire ever rise again like this?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/034: Forgive me. I got a little carried away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/035: Have you seen the talking frog in the tavern corner?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/036: When it first arrived, the whole village tried to drive it away./30d It was a monster, after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/037: But then, of all things, the frog spoke! It lamented its misfortunes so pitifully that we let it stay.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/038: I agree with those who say Lucia's family is simply a little unconventional.
