Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/039: People have a strange habit of dismissing or rejecting what they don't understand. Lucia's family is just a little unusual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/040: Legend says that whenever Lord Kars drew that sword, even beasts that knew no fear trembled before its murderous aura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/041: A fine sword alone won't make you a great swordsman, but Lord Kars's sword would certainly help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/042: He was a man... I thought of him constantly, but he saw me only as a childhood friend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/045: I'm traveling as part of my knightly training. Before my journey ends, I intend to obtain General Kars's Gigadeth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/046: I heard the sword was nearby, so I hurried here./30d Some strange fellow may have taken the Black Prince's Asura from Storm Island,/10d but I won't let that happen to this sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/047: Will you help me?/10d I'll reward you handsomely once the sword is mine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/048: Have you spoken to the youngster staying inside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/049: How can a child speak like that?/20d Honestly.../10d Such arrogance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/050: I don't know what grand family he comes from, but he actually asked me, "Are you a servant?" Ugh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/051: Heh. You're not after General Kars's Gigadeth as well, are you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/052: That sword awaits me. As heir to General Kars's line, I alone have the right to wield it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/053: I doubt it would even answer if you called it./20d Ha ha ha!/10d Stop dreaming and look elsewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/055: Everyone here is talking about Lucia's newly arrived family and General Kars's sword, which has suddenly drawn so many seekers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/057: Are you searching for the magic sword, too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/058: Croak. That sword is cursed. Croak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/060: I have been waiting for him for three years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/061: He said he'd return when the spring snow fell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/062: We're Lucia's family, the people everyone's talking about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/063: We're not as strange as the rumors suggest. We simply come from a place with a different culture.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/064: People in this village are strange. Why do they gossip so much about how others live?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/065: We expected some of this when we moved to the countryside... But it's going too far.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/066: What have our parents done to deserve such abuse?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/067: The villagers seem very strange... Their devotion to the Church is unnaturally intense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/068: Could there be something sinister behind all this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/069: What's this taste? This drink is different from the others!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/070: Has something gone wrong with my sense of taste? Everything I eat tastes bitter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/071: [Grandpa Jack]/nHo ho ho... Welcome to my shop. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/073: Ho ho ho... Take care. I hope you'll visit again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/077: You're a nuisance. Stop coming here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/088: There's something odd about the frog living in our tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/091: [Benson]/nAh... I've collected weapons from all over. Money's tight lately, so I'm selling a few. Care to browse?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/093: These are fine pieces I've collected over decades... You can trust their quality.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/000_3: It wasn't long ago that a frog came to our village.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/026_3: Welcome to the Bordeaux Inn. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/028_3: Honestly... If you didn't want a room, why bother me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/030_3: Lucia's family? They're an odd lot. How can people in one family be so distant? It's suspicious...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/036_3: When it first arrived, the whole village tried to drive it away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/037_3: But then, of all things, the frog spoke! It lamented its misfortunes so pitifully that we let it stay.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/038_3: I agree with those who say Lucia's family is simply a little unconventional.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/039_3: People have a strange habit of dismissing or rejecting what they don't understand. Lucia's family is just a little unusual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/040_3: Legend says all his enemies trembled whenever Lord Kars appeared with that sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/041_3: A fine sword alone won't make you a great warrior, but Lord Kars's sword would certainly help a swordsman like you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/042_3: He was a man... I thought of him constantly, but he saw me only as a childhood friend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/045_3: I'm traveling as part of my knightly training. Before my journey ends, I intend to obtain Lord Kars's Gigadeth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/046_3: I heard the sword was nearby, so I hurried here. Some strange fellow took the Black Prince's Asura from Storm Island, but I won't let that happen to this sword.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/049_3: How can a child speak like that? Honestly... Such arrogance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/050_3: I don't know what grand family he comes from, but he makes me sick... He actually asked me, "Are you a servant?" Ugh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/051_3: Heh. Are you after Kars's Gigadeth as well?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/052_3: That sword is meant for me. As heir to Kars's line, I alone have the right to wield it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/053_3: I doubt it would even answer if you called it. Ha ha ha! Stop dreaming and look elsewhere.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo01/078_3: [The Frog Prince]/nSuch a nuisance... Stop coming here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst18/000: I think I can hold my own now. Should I try the challenge as I am?/10d Or go back for the final training...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga01a/000: North - Geysir City/nSouth - Memphis, Nicosia/nWest - Ron
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga01a/001: << Geysir City >>/nYou are entering Geysir, the largest city in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga01a/002: Is Fire Dragon Cave this way?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga12a/000: East - Memphis Village/nNorthwest - Ron region/nNortheast - Nicosia region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/000: Did you enjoy your meal? I hope the food was to your liking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/001: How could it be otherwise, with you as our host? It was wonderful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/002: I'm so glad I could give you some small pleasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/003: I understand the situation is urgent. I'd like to dispense with the pleasantries and hear what this is about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/008: Cyrano may have caught you off guard, but we only wish to help you as soon as possible, Lady Esther Dodd. Please, tell us freely what troubles you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/009: No, he startled me a little, but Cyrano is right.../nIn fact, hearing you say that puts me at ease.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/010: Then I'll explain the problem that brought you here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/012: Though I hesitate to boast, Libreville is considered the second best place to live in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/013: Of course! No, I'd call it the very best!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/016: The previous lord and our people cleared the mountain lands and cut roads through the barren terrain. In time, Libreville became a hub for trade with Bifrost and Curtis to the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/017: This land is the fruit of our blood, sweat, and toil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/018: But... It was about a year ago, I think.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/019: East of town is the road to Curtis./nThe plateau just north of it was made a separate territory, and a new village was built there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/020: Surely you don't mean you're troubled by the division of your lands?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/021: I don't mind that. The problem is that this little village has openly seized the road as though it belonged to them and begun charging tolls. That road is Libreville's lifeline.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/023: But disputes like that are common throughout the imperial territories. Surely you haven't asked for our help over that alone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/024: She hasn't finished yet, Isabele. Let's hear her out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/025: Yes. If it were only a matter of tolls, I'd have settled it between us lords. But their lord never appears in public, and our letters go unanswered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/028: Then, one by one, people who traveled that road for work stopped returning to Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/031: Are you suggesting they were abducted?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/032: I didn't want to believe that, either. But I couldn't stand by while our people disappeared.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/033: Then why not fight them yourselves? Libreville is larger and more developed, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/034: Well... Our lack of strength is part of it, but there's something unnatural about that village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/036: Ah.../30d Yes... And not only that... They're using monsters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/037: Monsters... There is certainly more to this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/038: A lord who hides his face and uses monsters to abduct people.../40d He must be very fond of novels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/039: What do you want us to do?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/040: Obviously she wants me to cut him down with this spear!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/041: Zephyr Falcon won't stand by while innocent people suffer. Even without your request, my lady, we'd have acted if we'd known of this sooner!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/043: Wait. Surely you don't expect our help without offering any payment?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/044: Rest assured, I haven't come empty-handed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/045: What are you saying? We can't impose on our host...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/046: They say one should never refuse a generous offer. What have you prepared, Lady Esther Dodd?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/047: It's nothing grand, but I wish to offer a token of my gratitude. To be specific...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/048: I promise an annual grant of one million Eld, free use of my mansion, and protection for Zephyr Falcon's officers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/050: Such generosity befits a truly great ruler./nWe gratefully accept.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/051: It isn't only because of this trouble. I've long admired Zephyr Falcon's pursuit of justice. If I can help, I'll do all I can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/052: I'll give you five hundred thousand as an advance right away. Please put it to good use.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/053: Thank you very much, Lady Esther Dodd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/054: Please call me Esther from now on, Captain Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/056: It's nothing grand, but please accept it as a token of my gratitude.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/058: A messenger from Frederick arrived just now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/060: Why would Frederick send a messenger to Zephyr Falcon...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/061: It seems Bifrost's invasion of the empire has begun.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/064: Wasn't this foreseeable?/nBifrost has been building up its forces for some time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/065: Of course./nBut the situation is somewhat delicate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/066: Machiavelli's mission as a secret envoy seems to have had considerable influence.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/067: If that fellow had been killed then, none of this would have happened/10d... This is all your fault, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/068: What does that have to do with Frederick's messenger?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/069: Frederick intends to fight Bifrost./nHe's asking Zephyr Falcon for help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/070: A remarkable man./nTo ask his enemies to fight beside him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/072: So... What do you think, Clausewitz?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/073: We cannot permit foreign interference./nFrom the empire's perspective, this is clearly an invasion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/074: What do the rest of you think?/nDoes anyone disagree?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/076: We can't let Bifrost take the empire from us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/078: Who here would oppose it? Let's crush those Bifrost troops!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/079: ...Then I'll take that as unanimous agreement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/081: About two hundred thousand, I hear.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/082: Two hundred thousand... An enormous force.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/083: Yes. Even combined with Frederick's army, our side has only about a hundred and thirty thousand. We can't match their numbers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/085: To beat a larger force, we must rely on defense and surprise attacks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/086: I intend to retake Inferno, a natural fortress, and use it as our defensive stronghold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/088: General Frederick seems to be thinking along the same lines.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/090: We move out at dawn tomorrow./nRest well until then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/091: Oh, and we've acquired some new swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/092: PS-7 Blitz. You're all familiar with that sword, I trust?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/094: That's right./nOne of Pendragon's standard-issue swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/095: But exporting Pendragon's standard-issue swords is strictly forbidden... And Blitz is one of the top models!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/096: Well... I was simply lucky./nIn any case, these swords are for Cyrano and Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/097: Yes. It's the latest model in Pendragon's standard-issue PS, or Pendragon Sword, series.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s03/098: Powerful, certainly, but above all it's light and easy to repair. A very useful sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/000: This is the God of Destruction...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/002: Never mind Christina. Anyone who stands in my way will die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/003: We did it!! We've destroyed every part it can attack with!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/008: [Esmeralda]/nWith my own life, I beseech you...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/009: So... We can't destroy it without harming Christina at its core...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s04/010: It seems there's no other way.../40d The time we've shared.../30d I'll never forget it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/000: You haven't trained enough for the next lesson. Go farther afield and return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001: Go farther afield to train. The farther you travel from here, the more you will learn.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002: /2cFor more than a year after that, I studied Pendragon swordsmanship under her./30d Eoline Pendragon, one of the finest swordmasters of her day, taught me the kingdom's sword techniques. I learned many spells and other skills as well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/004: Sleep well. Don't push yourself too hard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/005: Aren't you pushing yourself too hard?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007: I've told the child inside. If you're tired, go in and rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/009: How did you find the rapier? Was it useful?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/010: It hit very hard, but broke so easily that I couldn't use it for long.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/011: Yes. That's because of what we call a "breakthrough."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/013: When an enemy attacks, the defender instinctively tries to block. Of course, no one can block every attack, but let's assume for now that the defender can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/014: Then the attack first meets the defender's weapon. The weapon acts as the first barrier against it. As with everything else, the outcome depends on which side is stronger.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/015: So that's why my sword broke?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/016: Exactly. If the attacker's Attack exceeds the defender's Weapon Limit, the weapon is damaged. The defender also takes damage equal to the attacker's Attack minus the weapon's Defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/017: When an attack gets past the defender's weapon, we say it has "broken through." Each breakthrough reduces the weapon's HP by 1. If its HP reaches 0, the weapon is destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/018: Rapiers maximize Attack, but have extremely low Weapon Limits. Most rapiers also have only 1 or 2 Weapon HP. That's why they break so easily in battle. You can repair a weapon as long as it hasn't been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/019: Then are rapiers useless in battle?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/020: No. Rapiers are mainly used to strike enemies at long range. They are especially useful when several allies fight together and divide their roles. They are less suitable when you have to face several enemies alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/021: Do you understand? Then put what you've learned into practice. Go a little farther this time. In our next lesson, I'll explain heavy swords, the opposite of rapiers, and teach you more advanced defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/027: Your swordsmanship has reached at least an intermediate level. Now let's go over the theory of heavy swords and defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/028: When explaining breakthroughs, I assumed that "the defender blocks every attack." In a real battle, though, you can't block every enemy attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/029: Yes. I couldn't block every attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/030: Your chance of blocking depends on your weapon type and your Agility. Rapiers aren't suited to blocking, so many attacks get past them. Heavy swords, on the other hand, improve your chance of blocking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/031: There is also the weapon's Defense. When you block, the weapon reduces the enemy's Attack by a certain percentage. Rapiers have low Defense, while heavy swords have high Defense. Even with the same Weapon Limit, a heavy sword will usually let you take far less damage from the same attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/032: Then is it wiser to use a heavy sword?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/033: Usually. Of course, rapiers and heavy swords aren't the only sword types. But a heavy sword can help you survive if your level is low, you're facing several enemies alone, or you're fighting in a confined space.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/034: Now I'll explain the defensive stance. It's useful when enemies focus their attacks on you and you need to wait for help or draw their attention. Taking a defensive stance doubles your chance of blocking. With a heavy sword, it could save your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/036: That brings us near the end of the lesson. Why not venture into the cave this time? Use this sword, and remember what you've learned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/038: It's a basic heavy sword, but it can block attacks from the creatures in this island's cave. Next time, we'll cover tactics for fighting with companions and switching weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/040: You seem to have a feel for fighting alone now. But wars involve many people. In time, you'll fight alongside companions too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/041: When fighting together, it's important to divide your roles. Send a companion with a heavy sword into the enemy ranks to block attacks and draw attention, giving your other allies an opening.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/042: Meanwhile, allies with rapiers or other swords with high Attack, and those using magic or guns, can strike from the rear at the enemies distracted by the companion in front and wipe them out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/043: Won't the one charging ahead be in danger?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/044: Heavy swords have strong Defense, so it's not too dangerous unless the enemy is overwhelmingly powerful. But it's also hard to deal damage with one. To "win" the battle, you'll need your companions' help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/046: Now, equipment switching. You know you can carry two pieces of reserve equipment in addition to what you hold in your hands. During battle, you can exchange a held weapon with reserve equipment. Usually, these are "backups" in case a weapon breaks, but switching also lets you combine different roles while fighting alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/047: So I can use two or more weapons with different strengths?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/049: Exactly. Carry both a heavy sword and a rapier. Use the rapier when enemies are few or far enough away, and switch to the heavy sword when you need to close in. You can still move and attack after switching swords, which makes this very useful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/050: Rapiers are especially good for finishing off enemies once you've weakened them. And when using a heavy sword, remember that magic can be more effective than attacking with the sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/051: We've now covered ordinary attacks. All that remains is the sword's ultimate technique: special moves. Use them well, and even the strongest enemy will be no match for you. Venture deeper into the cave this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/053: Are you ready to begin your lessons?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/054: I'm ready to begin right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/055: Then I'll begin teaching you how to fight today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/056: My lessons won't solve every problem, but you mustn't neglect theory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/057: First, I'll give you an overview of the different types of swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/058: Swords fall into four types: rapiers, heavy swords, longswords, and greatswords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/059: Rapiers are light, sharp, and slender. Heavy swords are relatively short, thick, and heavy. Longswords are long and are the most common type. Greatswords are just that: long, broad, and very large.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/060: Ordinary longswords are the easiest to use, but rapiers and heavy swords are more important tactically.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/061: If you can wield one, a greatsword is the strongest type. Good greatswords, though, aren't easy to obtain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/062: Rapiers and heavy swords are tactically important because of their distinct strengths./15d Rapiers excel at offense, while heavy swords excel at defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/063: Those are the basics of sword types. I'll explain rapiers and heavy swords in more detail later. For today, we'll finish with a few simple things to remember in battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/064: First, always keep your distance from the enemy and the direction you're facing in mind./15d This applies to every fighting style, not just swordsmanship.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/065: Always watch the distance between you and your opponent, and don't show them your back./20d You might dodge a predictable attack from behind if your opponent is weaker than you. But a true swordsman enters every battle as though the opponent were stronger.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/066: A knight's code forbids the cowardly act of attacking an opponent from behind. But if survival is your priority, attacking from behind is a tactic you can't afford to overlook.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/067: Second, know the enemy's strengths and weaknesses./20d It sounds simple, but applying it properly in battle isn't easy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/068: Knowing an enemy's strengths helps you focus your defense and improves your chance of blocking. Knowing their weaknesses improves your chance of landing an attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/069: For example, mages resist magic well, so ordinary spells have trouble defeating them. Swords and bullets, however, leave them helpless. Marksmen have long range and high Attack thanks to their guns, but their Defense is little better than a mage's, and they are especially vulnerable to magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/070: Weaknesses take many other forms too. You'll need to study them as well as learn through battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/071: Remember those two points. Next time, I'll explain combat techniques in more detail.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/072: Get some practice in battle, then come back. I'll teach you about magic next.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/073: Don't push too far at first. Build up your experience a little at a time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/075: Lesson 1: Sword Types and Combat Basics
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/077: You seem to have had some experience in battle. Now I'll explain magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/078: We touched on weaknesses earlier. Learning different ways to attack is just as important as mastering a single technique.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/079: You seem to know a little magic already... What spells can you use?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/080: I know a little dark magic, taught to me by Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/081: Then you should have little trouble learning mine. I'll teach you ice magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/082: Before I teach you, let me briefly explain the magic found in this land.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/083: Magic has six main schools./15d Fire, Ice, and Lightning are known as the three elemental schools. Dark magic is said to draw on the Dark God's power, and Holy magic on the Lord God's power. Support magic is believed to derive from Holy magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/084: The three elemental schools counter one another: Fire is weak against Ice, Ice against Lightning, and Lightning against Fire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/085: Dark and Holy magic oppose each other independently of the three elements. In that matchup, the attacker has an overwhelming advantage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/086: Support magic manipulates time and space. It has no affinity relationship with the other five schools.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/087: These affinities aren't limited to spells. Other things can have them too, so be sure to remember them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/088: Monsters are a common example you'll encounter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/089: For example, attacking a Fire monster with Ice magic or an Ice weapon deals double damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/090: But a Fire attack will be absorbed as HP, healing it. Lightning won't damage it at all, so be careful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/091: Now I'll teach you ice magic. Put it to good use in battle. Our next lesson will be about rapiers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/094: This time, I'll explain sword attacks and rapiers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/095: We briefly discussed rapiers and heavy swords before, didn't we?/15d Do you remember what I said about rapiers?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/096: You said they're light swords that focus on attack, but are weak at defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/097: Exactly. They're light and easy to handle, and can strike an enemy's vital points accurately. That gives them high Attack and a high chance of critical hits./30d But they're too thin and light for defense. Often, the sword is damaged while failing to stop the attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/098: Then it might be better not to block at all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/099: In the extreme, yes./10d But their Attack is so high that a well-executed first strike can end the battle before the enemy has a chance to attack properly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/100: It's a gamble, but their Attack is excellent for the price. If you have enough money, carrying plenty and treating them as consumables is a viable tactic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/102: I'll explain switching swords in more detail later./20d For now, use the Assault Sword I gave you to practice basic rapier tactics.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/106: There are two main traditions of swordsmanship in Antalya: the Kingdom style, centered on Pendragon, and the Imperial style, centered on Geysir. The Kingdom style emphasizes speed, while the Imperial style emphasizes strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/107: Imperial special moves use brute force to break through an enemy's guard and aim for a single killing blow. Kingdom special moves overwhelm the enemy with unexpected, rapid attacks in succession.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/108: As a former scholar, you'll be better suited to the Kingdom style, which values technique over strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/109: Let's take Vacuum Shura Blade, a basic Kingdom special move, as an example.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/110: Vacuum Shura Blade and other special moves require a corresponding amount of Vigor (/2cXP/5c).
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/111: Vigor is a little like the mana used for spells, but it rises a little whenever you attack, defend, or defeat an enemy. Your Attack and Defense rise in proportion to it. Using a special move doesn't consume Vigor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/112: However, your body can't sustain maximum Vigor for long. After a certain time, it naturally dissipates.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/113: Different special moves require different amounts of Vigor. Learn the others through experience in battle. And... this is a sword I once used. It should help you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/116: That is all the theory I can teach you. The rest must come from practice in battle... Train hard, and overcome Asura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/117: I'll also give you a dagger. Don't forget to equip it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001_2: Master yourself before you try to master the sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002_2: For over a year after that, I learned Pendragon swordsmanship/nfrom her./nEoline Pendragon, one of the great swordswomen of her time, taught me the Kingdom style. I also learned many spells and techniques/nfrom her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007_2: Master one thing completely, rather than learning a little of many.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/001_3: Master yourself before you try to master the sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/002_3: For over a year after that, I learned Pendragon swordsmanship/nfrom her./nEoline Pendragon, one of the great swordswomen of her time, taught me the Kingdom style. I also learned many spells and techniques/nfrom her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo01/007_3: Master one thing completely, rather than learning a little of many.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/001: It's far more imposing than I imagined...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/002: To think... the Black Prince could control this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/007: That sword... Asura is beyond human power to control!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/008: If an ordinary person touches it, their mind and body won't withstand it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/009: Whatever happens... I need this sword's power.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s03/010: This is my will, and the will of the Dark God Deimos...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy05/000: North - Dragon Breath Mountains/nSoutheast - Pretoria Region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/002: I've come to ask a few questions about what you told me last time,/20d and about you, Deimos.../20d There are things I'd like to know.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/003: [Deimos]/nVery well. Shall we talk?/30d Let me hear your story first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/005: /2cOne by one, I began to learn how he had been sealed again, who had been responsible, and why.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/006: /2cI learned that the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War, Eustacia of Destruction and Diablo of the Moon, had sealed Deimos to carry out a plan.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/007: /2cBut I couldn't discover what that plan was./40d I could only suspect that it would do humanity no good.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/008: /2cHe was more interested in hearing my story than telling his own. But I took no pleasure in it. Whenever I thought of the past, a vague anger boiled within me, followed by the despair that overwhelmed me in those final moments...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/009: All my past holds is pain. Pain I don't want to remember...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/010: [Deimos]/nAre you afraid to learn the truth because you want to avoid the pain? Didn't you say you had nothing left to lose? What are you afraid of?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s06/011: [Deimos]/nSearch your memories. Begin with the most beautiful one, then follow it as though unwinding a single thread.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/000: Stay out of the way and go rescue the prisoners!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/001: Come on. Let's slip into the mansion through the secret passage in the village's northern corner.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/002: The secret passage is to the north of the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02b/003: Let's open the hatch to the waterway and sneak into the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/000: Lately, there have been people wearing dark glasses around here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/001: To the north is Antananarivo. It borders Bifrost, so the region is in turmoil.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/003: I hear Lady Esther Dodd comes from an old, distinguished family...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/009: Have you ever seen Irus wield a sword? He's so powerful!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/013: Lady Esther Dodd and Josephine of Bifrost are known as the two beauties of the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/015: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/017: I know Nikacha of Cerepus too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/019: Culture and romance are the true joys of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/020: I don't make secret passages everywhere as a hobby, like Ruben does.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/027: They say Kars' sword is hidden in Demon Sword Forest... But it's dangerous there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/028: There's a village called Bordeaux north of Ron. It's a beautiful place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/029: I was near Bordeaux recently and saw people passing through wearing strange glasses.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/030: There's a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux. Strange legends about it have been passed down since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/031: Now they're saying Kars' sword is hidden there... When I first heard it, I thought, "Again?"
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/032: I hear fighting between the Zephyr Falcon and local lords is growing more intense across the country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/033: Aren't the Zephyr Falcon thieves who only target the wealthy? It's terrible... letting people like that run wild. Lord Frederick keeps Ron well protected, though...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/034: Mother is away from home a lot these days. She used to make delicious food and smile so often... Now she doesn't cook or smile anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/035: It's been like this since Father was shot and killed by the Pendragon border guards. He used to trade near the Pendragon border...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/036: I want to see Mother smile. I want to see Father again. I hate Pendragon. I really hate it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/037: The forests around here are rather dangerous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/038: I'd never seen clothes, glasses, or hairstyles like theirs before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/039: With so many people desperate to find that sword, it must really be hidden there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/040: Every last one of those troublemakers obstructing our empire's reunification should be arrested!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/041: Hmph... The people here trust Lord Frederick too much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/042: He's still just a lord and a landowner. Why won't people face that fact?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/043: Things may be better here than elsewhere, but the lords still own far too much. That has to change!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/044: Young man, I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/045: Have you ever heard of Lord Kars?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/047: No, I haven't heard of him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/048: So you've heard of Lord Kars... What a fine young man. But do you know what sword he used?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/049: Awen prayed to the heavens again. "You gave me this shining gem. If you did so because you understood my feelings for him, please help me."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/050: Then, in her heart, she heard the heavens answer. "I know your wish. But saving him will require a sacrifice."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/051: She closed her eyes and replied, "God, I offer you my voice. Please let me rise to where he is."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/052: When she opened her eyes, she found herself rising into the air. While the enemies pursuing them stood frozen in astonishment, she ascended to Al.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/053: When she reached him, Al said, "Oh, kind stranger. You seem to be from my homeland, but you needn't risk your life just to save me. Leave me here and save yourself."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/054: Awen wanted to answer, but no sound came. Silently, she tried to free him from his chains. Yet they were so strong that even she could find no way to undo them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/055: Awen saw the enemy below setting up a ladder and climbing toward them. Growing desperate, she placed her sword against Al's arm. There was no way to free him without cutting it off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/056: Al nodded. "Cut it off. It seems there's no other way." With tears in her eyes, Awen cut off his arm. The shock made him lose consciousness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/057: Awen had freed Al from the chains, but there was no way down. The enemy was climbing the cliff on ladders. She had to pray to the heavens once more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/058: "O heavens, merciful heavens! I will give him this gem. Protect him, as you granted my first wish. I offer you my life. Please, let him escape this place."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/059: She placed the gem on Al's chest, ran to the edge of the cliff, and leaped! As she fell, the cold gem against his chest woke him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/060: In that instant, Al saw her headband come loose, her hair shining like morning sunlight above skin as pale as morning mist. It was Awen, whom he longed for even in his dreams, giving her life for him... "Awen!" he cried. But she gave no answer, only falling farther and farther below.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/061: Then everyone there heard God's voice. "I know your love for Al. I will take your life and transform it into new life. Go and save him."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/062: Al saw the gem on his chest shine so brightly that he had to close his eyes. When he opened them again, an enormous, unfamiliar bird stood before him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/063: Al gazed into the bird's eyes. "Awen... Awen, is that you?" As though answering, it leaned forward. He climbed onto its back, and the bird took flight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/064: The people of Al's hometown were shocked that he had returned with one arm missing, but even more astonished by the strange bird with him. After his return, he became quiet, built a hut in a remote place, and lived with the bird, devoting himself to working stone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/065: Al spent his life trying to recreate the gem that had been placed on his chest. At last, he developed a new kind of gem: the Chaos Cube. After his return, brave, enormous birds like the one that saved him began appearing across the land. People called them falcons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/066: Did you enjoy the story? Thank you for listening to such a long tale. Let me give you a reward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/068: May Al and Awen bless the journey ahead of you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/069: - Geysir Academy, Ron Branch -/nWe have answers to your questions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/070: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nPrices in Ron City are rather high, but its strong army and well-maintained public order make it a very stable place to live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/071: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nDemon Sword Forest lies north of Ron, with Bordeaux Village farther north. Despite its name, the forest is easy to cross if you keep heading straight north toward Bordeaux. Turn east toward the magic sword, though, and you'll enter a much more complicated part of the forest...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/072: [Member of the Tactics Research Association]/nThe situation is becoming urgent. Sudden changes leave little time to maintain your weapons, so wouldn't it be wise to stock up on as much equipment as you can?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/073: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nWe once had a member named Paz. He was an excellent swordsman, known as 'Paz the Swift'...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/074: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nBut he was even more famous as a master of sword repair. No one could match him at maintaining or repairing blades.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/075: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHave you heard of Pendragon's standard-issue swords? They say the SP-7 "Blitz" is excellent... on a par with a mass-produced holy sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/076: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon has two renowned swordmaking houses. One is the famous Chrysaor; the other is Moglai, less well known in the empire. Moglai is said to be secretly developing a standard-issue sword to rival Chrysaor's "Blitz."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/077: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nWhich will be better: "Blitz" or Moglai's rival sword? Unfortunately, the Pendragon royal family's orders make these standard-issue swords very hard to obtain. Security is so strict that outsiders can't take them out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/078: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHis one fault was that he often coveted swords too much. We haven't heard from him since he was last seen near Antananarivo. I wonder what he's doing now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/030_3: There's a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux. Strange legends about it have been passed down since ancient times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/031_3: Now they're saying Kars' sword is hidden there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/032_3: I hear Lord Frederick recently attacked the Zephyr Falcon, who are active across the country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/033_3: I hear the Zephyr Falcon are thieves who only target the wealthy. Is that true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/034_3: Mother is away from home a lot these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/035_3: They say Father went to heaven three years ago. Mother hasn't smiled since.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02/036_3: I want to see Mother smile.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/000: When Sid returned, he briefly regained consciousness. He said he had a message for you, young master, and told me this:
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/002: He must have been having a nightmare. That's how deeply he cares for you, young master. What a good lad...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/003: Sid was extremely agitated just before he was kidnapped. He seemed angry too... He said he'd discovered something extraordinary...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/004: He said he'd tell me once he had conclusive evidence. But he was kidnapped that very day and is still in a coma.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/006: Sid is my age, but he knows so much. He does have an unrealistic dream, though.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/007: He dreams of becoming a scholar at the Imperial Academy, like Cyrano. Hah... Someone of his station.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/008: Perhaps his curiosity is what got him into danger this time. Sid always likes to uncover secrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/002_3: He must have been having a nightmare. That's how deeply he cares for you, young master. What a good lad...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/007_3: He dreams of becoming an imperial scholar, like Cyrano. Hah... Someone of his station.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber11/008_3: Perhaps his curiosity is what got him into danger this time. He's always trying to uncover secrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin03b/001: Something about this place gives me a bad feeling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/000: This is Caracas, a village on the edge of the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/001: Do you know General Kars? He was the empire's greatest swordsman... He's my idol.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/002: I hear General Kars' sword is still hidden somewhere.../20d Giga.../10d something.../10d deth...?/15d Whatever it's called, it's a frightening name.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/004: They say General Kars used an incredible special move... Even its name is impressive./20d Heaven and Earth... What was that other part?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/005: Have you met Karg, the chef at the tavern? He's eccentric, but I'd say his cooking is the best in the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/006: Caracas borders quite a few regions. The roads around here are well signposted too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/007: Many travelers stop here on their way elsewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/009: Have you been to one of Sharon's performances? Everything about her is wonderful, just wonderful!/15d I'm such a fan!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/010: ...I'm no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/011: Well... Their cause matched my ideals, but it was too dangerous... I was afraid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/012: Did you know there's a passage to a strange cave inside the Zephyr Falcon headquarters?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/013: Many say the empire's greatest swordsman was His Majesty the Black Prince. But simply calling him a swordsman seems.../30d If we're judging swordsmanship alone, it has to be General Kars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/014: One day, I'll go to Demon Sword Forest and pull out that legendary sword... the one General Kars used.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/015: They say Gigadeth, the sword General Kars used, is embedded in Demon Sword Forest near Bordeaux.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/016: However, I have yet to meet anyone who has actually seen that sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/017: People tend to think of Sharon as just an idol singer...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/018: In fact, Sharon has an incredible singing voice. It's just that her other charms shine even more brightly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/019: Sharon is always traveling... I don't know where she is now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/020: I doubt anyone knows the forests around here better than I do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/021: I found a beautiful mushroom deep in a cave not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/025: Isn't it beautiful? It looks and smells so wonderful that it seems a shame to eat it. I wonder how Karg would cook it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/026: Would you take this mushroom to Karg? I believe a mushroom this precious deserves a good chef.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/027: Oh... I haven't seen you before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/028: Do you know a plant called Love Herb? Its flowers are said to bloom only where true love has blossomed. Its wonderful fragrance makes it a prized cooking ingredient.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/029: Oh... I can sense the desert on you. Have you passed through it recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/030: It's best to avoid crossing the desert if you can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/031: They say it's important to believe you're on the right path when you're in the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/032: Trust people too easily and you'll get badly hurt!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/033: When I served in an imperial army unit directly under His Majesty the Black Prince, I attended General Kars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/034: The story that his sword lies buried in a forest near Ron is well known./30d Whether it's true, I couldn't say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/036: Heh... A passing traveler recently told me someone found Love Herb near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/037: Heh... I absolutely can't tell you that person lives in Pretoria. Wouldn't Chef Karg be pleased?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/038: My grandson is so frail. I'm terribly worried.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/039: Isn't there anything that could improve the boy's health? Anything at all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/040: Isn't this Higashi? It's famous as a cooking spice, but just as well known as a restorative tonic!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/041: Would you sell this to me? It should make a good tonic for my grandson. I'll pay you generously.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/042: Well, since it's for your grandson... I'll give it to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/043: I'm sorry. Someone else asked me to bring this to them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/044: There are many caves in the mountains near Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/045: The caves near Pretoria are no ordinary caves...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/046: It's an open secret that a legendary spear is buried there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/048: My father isn't here. I don't remember him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/049: I'd like to see Father, even just once...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/051: She said she could no longer live here, so she took the children away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/052: She sends letters sometimes, but I miss her and the children terribly. I'm thinking of following them once I've settled things here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/053: Shh! I'm an assassin on a mission. I can't tell you who my target is... Heh heh heh.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/054: It's hard to make a living these days, even in this line of work... You need demand, after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/055: Want some useful information? Ruben's men are cowards. They attack whoever has the lowest HP first. Heh heh.../30d That's how our companions fell, so it's probably accurate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/056: Did you know Ruben's men attack weakened enemies first?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/060: Swords fall into four main types: rapiers, longswords, heavy swords, and greatswords. Rather than the old classification by "size," we classify them by their performance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/061: Rapiers have long, slender blades, very high Attack, a low price, and a high Critical Rate. But their Defense and Block Rate are low, their Weapon Limit is extremely low, and they have only 1 weapon HP, so they break easily. That makes them expensive to maintain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/062: Rapiers include Stiletto, Saber, Rapier, Estoc, Cassandra, and Gramr. They suit those who prioritize Attack, but at a low level, their poor Defense could put your life at risk.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/063: Heavy swords are large, broad blades with low Attack and Hit Rate, but high Defense, Block Rate, weapon HP, and Weapon Limit. That gives them a great advantage in defense.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/064: A character carrying a heavy sword gains high Defense and Block Rate. These swords don't break easily either, which saves money. Their low Attack, however, means battles last longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/065: Heavy swords include Gladius, Swordbreaker, Heavy Sword, Chrysaor Girium, and Bastard Sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/066: Longswords are ordinary swords whose performance falls between heavy swords and rapiers. They are well balanced, but lack distinctive strengths, so famous swordsmen tend not to use them. Such fighters seek a style of their own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/067: Greatswords are also known as "holy swords." They include Great Sword, Durandal, and Claymore: legendary blades with high Attack and Defense, but very high prices. Many can't even be bought on the market.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/068: Our Swordsmanship Research Association collects, buys, and sells swords from across the land. Would you like to browse? All proceeds go toward our research.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/069: Swordsmanship Research Association Shop, Geysir Academy
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/070: Goodbye. If you find any fine swords, please sell them to us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/071: - Swordsmanship Research Association, Geysir Academy, Caracas Branch -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/072: There's an Imperial Geographical Society branch in Pretoria. You can learn a great deal about geography there. Pay it a visit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/073: Place fighters with defensive heavy swords in front as a barrier, use offensive rapiers to strike from a distance, and have those behind provide support with magic and guns. This is the strongest tactic currently known./n- Tactical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/074: Magic is the ultimate form of attack. Those who can use it should develop their skills to the utmost, for offense is the best defense./n- Head of Offensive Magic, Magic Research Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/075: Some swords have affinities. The Dark Sword has a Dark affinity, and the Silver Sword a Light affinity. The Flaming Sword, Thunder Sword, and Icy Sword have Fire, Lightning, and Water affinities, respectively.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/076: Have you heard of Stardust, the sword we've just acquired?/nMade entirely of diamond, it's the ultimate defensive sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/077: Depending on the enemy, these affinities can be a great advantage or a serious drawback for a sword...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/078: The so-called "holy swords" in particular tend to have affinities of their own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/079: Its unique special move, "Stardust," scatters fragments of the sword itself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/080: Since it's made of diamond rather than metal, it has only 1 weapon HP, but it probably will never break. It's the very sword our legendary member Paz searched so long for...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/002_3: I hear General Kars' sword is still hidden somewhere...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/004_3: An underground waterway connects to the northern outskirts of this village. Once you enter, there's no way out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/005_3: Have you met Karg, the chef at the tavern? He's eccentric, but I'd say his cooking is the best in the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/006_3: Caracas borders quite a few regions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/007_3: Many travelers stop here on their way elsewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/009_3: Have you been to one of Sharon's performances? Everything about her is wonderful, just wonderful! I'm such a fan!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/010_3: ...I'm no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/011_3: Well... Their cause matched my ideals, but it was too dangerous... I was afraid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/012_3: Did you know there's a passage to a strange cave inside our headquarters?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/013_3: I'm training hard with the sword so I can be like General Kars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/014_3: One day, I'll go to Demon Sword Forest and pull out that legendary sword... the one Kars used.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/016_3: But I haven't heard of anyone actually pulling the sword out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/018_3: In fact, she has an incredible singing voice. It's just that her other charms shine even more brightly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/019_3: She's always traveling... I don't know where she is now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/020_3: I doubt anyone knows the forests around here better than I do.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/034_3: It's an old legend that Kars' sword lies buried in a forest near Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/044_3: The cave where the Zephyr Falcon are based hides many secrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/046_3: It's an open secret that a legendary spear is buried there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/048_3: My father isn't here. I don't remember him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/051_3: She said she could no longer live here, so she took the children away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/054_3: It's hard to make a living these days, even in this line of work... You need demand, after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka02/055_3: Want some useful information? Ruben's men are cowards. They attack whoever has the lowest HP first. Heh heh... That's how our companions fell, so it's probably accurate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/001: It's time for us to say goodbye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/002: Thank you for everything you've done.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/003: There's no need to thank me./nFate brought all this about...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/004: Before you go, take this cloak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/005: I will never forget this kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/007: Have we perhaps... met before, long ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/008: Why do you ask so suddenly?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/010: It was the cloak he wore./nWill you treasure it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/011: Well... I'm not sure how to explain it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/012: For some reason... I often feel as though I've met you many times before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/014: I'm sorry for bringing up something so strange out of nowhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/016: Bloodthirsty revenge will only lead to your own destruction.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/017: I believe you can break free of revenge's hold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/018: But I can never forgive them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/019: Whatever happens, they must pay for their crimes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/021: Sometimes, along with the feeling of my blood growing hot...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/023: Thank you for everything you've done.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/026: I will never forget this kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/027: Then take care on your journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/029: Have we perhaps... met before, long ago?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/030: Well... I'm not sure how to explain it...

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/033: I'm sorry for bringing up something so strange out of nowhere.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/036: Whatever happens, they must pay for their crimes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/038: I'm sorry for bringing up something so strange out of nowhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/039: Thank you./10d/nWith your help... I was able to obtain Asura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/040: Now that Asura has accepted you as its master, you can use its power. However...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/041: You can only summon it when your Vigor reaches its maximum.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/042: Even then, you can use it for only a very short time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/043: And at your current level, you can't use "Asura: Sky-Shattering Dance," the technique the Black Prince once wielded.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/044: You'll probably need much more training.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/045: In the end, the Black Prince reached a new level beyond "Asura: Sky-Shattering Dance," but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s01/046: Whether you can reach such a level, I can't say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/001: W-well... Congratulations on your engagement, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/002: Oh... Congratulations on your engagement, Cyrano. You'll be getting married soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/003: Hee hee... When you marry, I'll make a special meal for the newlyweds. Look forward to it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/004: I'll make a special meal with some very fine ingredients. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/005: Oh! Congratulations on your engagement, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/006: You'll need to get some exercise now, Cyrano. You ought to build up your stamina, wouldn't you say?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/007: Would you like me to recommend a club I know well?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/008: Heh heh... I hear you're getting engaged. What a wonderful time of life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/009: No nagging wife yet, and you're dreaming of the sweet days ahead as newlyweds...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/010: Surely this is the happiest time of your life. Enjoy it to the fullest. Once youth has passed, it never returns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/004_3: I'll make you a special meal with some very fine ingredients, to keep you two blissfully in love. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/006_3: Heh heh... You'll need to get some exercise now, Cyrano. You ought to build up your stamina, wouldn't you say?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/007_3: Would you like me to recommend a fitness club I know well?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/009_3: No nagging wife yet, and you're dreaming of the sweet days ahead as newlyweds...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber10/010_3: Surely this is the happiest time of your life. Enjoy it to the fullest. Once youth has passed, it never returns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/000: Oh, dear! They say beauties die young... What if I don't live very long?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/001: To go to Geysir City from here, you must cross the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/002: The desert is terrible for my skin, so I can't go to Geysir. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/004: A little rain now and then would be nice... Why is the weather always the same?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/005: Ah... Look at that brilliant blue sky and the billowing clouds. The sky is as clear as Ron's Meteor Sword. It moves me to tears.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/006: Cerepus receives news from both the empire and Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/007: The Granada trading company is especially famous for its wide range of goods.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/008: They sometimes bring in unusual items too, but I hear those aren't sold in the shop. You'll have to obtain them another way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/009: It's been a long time since I last visited Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/010: That's Granada behind us, the largest shop in the empire. It's enormous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/011: They say there's nothing Granada doesn't have. But that can mean "many things."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/012: I saw a very beautiful young woman a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/013: Blue hair, blue eyes, fair skin...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/014: It was like seeing a photo of a younger Ruth, the one at the tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/015: Huh? There's a strange mist above your head...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/016: It looks as though bad luck is hanging over you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/017: If you want to rid yourself of that bad luck, go to Ron. A strange old fortune-teller said to live there can read your fortune.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/018: Have you heard the legend of Treasure Island? They say the legendary pirate Kidd hid his treasure there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/019: They say the gems buried there are beyond imagining. If only I could get there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/020: I hate port cities like this. So vulgar and disorderly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/021: I have a friend who moved to Libreville and wrote that it's a great place to live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/022: If Ruth, the woman at the tavern, became mayor, could our city be as pleasant to live in as Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/023: I hear a band of thieves called the Zephyr Falcon is causing trouble inland. Is that true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/024: Life is hard enough already... It's worrying.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/025: If Ruth from this tavern became mayor, would the city be safer?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/026: My friend Jane is in an inland village called Caracas now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/027: Her mother is a hunter, so Jane was always on her own. I wonder how she's doing now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/029: I once went to a place called Ron with my father.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/030: It was a long way... On the journey, I went into a strange cave in the forest near Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/031: I couldn't explore beyond a certain point. Next time I go, I'll explore the rest...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/032: I was sick last week, so I couldn't go on the outing to the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/033: Another child told me John had planned to tell me how he felt there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/034: It's so frustrating! What a terrible shame!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/035: Such clear skies. In weather like this, even sailing to Storm Island should be no trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/036: You've heard the legend of Storm Island, haven't you? Whoever pulls out the sword Asura embedded there can become ruler of the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/037: But the currents around Storm Island are strong, and the weather changes so sharply that it's difficult to approach.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/038: To reach Storm Island, you must either sail your own boat or take Pendragon's ferry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/039: Pendragon's ferry? Why, of course it's carrying supplies sent by King Rashid!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/040: Legend says that if you sail beyond Storm Island, you'll find a route to Treasure Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/041: I have a friend named Paz. If you find him, he'll be a great help to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/042: He used to be a swordsman, but he's even better at repairing swords than wielding them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/043: You look like swordsmen yourselves, so...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/044: Cerepus can only grow so much while the sea routes remain unsafe. It's a real problem...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/046: This is the best tavern in Cerepus!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/047: Our drinks are so good that even those Tuer folk never forget this place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/048: Not one of those sailors has any decency! They all keep sneaking looks at me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/049: Hmph... Still, at least they recognize beauty when they see it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/053: Please stay with us next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/055: I'm planning a journey through Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/056: The woman staying in the next room sets my heart aflutter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/057: All sorts of people gather here in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/058: Our inn is no different. All kinds of guests come and go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/059: My husband and I own this inn.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/061: Father has stepped away from the shop, so we're looking after it for him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/062: We know all the prices, so don't worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/063: Cerepus has had a famous thieves' guild for generations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/064: When everyone is struggling, as they are now, even the thieves' guild has a hard time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/065: We're Tommy and Tuppence, a married couple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/066: We are on a special mission for the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/067: We're posing as a married couple for a special mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/069: As a couple, we got an early start in business. Now we've even managed to rent space in Amigo Department Store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/070: Hmph... However clever they think they are, this shop was started with my money.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/071: Hmph. However clever they think they are, this shop was started with my capital.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/072: It took a great deal of effort to get this far.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/073: Along the way, we happened to meet an eccentric near Dragon's Lair in Geysir Forest, and managed to earn the money to start our business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/074: What's our special mission? That's a se-cret.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/075: After working on missions together for so long, I came to love him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/076: Our mission is secret. We can't tell you about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/077: After working on the same mission together for so long, I gradually fell for her. We couldn't even work well together at first...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/079: If you're having trouble with anything, leave it to us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/080: How do we know so much? We're Tommy and Tuppence, private detectives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/081: My father and Tommy are very close.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/082: But really, I built this inn almost entirely by myself. My foolish husband did little more than open and close the doors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/083: He doesn't realize that, of course. He thinks he's quite something. Still, it does me no harm to let him believe it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/084: Our employer is a strange man. His wife actually runs the inn, but he's the one who puts on airs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/085: This is my first visit to Cerepus too, but I've never seen such a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/086: If I miss this chance, I may never get another! I'll boldly approach my goddess and win her love! Wait for me, my love!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/087: The young man staying next door seems rather appealing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/088: Once this journey is over, I don't intend to return to the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/089: What's the best way to bring those women down a peg? Money? Fame? A handsome face?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/090: In the end, what touches a woman's heart is a small, sincere gesture. How can I show my beloved that kind of care?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/091: Someone like Ruth over there should become mayor and lock up all those men who think of nothing but that!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/092: The secret to good drinks is dedication. The willingness to sacrifice everything to make the best!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/093: If we want peace in the port, we must put limits on the unrestricted free-trade zone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/094: Too much freedom makes people foolish.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/095: I am Charles, the current mayor of Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/096: I have no intention of surrendering my office to a youngster like Ruth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/097: Are you Charles de Benarize, the current mayor of Cerepus?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/098: [Mayor Charles]/nI am. What do you want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/099: I've come to ask when the ban on ships sailing to Dakama will be lifted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/100: [Mayor Charles]/nHeh... When will the sailing ban be lifted? That route is far too dangerous. I think the ban will have to stay for a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/101: But unless you intend to close the route permanently, ships will have to sail again someday...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/102: [Mayor Charles]/nClose the route? What a fine idea! They say Dakama Port's economy is the worst it's been since the war. We have nothing to gain by trading with them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/103: [Mayor Charles]/nBe off! I have nothing more to say about that route!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/104: [Ruth]/nFor the revival of the Geysir Empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/105: Um... Excuse me, do you know a person named Ruth?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/108: [Ruth]/nHee hee... This must be your first visit to Cerepus. People who meet me for the first time are surprised that I'm a woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/109: [Ruth]/nWhat did you want to see me about?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/110: As you know, ships are banned from sailing to Dakama. I have an urgent reason to go there. Is there any way to lift the ban?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/111: [Ruth]/nOh... What do you mean? I'm only a candidate for mayor. I don't have that authority.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/112: But the townspeople told me you could help. Please, help me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/113: [Ruth]/nWell... Why are you so determined to go to Dakama? You don't seem to be a merchant...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/118: The truth is, I intend to go to Storm Island and pull out the sword Asura. To do that, I must reach Dakama first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/119: [Ruth]/nYou mean to pull out Asura on Storm Island? Are you another person chasing hollow fame through the sword's power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/120: No. It's true that I need the sword's power, but I'm certainly not after empty fame. Absolutely not!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/121: [Ruth]/nIf fame isn't your aim, why would you take such a risk?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/123: [Ruth]/nThat's quite a story. But are you sure you should be telling me all this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/124: Well... I received a letter saying my mother in Dakama is gravely ill and that I should come at once...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/125: [Ruth]/nHa ha ha! What an obvious lie! It's written all over your face. How am I supposed to trust you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/126: [Ruth]/nI dislike dishonest people. Excuse me, would you step aside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/127: Ruth, please give me one more chance. I have to reach Dakama.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/128: [Ruth]/nI'm sorry. I refuse to deal with liars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/129: Strangely, I wanted to tell you everything. I felt I could trust you with it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/130: [Ruth]/nVery well... Since you've trusted me, I should return that trust. I'll do what I can. Go to the docks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/133: Very well. I'll tell you the truth. I...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/134: [Ruth]/nI see... But are you sure you should have told me that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/135: I thought it was all right. Above all, I felt I could tell you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/136: [Ruth]/nThough you didn't at first, did you? Hee hee... Very well. I'll do what I can. Come to the docks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/138: [Ruth]/nUnlike a certain young gentleman, I tell only the truth. Until then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/142: Thank you very much for your patronage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/146: Does anyone live in this house...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/147: I can't give up yet. I have to reach Dakama.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/148: Finding Ruth seems to be my only option.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/149: Is that the mayor's residence? Mayor Charles should be there now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/150: Ruth, who's usually at the tavern, once spoke of Treasure Island too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/012_2: I saw a very beautiful young woman a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/014_2: When I grow up, I want to be beautiful like her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/022_2: Her family was a little unusual... If you visit Libreville, would you give her my regards?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/025_2: The nobles have so much money. Don't they ever think about keeping people safe?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/053_2: If you're not going to stay, why even ask?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/091_2: Really, beauty like mine is wasted serving people in a place like this. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/125_2: Ha ha ha! What an obvious lie! It's written all over your face. How am I supposed to trust you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/126_2: [Ruth]/nI dislike dishonest people. Excuse me, would you step aside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/012_3: I saw a very beautiful young woman a few days ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/014_3: When I grow up, I want to be beautiful like her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/022_3: Her family was a little unusual... If you visit Libreville, would you give her my regards?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/025_3: The nobles have so much money. Don't they ever think about keeping people safe?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/053_3: If you're not going to stay, why even ask?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/091_3: Really, beauty like mine is wasted serving people in a place like this. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/125_3: Ha ha ha! What an obvious lie! It's written all over your face. How am I supposed to trust you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy03/126_3: [Ruth]/nI dislike dishonest people. Excuse me, would you step aside?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/000: [Kana]/nYou've gone too far, Cyrano! How could you kill even little Christina without a moment's hesitation...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/001: [Esmeralda]/nEven when you killed Esther Dodd so brutally... I could understand.../30d But Christina was the child of the woman you loved...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/002: [Silver]/nYou're being unfair! Are you saying we should have hesitated, even a little?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/003: [Silver]/nYou know we were facing the God of Destruction! We had no choice!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/004: [Clausewitz]/nCyrano, this has shaken my faith in you. To kill Frederick and his wife's only daughter with your own hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/008: If you're so displeased, you can stop following me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/010: You've gone too far. We gave up two captains for your sake. How can you speak so irresponsibly...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/011: Let me make this clear: anyone who questions my actions again will be eliminated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/014: Esmeralda seems to think I've acted wrongly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/015: I'm sorry. It seems we've driven you to this point./50d I was at fault.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/016: But we have a cause to uphold. Your actions go against the Zephyr Falcon's ideals.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/017: From now on, the Zephyr Falcon will act independently of you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/018: Cyrano... There's nothing more I can do... I can't trust you anymore either...
