Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/019: I never asked anyone to trust me. Human trust is only an obstacle on my path to revenge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/020: You all heard that. We have no need of dissenters. Well? Does anyone still wish to follow us?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s01/023: Enough, Silver. There's no reason to delay any longer. We must hurry after Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga21a/000: This way leads to Ron./nNicosia lies to the southeast.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/001: As I thought. It's Ascalon, Bifrost's first-class magic machine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/002: Ascalon? You mean... the legendary magic machine...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/003: We have to fight that monster...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/004: Don't worry, Meditch./30d However legendary a magic machine's power may be, it can't reach its full potential if its pilot lacks the ability.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/005: Its pilot must be Catalina, said to be Bifrost's strongest warrior. But she's a Valkyrie by training./30d She's never piloted a magic machine before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/006: That should make it an opponent we can hold out against./30d Besides...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21a/002_3: That machine is the legendary Ascalon...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/000: Ruben's mother had long enjoyed the master's favor...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/001: Come to think of it, the former mistress was such a kind woman... Even knowing about that...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/002: Oh, dear... What a loose tongue I have. Hee hee hee...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/003: You know Sid, Jean's son? They say he was kidnapped while returning from a neighboring village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/004: The police found him three days after the kidnapping and brought him back. But the strange thing is, the kidnappers never contacted anyone during those three days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/005: Isn't it strange? Sid was definitely kidnapped, so why didn't the kidnappers make any demands?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber06/005_3: Isn't it strange? Sid was definitely kidnapped, so why didn't the kidnappers ever contact anyone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka17a/000: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka17a/003: << Geysir City >>/nYou are entering Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka09a/000: Northeast - Libreville Region/nNorthwest - Pretoria Region/nSouth - Geysir City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka09a/001: Libreville, our destination, lies northeast of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/000: Cyrano will reach this place soon./40d You should take refuge at once...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/001: That no longer matters. I've already achieved what I planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/003: Exactly./30d/nNow that the monster Cyrano has pursued me all the way here, the Bifrost court must realize he threatens them too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/004: Wait a little longer, and the lords of the imperial territories, the Zephyr Falcon, and even Bifrost will join forces to eliminate Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/005: But Your Eminence, shouldn't you still protect yourself? Otherwise, how will you lead the unified empire in the future...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/006: Heh heh... Do you think Cyrano can kill me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/007: My sword will find out whether you're immortal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/008: Heh heh... Such remarkable obsession. In that respect, you almost remind me of myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/009: Don't compare me to the likes of you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/010: Heh heh... Aren't you more vicious than I am now? You've even killed your former companions with your own hands./40d At least I've never dirtied mine myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/011: I have no wish to prolong this conversation./30d All I want is your life./30d That will be enough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/012: You dare demand my life, Cyrano?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/013: I am both a god and the hero who will unite the empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/014: At last... I've killed Cesare... At last...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/017: I'm glad I could give Grandfather true peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/018: Now... Father and Mother can rest in peace, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/020: Come to think of it, where's that fellow Machiavelli?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/021: I'm here. Don't worry, I won't run.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/023: You've got some nerve. Were you watching the whole time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/024: I was the one who let him go, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/026: Who are you, really?/30d Is Clausewitz even your real name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/029: I do have much to explain to you all. But my grandfather is waiting for us. Please come with me for now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/030: He only wishes to leave his judgment of Cesare and ourselves to posterity through his ideas. Nothing more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/031: No, I don't care what happens to him anymore. What concerns me is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s03/032: The God of Destruction's power has given me a divine body./30d In other words, I'm immortal!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri12/000: At last, we've found the Thunder Nightmare's lair!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/002: Leave the center, where Christina is, untouched! Attack the parts it's using to strike at us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/003: We did it!! We've destroyed every part it can attack with!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/008: [Mercedes]/nWith my own life, I beg you... Awaken, Christina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/011: [Cyrano]/nHow... How could you do something so foolish...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy... Why are you apologizing to me, Mercedes...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/020: Even at the end... all I do... is stand... in your way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/023: Cyrano!! The God of Destruction is moving again!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s05/024: ...Persistent wretch! This time I'll finish you for good!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/000: The famous Zephyr Falcon have their base in the mountains north of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/001: Esmeralda, the famous doctor, lives in our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/002: This is a mountain village on the western side of the imperial territory of Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/006: Yes, that's right./nMy hometown is near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/007: I didn't expect Kana to be a girl from the south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/008: Southern girls are usually so demure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/010: Anyway, the Church fortress is to the right of the village./nWe should probably be careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/014: I hate it when the priests come down here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/015: Mother always locks me inside on those days. She says I might be taken away if I go out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/017: I've been ill since I was little, so I've had to stay at home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/018: Mother always looks sad when she sees me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/020: We definitely agreed to meet Rodriguez somewhere around here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/021: Our village belongs to the Church's territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/023: I've traveled to many places, but however much I dislike the priests, there's no place like home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/025: [Sharon]/nI'm sick of it. I don't want to sing anymore. Truly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/026: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome. A night at our inn costs 90 Eld. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/027: Thank you. Have a restful night.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/028: Please stay with us next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/029: Thank you for your custom. Do stay with us again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/030: Our tavern serves only the finest drinks and food, made with the best ingredients.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/031: Heh heh heh... The landlady is kind and a fine cook. That's why I come here so often.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/032: [Sharon]/nSharon... Yes, that's my name. But I'm no longer a singer, so you can't call me "Sharon the singer" anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/034: [Sharon]/nAn autograph... Why are people so desperate for famous people's signatures? I don't understand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/035: Could you be Sharon, the singer?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/036: [Uncle Shen] Is there anything you need?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/038: Thank you for visiting. See you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/039: They say there's no place like home, don't they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/040: Did you know it no longer rains or snows in the Geysir territories?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/041: It snowed once fifteen years ago, but not since.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/042: Yet the rivers keep flowing. Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/044: After every argument, they ask me who's right. It's so upsetting...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/045: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/046: [Sharon]/nWherever I go, people see the singer Sharon, not me. Autographs are no different. All they want is Sharon singing and dancing on stage!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/047: ...Yes. That's what people want./30d But.../20d But don't you realize how fortunate you are that people want something from you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/048: Wherever you go, you can find people who need you and cherish you. That someone wants something from you, especially the joy you bring them... Isn't that a blessing from God?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/049: [Sharon]/n...People who need me... Yes. There are people like that...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/050: [Sharon]/nYes. I'm Sharon, Sharon Indricka. The people's idol. The enchantress of the stage. That's who I am.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/051: [Sharon]/nYou... wanted my autograph, didn't you? I'll give it to you. Let me have your autograph book...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/053: Thank you so much. The little girl who asked for your autograph will be delighted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/054: [Sharon]/nYes... I need my fans, and they need me... I should be thanking you. Goodbye, then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/055: [Sharon]/nYes... I'm Sharon, the "Sharon" named by those who love my songs. I'll find a little more courage and try again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/026_3: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome. A night at our inn costs 90 Gold. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/032_3: [Sharon]/nAn autograph? Have you come to pester me too? Please, leave me alone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/033_3: No. We only wanted to bring you the request of a girl who longs for your autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/034_3: [Sharon]/n...Is that so...? Then I'll give you my autograph.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltni01/035_3: Sharon? Excuse me, could we have your autograph?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcprh2/000: We can't go down this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/000: Father... Please, spare Christina at least...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/001: This is all for our cause. Don't interfere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/002: Besides, it's too late to stop the unsealing ritual. Interfere now, and you'll only endanger Christina's life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/004: Cesare! Step away from the seal!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/005: Well, if it isn't the rebel leader Meditch and his followers!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/007: Heh heh heh... Very well. I'll play with you a little to pass the time until the God of Destruction is resurrected.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/008: Meditch, we have to take control of that seal first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/010: No!! If you touch Christina now...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/011: Who are you?! Get out of the way!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/017: Hmph. Are you trying to get in Meditch's way again?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/018: Mercedes... You did this to Mercedes...!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/026: No! The God of Destruction's resurrection has begun!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/027: Who cares about some God of Destruction...? Let it come!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/029: Oh, you've won, Cyrano? You really are the strongest swordsman!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/031: I won't forgive you either! If you hadn't put Meditch up to it, Mercedes wouldn't have died!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/037: Cesare! Cesare!!/30d This is all your fault!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/038: Diablo! Cesare!! I'll destroy you all!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/039: Heh heh... You're descending into madness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s02/110: Yes, I've wanted to settle things with you for a long time! Prepare yourself, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/000: Congratulations, General Frederick./30d Without your skillful command, today's victory would not have been possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/001: Ha ha! I know this victory wasn't simply the result of my strategy or that of our adviser Clausewitz.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/002: Wasn't it our united strength that made today's victory possible?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/004: True, but this campaign will go down in imperial history as a success. Surely we have every reason to celebrate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/005: Speaking of which, where is the hero of this battle? The knight in the gray cloak, I mean. I'd like a drink with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/007: An error by the rear guard briefly broke our line, but his success in cutting the enemy's supplies restored the situation, didn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/009: Cyrano, come over and join everyone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/012: Leave him be. There's something he wants to do now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/014: Cyrano, you worked hard today./40d I'd like to raise a toast to the hero of this battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/015: ...That wouldn't be a bad idea./20d But there's something I want to do before we drink together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/017: General Alfred Frederick, I challenge you to a duel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/021: Where did that come from, Cyrano?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/022: Ha ha ha, please don't./30d/nI'm hardly skilled enough with a sword to face the finest swordsman in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/023: You seem to have misunderstood me./30d I'm not asking for a friendly sword match. I want your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/025: ...This is awkward./30d I don't know what grudge you bear me, but we're at a banquet celebrating our allied army's victory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/026: Even if I were to accept your challenge, I couldn't do it here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/027: Tomorrow morning, just before dawn. On the peak behind this valley. Come alone, of course.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/028: I trust you won't be late.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/029: What insolence! I won't accept a challenge imposed on me like that!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/030: A challenge imposed on you? You killed an innocent opponent in the name of a duel, yet you won't accept one yourself?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/032: Our general would never do such a thing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/034: Cyrano, please apologize to the general and withdraw your challenge!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/036: If you insist, very well. I accept your challenge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/037: But I'm certainly not accepting because your accusations are true.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/038: I accept only to prove that I have nothing to be ashamed of in anything I've done!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/041: I'm sorry, adviser. My actions will disrupt this alliance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/042: No. I believe you must have a reason for this, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/043: There must be circumstances you can't tell us about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/044: We'll trust that there are. You won't let us down, will you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/047: No, please take me with you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/048: Frederick will certainly come alone. If his sword defeats me and my life is in danger, can you promise not to intervene?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s01/050: I'm willing to die fighting him. But there is something I must bring to light, so I want a fair duel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/003: [Organization Member]/nHeh heh heh... Sorry, but we'll be taking that sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/004: [Organization Member]/nThat's the demon sword of Kars, the legendary swordsman!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwsw16/005: [Organization Member]/nIt's the sword "that person" has been searching so desperately for.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/002: We'll slip in through the secret passage as planned and rescue our prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/004: We've already begun engaging the enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/005: Everything is proceeding as Clausewitz predicted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/006: Good!/10d We'll use the enemy's confusion to infiltrate the fortress and rescue our prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/007: Zephyr Falcon, First Unit! Begin the operation!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s01/008: An impregnable fortress and a prison from which escape is said to be impossible:/nInferno.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/000: Welcome./10d Our tavern's drinks are the finest in the world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/001: Esmeralda, the famous doctor, lives in our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/002: We make our drinks with mineral water from the valley, so nowhere else...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/007: Thank you for shopping with us. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/011: [Miss Hayden]/nWelcome to our inn. A stay costs 95 Eld. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/012: Thank you. Have a restful night...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/013: Then please come back another time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/014: Thank you for staying at our inn. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/015: Without this water and Esmeralda, there'd be nothing to make life in this village worthwhile...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/016: A family from our village fled some time ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/017: They were in danger of a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/018: I won't leave this wretched world as it is. Never!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/019: My relatives abandoned their home to escape Viscount Ramon... I don't even know whether they're alive. Why... Why must the powerless suffer?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/020: I... I really hate those people with power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/021: Who... are you? Who... am I?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/022: Ah... My head. My head hurts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/023: Viscount Ramon is notorious for his womanizing. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/024: Not long ago, a family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent soldiers after them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/025: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/026: Our village has long been known for its beautiful scenery. Many nobles compete to become its lord.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/027: This is Pretoria, one of our targets for this operation./nLet's attack the mansion at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/031: Heh heh heh... I could handle a sword in my day too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/032: When wielding a sword, remember not to become attached to the weapon itself. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/033: Isn't true mastery being able to practice swordsmanship even without a sword? Don't cling to your weapon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/034: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/035: More and more people are learning the Tuer language these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/036: The war with them will end someday. When it does, we'll need their language.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/037: Don't run away. Running away won't solve the problem.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/038: Our lord is rather strange... The truth is, life here is difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/039: I kept a rubber band stretched for too long, and it snapped!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/040: It snapped against my leg and stung so badly I almost cried!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/041: This door seems to be locked from the inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/042: [Celia]/nWelcome. Is there anything you're looking for in our shop?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/043: You're fortunate to have visited our village. Goodbye...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/044: They say Viscount Ramon keeps vast treasures on the second floor of his mansion...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/045: Some classify swords as rapiers or heavy swords according to their traits... In any case, a heavy sword is better for staying alive. With a rapier, you're as likely to be struck as to strike. Unless your level is quite high, surviving a battle is difficult...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/046: A heavy sword such as Chrysaor Girium or Bastard Sword will help keep you alive, especially against a powerful enemy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/047: Swords fall into two broad types: defensive and offensive. Defensive swords are durable but have low Attack. Offensive swords break easily, but their Attack is very high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/048: Typical defensive swords include Chrysaor Girium and Bastard Sword. Typical offensive swords include Cassandra and Gramr.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/049: Bastard Sword is very sturdy, so it costs little to maintain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/050: Gramr has high Attack, but poor durability means high maintenance costs. Your fighters also lose a lot of HP in battle, so you'll need plenty of healing medicine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/051: Have you heard? A skilled swordsman recently went to explore Dragon's Lair, but his weapon broke along the way, and... he never returned alive. Perhaps durability really is a weapon's most important quality?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/052: Gramr can be the strongest sword in the right hands. As a rapier, it's poor for defense and its edge chips easily, but its power rivals the most famous blades.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/053: Our academy's Swordsmanship Research Association devotes itself to studying swords and showing people the appeal of this increasingly forgotten weapon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/054: - Official Meeting Place of the Academy's Weapons Research Association -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/055: The aim of battle is to survive, not merely to kill the enemy. Now that armor offers little real protection, your sword is what keeps you safe.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/056: Rapiers have impressive Attack, but fighting with one puts a great strain on your HP. You could say you're gambling with your life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/057: Rapiers also have poor durability. A string of fierce battles could leave you with nothing but broken swords, forcing you to fight bare-handed. That would be suicide.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/058: A branch of the Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy, is in the western part of this village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/059: Pretoria: A mid-tier village with relatively low prices, and home to the famous doctor Esmeralda. The nearby mountains are known for their vast, intricate terrain. Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but its danger prevents us from disclosing the exact location. The strongest Fire magic is said to be obtainable inside./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/060: Have you seen the Geographical Society members in the west? Strange people, always poring over maps.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/061: Imagine, people with so little to do still get to eat... while we work ourselves to the bone just to scrape by...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/062: It shows how hard life in the empire has become since the Black Prince died. We want a strong leader to unite these lands again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/063: - Pretoria Village Guide -/nTavern: Northwest/nItem Shop: West/nInn: Northeast/nWeapon Shop: East/nEsmeralda's Clinic: Western village/nImperial Geographical Society: Western village
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/000_3: Welcome. Our tavern's drinks are the finest in the world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/001_3: Esmeralda, the famous doctor, lives in our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/008_3: [Miss Barton]/nWelcome to the village where the famous Esmeralda lives. How may I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/010_3: Goodbye, and thank you for visiting our shop. May Esmeralda bless you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/011_3: [Miss Hayden]/nWelcome to our inn. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/014_3: Thank you for staying at our inn. Goodbye...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/017_3: They were in danger of a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/018_3: I won't leave this wretched world as it is. Never!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/023_3: Viscount Ramon is notorious for his womanizing. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/024_3: Not long ago, a family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent soldiers after them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/025_3: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/026_3: Our village has long been known for its beautiful scenery. Many nobles compete to become its lord.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/031_3: Heh heh heh... I could handle a sword in my day too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/032_3: When wielding a sword, remember not to become attached to the weapon itself. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/034_3: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/036_3: The war with them will end someday. When it does, I think we'll need the Tuer language.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr01/038_3: Our lord is rather strange... The truth is, life here is difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/001: Me? Well... Who am I, indeed...?/nOh! You have an unusual sword!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/003: I sense an unusual aura from a sword... Could you show me what's in your pack?/n...This is Excalibur! Where did you get such a fine blade...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/004: It's a fine sword, but it's so worn...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/005: A blade like this... How could you let it reach this state?! Wait a moment. I'll repair it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/007: Could you... be Paz? Thank you so much for repairing this sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/008: So you know my name. No need to thank me. Just being able to repair such a blade is enough... Farewell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/009: Me? Well... Who am I, indeed...?/nOh! You have an unusual sword!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/010: What are you doing... in such a remote, dangerous place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/011: [Paz]/nHmm... Me? I'm Paz. I spent my life traveling and repairing swords, but grew disillusioned with the world and came to live here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/012: But aren't you lonely or afraid... living here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/013: [Paz]/nAfraid? Ha ha ha... I was a renowned swordsman in my day. The monsters here can't harm me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/014: [Paz]/nIt's just... sometimes I long to see a truly fine sword. Eoline Pendragon's Excalibur, the Pendragon family's Barisada, or the lightsabers the Tuer are said to use...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/015: Excalibur... You mean that old sword? It's really such a remarkable blade...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/017: If by Excalibur you mean that very old sword, then yes, I have it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/018: [Paz]/nCould you show it to me for a moment? It's an old man's wish.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/019: Of course. It's no trouble. It's just so worn that I don't use it anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/021: [Paz]/nThis is... the legendary Excalibur! By the gods.../nBut it's terribly worn. Would you let me repair it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/022: You want to repair that old sword? It's so worn that no one ever thought to try... Very well. I'd be glad to make an unusable sword useful again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/023: [Paz]/nA "useful" sword, eh? Very well. I'll show you what a truly "useful" sword is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/026: [Paz]/nWhat do you think...? This is Excalibur, a truly magnificent blade!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/027: This sword... Its gleaming blade and keen edge! Its radiance promises powerful attacks, and its weight offers reassuring defense! Yet it moves as though I weren't holding anything. This is a truly great blade...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/028: You've repaired it so perfectly... Your skill is extraordinary.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/029: [Paz]/nHa ha ha! That was nothing! Bring me any sword, and I'll improve it by 120%! Pendragon's Barisada, anything at all! Just bring it! Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/030: (Is he really hiding away because he's disillusioned with the world...?)/nThank you, Paz. I'll never forget your kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma17/032: I used to be a renowned sword expert, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro01/002: Ron City is west of here. Bordeaux lies north of Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/005: How did I get to Cere... Ugh.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/007: Just a moment.../10d Relax and keep your eyes closed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/008: O almighty power of mana.../10d Grant a miracle through my prayer...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/010: There... Now you need only avoid overexerting yourself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/011: Was it you.../15d who saved me in the desert...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/012: Thankfully, you seem to be well now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/013: I'm Esmeralda. I live in Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/014: ..../10d Thank you./n/15d May I ask your name...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/015: I have nothing to repay you with now, but someday I'll repay this kindness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/016: Don't worry about that. Just take care of yourself./10d You seem to have a rather unusual constitution...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/017: I'm sorry, but I have things to attend to and can't stay with you any longer./nGoodbye, then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/019: I need to catch a ship to Dakama Port...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/020: Oh, excuse me, just a moment.../10d Storm Island.../15d Do you know how to get there from here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s05/021: Storm Island.../10d It's far to the south of the continent's eastern lands, so there probably isn't a direct ship from here./30d Go to Dakama Port first, then change ships there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/000: [Catalina]/nHeh heh... You certainly humiliated me last time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/001: [Catalina]/nBut not this time. Tremble before Bifrost's power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/002: Ah... It should be about time for it to arrive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/004: What I arranged for should be arriving now. Excuse me for a moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/005: Wait, Clausewitz! We're in the middle of a battle! What are you talking about?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21b/010: This is my true appearance. I'll explain everything after we've defeated Ascalon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr104/000: The torture chamber is underground. We need to go down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx05/001: They say Machiavelli headed toward Antananarivo, beyond Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/000: Curiosity killed the cat, as they say./20d Digging too deeply into anything can be dangerous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/001: If you drag up something best left alone and make an issue of it, there's always a price to pay in one form or another.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/002: When you're young, you can't help wanting to uncover everything. But what must come to light will reveal itself in time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/000_3: Curiosity killed the cat, as they say. Digging too deeply into anything can be dangerous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/001_3: If you drag up something best left alone and make an issue of it, there's always a price to pay in one form or another.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber12/002_3: When you're young, you can't help wanting to uncover everything. But what must come to light will do so someday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/000: Didn't our lord personally set out to suppress the Zephyr Falcon for the sake of peace elsewhere? As people of Ron, we should gladly join the campaign.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/001: Ron will become the center of the imperial territories. We can't have thieves like the Zephyr Falcon running wild everywhere, can we?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/003: Grandfather is still very vigorous, despite his age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/005: No... How could a woman be the first to say it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/009: They say our lord received his lightsaber from a Tuer knight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/010: Father says the Zephyr Falcon are a band of violent thieves.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/012: They say Sharn Hoiste, the phantom thief, is remarkable. He's never failed to steal something he set his sights on.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/013: His disguises are extraordinary too. One lord was fooled when he disguised himself as the butler who had served that lord for thirty years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/014: What does he look like? I'd like to see his face, just once...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/016: No, too ordinary. "Would you spend your life with me?" Hmm... That's no good either.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/017: Why won't that foolish man propose? He always loses his nerve at the crucial moment...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/018: My son visited Libreville not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/019: He wouldn't stop praising the beauty of Lady Esther Dodd, Libreville's ruler. Heh heh... If only I were ten years younger...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/020: Don't believe me? Don't underestimate the man they called the "Prince of the Wind" in his youth!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/026: I love you. Please marry me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/028: If there's a problem, it's that he's a little too vigorous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/029: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon's swordmaking is highly advanced. The knights' SP-7 "Blitz" and PSX-9 "Armada" are magnificent blades. But obtaining these standard-issue swords in the empire is all but impossible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro03/030: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon strictly forbids taking its standard-issue swords out of the kingdom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/001: Boss!/nThat fellow's come up on deck!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/002: Hmph. Is that him? The one who's supposed to be so skilled?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/004: I'm Silver./nIt seems my men owe you a debt.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/005: A debt, Boss...?/10d We went through so much...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/007: He went easy on you. That's why you're still alive!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/010: Good. Let's see what you can do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/012: Well, I don't really want to fight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/014: Could you give me passage to Cerepus?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/015: Ha ha ha... You've got nerve./15d I like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/016: Beat me, and I'll not only take you to Cerepus, I'll serve you for the rest of my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/018: Go on, Boss! You can do it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/021: Th-this can't be... The boss and all the others...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/029: As promised... I'll take you to Cerepus...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s03/030: And I'll help you in whatever you do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/003: [???]/nYou're on Storm Island./15d How are you feeling...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/005: [???]/nI must say, I'm surprised./nI never expected you to regain consciousness after just one day.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/010: Do you know... where Asura is?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/013: [???]/nSo many young people have lost their lives to it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/015: [???]/nEnough./nJust concentrate on taking care of yourself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/016: Excuse me... May I ask your name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/020: I still don't know where Asura is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/021: Eoline Pendragon... One of the leading figures in the Creation War...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/022: So Pendragon's ferry was for her after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/023: How are you?/20d Can you move around now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/025: If you can move, leave this island at once./nThis is no place for people to live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/026: ...I need to go where Asura is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/027: I will not tell you where Asura is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/028: Nothing you say will change my mind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/029: Stay in this house until the next ship arrives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/030: Where do you think you're going?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/031: There's no other way./10d I'll have to find it myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/035: There's something I must do./nFor that, I need Asura's power.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/037: And I think I know where Asura is.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/038: Asura lies where the Black Prince died: the place where the magic machine Asmod rests.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/039: On this small island, there's only one place large enough for a giant magic machine. That is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/040: But how did you know that...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/042: Oh, no... If I don't stop him at once...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/043: Asura lies at the very place where the Black Prince died...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/044: Where the giant magic machine Asmod rests...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/045: You seem to be feeling a little better now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/047: Don't concern yourself with anything else. Just rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/049: ....../15d/nDemon Sword Asura belonged to the Black Prince, Carl Steiner./15d/nThen...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/050: The Secret Records say the Black Prince piloted the magic machine Asmod in the final battle...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/052: Let's think carefully... about what the Secret Records said.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/053: The Black Prince died on Storm Island...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/054: Let's give it/10d a little more thought.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/056: Storm Island isn't very large.../10d And it has only one mountain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/057: Hmm...?/10d/nLooking closely at the painting... the summit is indistinct.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s02/058: Is it only the mountain mist...?/10d If not...!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy01/000: East - Pretoria Region/nNorthwest - Dragon Breath Mountains
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/000: During the three days Sid was missing, his mother Jean was beside herself. Why was he kidnapped in the first place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/001: The kidnappers never sent a ransom letter, and there was no apparent reason to abduct Sid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/002: There must be some other plot behind it. I don't know what, though...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/003: Sid still hasn't regained consciousness. He just keeps sleeping. The doctor thinks he was given some kind of drug.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/004: Sid has always been curious. He respects you more than anyone, young master. His dream is to become a scholar like you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/000_3: During the three days Sid was missing, Jean was beside herself. Why was he kidnapped in the first place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/002_3: There's almost certainly some other plot behind it. I don't know what, though...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/003_3: Sid still hasn't regained consciousness. He just keeps sleeping. The doctor thinks he was given some kind of drug.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber07/004_3: Sid has always been curious. He respects you more than anyone, young master, and dreams of becoming a scholar someday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/001: This is the Bifrost army's logistics base, the one Clausewitz mentioned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/005: [Bifrost Officer]/nDamn... The enemy has reached us here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/007: Come on. Let's take this base at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/008: Does that settle matters here, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/009: Yes./nThe enemy seems to have fully retreated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/011: A message has arrived from Clausewitz.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/012: Rhidelhard and Meditch's unexpected actions have allowed the Bifrost army to occupy our supply route.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/013: He asks Cyrano and his companions to return to our camp as quickly as possible and retake the supply route.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/015: Don't tell me Meditch and Rhidelhard have...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/016: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss41/018: [Jackson]/nI'm Jackson. Clausewitz put me in charge of supplying weapons. What do you need?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/000: Is that the lord of Caracas' procession?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/001: [Soldier]/nThe lord is passing! Clear the way!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/004: What's wrong? Do you know him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/005: I'll never forget that face, even in death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/006: You don't know the famous Duke Ruben Bernstein?/30d You must be from elsewhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/007: Excuse me, what is the name of this place's lord?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/010: Let's rest today and attend tomorrow's burning at the stake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/011: It's too late to follow the carriage. Why not wait for tomorrow's burning at the stake? They say the lord will attend.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/012: Yes, Silver./20d We should attend tomorrow's burning and look for a sure opportunity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/013: It seems we'll have to attend tomorrow's burning./30d For now, let's find an inn for tonight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s02/015: He's notorious for his cruelty./20d He came here today to prepare tomorrow's burning at the stake, which he'll preside over himself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/000: It's such a relief to have Esmeralda here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/001: Damn... How did I end up like this?/nTo think taxes brought me to this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/002: Cardinal Cesare has gone too far.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/003: Oh... I never thought I'd get to meet Esmeralda.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/006: That musketeer Chris is so handsome. Hee hee hee./nI wonder if he has a sweetheart?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/009: There's no need to worry here. Hurry to the Church fortress...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/010: These poor people.../nHow much they must have suffered.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/011: Strange.../10d There are no enemies here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/014: ...You don't look like those Church people./10d/nBut you're still suspicious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/020: I told you not to move!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/023: Be brave, now... Just hold on a little longer...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/030: You don't know Esmeralda? She's the finest doctor in the empire!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/036: We told you, we're the Zephyr Falcon!/nHonestly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/038: Oh... I'm sorry for my rudeness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/039: By the way, who are you...?/nAnd who are the people behind you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/041: We were all imprisoned beneath the church, but Chris rescued us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/042: Can you believe it? They're even charging tolls at the village entrance now. We came here to protest, and...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/043: You said you're the Zephyr Falcon, didn't you?/nWould you fight alongside me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/044: Why do you want to fight the Church?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/045: Well... I'm sorry./nI can't tell you right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/046: It makes no difference to me. Do as you wish./nJust stay out of the way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/047: I'll stay here for a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/048: I should help these people./nThey all seem unwell...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni08/051: And I have the key to the western building.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst09/000: I've come quite a way./15d I'd better complete the fourth stage of training before going any further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr99/000: Esmeralda should be on this floor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/000: This ship is bound for Dakama. I've sailed this route for decades.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/001: Hello. Is this the ship to Dakama?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/002: [Captain]/nIt is, but our departure has been postponed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/004: [Captain]/nI'm furious too. They've issued a ridiculous order banning departures for Dakama Port for now, because there are so many pirates about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/005: [Captain]/nWe can't sail this route because of a few pirates? Absurd! Everyone knows it's really because the mayor dislikes me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/006: When will you be able to sail, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/007: [Captain]/nI don't know. His house is two blocks ahead, above the tavern. We may not sail again until we tear it down and elect a new mayor!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/008: Only the mayor of Cerepus has the authority to permit departures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/009: As far as I know, the current mayor of Cerepus and our captain don't get along.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/010: Well, at least it gives me a little rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/011: [Captain]/nI don't know. His house is two blocks ahead, above the tavern. We may not sail again until we tear it down and elect a new mayor!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/012: Quite different from our current mayor, in many ways.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/013: I believe Charles, Cerepus' current mayor, lives near the Granada trading company... He and our captain don't get along. Lifting the sailing ban requires his approval...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/014: Hmph! Asking that pig won't do any good. He really hates our captain!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/015: Well, at least it gives me a little rest...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/016: [Captain]/nI don't know how to thank you, Ruth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/017: [Ruth]/nDon't mention it. I only put right what was wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/018: [Ruth]/nIt's absurd to let a personal grudge interfere with a public shipping route, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/020: [Captain]/nOh, you're Cyrano? Ruth told me about you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/021: Can we leave for Dakama now, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/022: [Captain]/nOf course. And don't worry about the fare. Ruth has taken care of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/023: Ruth...! I don't know how to thank you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/024: [Ruth]/nPlease, don't worry. It's just a small thank-you for the interesting story you told me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/025: [Captain]/nShall we set sail for Dakama, then? All hands, prepare to sail!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/005_2: [Captain]/nWe can't sail this route because of a few pirates? Absurd!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/011_2: Ruth, the candidate for mayor of Cerepus, is someone you can reason with. For a politician, anyway.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/013_2: I believe Charles, Cerepus' current mayor, lives near the Granada trading company...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/017_2: [Ruth]/nDon't mention it. I only put right what was wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/005_3: [Captain]/nWe can't sail this route because of a few pirates? Absurd!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/011_3: Ruth, the candidate for mayor of Cerepus, is someone you can reason with. For a politician, anyway.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/013_3: I believe Charles, Cerepus' current mayor, lives near the Granada trading company...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy01/017_3: [Ruth]/nDon't mention it. I only put right what was wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy08/000: Everyone comes to moments of choice./nThe choice is yours,/nbut gaining what you cherish may mean giving up much else./nLife is fair to everyone./nDo not regret your choice./nOne day, the time will come to look back...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr03/000: I have no business here right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/000: But the last few years have been quiet. No major forces have headed toward Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/001: Antananarivo has always stood near Bifrost's border, so it has scarcely known a peaceful day.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/003: But now... Bifrost itself seems to be looking to expand beyond its borders.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/005: I hear there's a group that treats the faults of a few religious people as though they were the faults of all believers...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/009: This is Libreville. Frederick may be the strongest military lord, but the best place to live is right here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/010: Still, no place seems able to get through these troubled times unscathed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/011: Do you know of the sword Kars is said to have left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/012: They say Sharn Hoiste has appeared around here too... Who is that phantom thief, really?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/013: Isn't Sharn Hoiste just a thief, like the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/015: Then perhaps it's only natural that they have good weapons.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/016: I was once a prisoner of the Tuer and saw how they lived. Their advanced civilization lets them make and use all sorts of useful machines.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/017: I'm a devout follower of the Church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/019: Cesare seems too determined to unite the empire in his own way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/020: That way demands far too many sacrifices...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/021: If Mother isn't my real mother... Could my younger brother or sister be living somewhere else, not even knowing I exist? Oh... How romantic...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/023: They say money won't buy that mirror. He sells it only to the person the mirror chooses. Such a strange old man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/025: Most monks aren't corrupt, whatever the rumors say. Only some religious people are at fault.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/026: The hardest things often break most easily. There's more than one way to solve a problem.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/027: I once saw an old man selling an unusual mirror...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/028: It reflected what you most deeply desired...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/029: I hate Mother! She's always scolding me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/030: She can't be my real mother. Where is my real mother?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/031: Disguised as a man, Awen searched for Al across the battlefields, protected by the gem's mysterious power. Her countless adventures under the name "Kane" made her famous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/032: At last, Awen learned where Al was fighting. She raced there like the wind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/033: You can hear the next part in Ron. You've now heard the first at the tavern, the second from the child, and the third from me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/034: Bifrost is such an unremarkable country. I visited once, and it was terribly provincial! Nothing but countryside!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/035: And why are the people so narrow-minded? I simply don't understand...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/036: Mother told me Chaos Cubes are very precious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/037: Mother says a Chaos Cube's power is a gift from God...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/038: Our family has a Chaos Cube passed down as an heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/039: Even in times like these, our family lives this well thanks to the Chaos Cube, doesn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/040: Surely Libreville is the best place to live in the whole empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/041: I've heard Duke Frederick of Ron is very capable too, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/042: Ron may excel in military strength, but this place is better for everyday life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/043: You think I look like Nicole Kidman in "Far and Away"? Oh... Thank you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/044: But you don't look like Tom Cruise, do you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/045: Our family used to live in Pretoria, but we fled here because of its lord.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/046: Our life is fairly stable now, but those memories are like a nightmare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/047: Recently, I met children who'd suffered as we had, and took them into my care.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/048: At the bottom of the lake, Awen found a strangely glowing gem and retrieved it. Then the star's voice spoke again: "With that gem, he will be safe."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/049: Thank you for what you did before. You saved our lives... and avenged us too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/050: My younger sibling hasn't spoken since the shock of that day.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/051: But I will never, ever forgive those lords. Never.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/052: All he does is drink, drink, drink! How much longer must I put up with this?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/053: How does he expect to get anywhere like that?! Why, why, why must he behave this way?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/054: I wouldn't have married him if I'd known it would be like this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/055: [Mr. Jones]/nAh... Drink is life's joy and pleasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/056: [Mr. Jones]/nWithout drink, I have no reason to live... Whatever my wife says, I can't help it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/057: [Mr. Jones]/nAnd I don't even drink that much... Why does she hate it so?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/059: To whoever reads this: While tidying my shop's basement, I found a passage to a strange cave. It's an intricate place. This time, I intend to prepare properly before exploring it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/060: A letter and a key lie on the desk.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/061: There doesn't seem to be anyone in this house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/062: Is this the arena owner's house, the one the weapon merchant mentioned? Strange. The door seems open.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/063: [Mr. Jones]/nYou know the tavern down there? Save a dying man and fetch me a drink. My wife won't let me go there myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/064: Oh, dear... Must you go to such lengths for a drink?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/065: [Mr. Jones]/nCome now. I'll reward you separately. Take this Brass Gem to the tavern keeper and bring back some drink.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/068: [Mrs. Jones] Dear! You're not sending someone out for drinks again, are you?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/069: [Mr. Jones]/nNo! Of course not!/n(whispering) Hurry and get it. Hurry!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/070: [Mr. Jones]/nYou thief! What have you done with my Brass Gem?! Thief!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/071: [Mr. Jones]/nThank you so much... Here's a small reward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/074: This key looks as though it will fit the arena door.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/075: But Al had already left for the war. Awen took the gem and, with only a sword to rely on, raced to the battlefield where he was fighting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/076: That's the second part. Someone else will tell you what comes next. You heard the first part from the young woman at the tavern, didn't you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/078: You've learned the whole legend of the Chaos Cube. That makes you worthy to receive one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/081: There's a beautiful legend about the Chaos Cube...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/082: I love that legend, but I only know it from the middle onward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/083: I could tell you if you've heard what came before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/084: Even so, it's a wonderful place to live! Our city's water is excellent!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/085: Whichever side it is, I doubt it matters to a poor fellow like me. What harm is there if the rich lose a little money?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/086: We need weapons like theirs to defend ourselves... Our village's weapon shop stocks quite good ones. It couldn't hurt to take a look, could it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/087: What shocked me most was that they didn't even know "chocolate." Chocolate! I know it's a new food introduced by the Tuer, but still! I couldn't believe it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/088: Mother has never even shown it to me. She says I'm not entitled to see it until I'm an adult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/089: Our family has a saying: give the gem to whoever knows the whole legend of the Chaos Cube. Have you heard it all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/090: Ho ho ho! You do look a little like Bruce Willis, though!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/092: Did you see the large bridge on your way into town? That's Libreville Bridge, said to be the most beautiful bridge in the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/093: There's a legend about its construction. Whenever work was about to begin, heavy rain and floods kept it from progressing. A shaman said, "The guardian spirit of this river will not permit the bridge to be built."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/094: The people tried everything to appease the river's guardian spirit, but nothing worked. At last, they turned to human sacrifice...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/095: Would you like to hear the next part of the bridge's legend? The people looked for a maiden willing to give her life for the bridge, but of course no one volunteered. Then one day, as the delays continued, a young girl came to the building site.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/096: The girl said, "I'll make it possible for the work to continue. In return, give me the bridge." The people were puzzled. They thought she meant to sacrifice herself to the river god, so how could she own the bridge?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/097: After discussing it, the people agreed to give her ownership of the bridge. She let out a shrill laugh and leaped into the river! You'll have to ask someone else for the rest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/098: I love legends. Do you know any old stories you could tell me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/099: Oh... I suppose you'd like to hear the rest of the bridge's story?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/100: Here's what happened next. The girl who leaped into the river turned into a dragon and fought the river god. The people had assumed she would be a sacrifice, and watched the battle in terror.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/101: The battle lasted three days and three nights. Throughout that time, the earth and sky were dark, and the people saw no light.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/102: At last, dawn broke, and the people saw the girl standing by the river. As they approached, she said, "From now on, this river belongs to me. Building a bridge across it would break the former god's spell. I drove him away so that you could build it."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/103: "But you must make this bridge the strongest and most beautiful in the world. It will be the symbol of my ownership of the river, and my spell. If it breaks, I will die, as will you who built it, or your descendants."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/104: Then the girl vanished as if she'd never been there. The people built the bridge as though their lives depended on it, and the result is the bridge you saw. Well? Wasn't that a good story?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/105: This area lies lower than the surrounding regions and is at risk of flooding./nGeysir Geographical Society
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/107: You like stories too, don't you? Here, take this. I found it a little while ago, but it doesn't fit me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/031_3: A friend of mine lives in Paro. Apparently something strange happened there recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/032_3: The son of a powerful family planned to marry a pagan despite the Church's objections, but suddenly called off the engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/033_3: Good heavens! You can't even marry if the Church objects? How do the people out there put up with being treated like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/055_3: Ah... drink is one of life's joys and pleasures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/056_3: Honestly... without drink, I'd have no reason to live... No matter what my wife says, I can't help it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri02/057_3: Besides, I don't drink all that much... I don't know why she hates it so much.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck04/001: I have a bad feeling about this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck04/006: Meditch is no match for him.../30d/nSilver!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck04/007: I'm sorry, but stay here and help Kana rescue the prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck04/009: There's something troubling me... Excuse me for a moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp104/000: They say the torture chamber is underground.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcp104/002: Who are you to cause a disturbance in this lord's mansion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/001: So Irus was.../20d one of the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/003: [Irus]/nMy overwhelming power will leave you floundering in despair.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/006: [Irus]/nI... Impossible... A human who can breach my barrier...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/009: The setting moon falls upon the blade; the Black Shadow in the darkness shall destroy the world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/010: Let me make one thing clear: Irus's life is mine to take.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/012: [Irus]/nYou... How dare you, in my presence.../nI'll send you both to the afterlife!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/014: I am Sharn Hoiste, the last heir of the Black Shadow!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflvsirus/001_3: So Irus was... a God of Destruction!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/000: /2cJoint Headquarters of Zephyr Falcon and Frederick's Army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/001: To think we could take Inferno so easily...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/002: We owe it to the supporting fire from General Frederick's artillery.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/003: As you know, Inferno is a natural fortress, but it has a great many hidden passages.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/004: With an accurate knowledge of its layout and supporting troops to distract the enemy, taking it isn't too difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/006: One team still hasn't returned, though.../10d Ah, here they come.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/008: I... I have something to attend to...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/011: Did you think I wouldn't recognize you dressed as a boy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/013: That's enough. Go home at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/020: I'm sorry, but from now on.../10d I won't be able to fight alongside you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/021: I'm sure Kana will work twice as hard to make up for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/000_3: /2cJoint Headquarters of Zephyr Falcon and Frederick's Army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/003_3: As you know, Inferno is a natural fortress, but it has a great many hidden passages./10d With an accurate knowledge of its layout and supporting troops to distract the enemy, taking it isn't too difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/004_3: With an accurate knowledge of its layout and supporting troops to distract the enemy, taking it isn't too difficult.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/013_3: That's enough. Go home at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s05/021_3: I'm sure Kana will work twice as hard to make up for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka04a/000: This leads to the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka04a/001: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/001: She's so devoted to treating the sick that she even uses her own home as a ward.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/002: Let's ask her to treat the children right away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/003: I'm sorry. I didn't realize we had visitors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/004: Ah, Esmeralda. These children are injured. We've come to ask you to treat them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/005: Oh no! These children have been shot...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/006: Their wounds are serious. Please treat them at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/007: These wounds are serious. We must begin treatment immediately. This way, quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/008: But how did children so young come to be shot?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/009: The lords' soldiers killed their parents, and shot the children too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/010: Even children that young... How could they be so cruel...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/011: But... I seem to remember meeting you at Port Cerepus...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/012: No, I don't recall that. You must have mistaken me for someone else.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/015: When will the children be well enough to leave?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/016: They should regain consciousness tomorrow morning. A full recovery will take a little longer...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/017: Then we'll take our leave. We'll come back for the children.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/022: Hey, pull yourself together. Where's Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/023: You're the visitors from yesterday...! Please, save Esmeralda!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/024: Viscount Ramon? Why would he take her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/025: He accused her of healing people with demonic powers. It's an absurd lie, but he's branded her a witch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/026: What?! Why would he do that?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/027: Viscount Ramon... had long been infatuated with Esmeralda and courted her repeatedly. When she finally rejected him, he began to bear a grudge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/029: Cyrano, we must go after Ramon and rescue Esmeralda right now. We can't let him use his power to torment innocent people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/031: Let's watch Ramon's movements a little longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/032: I'll rescue her, whatever it takes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/033: Silver, we're heading straight into Viscount Ramon's mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/035: We still need more time to prepare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/036: We can watch Ramon's movements before we attack. There will still be time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/039: It's fortunate you gave them such good first aid. For now, I think you can rest easy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/042: You said your name was Cyrano, didn't you?/30d Have we met before?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/044: Ah, I remember. In Cerepus City...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/045: I'm not sure... Could you have mistaken me for someone else?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/046: You helped me before, in Cerepus City... No, in the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/047: That's right, Cerepus. It was two years ago, wasn't it?/30d I'm glad to see you're well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/048: What? You two already knew each other?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/049: Anyway, we'll take our leave for today. We'll call again tomorrow morning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/050: Oh, what about the treatment fee...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/051: Of course. Please come by again, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/052: Were you in Cerepus two or three years ago, by any chance?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/053: I've only been to Cerepus once, recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/054: Anyway, Esmeralda, we'll take our leave. We'll call again tomorrow morning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/058: What's wrong? Has something happened to Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/059: Tell me what happened, calmly and from the beginning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/060: Viscount Ramon... His soldiers burst in and dragged Esmeralda away...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s02/061: Viscount Ramon, the lord here? Why would he take Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/000: Clausewitz, this has to be said!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/002: I can't stand watching Zephyr Falcon dance to Cyrano's tune any longer!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/004: Kana, you need to face reality too. He's only using us as tools for his own revenge!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/005: You call it Cyrano's personal grudge, Meditch, but his ultimate aim is to overthrow Cardinal Cesare. Don't forget that this is also Zephyr Falcon's goal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/006: Damn it! Everyone's taking Cyrano's side!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/007: It may not be my place to interfere, but I think Cyrano is simply being misunderstood.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/008: Misunderstanding or not, if this goes on, I'd sooner leave Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/009: Same here! Either Cyrano goes, or you lose both of us. Make your choice!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/011: I owe Meditch a debt I'll never repay. But without Zephyr Falcon's help, I may never be able to get to Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/014: I don't want Zephyr Falcon to split apart because of me./40d I'll leave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/016: A wise decision, Cyrano. You're not as stubborn as I thought.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/017: If Cyrano leaves.../30d I'm going with him!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/018: Kana, that would defeat the purpose of my leaving Zephyr Falcon./50d Please respect my decision.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/021: Of course I'll go with Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/022: Cyrano, I'm terribly sorry. I never thought it would come to this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/023: We're only going back to how things were before I joined. Don't worry yourself, Advisor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/024: I hope you all achieve what you set out to do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/025: I believe Meditch is wrong./40d I cannot leave Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/027: Meditch has certainly gone too far. But we cannot welcome the prospect of him and Rhidelhard leaving Zephyr Falcon either.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/028: Can't welcome it?! So what?!!/40d Shut up! I've never liked you anyway!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/029: Without Meditch, do you think we'd ever have become this powerful?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/030: Enough, Rhidelhard. Those who choose Cyrano can stay. Those who choose me will come with me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/031: A newcomer driving out the old hands!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/033: Esther Dodd will take me in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/035: Isabele, will you come with us too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/038: Let's see how well you do without us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/039: We have no time to stand around. We must head for the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/040: The underwater city near Cerepus? Isn't that one of the Seven Wonders? Why would we go there...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/042: According to the Secret Records of the Creation War, the last God of Destruction remains sealed there. He must intend to break the seal and revive that god.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/043: Understood, Cyrano. I'll move our main force to the area around the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/044: Where will you go now, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/045: I'm not sure... Perhaps back to Geysir City for now... I feel I might find something I've forgotten.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s05/049: I'm sure I'll find something I've forgotten if I go there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/000: Just you wait, Cesare.../30d You won't escape now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/005: I'm sorry, Cyrano./30d We can no longer stand by and watch your destructive rampage./30d Please lay down your sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/006: You've even joined forces with Bifrost to stop me?/30d Heh... How absurd.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/007: Come on, stop me if you can!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/009: What are you saying, Silver? Together, we can defeat them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/010: But there's no time./30d If we linger here, you may never fulfill your dearest wish.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/012: Yes./20d So hurry after Cesare and fulfill your wish.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/014: Your wish is mine as well./30d If you can find satisfaction, so can I.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/016: How long will you keep whispering?!/30d If you won't drop your sword, prepare to die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/017: Cyrano has no need to face the likes of you./30d I'm more than enough for you all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/018: So you're determined to fight to the end?/30d Fine. Let's see how long you last!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s02/019: Come at me, you meddling fools!/30d You may kill me, but you'll never stop Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/002: Will you head into the former imperial territories from here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/003: Geysir./15d I won't need the ship any longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/004: You all heard him! He won't need the ship any longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/005: Then we can go back to piracy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/006: From now on, do as you please./20d Keep sailing as pirates,/10d use what you've earned to start a business,/10d or settle on a farm...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/007: I've had a wonderful time with you./20d I hope you all stay well and live happily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/008: Boss, what are you doing?/20d It sounds like you're saying goodbye too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/009: You older hands had better look after our foolish youngster.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/011: I'll never forget... all the good times we had with you, Boss.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/012: If you're leaving, Boss... I suppose it's time we gave up piracy too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/013: Then farewell./20d I'm sure we'll meet again someday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/015: Heh... I can't help worrying about leaving those fools behind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/016: I have no intention of doing that./15d Once I've made up my mind, I don't change it on a whim.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/017: If you don't want to come, don't force yourself. Bringing me to Cerepus has already fulfilled our original agreement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/018: I see.../30d/nThen I'll be counting on you from now on.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/020: Let's cross the Trisis Desert and make for the area around Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/021: So that's the person the Boss has been waiting for...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/022: The Boss was always waiting for someone who could defeat her. Looks like she finally found him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/023: Whew... With the Boss's skill, I thought that would take a lifetime...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/024: Then what does that make us, after serving only the Boss all this time?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s04/028: Oh, forget it. We've got plenty of money to start with. Maybe we should go into business...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/001: Hmph! You wicked lord, tormenting your poor subjects! We've come from Zephyr Falcon to bring you to justice!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/002: Guards! Guards! Hurry and a-arrest them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/003: Ha! Do you think you have any guards left? We've already dealt with every guard nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/009: This man is definitely not Ruben.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/010: You mean Ruben put a double in his place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/011: Exactly. This man is nothing but Ruben's puppet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/012: But how can you tell? He looks like Ruben to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/013: He isn't Ruben. I'd recognize him even if nothing were left but his bones.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/014: Silver, we can't waste time here. We're going after him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/015: Do you have any idea where he might have fled?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/016: He wouldn't leave his lands far behind. He must have gone to a nearby lord for help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/020: What happens from here has nothing to do with Zephyr Falcon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/021: Ruben has abandoned his lands and fled. Doesn't that mean Zephyr Falcon has achieved its goal?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/029: F-fine./10d/nGo wherever you like! It's no concern of mine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/032: And what do you want, Mr. Impostor?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s04/034: Stop hanging around in front of me and go home already!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri01/000: The road lies beneath your feet./n- Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri01/001: To think there's a cave like this beneath the city...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl25_s03/000: [Diablo]/nHeh heh heh... You've forced me to reveal my true form for the first time in centuries. Now you must die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/001: Damn it! As the Church's influence spreads across Geysir, merchants like us have it harder and harder.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/002: Those Church people do nothing themselves, but keep telling everyone else what to do. The more you see, the more ridiculous it gets!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/003: The mayor and the captain on the Dakama run really don't get along. Didn't they have a huge row just recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/004: Even a wolf has to wear sheep's clothing. That's how you survive in this wretched world.
