Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/005: The more people resent the Church, the more flock to Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/006: The mayor's residence is the first house as you enter the western part of town. I wonder if Zephyr Falcon will target it too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/007: These days? It's misery. Prices keep rising, and thieves are everywhere...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/008: I'm barely earning anything as it is, and now the Church is collecting even more donations!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/009: He usually has a drink at the tavern next to Granada's shop. For a politician, he puts on no airs. He's easy to talk to.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/010: With all the bandits in the desert these days, it's getting hard to make a living at this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/011: The harder the desert is to cross, the higher prices rise. If you can make it across, you can make a fortune.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/012: They say Mayor Charles used to be a desert caravan merchant too. His residence is just inside the western part of town.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/013: If you think only the desert is full of bandits, you're wrong. The pirates at sea are worse than ever!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/014: Isn't it all because of those damned Tuer people?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/015: Nothing will change unless Mayor Charles tightens security. He lives in the mayor's residence in western town.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/016: Dakama? Isn't that where every pirate in the world has gathered to operate these days?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/017: They say even pirates flee when they meet Tuer warships. How does Pendragon manage to fight them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/018: "The pirate who controls Dakama rules all the seas." That's what pirates keep saying these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/019: How many years has it been since Rashid III left Pendragon's royal castle? He's Rashid II's son, and the leading contender for the throne.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/020: The Pendragon royal family has always been famous for its wanderlust.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/021: Rashid III? He's the only grandson descended from Robin and King Rashid. No wonder he has the king's wholehearted support.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/022: Surely you know Robin? King Rashid's first wife, and said to be the one he loved most.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/023: King Rashid made Robin his queen despite their difference in status and his ministers' fierce opposition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/024: They say King Rashid met Queen Robin when he was young, on his quest to rebuild Pendragon. That's how their love began.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/026: Dakama must have the best location for trade in all Geysir. This place did well too, back when the Empire still existed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/027: I miss the days of the Empire. Back then we had hope, ambition... People were full of life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/028: Of course, we couldn't have imagined the Church throwing its weight around the way it does now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/029: Oh my! Aren't you a charming one?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/030: Have you heard the legend that the dragon on Fire Dragon Mountain wakes once every thousand years?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/031: You haven't? Of course not! I just made it up!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/032: The nearby Lake Cerepus, with its underwater city, is famous for its legends and beauty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/033: Ah... My husband proposed to me by that lake, where you can see the underwater city... I was so happy then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/034: Even now, I blush just thinking of it. Ho ho ho.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/035: Mother talks about Father every single day.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/036: What's so wonderful about a father who abandoned us?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/037: I'll never be like him when I grow up!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/038: Oh, is this your first time here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/039: Has something wonderful happened? It's written all over your face: "I'm the happiest person in the world."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/040: Ho ho ho! You must have a wonderful sweetheart! Ah, how lovely... If only I were your age again... So, what's your sweetheart like?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/041: She's my wife, but honestly, she talks far too much...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/042: How can that mouth keep going without a moment's rest? I don't understand it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/043: Look it up in a dictionary.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/044: Everyone admits my sister-in-law talks a little too much. But she's kind at heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/045: All right, all right. I'll concede that my sister-in-law talks too much and makes plenty of mistakes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/046: All right, I know. If I weren't living off this household... I'd never live with someone like my sister-in-law.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/047: I know Mother sometimes goes too far, but can't you be a little understanding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/048: How else can women who keep house relieve their stress, if not with a little gossip?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/049: Whatever anyone says, she's still my mother... I can't speak ill of her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/050: Hmph! Who do they think they are, looking down on me? Back when the Black Prince was alive, I was someone in the Imperial Army!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/051: If only the Black Prince were still alive, this place would never have come to this! Sob... My Black Prince...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/052: My master isn't quite right in the head. A bit senile, you might say.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/053: But it's an easy place to work. I can take my time... And best of all, the pay is good.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/054: The maid in the old man's house nearby doesn't have a good reputation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/055: They say she's badly behaved, and worse, that she deceives her master...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/056: Standing here like this makes me look back over my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/057: I have been to a place called Pretoria near Inferno.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/058: I could feel a strange presence coming from the nearby mountains. The caves were the same...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/059: Cerepus lies on the outskirts of the former imperial territories, but news from every region is surprisingly easy to come by here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/060: Traveling through the former imperial territories means crossing mountains and forests.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/061: There may be no plains, but our well-established trade routes have kept us fed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/062: I wonder who'll become mayor of Cerepus City this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/063: Will Ruth finally win on her fourth attempt, or will Charles hold on to his seat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/065: By the way, have you heard?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/066: Hmm... Charles, the current mayor, is a loathsome fellow. But Ruth, who's running against him, is a decent person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/067: Mayor Charles's house is near Granada's shop. But he isn't someone I'd want to meet. Not. At. All.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/068: Hmm... The candidates couldn't be more different. Ruth likes meeting people at the tavern, while Charles stays holed up at home beside Granada's shop.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/072: This house appears to be unoccupied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/073: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/074: Ah! Are you Rashid Pendragon?! Come here! I'll show you the taste of my blade!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/076: I... will soon leave this world. What use are ornaments to me now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/078: Take the gem and use it well... Goodbye, handsome stranger.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/079: I've waited seven years for the man who left me. Now I'm going to die...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/080: I wish the thieves would rob the mayor's residence instead. It's the first house as you enter the western part of town.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/081: He betrayed me. He said I was his only love, then yesterday he married another woman... someone who used to be my friend. I... Is my life even worth living now? All I have left is death... I want to rest in peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/083: Tell her to find another man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/085: What a man... But miss, there are plenty of other men in the world. Surely he isn't your whole life? Does it make sense to throw your life away over him?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/086: Wouldn't living a happier life than his be the best revenge? You must find the courage to go on...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/088: .../30d You're just like the rest of them. I have nothing to say to you. Go away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/089: He... Perhaps he had some reason for leaving you? Could you let him go, and forgive him...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/090: .../30d You... I think you carry sorrow in your heart too. I don't hate him. No, I can't hate him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/091: It's only... myself that I hate.../20d Ah. Please take this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/093: I gave him that gem as a present... The day before his wedding, he asked to see me and gave it back. But I can't keep it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/094: I'd only throw it away... So please, say nothing and leave. Quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/095: I say all that, yet I can't put my own heart in order. Heh... He must have had his reasons? What a joke, Cyrano Bernstein...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/096: Swords can be classified by size, but also by their characteristics.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/097: For example, some swords are made specifically for attack or defense. An offensive sword sacrifices every other quality for Attack alone. A defensive sword disregards Attack and is built for protection.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/098: Cassandra and Gramr are typical offensive swords. Chrysaor Girium and the Bastard Sword are typical defensive swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/099: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nCombat is built around attack and defense. Weapons have the greatest influence on both. Here's how they work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/100: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nFirst, attack. Its power depends on the attacker's Strength and the weapon's Attack. Naturally, the higher both are, the greater the overall power. Accuracy depends heavily on the weapon's Hit Rate. With firearms, the gun provides the Hit Rate, while the ammunition provides the Attack.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/101: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nDefense is a little more complicated... Someone else will explain that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/102: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nLet me explain defense. Once an attack hits and its power is determined, we check whether the defender blocks it. The chance of blocking comes from the equipped weapon's Block Rate. If the block fails, the defender takes the attack directly. If it succeeds, the weapon's Defense is applied.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/103: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nWhen a block succeeds, the weapon's Defense reduces the incoming attack by that /3cpercentage/5c. The remaining power is applied to the defending weapon. If it is below the weapon's Weapon Limit, the defender takes no damage and loses no HP. For example, an attack of 1000 against a weapon with 30 Defense is reduced by 30%, leaving 700. If the weapon's Weapon Limit is 800, I take no damage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/104: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nIf the power applied to the defending weapon exceeds its Weapon Limit, the attack breaks through. The weapon loses 1 HP; if its HP reaches 0, it breaks and disappears. The defender takes damage equal to the power applied to the weapon minus its Weapon Limit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/105: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nWould you like to learn about magic? Its power depends on the spell's own Attack and the caster's Intelligence. Intelligence is especially important: the same spell can vary greatly in power from one caster to another. Spells also have a minimum Intelligence requirement, so you may be unable to use them until your Intelligence rises.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/106: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nEvery spell has its own affinity: Fire, Lightning, Water, Dark or Light. If an enemy monster also has one of these five affinities, damage is calculated differently. Consult the manual for details...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/107: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nOf course, you can't cast magic without MP. Some people's MP can never increase.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/108: - Cerepus Branch of the Imperial Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/109: - Cerepus City Guide -/nGranada Trading Company: Western City/nMayor's Residence: Western City
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/110: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nDo you understand attack and defense now? Then let me tell you a little about the different types of swords.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/111: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThere are four types of swords. Rapiers and heavy swords are especially important. Rapiers have high Attack, but low Defense, and break easily, so they're risky at low levels. You may kill enemies quickly, but you'll also lose HP quickly, and upkeep is expensive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/112: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHeavy swords have high Defense and don't break easily, but their Attack is low. Still, without at least one heavy sword, you may be unable to keep fighting when all your rapiers have broken.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/113: - Sword Types -/nRapiers: Stiletto, Rapier, Saber/nHeavy Swords: Gladius, Swordbreaker/n/nSwordsmanship Research Association, Imperial Academy
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/001_2: Damn it! As the Church's influence spreads across Geysir, merchants like us have it harder and harder.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/003_2: But what can we do? Who could stop the Church's influence?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/004_2: Even a wolf has to wear sheep's clothing. That's how you survive in this wretched world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/005_2: The more people resent the Church, the more flock to Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/006_2: Without Zephyr Falcon, the Church would act even more as if it owned the world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/008_2: I'm barely earning anything as it is, and now the Church is collecting even more donations!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/012_2: I heard a caravan crossing the desert was attacked by bandits recently. They were wiped out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/015_2: The weather on the Dakama route is perfect, but security is terrible. We risk our lives just to earn a living.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/036_2: What's so wonderful about a father who abandoned us?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/054_2: Have you heard? They say that old man nearby and his maid are... involved.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/055_2: The old man and his maid? Well, there are strange rumors... They say she's poisoning him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltcy02/065_2: Have you heard? They say that old man nearby and his maid are... involved.

Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s02/002: You needn't worry about that./nI'll handle it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s02/004: Heh heh heh... So Frederick has sent his troops...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s02/005: Now, shall we see how long Frederick holds out?/15d/nHow intriguing... Heh heh heh.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s02/006: Bifrost's army is moving just as expected too./15d/nEverything is going according to plan...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s02/007: Thirty years have already passed since your death.../nThe moment to avenge our suffering is drawing near.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/000: Damn! He escaped while we were dealing with the guards...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/002: We have no choice. We'll have to storm the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/003: Wait! A frontal attack on the duke's mansion would be reckless!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/004: Heh. Don't tell me it's reckless just because of the guards?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/005: Yes, I've seen your skill. You could handle the guards easily enough./40d But while you were fighting them, the duke would escape again, wouldn't he?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/006: Let's get to the point. What do you want, miss?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/007: Heh... Now we're getting somewhere./30d One of our agents has found a secret passage into the mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/008: If we go in that way, Duke Ruben won't stand a chance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/009: We seem to want the same thing. Follow my instructions and help us, and I'll show you the secret passage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/010: That won't be difficult./30d/nThen lead us there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_s05/012: There's a sewer behind this tree./30d This way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/001: This is the entrance to the meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/002: There's a strange drawer in the meeting room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/003: The meeting room is the most lavishly decorated room in our Zephyr Falcon base.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/004: The entrance on the left leads to the shop and officers' quarters.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/005: Zephyr Falcon's morale is at its peak, but our enemies seem to be growing stronger too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/006: General Frederick's army in Ron is especially difficult to face.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/008: Sometimes I hear strange noises from one of the tavern walls. Have I had too much to drink?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/009: Before joining Zephyr Falcon, I was a petty thief in Caracas. But I've put all that behind me now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/010: Hmph... He says he's given up stealing? I wouldn't trust him even if he told me the sky was blue.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/011: He's selling the very things that have gone missing from the barracks lately!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/012: Zephyr Falcon's fame has spread far and wide, and our morale is sky-high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/013: We're more than a band bent on revenge, or outlaws who help the poor. We're an organization fighting to transform the Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/014: Lord Frederick's troops in Ron are the last force I'd want to face. Their elite marksmen aim and fire with precision, and their swordsmen are formidable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/015: If the other lords were like him, there'd be no need for us at all. Don't you agree...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/016: I joined because my entire family was massacred. By a lord, no less...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/017: Revenge is the only thing keeping me alive. Without it, I'd have no reason to go on...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/018: As Zephyr Falcon's reputation grows, more and more people try to keep us in check. That's becoming a problem.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/019: Perhaps our reputation exceeds what we're really capable of.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/020: I sometimes hear strange noises in the tavern, even though I don't drink much...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/021: Sometimes I feel there's something on the other side of the tavern... Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/022: These are Zephyr Falcon's women's barracks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/023: We women do our full share as members of Zephyr Falcon. There's no discrimination here. Half our commanders are women, aren't they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/024: Come to think of it, no one knows anything about the leader who founded Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/025: What kind of person could the founder be? A fallen noble whose family was destroyed by the Church? Or someone born a commoner?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/026: When I went into the barracks yesterday, some of my things were missing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/027: After searching for ages, I found out they were being sold on the barracks' black market.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/028: Damn it... I think I know who stole my things and sold them, but I have no proof.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/029: What on earth does Clausewitz write in his notebook?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/030: He always seems to be writing something...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/031: Clausewitz's famous notebook? No one knows what's in it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy01/032: Surely he isn't keeping a list of personal details about us women...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02b/008: Why... Why did you only appear now?/10d/nIf we'd met just a little earlier, Silver...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02b/008_3: Why... Why did you only appear now?!!/10d/nIf we'd met.../15d just a little earlier, Silver...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro02b/011_3: ...Let's get out of Ron first./nOur pursuers are closing in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/000: Where on earth am I?/nI need to find a way out, quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/001: This exit seems to be completely blocked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/003: Damn it... How many hours has it been?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/004: The cave collapsed, and I ended up in this strange place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/005: I can't tell which way to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/006: I need to find a way out, quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/007: Damn... How many hours has it been?/15d/nI can't tell which way to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/008: The cave collapsed, and I ended up here alone.../10d I wonder if the others are all right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/009: Come on, pull yourself together. Find a way out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/010: There are plenty of monsters around here. I'd better equip a pickaxe, at least, to fight them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/007_2: Damn it... How many hours has it been?/15d/nI can't tell which way to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin01a/008_2: The cave collapsed, and I ended up in this strange place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/005: You have no more business with us.../15d/nWhy are you sneaking after us like a stray cat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/008: No.../15d I.../10d You see, the reason is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/009: Ah... Ha ha ha ha.../10d Sigh.../10d Sigh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/011: Ugh... Don't look at me like that!/nWe were fighting together only a little while ago!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/014: Ugh.../10d Why did I come all this way just to be humiliated.../nOh!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/028: Heh heh heh./nRun all you like. You won't get away from me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/029: How dare you plot a rebellion...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/030: What should we do with the children?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s01/037: Please... It's your mother's last... request... Hurry...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s02/000: [Diablo]/nHeh heh heh... You've forced me to reveal my true form for the first time in centuries. Now you must die.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldpx15/006: They say the Phoenix Egg lets you cast powerful Fire magic...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s04/001: It's the song I wrote for you on your last birthday...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s04/002: Ours.../15d/nYes, this song belongs to you and me alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s04/003: Whatever lies ahead, let's live like this song, helping and cherishing each other./30d/nForever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/000: It's been a long time, Lady Frederick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/001: Prince Rashid... Has it been three years? So long already?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/002: You seem to be governing the Empire admirably./30d I'm truly impressed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/003: It would have been difficult without Lord Meditch's help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/004: Ah, Lord Meditch... I see. And is Lady Meditch well too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/005: Isabele is well. She's been a great help to me too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/006: The houses of Frederick and Meditch... It's a relief to see the imperial territories finally settling into stability.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/007: But you laid the foundations for all this, Prince Rashid. You have my heartfelt thanks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/008: I... No. Perhaps I did a little, but I didn't give you all the help I could. I don't deserve your thanks.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/009: The person we must truly remember and thank is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/011: Yes, Cyrano Bernstein. The benefactor of you both, who now lead the imperial territories, and the man who opened our eyes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/012: His great sacrifice laid the true foundation for all this. I'll never forget what he stood for.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/014: When will you return to Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/015: I have no plans to return for a while. Before war flares up again, I mean to visit my homeland.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/016: And visit my father's grave while I'm there...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/018: Yes. It's been about fifteen years since I was last there, and war was still raging when I left. It must have changed a great deal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/019: Then it may be several years before we meet again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/020: I can't say how many years it will be. But I hold Asura, which once belonged to the Empire, so we are sure to meet again someday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/021: In the meantime, I'll work to build a stronger Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/022: I'm sure Christina Frederick won't disappoint me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/024: I wish you success in all you seek.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s02/025: /2cFour years later. The entrance to the underwater city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma11/000: << Crystal Unicorn >>/n/nThe celestial unicorn is a symbol of purity./nOnly one with the purest and noblest soul can win its heart./n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/001: Heh... Cyrano./20d Forgive me for always taking what you hold dear./30d/nThat woman last time... Silver, was it?/15d Such an inflexible woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/002: Don't sully Silver's name with that filthy mouth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/003: You're as inflexible as ever.../20d To think you'd actually go to Mercedes./10d Heh heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/004: Heh heh heh... Cyrano./15d Make no mistake./30d I've changed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/005: I'm no longer the man who could only feel inferior to you, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/006: You'll need more than that to stop me, Iscariot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/007: As I thought... I can't defeat you with ordinary strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/008: But the ultimate power I've gained is another matter!/40d Prepare yourself, Cyrano!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/009: Heh... Cyrano... You've gained the greatest power of all. Far greater than mine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/010: Iscariot... Did you want power so badly that you'd become such a hideous monster?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/011: Isn't that what allowed me to betray you...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/012: In the end, you're a monster just like me... An outcast who can never live among other people...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/014: At least I... can die at your hand... But you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/019: He went to the underwater city to revive the God of Destruction?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s03/020: Iscariot, Cesare's dog.../20d Your death will lay Silver's spirit to rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwst02/000: I don't know whether coming this far is enough training./15d But I'd better return for the third stage before going any further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl22_s3t/000: [Iscariot]/nBehold, Cyrano! This is the mighty power of Grima!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/000: Geysir City was once the imperial capital. Even with its former glory gone, its tax revenues are enormous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/001: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/002: Geysir Cathedral was completed over ten years ago. As I recall, it was a huge project that took a very long time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/003: There have been no religious trials here since it became Church territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/005: Sharon's most recent performance was here in Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/006: The young woman next door is a little strange. Sometimes she's endlessly kind, but at other times she becomes terribly violent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/010: It's bitterly ironic that the Bernstein family was wiped out in the very year Geysir Cathedral was completed. They had donated more to its construction than anyone else.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/011: There's a path in the nearby forest to a cave where a dragon once lived.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/013: There are old underground waterways beneath Geysir Cathedral.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/014: They say the war between Pendragon and the Tuer has recently entered a lull.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/015: Still, the waterways and the dragon's cave are only rumors. No one knows whether they really exist.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/017: Mother says that young woman had a strange temperament even as a child...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/019: Perhaps the Bernstein family was doomed all along. They stood in the way of Lord Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/021: I heard the women saying she became like that after her stepfather abused her. I asked what they meant, but got a terrible scolding...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/024: Geysir City is ruled by Cardinal Cesare now, so of course it's Church territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/026: You can feel Geysir declining. Above all, its population simply isn't growing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/027: Why is that? The Church is far less oppressive in Geysir City than in other cities...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/028: Could people be leaving Geysir City because it has lost its youthful spirit?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/029: Pendragon and the Tuer have been at war for ages. They say sheer numbers are what can hold back the Tuer's tremendous firepower.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/030: I hear Pendragon's overwhelming numbers have checked the Tuer offensive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/031: General Sander is retired from the army. He moved to Geysir City recently. Retired soldiers usually go to Ron, the "City of Soldiers," though...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/032: General Sander has four daughters. They say every one of them is beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/033: The general was apparently very hot-tempered during his military days. They say he still is, to some extent...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/034: General Sander's house is famous for its frequent parties. He certainly belongs in this city of venerable traditions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/035: You really ought to attend one of General Sander's parties...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/036: A great many people gather at his house. General Sander seems to have acquaintances everywhere.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/037: Well, if you still enjoy adventure, you could try looking for that cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/038: I often went looking for the dragon's cave when I was young.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/039: It's been a long time since then, but there hasn't been any news of another performance. I wonder why?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/040: I'd love to see Sharon, my idol, perform again... Surely she isn't giving up singing, as the rumors say?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/041: For a member of Geysir City's garrison, nothing is prouder than the annual military review.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/042: Marching through Geysir's streets gives me a glimpse of what the reviews must have been like when the Black Prince was alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/043: Of course, our little force now can hardly match the splendor of those days, when the army commanded all Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/045: Subversive forces like Zephyr Falcon still have very little influence here. You needn't worry about Geysir's security.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/046: The worst unrest was over ten years ago, when the Bernstein family was wiped out. Their remaining followers kept resisting...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/047: I once served as a soldier under the Bernstein crest. I was on leave when the family was wiped out ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/048: When I heard the Bernstein family's young master was to face a religious trial, I rushed back to Geysir City, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/049: By then, it was all over. The greatest shame of my military life... I was absent from the battlefield while my comrades were wiped out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/050: I'm a mage studying at Iscariot's academy. I've just returned from a trip to Dakama Port in Pendragon territory to obtain research materials.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/051: At Dakama Port, I could see how badly Pendragon's economy is suffering. The war with the Tuer must be taking its toll.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/052: If only the strength of our Empire were united at a time like this... Ah... My Black Prince...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/053: General Sander? My older brother likes his third daughter. All his daughters are beautiful, though the general himself is ugly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/054: Their mother must have been very beautiful, mustn't she? But frankly, I don't like General Sander.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/055: My brother's a doctor. When I say that, he dismisses me as a little kid. But I pride myself on being a good judge of people! He'll learn the hard way someday...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/056: [Dustin]/nI'm a doctor. I fell in love with Priscilla, General Sander's third daughter, after meeting her recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/057: [Dustin]/nBut recently, I saw her brought in on suspicion of taking drugs. She was released after I vouched for her as a doctor, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/058: [Dustin]/nPriscilla must have fallen under the influence of bad people! Isn't there some way to help her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/059: If our shopkeeper has one failing, it's an obsession with sweets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/060: This shop has been handed down through the owner's family for generations. The current owner doesn't seem to love it as much as the last one did.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/061: Father isn't really suited to running a weapon shop. What he loves most is cooking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/062: Father's cousin is looking after the counter. Father is away on business for a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/063: Honestly! My son has no attachment to this fine old shop, handed down through our family! All he thinks about is food...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/064: Do you know Fire Dragon Cave, where Lord Kars slew a dragon and sealed the place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/065: They say Fire Dragon Cave is south of this city.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/066: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. Our inn offers spotless rooms and attentive service. A stay costs 80 Eld. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/068: Please visit us again. We always offer the finest service.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/069: Thank you for staying at our inn. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/070: [Mr. Oldfield] Welcome! We've gathered the finest weapons in the world! Browse to your heart's content!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/072: A good weapon can save your life in a crisis. Please shop with us again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/073: [Mrs. Oldfield]/nWelcome. I help my husband by selling the firearms.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/075: Thank you for shopping with us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/076: [Raymond]/nWelcome! We deal only in the finest goods! Why not try something?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/079: There's a dragon's cave nearby. Sometimes people bring precious ancient treasures out of it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/080: But everyone says those who enter never return. You'd be better off staying away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/081: [Mr. Durant, Merchant]/nCome on, take these leftover goods off my hands! Clearance prices!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/083: Thank you, thank you! On my next trip to Dakama, I'll bring back even better goods for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/084: Hmph! Durant calls it a clearance sale, but his prices aren't even low!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/085: I am traveling in search of enlightenment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/086: Recently, a mysterious light spoke to me beneath a bodhi tree. It said, "Depart."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/087: I won't return until I've found enlightenment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/088: Young people these days have no spirit! In that respect, Lord Frederick of Ron is a fine example to them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/089: Do you neglect your own affairs for other people's? What matters most is fulfillment. You must live a life that satisfies you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/090: As for me, I've lived far too recklessly... I miss my hometown, Pretoria...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/091: Iscariot's Imperial Academy seems to be exploring the limits of magic lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/092: I know who you really are. Do you think all these years have taught me nothing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/093: You watch a monitor and click a mouse. Aren't you a wanderer through time...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/094: Have you heard the legend of the Geysir mansion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/095: The Bernstein family lived there ten years ago. But the family was wiped out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/096: No one has lived there since. The reason is...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/097: Haven't there been an unusual number of traveling merchants lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/098: More families are being bankrupted by the lords, so many turn to peddling to make a living.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/099: Still, things are better here in Geysir City... I don't know how lucky I am.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/100: It's foolish to come down to every basement expecting to find something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/102: Business is terrible these days. Where has everyone's money gone...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/103: If even Geysir City, supposedly one of the better places, is like this... How bad must it be elsewhere?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/104: The economy was never like this while the Black Prince was alive. Look at it now!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/105: The Empire must be reunited! And only our Cardinal Cesare can do it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/106: Hmph... If you want to admire my beauty, bright light won't do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/108: You must never trust a merchant's word!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/109: I'm on leave today, so I've come home to Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/110: My unit is stationed on the far side of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/111: A friend of mine is on duty here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/112: The door to this house is locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/114: [Ancestor of Bors]/nYou have entered a room you should not enter. To leave, answer the following question correctly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/120: [Ancestor of Bors]/nYou are unworthy of a longsword!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/121: [Ancestor of Bors]/nI will let you leave this place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/122: [Ancestor of Bors]/nIn our family's name, you may leave this room. Please look after Bors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/123: [Soldier]/nStamina is a warrior's greatest asset! Run three laps around this city and I'll give you two Brass Gems. Run ten and you'll get a Diamond Gem! But if you leave this area, you'll have to start over! Off you go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/124: [Soldier] Good, you've passed the west gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/125: [Soldier] Good! You've passed the south gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/126: [Soldier] Good! You've passed the east gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/127: [Soldier] Good! You've passed the north gate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/128: [Soldier] Well done! That's one lap! Keep going!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/129: [Soldier] You've finished all ten laps! Come here and I'll give you your reward!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/130: [Soldier]/nGood! That's the discipline of a soldier! Here, take this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/132: You've graduated! Never forget to keep building your stamina!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/133: The forests of the former imperial territories are extremely dense. Travelers should map their route.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/134: Central Square of the Great City of Geysir
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/136: [Soldier] That's three laps! Come here now for two Brass Gems! Keep running and there's another prize!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/139: [Soldier]/nRight... Back to the beginning! Run hard!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/140: [Soldier] That's five laps. Come here now and I'll give you a Brass Gem!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/141: [Soldier]/nStamina is the foundation of a soldier! Never neglect your training!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/142: [Soldier]/nIf you leave, you'll have to start your laps all over again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/010_3: In the year when Geysir Cathedral was completed, the Bernstein family, which contributed the most to the project, was exterminated. This cannot be said to be ironic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/066_3: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome. Our inn offers spotless rooms and attentive service. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01/112_3: There doesn't seem to be anyone in this house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/001: An emergency has arisen./10d/nAt Cardinal Cesare's request, Bifrost has mobilized its army again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/002: They still haven't learned their lesson. This time we'll crush them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/003: This invasion will not be so easy to repel.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/004: They plan to deploy Ascalon, the first-class magic machine they recently excavated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/006: First-class magic machines have a decisive effect on both morale and military strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/007: Conventional tactics won't work against such an opponent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/009: I propose an attack on Mount Mantigoa, where the enemy's main force is stationed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/011: If a small elite force can seize their headquarters in one stroke, we have a good chance of victory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/012: Even so... who will face Ascalon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/013: You needn't worry about that./nI've already prepared several alternatives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/014: And this will be Zephyr Falcon's final operation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/015: Its outcome will decide the fate of Bifrost, the Church's allied forces, and Zephyr Falcon itself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/016: Please keep fighting with all your strength... to the very end.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/017: Everyone, we lost so many comrades in the last battle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/019: Ah, and I have a sword for you, Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/022: "Armada"? Isn't that the next-generation standard-issue sword Pendragon is secretly testing?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl20_s01/023: That's right. This is Chrysaor's new sword, a contender to succeed the "Blitz" you received earlier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/000: << Operation Dragon Strike >>/nInfiltrate the enemy's rear and cut off their supply routes!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/001: I've come to supply you on Clausewitz's orders. Of course, it won't be free.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss01/003: For the glory of the Empire!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro10/000: << Warning >>/nThis dungeon is extremely dangerous. Civilians are forbidden to enter./n- Lord of Ron
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/003: Actually... a letter addressed to you has arrived from Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/004: Hmm... A letter from Frederick's adjutant?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/005: No./20d It's from General Frederick's widow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/008: It was addressed to you, so I thought I should tell you.../50d But I don't believe its contents deserve much attention.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/010: Of course not. But in the present circumstances, the contents of a letter from Ron are hardly difficult to guess.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/011: And if General Frederick's widow wrote it herself, it must be either deeply emotional or brief and cold. One or the other, surely?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/014: /2cDear Cyrano/n/n/n/n/n/nI shall be waiting in my salon in Ron./n/n/n/n/n/nMercedes Frederick
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/017: ...Cyrano./30d Whatever your past with General Frederick and his wife, this invitation is unquestionably a trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/018: But I have no choice. I must go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/019: Cyrano, please think calmly!/30d There's no guarantee she'll even be waiting there! This is surely Cesare's doing!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/020: I am quite calm./nIf you knew how I've lived until now, Clausewitz, you would understand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/021: Even if it costs me everything, I must go there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/027: .../30d Understood. I'll await your considered decision, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/028: Mercedes.../30d But Silver, Kana and Esmeralda, who have followed me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/031: I can't leave without saying goodbye to Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/034: There's no need to think of anything else. Seeing Mercedes is what matters most now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/035: Even if it's Cesare's trap... even if it costs me my life, I will see her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/037: Silver.../40d Yes. After all this time by my side, I can't leave without even saying goodbye to her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/038: She'll certainly try to hold me back. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/042: I can't let you go there alone, Cyrano!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/044: Why... Why are you leaving me behind? If you go there, you won't come back safely!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/045: That's exactly why I can't take you with me, Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/046: You've followed me so faithfully all this time... There have been so many hardships for a woman to bear.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/047: What... What are you saying? Are you really going to leave me behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/048: There is... very little chance I'll return safely. And even if I do, I have no right to bind you to me any longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/050: My final order, Silver./30d Don't hold me back.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/051: I cannot obey such an order!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/052: If you must see that woman.../40d you'll have to step over my corpse!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/054: Even if you cut me down, I'll go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/055: All right, Silver. I won't go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/056: Even if you cut me down, I must go. Seeing her again is what I've lived for all this time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/060: Kana... I may never see her again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/061: No... Perhaps leaving her is better for her sake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/065: Is it true? You received a letter from Frederick's widow, and you're going to see her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/067: Why... Why would you walk into it, knowing it's a trap, Cyrano?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/068: Because that is what's kept me alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/073: If... if I let you go there... I couldn't go on living.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/074: I love you... Cyrano... Please/30d don't go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/076: Move aside, Kana. I must go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/077: Kana, I'll do as you ask. I won't go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/078: Stop pestering me and step aside, Kana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/080: Let go of this hopeless attachment. Loving someone like me will bring you nothing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/082: You're cruel, Cyrano... You can't do this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/083: ...Yes, Kana. I've had you all along.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/086: Esmeralda... Another person who saved my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/087: But I may never see her again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/088: I never knew... you cared for me so much, Silver.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/089: How could I think only of myself, without considering you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/091: I won't go, Silver./30d I'll stay with you always.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/094: What are you saying, Silver? You acted out of concern for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/095: Now, let's forget that letter and prepare for the next operation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/100: ...You know I intend to go there, then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/101: Even if I asked you not to go... it would be no use, would it...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/103: No... If you ask me, Esmeralda...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/104: Yes, my mind is made up./30d The reason I've lived this long is there. I must go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/105: So... it is because of Frederick's widow...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/106: Cyrano... I pray.../40d that you'll return safely.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/108: ...No./40d How could I refuse your request, Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s05/110: I could hardly die without your permission, could I, Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmf05/000: Right, let's use this way to get out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr108/000: They say this place was sealed off after the last incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/001: This is the Bifrost army's logistics base, the one Clausewitz mentioned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/005: [Bifrost Officer]/nDamn... The enemy has reached us here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/007: Come on. Let's take this base at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/008: Does that settle matters here, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/009: Yes./nThe enemy seems to have fully retreated.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/011: A message has arrived from Clausewitz.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/012: Rhidelhard and Meditch's unexpected actions have allowed the Bifrost army to occupy our supply route.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/013: He asks Cyrano and his companions to return to our camp as quickly as possible and retake the supply route.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/015: Don't tell me Meditch and Rhidelhard have...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/016: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/018: The quickest route to our supply line is around the mountains to the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/019: I've come to deliver supplies on Clausewitz's orders.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmi41/021: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy09/001: This way leads toward the Dragon Breath Mountains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcpr100/001: No... You can't be...!/30d Hey! What are you waiting for? Seize him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/000: Today is the young master's engagement ceremony, so everyone in the household is busy with the preparations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/001: The young master is so composed. I'm sure he'll manage without any trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/002: You're a grown man now, young master, with a woman to care for. You must look after yourself even more carefully.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/003: Congratulations, Cyrano! A wife as beautiful as Mercedes... I'm so jealous!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/004: When I grow up, I'll marry Lance too. By then she'll be a lovely lady, just like Mercedes is now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/005: Oh, Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/006: Do you think Joel will be as wonderful as you when he reaches your age?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/007: Today will be the busiest, happiest day for the Bernstein household.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/008: We're all excited to welcome such a beautiful lady to the household. Since our mistress passed away, the Bernsteins have needed someone to preside over the home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/009: Mercedes is renowned for her beauty and impeccable upbringing as a lady, isn't she? It's an honor for us to serve her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/010: Ha ha ha... What a happy day./20d The young master is finally becoming a true man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/011: The young master is charming when he plays the piano, but I've never seen him look as splendid as he does today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/012: I've never felt so happy and moved.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/001_3: The young master is so composed. I'm sure he'll manage without any trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/003_3: Congratulations, Cyrano! A wife as beautiful as Mercedes... I'm so jealous!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/004_3: When I grow up, I'll get engaged to Lance too. By then she'll be a lovely lady, just like Mercedes is now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/005_3: Oh, Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/007_3: Today will be the busiest, happiest day for the Bernstein household.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/008_3: We're all excited to welcome such a beautiful lady to the household. Since our mistress passed away, the Bernsteins have needed someone to preside over the home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/009_3: Mercedes is renowned for her beauty and impeccable upbringing as a lady, isn't she? It's an honor for us to serve her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/010_3: Ha ha ha... What a happy day. The young master is finally becoming a true man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/011_3: I like seeing the young master play the piano, but I've never seen him look as splendid as he does today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber05/012_3: I, Ruth, have never felt so happy and moved.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/002: Surely you don't mean to leave the humiliation of your last campaign unanswered?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/003: This is the perfect chance to destroy the rebels and the lords who support them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/005: And shouldn't you test the capabilities of Ascalon, now that you've successfully unearthed it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/006: Oh, impressive. That information is classified top secret.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/007: Why hesitate?/n/10d Help me reunify the Empire, and I'll grant you half its territory.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/009: We've come this far. There's no choice now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/010: You do go straight to the heart of the matter, Cardinal Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/011: Very well. Then I will mobilize our army and Ascalon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/012: I'll send an envoy to Pendragon with a letter explaining that rebels have thrown the Empire into chaos, and that I therefore requested Bifrost's assistance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/013: As this is an internal affair, even Pendragon cannot readily intervene.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s02/014: Heh... Even without that, Pendragon is occupied with the Tuer war. There's little they could do.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr17/000: Do you know true courage?/nIt is not for the strong to face the weak, certain of victory./nNor is it to deceive yourself for fear of the world's judgment./nEven knowing you will lose,/neven prepared to endure the world's ridicule,/na true man follows the path he believes is right./n/nMay I live without a shred of shame until my dying day.../n- Imperial Knight Kars
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/003: They say Bifrost... has crossed into the imperial territories with a vast army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/004: Hmm... So they've come after all...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/009: Put the entire army on alert!/nWe cannot let Bifrost's troops tread on imperial soil...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/010: We depart at noon tomorrow./nMake thorough preparations. There must be no delay.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/012: So this is why my father-in-law sent Machiavelli to Bifrost...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/013: Even so, bringing in a foreign power is a matter of imperial pride!/15d This I will never tolerate!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/015: The problem is Bifrost's Valkyrie force...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s01/016: First, I must send a messenger to Clausewitz of Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/001: It's the legendary summoned beast, Unicorn!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/005: To... reach... this... place... You... cannot... be... an... ordinary... human.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/007: I... have... no... name./nI... merely... govern... Ice... one... of... the... three... great... elements...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/008: The Ice Dragon Zavier? The one said to accompany Holy King Rashid...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/009: But... enough... of... that... There... are... several... souls... within... your... body.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/011: One... is... a... human... with... a... powerful... will.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/014: Perhaps... you... may... be... able... to... do... it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/016: It... is... a... summoning... seal./nUse... it... and... I... will... lend... you... my... strength... whenever... you... need... it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/022: This... place... is... bitterly... cold./10d/nWith... every... breath... the... cells... in... your... lungs... slowly... freeze.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldma20/023: This place... is filled with terrible cold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/000: Welcome, Cyrano. Lady Eoline has ordered us to keep a bed ready for you at all times. Would you like to rest?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/001: Rest well. Training on Storm Island requires plenty of rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/002: Don't push yourself too hard in training.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfliyo02/003: Did you sleep well? Another fine day awaits. Come back whenever you're tired.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro00/000: East - Ron Forest/nNorthwest - Ron City/nNorth - Demon Sword Forest
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/000: You need someone to stand watch while you sleep out here. Would you like to rest?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/001: Sleep well. We'll keep watch over you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/002: Oh dear... Cross the desert without sleep, and only death awaits you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/003: Did you sleep well? Until next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/004: Welcome. You'll need plenty of equipment to cross the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/007: Welcome. You'll need plenty of equipment to cross the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/010: You'll need plenty of weapons and courage to cross the desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/012: Travel safely. Stay alive out there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/000_3: To rest in the desert, you need someone to stand watch while you sleep. Would you like to stay? Our inn charges 1500 Eld.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/002_3: Oh dear... Are you sure you don't need sleep? Pressing on when you're exhausted could cost you your life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/003_3: Travel safely. Stay alive out there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/006_3: Then good luck... in this desert of death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/013: Looking for Lake Cerepus?/n/20d It's just a short way southeast of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/014: Head straight west for Caracas Forest. Southeast will take you to Cerepus or Lake Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldes04/015: They say the underwater city, one of the Seven Wonders, lies beneath Lake Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/001: It's a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/002: They say Geysir City lies to the south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/009: Have you ever seen Irus wield a sword? He's so powerful!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/011: David? They say he was caught hiding an evil demon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/012: David was a fool to shelter Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/013: Perhaps we'd be better off with a church. Right now, Lord Ruben seems to do whatever he pleases.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/015: Why is there no church in our village? Lord Ruben opposed having one built.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/016: Of course, we follow the Church's faith here too. But Lord Ruben says individual faith is enough; we don't need a church.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/017: Of course, Lord Ruben conducts the religious trials himself... Poor David...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/019: Culture and romance are the true joys of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/020: I don't make secret passages everywhere as a hobby, like Ruben does.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/022: They say the desert sun stays up so long that it seems fixed in one place. Is that true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01a/023: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, is famous for his strange behavior. Duke Ruben here is hardly any better...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/001: Wow! There really was treasure here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/002: Incredible! This should keep us from worrying about military funds for ten years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/003: Ha ha ha! See?/10d/nI told you Clausewitz's information was reliable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/005: Look at this!/10d I've never seen such beautiful diamonds...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/006: Heh heh heh... Clausewitz is remarkable. How did he get a map of a place like this...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/010: It seems... this treasure already has an owner.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/012: Now, don't be like that. Shouldn't good things be shared?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/014: Wh-what do we do now? They'll probably keep coming...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/015: Hmm... Well, there's no other choice now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflgold21/016: Grab what you can and get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme02/000: Something tells me I shouldn't go this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/000: Our lord is a truly violent man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/001: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/002: Our lord is notorious for his violence. Get on his bad side and you're in trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/003: A relative wrote to say they've settled in Libreville. I'm thinking of moving there too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/005: I saw a beautiful woman pass through here recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/006: When the lord goes hunting, he leaves no animals in the forest at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/010: No one taken prisoner in the castle has ever come out alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/011: The lord of Memphis is very violent. Your best bet is to stay out of his sight...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/013: Our rice wine is excellent. You're in for a treat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer has quieted down lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/015: Once I've saved a little money, I may move to Ron... I hate to leave the home I love, but I have to survive. This place...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/019: Always stirring up the village, even as a child...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/026: I have no reason to go there right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/027: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome! Is there anything you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/029: Thank you. I hope to see you again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/030: Someone proposed to me recently. But I'm worried... If we stay here, we'll have to pay the marriage tax.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/031: This used to be a lovely place to live.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/032: But since the current lord took over, he's tormented everyone so badly that life is unbearable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/033: Why, just recently he drove the tailor's family out, saying he didn't like them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/034: They say he beat the tailor so badly he left him crippled, then threw him out. Honestly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/035: I proposed recently, but she turned me down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/036: What hurts is that she married someone in Libreville and moved away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/037: The women of our village don't want to stay. I'm wondering if I'd be better off leaving too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/039: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/040: It's been about ten years since I came here, hasn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/041: I barely escaped with my life and fled here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/043: I'm not sure... Who are you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/045: /nAround the corner, waiting still,/nA new road and a secret door./nThough I have often passed them by,/nOne day, when the time has come,/nWest of the moon, east of the sun,/nI'll walk that hidden path.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/047: [Sid]/nSo it is you... You're well, young master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/048: [Sid]/nNow that I've seen you again, I could die without regrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/049: Sid... It really is you. I heard you'd been kidnapped... Are you all right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/050: [Sid]/nThe kidnapping... The shock left me unable to remember what happened then. But I'm all right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/051: [Sid]/nAh... yes. Young master, I have something to return to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/052: [Sid]/nThis is... your family's treasured sword. I kept it safe through the turmoil back then. At last, it has found its owner again...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/054: [Sid]/nI hope that sword will be of some help to you, young master. Well then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/057: [Edros]/nI dream of having a shop of my own... Looking for anything?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/059: Thank you. When I have my own shop, I'll give you a wonderful bargain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/062: Tell me whenever you're feeling ill!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/063: Sid, the man in the house at the upper left of the village, is a little strange.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/064: He lives alone... and always looks so sad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/065: The forest seems to be growing denser lately. So many people get lost that they had to put up signs!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/066: Follow the signs carefully if you don't want to get lost in the forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/067: [Guesthouse Owner] Welcome! Our family takes in travelers and gives them a comfortable place to rest. Only 80 Eld! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/069: Hmph... You won't find anywhere cheaper than here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/070: Travel safely. May peace and good fortune attend you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/033_3: Why, recently the lord drove the tailor's family out, simply because he didn't like them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/036_3: What hurts is that she married someone in Libreville and moved away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/037_3: The women of our village don't want to stay. I'm wondering if I should leave too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/039_3: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/040_3: It's been about ten years since I came here, hasn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/041_3: I barely escaped with my life...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme01/049_3: Sid... It really is you. I heard you'd been kidnapped... Are you all right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/000: Are you from Zephyr Falcon?/30d/nOur lady has been expecting you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/001: Have the other Falcon members arrived too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/005: Yes, everyone is here except Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/006: As expected... Meditch is late again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/007: It may be quite a while before Meditch arrives./20d Perhaps you should meet our host, Lady Esther Dodd, first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s03/008: Very well. I'll meet our host.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s2b/000: Something tells me I shouldn't enter here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/000: At last, I've reached the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/001: What are you going to do next?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/002: I'll need to find out how things have changed in the empire since I left.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/003: If I remember correctly, this is the Caracas region...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/005: Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for you, Kana Milanovich!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/006: A Zephyr Falcon unit commander! A bigger catch than I'd expected!/30d Now surrender without a fight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/007: Damn, so it was a trap after all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/008: But this is the only road to the duke's lands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/009: Hey! Over here, over here! Hit them in the flank!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/010: What?! More of them over there!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/011: Good! Don't let them escape either! We'll wipe them all out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/012: What's that girl playing at?!/20d Dragging innocent bystanders into this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/013: Heh. That girl certainly takes risks.../20d But if the soldiers are blocking our way, there's no reason to avoid a fight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/014: I'm sorry for dragging you into this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/015: Hmph, you might as well stab someone first and then say sorry!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/016: Is that all the soldiers dealt with, then?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/017: Thank you so much for your help, but I'm in a hurry. I have to go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/020: Well, I'll take it as a welcome home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/021: Now, there should be a small village nearby./30d Let's stay there tonight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl06_xx/023: Tsk! They were lying in ambush!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldri13/000: << Thunder Nightmare >>/n/nIn the beginning was chaos./nA single flash of lightning pierced it.../nHere is sealed the demon king who governs lightning./n/nYear 705 of the Esghar calendar, Adventurer King Yggd Fein
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/001: This is Paro Village. We're quite close to Geysir City, but our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/002: Unlike the troubled world outside, our village is peaceful and quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/003: It's dreadful. The most handsome man in the village has developed a mental illness... And he's engaged, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/004: We're rather remote, so we don't get many visitors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/005: But a chef moved here from elsewhere recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/006: The chef was looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine, and apparently liked how clean it is here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/007: I was once invited to Geysir City and went to visit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/008: The wide streets, beautiful buildings and splendid people were dazzling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/009: Living in a city must be so much more wonderful than living in a country village like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/010: In a small village like ours, bandits are the greater worry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/011: It's all the fault of the Silver Arrow Alliance that destroyed our Geysir Empire. If only they hadn't ended our royal bloodline...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/012: It may be late, but shouldn't we form a single nation, or an alliance? How long must this disorder last?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/013: I knew it! Haven't I always said Dan Waring wasn't in his right mind?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/014: Brian really has everything: looks, money, brains, athletic talent... How can anyone be so wonderful?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/015: Ah... I'm so jealous of Diana. They must be so happy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/016: Our lord seems very fond of children. There are so many in his house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/017: But strangely enough, they're all girls.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/018: He likes flowers too. They say his garden is full of them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/019: I've seen Sharon perform too./20d She was so beautiful... And such a good dancer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/020: I wanted her autograph, but all the older boys pushed ahead of me. I never got one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/021: If you meet Sharon, could you get her autograph for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/022: [Dan Waring]/nOur family is cursed./15d I opposed my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/023: [Dan Waring]/nAfter everything that's happened, my son seems to understand our bloodline now./10d Heh heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/024: [Dan Waring]/nNow this cursed family line will end.../10d Heh heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm finished. To have done something so terrible with my own hands.../20d Marriage?/10d I was a fool to hope for that!/15d Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need your words of comfort. Don't try to persuade me./20d Death is all I have left...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/027: [Diana]/nNo, he can't have lost his mind. I mean it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/028: [Diana]/nSomething is wrong here.../20d Brian has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/030: [Haisen]/nOh, Cyrano! I'm well. Brian and Diana asked me to send you their regards.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/031: [Haisen]/nDan... He wasn't so strange when he was young. Cheerful, brilliant at every sport, clever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/032: [Haisen]/nLooking back now, it's truly a pity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/033: Shouldn't we build one united nation too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/034: With this power vacuum, nothing that happens would surprise me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/035: What's more shocking is that the pieces were found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/036: Welcome! Whatever else you may think, we certainly serve generous portions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/037: Where could Rashid III, first in line to Pendragon's throne, have gone into hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/038: Well, King Rashid is still hale and hearty, so he won't inherit the throne soon... But if he ever visits my place, I'll give him plenty of snacks on the house...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/039: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant in Caracas, near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/040: He's a fine cook, but far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/041: Whenever he gets the chance, he pesters me to find good ingredients for him too. Ha ha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/042: Ho ho ho... Do you think someone who can rule the Empire will truly emerge soon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/043: To rule the Empire, wouldn't one need a force strong enough to defeat Cesare Borgia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/044: They say someone has drawn Asura, the sword that decides the Empire's ruler... But a rumor is only a rumor, isn't it? Ho ho ho.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/046: I got Sharon's autograph at her last performance. Heh heh heh... I'm the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/047: I won't sell it, whatever you offer./15d I'll pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/048: Hmm... I might consider it if you brought something truly special. A fragment of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/049: Diana is the village's greatest beauty. Every man here admires her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/050: When she announced she would marry Brian, who was admired by every woman in the village, there was so much gossip...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/051: In a way, no one welcomed their engagement except the couple themselves.../20d Everyone envied them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/052: Welcome. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/054: Thank you for shopping with us. Safe travels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/056: You're giving it to me, aren't you?/10d Oh, I'm so happy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/057: I'll give you something in return!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/059: I found this ring in the forest recently! Isn't it pretty?/20d Thank you for the autograph!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/060: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/061: It's a flower said to bloom only where true love takes root. The herb is very rare, so keep it safe and deliver it to my younger brother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/063: Would you like to rest? Our master offers hospitality to visitors. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/069: I'll have more fine goods for you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/070: Wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCrimes: Arson and murder/nBounty: 1,000,000 Eld
