Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/071: Will you agree to get Sharon's autograph for the girl?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/072: If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/073: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/074: All right. If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/076: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/077: Besides, an autograph means more if you get it yourself./20d Don't ask someone else. Go and find Sharon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/078: Aww... That's mean.../10d I'm too young to travel!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/079: Thank you./nDon't forget your promise to get the autograph for me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/081: Life here may not be glamorous, but we take pride in living peacefully and quietly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/082: [Brian Waring]/nMove! Go away! Please, just leave me alone!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/083: In that respect, perhaps the Church does help maintain order, doesn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/084: [Brian Waring]/nIt first happened last autumn. On the evening of the village festival, I got terribly drunk./10d I ate and drank without knowing what I was doing. When I came to my senses, I was at home. I went to the washroom to cool my aching head... and there was blood on my hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/085: [Brian Waring]/nI thought I might have hurt myself, so I checked my whole body. Not a single wound. The next day, I heard a wolf had raided a village farm, killed chickens and livestock, then fled./10d But... but I sensed it wasn't a wolf.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/086: [Brian Waring]/nAt first, I told myself it had only been a terrible dream. But it kept happening.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow I'm afraid to wake up. When I find my room torn apart, or my hands stained with blood, I become truly, truly afraid of myself./10d I'm scared.../10d So scared... Now I'm afraid even to sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/088: [Brian Waring]/nMarriage! Ha... ha ha ha! One day I might wake to find my beloved Diana, with my own hands... No! No, never that! I cannot marry./10d Not while this cursed blood flows in me. Heh... heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/089: [Dan Waring]/n...Mental illness has run in our family for generations. The price of marrying within the family to preserve our bloodline... Such a line should vanish from the world. Don't you agree?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/090: [Diana]/nBrian has lost his mind? That's absurd! Only a year ago, there was nothing wrong with him at all!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/091: [Diana]/nWe first met at Geysir Academy. I was looking for a quiet country village, so I moved here. We became engaged about a year after I arrived.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/092: [Haisen]/nBut Diana, someone who's lost their mind isn't always like that. The episodes come and go.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If something really is wrong with him, why won't he even see a doctor? If he's ill, can't he be cured?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/094: [Haisen]/nIt isn't something that can be cured, Diana. It's inherited in that family...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/095: [Diana]/nNo! No, that can't be true! I'll cure him! Whatever it takes, I will!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/096: The Warings? That family has been cursed for ages. No one in it has met a normal death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/097: For instance, Dan's parents disappeared. And his wife died when their boat overturned while they were out on the water together, didn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/098: When Dan's wife died, there were rumors that he'd pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/099: And now it's his son's turn? Poor boy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/100: It seems that family really does have some hereditary problem.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/101: You could say that. But perhaps the real cause is how wealthy they are?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/102: You mean they're ill because they're too rich?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/103: Not exactly... That family has always been full of plots over inheritance and succession. Perhaps that's why they behave so strangely?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/104: Come to think of it, wasn't there once some doubt that Brian was really Dan's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/106: So they married within the family to avoid disputes, and that led to an inherited illness...? Money isn't always a blessing, is it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/107: [Dan Waring]/nI opposed my son's marriage from the start. It could never be allowed. Heh heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/108: Excuse me. I'm going to visit Dan and would like to take him a gift. What would you recommend?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/109: A family full of plots... I'd like to learn more. Perhaps someone else could tell me something?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, Dan Waring? His eyesight has been poor lately, and he's taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/111: [Pharmacy Owner]/nPerhaps he's distracted by his son's troubles, but he hasn't come in, though it's time for more. It might be a good gift to take him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/112: Datura... Isn't that a dangerous poison?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt's all right. He's taken it for a long time and knows the dosage well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/117: So... he was behind it. I'll go to the Waring house... This must be settled.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/118: Excuse me. Do you know anything about the Waring family?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/119: The Warings? Of course! They've always been trouble. I knew it when Rachel married into the family. Their marriages have never felt right... Even this one...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/120: (If I let her go on, she'll never stop.)/nAh... Who is Rachel, ma'am?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/121: Rachel? Dan's wife. Haisen loved her too. When Dan married Rachel, poor Haisen went away on a long journey. He's only recently returned. But not long after he left, trouble began...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/123: Rachel gave birth to Brian, a little earlier than expected. People whispered that he might not really be Dan's son. Dan did publicly acknowledge him later, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/124: People suspected something between Rachel and Haisen, but Haisen wasn't here, so it all came to nothing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/125: Well, I'm not saying it happened... Only that it could have, you know? Oh dear, listen to me gossiping like this to a stranger... Well then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/126: Intriguing. A family touched by madness, with such a tangled history... Now the father seems suspicious. I'll investigate further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/127: [Brian Waring]/nDo you have business with this madman?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/128: A madman... In a way, is anyone in this world truly sane? But you are.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat... What do you mean, I'm sane?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/131: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWelcome. What can I get you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/132: The village pharmacy... If someone has deliberately caused Brian Waring's condition, perhaps I'll find a clue here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/134: I haven't seen you before. Is this your first visit to our village?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/135: Yes, I've never been here before. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/138: [Diana]/nHe did grow increasingly gloomy about a year ago, and eventually began saying strange things. But to me, he seems perfectly sane.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/140: Ask about the background of the incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/141: You mean Brian Waring might not be Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/142: What's the matter? I'll help however I can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/144: Ask who has bought potent poisons recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/145: Ask what gift Dan Waring would like.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/146: I know this may be an imposition, but could I have a list of people who recently bought potent poisons?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Do you look down on us because we're a small village pharmacy? We have professional ethics too. Do you expect us to hand over such information to a complete stranger?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf that's all you mean to ask, get out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/150: Damn... I won't be getting any information from the pharmacy now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/151: [Mr. Haisen]/nDiana, you mustn't do this. Let's go home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/152: No, this is fortunate. Please hear me out, Haisen, and you too, Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/153: First, let me make this clear: Brian Waring is not mentally ill. He has been caught in a trap set by someone who wanted him to appear mad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/155: [Dan Waring]/nWhat nonsense! My son needs complete rest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/157: You've traveled for many years, Haisen. Surely you've heard of a plant called datura?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/158: [Mr. Haisen]/nDatura? A deadly poison that causes hallucinations, isn't it? Too much can kill...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/159: [Brian Waring]/nNow I can't taste anything I eat or drink. My head always feels heavy, and my mouth is bitter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/160: Exactly. Datura is bitter, and headaches and dizziness persist even after the hallucinations wear off./nHasn't Brian Waring been complaining of a bitter taste and dizziness lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/162: And you, Dan Waring... Haven't you been taking datura medicine lately?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/166: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you saying...? I do take datura medicine, but why would I harm my own son...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/167: Even if he isn't your son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/168: [Brian Waring]/nWhat are you saying...?! He is my father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/169: Haisen may know the answer to that better than anyone. Isn't that right, Haisen?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/173: [Dan Waring]/nWhy... Why do you call me Father? Who could understand my shock and rage when Rachel told me she was pregnant?! I was unable to father a child!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/175: [Dan Waring]/nYour mother... At the lake, with these hands... No! No, it wasn't me! She jumped in! Yes, she jumped in herself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/176: So your resentment led you to poison your son, make him hallucinate, and stage all this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/177: Haisen, aren't you Brian's real father? Dan's jealousy led him to give Brian datura, induce hallucinations, and make him appear mad. His mother's death was probably no simple accident either. Isn't that right, Dan Waring?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/178: [Dan Waring]/nDamn it, my head hurts! I must go to the pharmacy for medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/181: Dan Waring... has gone to seek his own answer. You mustn't follow him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/182: Then will you leave this place, Brian?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I'd like to travel for a while and clear my head. With my beloved Diana, of course... Ah, wait a moment. This way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is a family heirloom. It holds sad memories for us, but I believe it could bring you happy ones. I'd be grateful if you'd accept it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/187: Diana's house. She must be away traveling now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/188: The Waring house. Its residents must be away traveling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/189: Do you know anything about Diana?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/190: Diana? She followed Brian here about two years ago, after he'd gone to Geysir to study. They seem to have met while he was a student.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/191: But with her natural beauty and bright, outgoing manner, she drew every man's attention as soon as she arrived. Well, they weren't engaged then...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/192: Hmph... It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say every young man in the village courted her. Honestly, men...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/193: [Tavern Owner]/nBut isn't it strange that nobody knows anything about Diana's past? She still lives alone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/194: Come to think of it, I heard a young man tried to court her behind the party venue and was turned down very coldly. Didn't she say, "I don't want anything to do with a fellow who has neither power nor money"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/195: I heard she rejected him because he tried to drag her away by force. The rumor seems to have become rather twisted.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/196: [Tavern Owner]/nWho can know a woman's heart...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/197: I'd like to hear about Brian Waring's broken engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/198: That? Diana and Brian became engaged about a year ago. Then recently, Brian suddenly called it off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/199: He said it was because of his mental illness! It caused quite a sensation here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/200: [Tavern Owner]/nFrankly, no one welcomed the engagement except the couple. His father's madness was well known, and nobody wanted Waring wealth going to an outsider, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/201: But did Brian really become mentally ill? His behavior has certainly been strange lately...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/202: Livestock have been killed on the farms again and again lately. They say Brian did it all. Would a sane person do that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/203: [Tavern Owner]/nIt's true that something doesn't quite add up, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/204: Then Brian and Dan Waring, father and son, always had something strange about them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we'll meet again on our travels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/206: What a shock, that Dan Waring was behind it! Then the family's true bloodline has ended.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/207: A toast to Diana's newfound happiness... and to those left behind...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/208: Welcome. Our mistress Diana has instructed us to offer visiting guests a free bed. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01_/211: The Waring house. Brian Waring, its owner, is traveling with Diana. It's empty and locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/002: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nWe're surveying the forests and mountains near Ron again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/003: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nLooking for Ron? Head west from here, then south, then keep going west.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/004: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nRon and Geysir are far apart. From Geysir, you must cross Geysir Forest, pass through the Ron mountains, then cross Ron Forest. This is about two-thirds of the way between them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/005: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nFor Geysir, head south, then keep going east until you reach the forest. Continue east inside it. When the way is blocked, keep heading north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/006: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nKeep heading north from here to enter Ron Dungeon. It's long been famous as a mine for rough diamonds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro08/007: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nFor Memphis Village, head toward Geysir. At the second fork in the forest, go north, then head straight south at the first fork after that. For Nicosia, go north from the fork for Memphis, then east at the next fork.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/000: Have you changed your mind yet, Esmeralda?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/002: Hey, won't you even answer me now?/30d Hmm?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/003: Listen, Esmeralda... Obey me, and you can live in wealth and splendor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/004: A man of my standing offers you his affection, and you dare refuse so firmly?/30d Hmm?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/007: You are a pitiable man.../30d Do you think money can buy someone's heart?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/008: You... Insolent woman... How dare you, before me...!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s04/009: Speak out of turn once more,/20d and I'll make sure you never utter another word.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka15a/001: Nicosia lies beyond Geysir City, at the continent's southern tip./nI'd better find Geysir City first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga04a/002: Fire Dragon Cave is this way!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/002: If we don't get out of here quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/003: This way has been sealed off. Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/005: This way has been sealed off. Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/006: This is the staircase leading to Frederick's mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/007: ...Let's hurry and get out of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/009: Thank goodness./nIf we can get out this way...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/014: Heh heh heh... You've fallen into my trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/017: My name is Iscariot. An old friend of Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/019: Well, what will you do now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/020: Hand my friend over willingly, and I guarantee your lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/025: (Go!/nYou know better than anyone, Kana, that we can't fight together.)
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/027: (Don't worry. I won't push myself too far.../nI'll follow soon. Wait for me.)
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/003_3: This way has been sealed off. Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/005_3: This way has been sealed off. Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/007_3: ...Let's hurry and get out of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/009_3: Thank goodness./10d/nThis way hasn't been sealed off yet./10d/nIf we can escape here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/014_3: Heh heh heh... You've fallen into my trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltro01b/017_3: My name is Iscariot./10d/nAn old friend of Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/000: Lady Esther Dodd has a beauty that captivates people. As a citizen of Libreville, I can't help feeling proud.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/001: It's surprisingly warm for so far north. We citizens call it "Esther Dodd's breeze."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/003: They say Lady Esther Dodd comes from a venerable family. How else could she have such grace?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/005: Trade between the two countries used to be modest, but a great deal of goods has been moving lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/009: My family runs an inn, so I meet all sorts of people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/010: There's been a lot of traffic from the north lately. We run an inn, and we're getting far more guests coming down from Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/012: Have you heard of Josephine, the favorite concubine of Bifrost's archduke? There are all sorts of rumors about her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/013: Some say she's from a common family here. Others say she was a prostitute in Geysir... Whatever the truth, she certainly isn't of high birth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/015: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/016: The Tuer staked the war on their superior technology. Pendragon, fighting on its own soil, used abundant resources and sheer numbers to wage a long war. They say neither side has prevailed, and fighting is now in a lull.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/017: I know Nikacha of Cerepus too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/018: At my age, you look back on your life. What have I done with all these years? What kind of person am I...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/019: Come to think of it... I heard strange noises beneath the arena recently. Am I getting too old...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/020: People here aren't much for physical training. That worries me... In a crisis, what matters most is strength and money, isn't it? Our people are far too weak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/026: They say the war between Pendragon and the Tuer has passed its fiercest stage. Is that right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/027: Libreville's main income comes from trade between Bifrost and the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/028: They say a man who sees Lady Esther Dodd once can never forget her face.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/029: Well, I'm a woman, so I can't speak for the men... But our lady certainly is beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/030: Welcome! Our arena always offers entertainment at affordable prices...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/031: Of all the kings of the past, surely Yggd Fein, the Adventurer King, has the most legends to his name?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/032: The Black Prince left remarkable legends on his journey as a knight in training. But Yggd Fein seems to have left plenty of stories even while on the throne.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/033: Heh... What is there to fear from a backwater like Bifrost? At the Empire's height, we could have had them for breakfast...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/034: Besides, through all their long history, haven't they known only defense?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/035: Oh... Haven't you heard that the strongest things break most easily?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/036: Being too strong is never a virtue. They say softness overcomes strength, don't they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/039: Thank you for buying our weapons. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/040: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome. Looking for something particular? I'll help you find it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/042: Thank you for shopping at Libreville's finest store. Please visit us anytime.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/043: Have you heard the strange noises near the arena? Is it even operating these days?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/044: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome. Libreville Inn offers the cleanest rooms in northern Geysir. Only 150 Eld! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/045: Thank you. Have a comfortable night. Libreville Inn always offers the finest service.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/046: Whenever you visit Libreville again, please come and see us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/047: Thank you for staying with us. Whenever you're in Libreville, you're welcome here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/048: They say Esther Dodd's mansion once had a passage into a strange cave. It's sealed off now, though...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/049: I once heard strange sounds near the arena at night. Nobody goes there anymore, but it makes me terribly uneasy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/050: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/052: Yggd Fein explored the world's remotest places despite being a king. They say he disappeared in the Demon Sword Tower.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/053: A colleague at work says he likes me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/054: But the problem is, he's younger than I am. Five whole years younger...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/055: I've been worrying about it lately. He's more like a little brother to me than a lover... How could we ever be a couple?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/056: The arena door is secured with an unusual lock.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/057: Cheers to peace in beautiful Libreville!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/058: A toast to Lady Esther Dodd of our beautiful Libreville!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/059: And a toast to you, my beauty!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/060: [Gustav]/nThe arena here in town? I used to go there quite often, but the people here have no interest in physical training. It closed a little while ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/061: [Gustav]/nWell... some people say they've heard strange noises there, but I don't really believe them. If you're that curious, why not talk to the owner? He's friends with the weapon shop owner and spends a lot of time there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/062: [Mr. Emery]/nThe arena owner? He comes here all the time, but he hasn't been in today. Says he's not feeling well, apparently. He's been saying some strange things lately... I think having to close his business really upset him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/064: [Mr. Emery]/nIn the northern block, in the house across from the stairs leading down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/065: Shall I try the key I found on the desk earlier?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/067: Do you know the mysterious story behind the Chaos Cube?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/068: Long ago, the Chaos Cube was a star in the sky. There were many wars then, just as there are now. One day, a young woman whose lover was going off to war stood by a lake and wished upon that star. "Please protect my lover on the battlefield," she prayed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/069: Moved by the young woman's pure heart, the star replied, "I can grant your request, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/070: Do you know the story of the Chaos Cube? Long ago, when war raged endlessly across this land, there were two lovers. Her name was Awen, and his was Al. They had promised to marry, but Al was called away to war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/071: Awen prayed to the star for Al's safety, over and over again. Moved by her devotion, the star spoke to her one day. "Do you truly have the courage to save him? If so, enter the lake behind the village."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/072: Someone else will tell you what happened next...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/073: Mr. Jones sent me. Could you give me some liquor for him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/074: [Tavern Keeper]/NJones...? Forget it. Are you trying to ruin my business? Whenever his wife catches him drinking, she comes here and raises hell!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/075: But Mr. Jones gave me this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/076: I placed the Brass Gem on the counter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/077: Uh... is that a Brass Gem? Ha, hahahaha! Well, the man does have it rough, with a wife like that. Take away his drinking, and what pleasure does he have left in life?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/079: Make sure it gets to him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/080: There's a beautiful legend about the Chaos Cube.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/081: A very beautiful, very sad one...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/082: But I don't like the people of Bifrost. Those frightening eyes, the way they glare at you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/083: Still, her beauty and charm must be remarkable. They call her and our Lady Esther Dodd the two beauties of the North. She could never match Lady Esther Dodd's grace, of course.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/084: Well, it hardly concerns us here in Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/085: Are the rumors of a Bifrost invasion really true? I hate war...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/086: Hohoho! I suppose no man can resist a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/087: A little offensive from Bifrost? Surely Libreville alone could hold them off! Hahaha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/088: I hear Bifrost is planning to invade Libreville. Is that true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/089: I'm truly afraid of war. That gentleman over there scoffs at Bifrost's military strength, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/090: What really frightens me is someone like him, full of empty bravado. All talk, and never a thing to show for it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/091: It's the same with weapons. A weapon isn't necessarily good just because it's expensive and sturdy. Still, expensive weapons have the advantage of lasting a long time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/092: The strange noises started just after the arena closed down. Late in the evening, when everyone was home.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/093: The sounds seemed otherworldly. At times they were like the wind, at others like moaning, echoing ominously through the night.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/094: Could there be another world beneath Libreville? I'm terrified. What if something suddenly comes out of it one day?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/095: I've been to Antananarivo. It's a small village, but the people are terribly rough.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/096: Perhaps all those years of war have left their mark on them. Still, it was quiet there for a while after our empire fell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/097: With no armies advancing into Bifrost, the village was fairly quiet... But now there are rumors of Bifrost marching south, and I'm worried.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/098: I'm sorry. You mustn't come in that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/009_3: A friend of mine is moving to Caracas. What could they possibly want in a backwater village like that...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/012_3: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/013_3: Lady Esther Dodd and Josephine of Bifrost are known as the two beauties of the north.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/016_3: They say the Tuer's technology is truly remarkable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/020_3: Have you heard of the Chaos Cube? They say it's an extraordinary item.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/031_3: Bifrost's recent movements are very suspicious. Their military buildup is the biggest concern...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/032_3: Perhaps Bifrost's suspicious movements mean their expansionist ambitions are becoming increasingly clear.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/040_3: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/042_3: Thank you for shopping at Libreville's finest store.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/044_3: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome. Our inn here in Libreville offers the cleanest rooms in northern Geysir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri01/045_3: Thank you. Have a restful night.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/000: [Cesare]/nWith the God of Destruction's power,/30d I am no longer human. I am a god!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/001: [Cesare]/nTo oppose me is blasphemy! Atonement can only come through death!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl26_s04/002: Even a true god would find no mercy from me./30d Your time has come, Cesare!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx23/000: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx23/001: << Phoenix Cave >>/nOnce every 1000 years,/nthe phoenix burns its own body/nto bring forth new life./n/nTo gain what is most precious,/none must sacrifice what one holds most dear.../n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/000: This is the magic machine Asura!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/002: So Cesare really has been building magic machines in secret!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/003: Let's destroy it before it's fully operational!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/004: The Church is even building magic machines...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/006: Forgive me, but could I join the Zephyr Falcon too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/007: Why do you want to join our cause?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/008: I can't explain all my reasons, but I wholeheartedly share your ideals./nPlease let me join the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcni12/009: For now, let's return to the base together and discuss it with the Advisor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx13/000: North - Mountain Summit/nSouth - Pretoria Village/nEast - Caracas, Geysir
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka11a/000: This way leads to Libreville./nNicosia is said to lie in the south of the continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka11a/001: This way leads to Libreville./nPretoria is to the west.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/000: There are rumors of suspicious movements in Bifrost. Their current ruler, Grand Duke Moser II, seems far too ambitious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/001: It began under the previous Grand Duke, but by now Bifrost's Senate system has effectively collapsed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/002: An ambitious man who trusts in his own abilities can easily shake the Senate system. All the more so when people are looking for a hero...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/003: We'll have to face Lord Frederick. He stands at the head of Geysir's lords. Until we've defeated him, we cannot subdue the others.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/004: Lord Frederick's strength comes from his sound governance. His people trust him, and his soldiers' morale is high.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/005: To the empire's everlasting glory and prosperity! We can be the heart that brings everyone's strength together!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/006: To the prosperity of the empire and its people!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/007: Hmph... Can we really change the course of the empire's history?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/008: I'm only part of this group to pursue my own revenge. For the people of the empire? Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/009: Sometimes I hear strange noises around here. Am I imagining them...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/010: I must be drinking too much lately. Whenever I leave here after a drink, my ears ring and I feel strange...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy03/011: I once saw a friend get sucked through the wall. Of course, I must have been so drunk I imagined it... but it looked so real...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/001: [???]/nHmm... It's been a very long time since anyone came here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/003: [???]/nUnfortunately, it seems I am. You don't look like one of their underlings. How did you get in here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/004: Who are you? And by "they," do you mean the Church?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/005: [???]/nOne question at a time. You show little consideration for others.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/006: [???]/nFirst, I know nothing of this Church you mention. And my name is Deimos.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/007: Deimos... I've heard that name before... In any case, you must have been imprisoned here far longer than I have, if you don't know the Church that holds sway throughout the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/008: [Deimos]/nYou keep bringing up the Church. I take it you were imprisoned for opposing them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/009: Opposing them...? If that were the case, I would have no cause to feel wronged. Cardinal Cesare, the man behind the Church's rise to power, was my fiancee's father.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/010: [Deimos]/nThen you must have done something that greatly threatened the cardinal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/011: No. I merely tried to study the truth of history. How could that possibly threaten the Church?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/013: [Deimos]/nBut this historical truth... What exactly were you trying to uncover?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/014: I was only studying the Secret Records of the Creation War, a history written by a sage of the old empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/015: [Deimos]/nOh, you've studied the Creation War? Then perhaps you know of me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/017: [Deimos]/nSurely you've seen my name in that book?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/019: You're Deimos, the leader of the Dark Gods!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/021: You're truly a Dark God?/30d I can't believe it... So the Secret Records of the Creation War really were true!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/022: [Deimos]/nIn any case, I'd rather hear the rest of your story. Perhaps I can answer the question that's troubling you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/023: About the false charges against me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s04/024: [Deimos]/nIt seems it's time. If we meet again, will you tell me the whole story?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/001: Mom, why is that man there?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/004: Don't ever talk to someone like that again. Understand?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/005: That's strange. He gave me candy just a little while ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/007: He's a very wicked man who takes good little children away and eats them!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/009: To think the eldest son of the distinguished Bernstein family is a devil worshipper.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/010: There's a limit to how much shame you can bring on your family!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s12/013: I never imagined you could be.../10d such a person.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/001: Yes./nHe turned his army back when he could have wiped out the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/003: Tsk, tsk... He was nothing but a mercenary captain until I raised him to this position. And this is the gratitude he shows me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/004: After this, it seems I can't trust him either.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/005: I hear he also strongly opposed sending Lady Christina to marry in Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/006: Fool./20d Does he think he can keep his daughter by his side forever?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/007: A daughter is a political tool, after all./30d /nIf he cannot use his greatest asset, he hardly deserves to be called the empire's overlord.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/008: Then do we have no choice but to turn to Bifrost?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/009: Has there been any word from Josephine lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/010: Moser II seems to be thoroughly infatuated with Josephine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/011: They say most of the opposition has been eliminated by the dark assassins Your Eminence sent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/012: Then it's your turn to make yourself useful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/013: You want me to bring in Bifrost's army.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/014: But wouldn't that be rather dangerous?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/015: It'll be fine. Moser is easy to manipulate./nIf we use this opportunity well, we can take Bifrost itself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/016: Lord Frederick won't take that lying down...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/017: Don't worry./15d I've already made arrangements to deal with him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/018: When will we reunite the imperial territories under Your Eminence's leadership and restore the empire's glory and peace?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/019: Soon. The day we achieve our great ambition is drawing near...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/020: Fools may refuse to acknowledge our greatness now, but history will give our achievements their due.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/023: Hehehe.../25d /nJust a little longer... and my ambition will be fulfilled.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/024: The Zephyr Falcon, Frederick... none of them can stop me./nHehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s01/026: Soon, the empire,/15d Bifrost, Pendragon, Astania.../20d all of Antalya will be reborn as one mighty nation!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/001: It's a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/002: I heard that Geysir City is south of here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01_/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga01b/002: The cathedral is in the east of the city./nCesare should be there!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka12e/001: We must go and find the treasure./nGeysir Forest lies farther south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck01/000: This way leads to the village./nLet's find a way into the mansion, quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/000: ...So I'll leave things here to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/001: Don't worry about things here./10d/nThe Grand Duke is waiting. You should hurry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/004: You're a moment too late,/nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/006: My name is Catalina./nI command Bifrost's Valkyries.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/007: I've taken an interest in you for some time./nThey say you're the empire's finest swordsman...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/008: To pass this way, you'll have to defeat me, Bifrost's finest swordswoman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/010: I'm in a hurry. I'll make this quick.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/012: All that boasting, and look at you now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/016: [Catalina] /nCyrano Bernstein. I will never forget this humiliation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma13a/019: That took longer than I expected. I wonder if I can still catch Machiavelli...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/003: Bring back enough sulfur, and I'll let you rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/004: Hehehe... How many will make it out alive today?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/005: Vermin like you should be mining sulfur for the state!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/006: If you don't want to work, try escaping./15d If you can, that is./nHehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/009: Where do you think you're going, No. 102?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/010: Did you think you could leave without doing any work?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/011: So you've finally all dragged yourselves here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/013: Keep moving unless you want to end up like those 13.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/014: You're traitors to the state./nI'll make sure you pay dearly for your crimes here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/015: Of the 20 men in Group 12 who went to work yesterday, only 7 came back alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/017: Then stop dawdling and get moving!/nYou scum!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/018: Tch... Having to deal with scum like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/022: You bastard!/nTrying to slack off again?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/023: Stop faking it and get up!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/028: If he's dead, get the body out of here before it starts to rot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s03/032: Then get your hide into the sulfur mines, too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/001: Hehehe./15d /nThose Zephyr Falcon fools are running for their lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/002: General, what are your orders?/nShall we send a pursuit force?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/003: No need./nThis should teach them a lesson.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/006: There's a report that someone resembling Lady Christina was among the retreating Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/007: Christina is with the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s08/009: Good!/nAll our objectives are achieved. Prepare to return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/001: I'll find a way to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/002: E... Esther Dodd... She did that to Rhidel...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/004: [Esther Dodd]/nHee hee hee!/30d You betrayed your companions in the first place. How foolish to blame me for your own mistake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/005: Esther Dodd, it's not too late. Go after him and ask his forgiveness. I'll forgive you, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/007: Heh heh heh... You're lower than a worm!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/009: Diablo... And Cesare Borgia!/40d To find both my enemy and my master's enemy together here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/010: But hand over Christina without a fight, and I'm willing to spare your lives.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/011: You wound me, Cyrano Bernstein./nCalling the man who saved your life your enemy! Didn't I spare you when you were about to be burned alive?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/012: And how dare you speak of Lord Diablo that way!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/013: Enough, Cardinal Cesare. If my senses are right, the aura coming from that boy is the same as Deimos'.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/014: So that's why I haven't sensed Deimos' presence for years. He merged with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/015: Heh heh heh... What are you to Christina, to order me to hand over my own granddaughter?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/016: Enough talk./20d Hand over Christina, and I'll grant you a painless death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/017: Lord Diablo, that poisoned wretch is already at death's door. He's lower than a worm. Pay him no heed, and continue the ritual...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/018: Let's see how long you can keep spouting such nonsense, Cesare! Prepare yourself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/019: Then we'll die together, Esther Dodd!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/024: Why... Why did you save me?!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/025: I can't stand by and let the person who saved my life die for nothing, can I?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/027: I don't know whether you still remember the prisoner who escaped Inferno with you three years ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/029: Your eyes shone then. Now that enchantress has bewitched you, and their light is fading./60d Look at yourself, Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/032: Hee hee... Throwing yourself into danger for a coward like him? You're quite the fool, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/033: There's a limit to such ridiculous jokes! What? Ask for forgiveness?/50d Hee hee hee!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/034: Lord Diablo will protect me! You're the ones who should beg forgiveness!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/037: It's too late! The God of Destruction... is awakening!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/038: Christina... Esmeralda gave her life to save her...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/039: It's no use... Christina's breathing is growing weaker...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/041: The underwater city is collapsing! We have to get out of here first!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/042: Christina will die before we can get out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/043: But there's no other way. I'll carry Christina and get her out as quickly as I can!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/045: Deimos... I think I finally understand how you felt.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/048: We have no choice! We must destroy the God of Destruction before it can unleash its full power!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/050: Deimos!! Please grant that child your life!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/055: Take care of... Christina... Sharn... No, Clausewitz...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/058: He gave his own life to save Christina...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/060: The city is starting to collapse in earnest, Kana!/50d I'll take care of Lady Christina. Let's get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/063: He was so lonely... All his life, he chased the shadow of the woman he loved...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/064: Only now has he finally found peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/065: I will stay by his side. Forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/066: ...I understand. Happiness means something different to each of us. I can't stand in the way of yours.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/067: I hope you find true happiness.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/068: You've held out well. But the games end here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/069: Damn it... Is this as far as our strength can take us...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/070: Cyrano... If only he were here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/073: Why did you save us?! You're no longer part of the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/074: I may no longer be in the Zephyr Falcon, but we were comrades who faced life and death together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/075: Even if it costs my life, I cannot treat yours as expendable.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/077: Cyrano... You hadn't abandoned us after all...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/079: We must put the past aside. Now is the time to join forces against the enemy before us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/080: So you're Cyrano? You've inherited Deimos' life, and it shows. You're rather different from the others.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/083: Of the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War, I killed Irus myself. That leaves only you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/085: And Cesare... the root of all evil. I'll destroy you myself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/086: Hoho... We meet after so long, and your first words are so bloodthirsty./30d Didn't my mercy save your life, when you were about to become a handful of ashes at the stake?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/087: Enough of your games, Cesare!/20d Even setting my own revenge aside, I could never forgive you, for humanity's sake!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/091: Isabele, I'll fight at your side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/093: Hoho... You still cling to those foolish preconceptions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/094: Everything I do is for my country. I don't ask you to understand, but don't misunderstand my intentions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/095: I've heard Machiavelli's account, and I know what you think. But your reasoning is flawed. A goal achieved through wrongful means has no meaning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/096: People and history alike grow through trial and error, failure and success!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/097: Forcing history onto a chosen path can only lead to regression in the end!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/098: I never expected to be debating philosophy with you at a time like this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/101: We're out of time!! At this rate, the God of Destruction will be revived...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/105: All right, Cyrano. Let's fight together!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/106: All right, Cyrano! I'll help you too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/107: Diablo is dead. Now this truly is the end, Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/116: Sending me, your former fiance, to hell wasn't enough. He murdered your husband, and now he wants to use your daughter too. Would you shield him simply because he's your father?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/117: I know he's evil... a murderer... a terrible father.../50d But.../30d But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/119: The... the God of Destruction's seal!!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/121: Your father is a murderer who has harmed countless people, including your husband. If he lives, he will only bring more people misery.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/123: But.../30d He's the father who brought me into this world and raised me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/124: What a shameless woman! Asking us to spare a villain like him just because he's her father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/127: She's not doing well./30d Esmeralda, can you save her?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/133: Everyone, look out! The underwater city is starting to collapse!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s02/134: Let's get out of here, quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/000: Maze Forest/n1. Never turn back the way you came./n2. Always walk toward the sun./n/nLargo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/001: This place... We've been caught in Bifrost's labyrinth trap!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss27/002: Everything around us is an illusion./nNever turn back the way you came./nWalk toward the sun!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/000: Strange./nThis is where we were supposed to meet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/001: How odd./nI'd expect this from Meditch, but the Advisor is always punctual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/007: At Clausewitz's request, they all left for the summit of Mount Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/009: I don't know the details either, but they say General Frederick is near Mount Ron. Perhaps that's connected...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/012: Then are we heading to the summit of Mount Ron too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl11_s04/014: Well... Please go on ahead. There's somewhere I need to stop first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflddr00/000: < Fire Dragon Cave >/nDanger: No civilian access.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwro04/000: West - Ron City/nRebel activity to the south. No civilian access.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/006: You followed me all the way here.../nYou're quite something.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/007: Well, there's nothing I can do now./nI'm only a scholar./30d I can't resist you. Do as you please.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/008: Hmph. Did you think that would save your skin?/nI'll send you to the next world painlessly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/012: Do you think I'd recognize some insignificant rebel?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/013: I suppose it's been 15 years, after all...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/014: I was once called Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/015: Cyrano! /nHow is it possible...you are still alive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/016: Heh... I seem to have a knack for surviving.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/017: But seeing my once close friend doing Cesare's bidding gives me no pleasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/018: I'm a scholar. Following my convictions matters more than friendship or personal ties.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/019: My own philosophy is what leads me to follow His Eminence Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/020: Cesare's philosophy? Plotting to frame his friend's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/021: Using his own daughter as a tool to seize power?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/022: Or bringing foreign forces into our homeland, as you have now? Is that what you mean, Machiavelli?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/023: The empire has no emperor now./nThat makes a man like His Eminence all the more necessary./nWe need a ruler who can put every personal feeling aside and use even ruthless means to reunite the empire and restore peace.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/024: You know as well as I do that His Eminence Cesare is the only man who can reunite the empire now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/025: History is not for one person to dictate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/026: Why must the empire be reunited for his sake? Why must countless people shed their blood for him?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/027: Shouldn't history take its own course?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/028: Of course, given decades or centuries, the empire's present turmoil will eventually subside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/029: But how many people must be sacrificed in the meantime?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/030: And how many more wars must be fought?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/031: People today may condemn His Eminence Cesare, but future historians will thank him for shortening the suffering of countless people.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/032: We have to hurry! Once the Valkyries close the encirclement, we won't be able to escape!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/033: Let's finish him off and get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/034: I have only remained true to my convictions as a scholar./nEven if my life ends today, I have no regrets.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/036: Very well, Machiavelli./nI'll spare you today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/038: Tell him Cyrano is coming for his rotten head.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/039: You're going to let him live?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/040: Please./nHe is too valuable a man to kill.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s08/041: Come on! Whatever else, we need to get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s07/000: So this is... Asura's true form...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl04_s07/001: Can my own skill/10d really overcome this enormous monster...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma14a/000: Mount Mantigoa.../20d The summit is just ahead./nLet's attack the enemy's headquarters at the top!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma14a/001: Cesare is fleeing toward the summit!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber02/001: Hoho, Cyrano./15d I'm sorry, but would you mind leaving?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber02/001_3: Hoho, Cyrano. I'm sorry, but would you mind leaving?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl14_s01/002: Everyone, please look at the map.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/002: More importantly, is everyone all right?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/003: Yes./20d Fortunately, no lives were lost. Most injuries are minor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/004: Haha! The operation succeeded, just as planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/005: Disperse here, then regroup at the second rendezvous point as planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/010: Heh, nothing out of the ordinary.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/012: If you have no other plans, why not join the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/013: I'm sorry, but there's something I must do./30d Something very important...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/014: I see. If you have something to do, it can't be helped.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/015: Then I suppose we part ways here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/018: I'll never forget what you've done for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/020: I'm Roberto de Meditch, commander of the Zephyr Falcon's First Unit./nIf you're going to remember me, get it right!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/021: Then I wish you good luck.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/023: The sky... for the first time in 13 years.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s08/024: This beautiful night sky hasn't changed since then, and yet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/000: Esmeralda's clinic is here in our village. She's famous... You've heard of her, haven't you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/001: People have long come here to see her beauty, or to witness her true spirit of service.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/003: Heh, the more I think about it, the more I like this place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/005: Maybe I should settle down here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/006: It's terrible. Prices have been rising so much lately...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/007: It's hard enough to make ends meet already... I may have to sell the only clothes I own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/008: Oh... My older brother is very popular with the girls.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/009: My brother was studying medicine at Esmeralda's place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/010: Esmeralda is just like an angel! Her voice, her looks... and she heals sick people, too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/011: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor like Esmeralda too!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/012: Esmeralda, it's been a long time since you last came here. All is well at the clinic. With no patients being treated anymore, there's little to manage...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/013: Mom and Dad went to heaven together a little while ago. That's what my uncle told me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/014: When I told my uncle I wanted to go where Mom and Dad are, he got really angry with me. I hate him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/015: Grown-ups are strange. Why do they always stop us doing what we want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/016: It's fair to say Viscount Ramon killed that child's parents. Poor little thing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/017: But I'm not even married, and now I've been left to raise a child... What a rotten world.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/018: Why must parents die and leave a child like that behind? Do the powerful really have the right to torment the powerless, even kill them?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/019: I think it's true what they say: Esmeralda is God incarnate.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/020: She's beautiful and kind, and she even treats those who can't pay for free, doesn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/021: Some people in our village are very fond of maps. I love maps too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/022: Have you heard of Largo, the legendary geographer? Though he was from Silver Arrow, he spent his later years in the old imperial territories, devoting himself to mapping them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/023: It's no exaggeration to say that he drew the first drafts of the maps known throughout the empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/024: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry on her work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/025: Her students are spread across the country, helping people. Just visit whichever is closest to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/026: Though she isn't here now... her spirit of compassion lives on.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/027: It's because all of Geysir is in turmoil. Why is the Zephyr Falcon unsettling the whole country?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/028: They aren't here anymore. They've gone to Pendragon to study advanced medicine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/029: The children at our school all skipped class yesterday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/030: The student council president led the whole school in protest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/031: But there was quite a scolding at school today...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/032: Doctor Esmeralda, how have you been?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/033: The others have all returned to their hometowns. They've sent word that they arrived safely and are doing well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/034: I... I... will wait here until you return to the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/035: Welcome, Esmeralda. I'll offer your companions a special discount.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/037: Goodbye, Esmeralda. Take care of yourself... We'll be waiting for your return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/039: People who know how to survive don't turn their noses up at work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/040: There's a Zephyr Falcon base nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/041: The forest below the Zephyr Falcon base has long been known for strange occurrences.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/042: There are many caves around here, each with its own legends. And every one of those legends concerns treasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/043: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/044: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry on her work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/045: All of Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns to carry on her work.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/046: If you want to earn money, you have to be ready to tackle any job... This village really is too poor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/047: Imperial Geographical Society, Pretoria Branch/nWe help anyone unfamiliar with geography. We are part of the publicly funded Imperial Academy Foundation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/048: To travel the old imperial territories without getting lost, you must learn the forest paths. Know those, and you can claim to know half the empire's geography.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/049: Take the forest between Ron and Bordeaux. Its northern and southern paths lead to the cities, but turn right and you'll enter the labyrinth of the Demon Sword Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/050: The forest between Geysir and Ron is quite confusing. Geysir Forest has few signposts. It leads east to Nicosia and south to Memphis. West takes you toward Ron, but you must cross another mountain on the way. It's a difficult route...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/051: The forest near Caracas connects many regions: Libreville to the north, Geysir City to the south, Paro Village and Trisis Desert to the east, and Pretoria here to the west. Think of it as the main crossroads north of Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/052: In the forest near Caracas, you can assume each branch at a fork leads to a different region.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/053: Leave Caracas and keep heading south to reach Paro. For Geysir City, head south, turn west, then south again. For the Libreville region, head south, then west, then north, and finally northeast. You know the road between Caracas and Pretoria here, of course?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/054: Leave our village and keep heading north to find Phoenix Cave. The famous one...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/055: Leave the village, head west, then turn southwest to reach the southern Dragon Breath Mountains. Many resistance groups have operated there over the years. The southern range also leads to an unnamed cave, said to hold valuable treasures.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/056: The cave is said to lie at the western end of the southern Dragon Breath Mountains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/057: Geysir Forest, south of Geysir City, lacks signposts because the city has neglected it. But it's vast and connects many places, making it a major crossroads in the south.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/058: Leave Geysir City and keep heading south to reach Memphis Village. Head south, then turn northeast for the Church fortress at Nicosia. Head south, then northwest for the road to Ron. Though you might confuse the road to Ron with the one to Fire Dragon Cave...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/059: Getting from Geysir to Ron isn't easy. Head south from Geysir City, turn northwest at the second fork, then keep heading west. Those forests are quite confusing...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/060: I'm a member of the Geographical Society. I earned my doctorate with a thesis titled "A Differential Study of Geography and Changes in People's Lives in the Bifrost Borderlands."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/061: To reach Libreville, keep heading north from Geysir City, cross the bridge to the east, then head north again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/062: Northeast of Libreville lies Antananarivo, a remote mountain village. To get there, head north through the forest near Libreville. At the first fork in the mountains, go west, then immediately turn north and keep going.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/063: Ah, Esmeralda. People still come here looking for you. Many won't listen when we tell them to visit the nearby charity hospital run by your students.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/064: You don't plan to return just yet? ...I had hoped you would take some time to live for yourself...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/065: Follow your heart, and make choices you won't regret. I'll stay here and look after things.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/066: Ah! Doctor Esmeralda! I followed your wishes and opened a charity hospital in my hometown. But perhaps my skills weren't enough. No one came...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/067: Above all, I lacked the funds to keep the charity hospital running. It's closed now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/068: Now I truly admire you, Doctor. Both your dedication to helping others and your skill in running a business...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/012_3: This is Esmeralda's hospital. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/020_3: She's beautiful and kind, and she even treats those who can't pay for free, doesn't she?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/021_3: Dad went to the village down below.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/022_3: He said to keep the door closed so bad people couldn't get in... Why was it left open?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/023_3: You're not a wolf, are you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/024_3: With Esmeralda away, we are no longer treating patients here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/027_3: It's because all of Geysir is in turmoil. Why is the Zephyr Falcon unsettling the whole country?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/032_3: I'm a nurse at Esmeralda's hospital.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/033_3: The others have all gone back to their hometowns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/034_3: I intend to stay here until she reopens the hospital someday.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/035_3: We're selling off the medicines Esmeralda used here. Would you like to choose one?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltpr02/040_3: There's a Zephyr Falcon base nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss23/000: Maze Forest/n1. Never turn back the way you came./n2. Always walk toward the sun./n/nLargo
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s03/001: [Zephyr Falcon Marksman]/nI've checked the way ahead.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s03/003: Good. We're inside. Split into groups here, as planned.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s03/004: Louis and Bors, come with me. The rest of you, head upstairs and plant the explosives at the assigned locations.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s03/005: Then I hope to see you all safe at the rendezvous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s03/007: They say our comrades are in the underground cells.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s02/004: Navigator, what's wrong?/nThe weather's fine today...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl05_s02/011: ....../15d/nA storm on the way to Storm Island, and pirates on the way back...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/004: How does the voyage look?/nThe sky seems ominous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/005: We should reach Storm Island in about 8 hours.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/006: I hope the weather holds until then.../10d But something doesn't feel right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/007: Indeed./nWe ought to see seagulls by now, but it's far too quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/015: What is it now? We're busy!/nGet moving!/nDidn't you hear there's a typhoon coming?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/016: W-well.../15d /nThe sea monster Kraken has appeared behind us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/020: Wh-what are we going to do...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s07/024: What is it now? We're busy!/nGet moving!/nDidn't you hear there's a typhoon coming?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/003: Captain Meditch, we have no key that fits this door./20d We're out of time. I think we should leave the prisoner in this cell.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/004: What are you saying?!/nEven if he's not one of us, we can't come this far and then turn a blind eye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/006: Can a man locked away in a place like this still be called a nobleman?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/007: We're out of time, Captain./nWe have to get out of here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/010: There's no time. Go on to the rendezvous point./30d I'll rescue him and follow you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/012: You're as stubborn as ever, Captain.../30d /nVery well. We'll go ahead and wait for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/013: Hold on a little longer./nI'll get you out soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/014: Damn... This door won't give easily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/015: It's no use. Not even gunpowder can blast this door open.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/016: Gunpowder may not work, but this should!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/018: Heh, save the admiration for later. Let's go!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/020: [Kain]/nYou've come to rescue us, Captain Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/021: I'm here to rescue you. Get out, quickly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/023: All right, let's get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/025: [Kain]/nGo on ahead. I'll get out shortly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/026: [Miller]/nKain and Owen are in the next cell too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/027: [Owen]/nPlease rescue the prisoner in the cell just west of mine too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/028: They're swarming this way./nWe won't get through here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/029: No, we can't go this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/035: Damn.../30d /nI suppose I'll have to jump too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s04/036: Come on, let's rescue our comrades!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmro12/000: Twelve years since I first took up a sword as a child,/nthe martial path remains long and arduous./nYet every path lies within the heart./nCleave doubt with a single stroke, and all becomes clear./n/nCarl Steiner found the way of the sword here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21d/000: [Cesare]/nWith the God of Destruction's power,/30d I am no longer human. I am a god!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma21d/001: [Cesare]/nTo oppose me is blasphemy! Atonement can only come through death!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmf04/000: We must head down the mountain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/001: ....../30d That day will never return, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/004: There you are, Cyrano./30d I've been waiting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/009: I'm sorry, Esmeralda.../30d Just a moment...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/010: Cyrano, so many passages have collapsed that we can't reach the second floor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/013: The copy of the Secret Records of the Creation War should be in my room on the second floor...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/014: Is there nothing we can do...?/30d Where are the remaining books...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/016: That's it!! What remained!! Beladin left the God of Destruction in the underwater city, the last of the Seven Wonders!/70d So that was it... Cesare...!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/017: The God of Destruction Beladin left behind? The underwater city... in the lake near Cerepus...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/018: Yes. Cesare feared that I would learn of that God's existence... and reveal it to the world...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl23_s01/019: The Cerepus region would have been beyond Cesare's reach then... I see...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmma02a/000: This way leads to the summit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat02/000: The iron gate is completely sealed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber04/000: Young master, what brings you here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber04/001: If you're looking for Ruben, he's not here now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber04/002: Don't you think Ruben has been acting strangely lately? It seems to have started just after the news of your engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber04/002_3: Don't you think Ruben has been acting strangely lately? It seems to have started just after your engagement was announced...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/006: Come on, let's get out of this dreadful place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/007: The lord has learned a hard lesson this time. He shouldn't dare to bother Esmeralda again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/010: Oh, no... Gone again!!/20d I missed my chance again...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/011: So this isn't the first time Sharn Hoiste has helped you and then disappeared?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/012: It wasn't just me!/20d Isabele received help last time, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/014: I completely forgot we were supposed to meet the other unit commanders...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_s06/015: We'd better hurry to the rendezvous point./20d Let's all go together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/002: Argh! This is infuriating!/nHow can a frog be so fast?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/003: If I can't catch that frog...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/006: What's going on?/10d All of a sudden...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/009: Oh... no./15d I've lost it completely...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/010: What's this about a frog all of a sudden?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/011: You're really slow on the uptake./n/15dCheck your bag.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/014: Aah! All the equipment I struggled to buy yesterday... all of it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/016: It's probably all in that frog's belly by now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/018: I've heard rumors of frogs that steal things and sell them, but I never thought they really existed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/021: I went to so much trouble to buy those Mithril Rounds... Sniff.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/024: Once we find the treasure, a few rounds of ammunition won't matter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/026: Let's stop wasting time on distractions and be on our way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/027: According to the treasure map, it's in Fire Dragon Cave, in the center of Geysir Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/028: Oh, fine... Then let's go find the treasure!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s03/029: First, let's enter the forest through Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/002: Honestly, how can a man enjoy a drink with all this trouble?/30d Even this place isn't worth coming to anymore.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/003: We've ended up back in Ron after all...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/004: Meditch surely hasn't left the imperial territories, yet we can't find him... Where could he be...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/008: Come to think of it... We haven't tried the tavern in Ron.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/009: Hey, barkeep! Do you know who I am? Huh?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/011: How could I know who you are, sir...? I won't charge you. Just calm down and leave, please.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/012: What? Do you take me, Meditch, for someone who won't pay his debts?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/013: Meditch! I thought it was you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/017: As you can see... He's not doing well...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/018: Meditch, this is pathetic. Aren't you ashamed to bear the name Roberto de Meditch in this state?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/020: Damn it... What do you expect from me now...? What could you want from someone as useless as me...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/021: Cyrano... His death was my fault too... Mine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/022: Cyrano died because of me. He chose to sacrifice himself to save my life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/023: Yes, if I thought as you do, I could never face him. I'm alive only because he gave his life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/024: But I cannot let his sacrifice be meaningless. That's why I try to live each day as fully as I can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/025: It's not too late, Meditch./30d Together, we can rebuild the Zephyr Falcon with our own hands!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/027: You're Roberto de Meditch, the Zephyr Falcon's true leader./30d You can do this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl19_s01/028: Yes... I'll try. I can't let his death be in vain...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri03/000: You cannot see the lord without an appointment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltri03/001: So this is Lady Esther Dodd's mansion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltme03/000: We have no business here right now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/000: I've been waiting for you, Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/002: Never mind that. We must hurry down to the altar and change Lady Christina's mind./30d It seems she has volunteered to serve as the catalyst for the God of Destruction's revival, determined to avenge herself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/003: Whatever the case, we must stop the revival ritual immediately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/006: I can't believe it./20d He wants power so badly that he'll even use his own granddaughter...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/007: He wouldn't be Cesare if that troubled him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/008: If the God of Destruction fully revives, we won't be able to stop Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/009: Sharn Hoiste... Fight alongside them in my place./20d You'll be more help than I would.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/010: Very well./20d I'll join you in stopping Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/011: Hurry down to the lowest level and stop the God of Destruction's revival.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/012: I'll stay here and keep our escape route open.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/013: I wonder what Meditch is doing now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/014: [Isabele]/nI'll keep watch. Rest for a while.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn31/016: Hurry down to the lowest level and stop the God of Destruction's revival.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/005: Such a young child... What could they possibly have done wrong...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/012: The injuries are severe./nLike this... the child won't last more than a few hours.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/013: Damn it... We need someone who can use healing magic.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/015: There's a famous doctor named Esmeralda in Pretoria Village, over the mountain!!
