Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/016: Esmeralda? The woman people revere as a saint...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/017: Yes!/nShe can surely save this child.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl07_te1/020: Silver, wrap the child in this cloak to keep them warm. Kana, lead us to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcka16/000: There seems to be no one here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflinf1f/000: Damn, the door's locked!/nWe'll need a key...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s03/003: Seeing you all waiting out here, I suppose you were worried about the duel./40d You can stop worrying now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s03/004: Then, Cyrano... You really did defeat General Frederick...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s03/006: Don't mock the dead, Cyrano!!/30d There's more to a man than his skill with a sword!!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s03/007: The dead? What are you talking about?/20d Are you saying I killed Frederick?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl15_s03/008: What am I talking about?! Stop playing games, Cyrano!/30d If the General isn't dead, is that body in the tent just a doll?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/001: Ah! You're safe./15d /nWhat happened to Duke Ruben?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/003: Impressive!/nYou really are skilled./nIn any case, thank you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/004: Hmph! Don't think saving our commander gives you something to boast about!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/005: Not at all. I was merely lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/006: Of course not. I only gave Meditch a little help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/007: Hehehe... There's no need to be so modest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/008: Without you and that phantom thief, Sharn Hoiste, the Zephyr Falcon might have been wiped out...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/013: Then... what will you do now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/015: I mean your plans from here./nAfter this, the Church will brand you a traitor, just as they have the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/017: And if the true nature of your body, your sword and your magic becomes known, your freedom to act will be severely limited.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/019: The entire Church will be desperate to find you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/020: What do you say?/nWouldn't it be better to join forces with us?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/021: The Zephyr Falcon's intelligence network could be a great help to you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/024: Excellent./nFor now, we'd appreciate your help in Kana's Fourth Unit. Their strength was greatly reduced in this incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s04/025: Hooray!/nThen we'll be working together from now on!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/000: Then I suppose I must be on my way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/002: [Frog Merchant]/nHumans keep coming to this dangerous place, eh? If you want to live, stock up on my wares!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/003: Frog Weapon Shop - Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/005: [Frog Merchant]/nIn a dangerous place like this, you need the best medicine and equipment to survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/006: Frog Accessory Shop - Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/007: [Frog Merchant]/nJust make it out of here alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/008: [Frog Innkeeper]/nWelcome. Stay here, and our friends will protect you. Only 100 Eld! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/009: [Frog Innkeeper]/nHohoho! Fooled you! I'm taking 10000 Eld instead!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/010: Hmph... Leaving without staying? I hope you get a Game Over out there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwtn35/011: [Frog Innkeeper]/nYou won't be seeing me again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/001: Fool./40d You dare challenge me with such meager skill?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/007: Are you with this weakling too?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/010: You're Deimos!!/30d /nNo, something's different./20d I sense both Deimos and the Black Prince within you. What are you?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/011: There's no mistaking the presence of Deimos' soul.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/012: If you intend to oppose me with Deimos' will, I'll fight you with all my strength!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/013: Cyrano... So the rumors were true. You're alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/014: Lord Irus, he's no ordinary man. You should be careful...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/001_3: Fool. You dare come against me...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/011_3: Hehehe... Deimos./nSo this is how you intend to oppose me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/012_3: Then... I'll show you my true form!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/013_3: Cyrano... So the rumors were true. You're alive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka03b/014_3: Lord Irus, he's no ordinary human. You should take some care...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/004: ...Three years, and all I've gained is sulfur poisoning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/005: Why... must I keep living in this hell?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/006: Must I spend the rest of my life... like vermin...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/010: Damn it... Why can't I forget her? The woman who betrayed me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/016: Hehehe... Three years have brought me nothing but/15d despair and/15d this ruined body.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/017: Why.../10d must I keep living in this hell?/10d /nSuffering like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/018: Must I spend the rest of my life.../10d like vermin...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/021: Damn it.../15d Why can't I forget her?/nThe woman who betrayed me...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/028: Get up! Move it, unless you want to die!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/029: Get down to the mines and start working!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/031: Damn it./nWhen you dawdle, I'm the one who gets yelled at.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/032: Tch... Tough bastard./nStill clinging to life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl02_s02/033: If only that wretched man were gone, I could have some peace...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldpr13/000: [Pirate Kidd]/nHehehe... So you're the one disturbing my sleep? I'll let it slide three times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldpr13/002: Hehehe... Farewell. Once you leave, you'll find it difficult to return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/001: So, from tomorrow, we'll be fighting alongside Frederick...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/002: It feels strange. He was our enemy not so long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/004: Bifrost's Grand Duke has some nerve, daring to invade the empire...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/005: Hmph. I hear it's all because of that woman Josephine...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/006: Honestly, men are all the same.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/007: Come to think of it, where did Cyrano and Commander Meditch go?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/008: They went out with Esther Dodd a moment ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/015: Oh! Then play something for us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/016: Well... It's been a long time. I'm not sure how well I'll play.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/019: It's a lovely piece, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/020: It's a piece.../10d my mother loves...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/023: This is as far as one person can play./nFrom the next passage, it needs two players.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/024: Yet Mother always played it right through. Every time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/028: Huff... Huff... What's happened?/nYou rushed into this room without a word...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/029: That piano piece just now... Who was playing it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/031: That piece.../10d Where did you learn it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/032: ...? /nFrom my mother. Why do you ask?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/035: I'm sorry, but... could you play it once more?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/042: Ah! How do you know this piece...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/046: Goodness... I never knew Cyrano could play the piano...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/048: But how does Cyrano know this piece?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/050: Surely only my mother knew that piece...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl13_s04/051: Don't concern yourself with it./nI merely heard it once, long ago...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmpx19/001: Our attack targets are the lords' mansions in Pretoria, Memphis and Bordeaux.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat21/000: So they were being held here after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcat21/003: Come on, let's get the residents out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/000: Hmm... You scoundrels... I never thought you'd make it this far.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/001: Hehehe... I hired Tuer soldiers for my private army, in case of just such an occasion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/002: Damn it! Seize them at once!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/003: ...Where are you holding the Zephyr Falcon prisoners?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/004: I-in the prison on the roof...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcbo09/005: You have one hour./nRelease your prisoners and leave this region!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/002: Fortunately, the wound isn't fatal./nHe seems to have twisted aside instinctively at the critical moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/004: And your swordsmanship.../10d It's quite unusual.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/005: What about you? You call yourself an heir of the Black Shadow, yet you use Pendragon swordsmanship. Why?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/006: Heh... We both have plenty to hide, it seems.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/012: We haven't fully secured the mansion yet. Esmeralda is treating the wounded, and Kana has gone to support the other units.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/013: Good./nThen look after Meditch./nHis wounds aren't fatal, but he's still unconscious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/015: I'm going into the mansion./nRuben... will be waiting for me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/017: Will you be all right going alone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/018: Ruben and I have something to settle.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/021: Ruben and I have something we must settle alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_te1/023: [Zephyr Falcon Supply Soldier]/nIf you need anything, I can provide supplies.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflxca06/000: Is this the Church's secret hideout?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/000: ...I never thought you'd get this far.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/001: Hehehe... I expected this, so I hired Tuer troops...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/002: Damn it! Teach them a lesson!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/004: ...Where are you holding the Zephyr Falcon prisoners?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflcme24/006: You have one hour./15d/nRelease your prisoners and leave this region!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/000: So this is the God of Destruction's true form...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/002: Leave the center, where Christina is, untouched! Attack the parts it's using to strike at us!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/003: We've destroyed all the God of Destruction's attacking parts!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/008: [Esmeralda]/nAlmighty Mana, I offer my life in this prayer...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/009: So... We can't destroy it without harming Christina at its core...?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s03/010: It seems there's no other way.../40d The time we've shared.../30d I'll never forget it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/000: Whew.../10d We barely made it out.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/006: This is... the underwater city's entrance?/15d And you, Sharn Hoiste...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/007: There's no need to hide it any longer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/009: Goodness!/15d That bookworm Clausewitz was the phantom thief Sharn Hoiste all along!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/010: I had my reasons for working under a concealed identity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/011: Did you bring me out of the underwater city?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/013: I remember merging with the God of Destruction, then attacking Cyrano...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/014: Esmeralda's sacrifice freed you from the God of Destruction./30d Then Cyrano sacrificed himself to save your life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/016: But I don't understand./30d Why did Cyrano save me, when I tried to kill him?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/017: I don't know why either, but one thing has recently become clear./30d Cyrano did not personally harm your parents.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/018: A thorough examination of Lord Frederick's body, supposedly slain by Cyrano,/40d revealed traces of the dark assassins serving Cardinal Cesare.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/020: Lady Frederick did die after meeting Cyrano, but our information indicates that she died of poisoning.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/021: Would Cyrano need poison to kill a woman?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/022: ...Could Mother have...?/30d No... That can't be./20d She's Grandfather's only daughter...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/023: With Cyrano dead, much remains a mystery. But Cardinal Cesare's involvement is certain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/024: Come to think of it... Mother seemed to know Cyrano well./20d There was that piano piece, too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/025: When she taught me that piece, she said that only the two of us knew it anymore. She looked as though she longed for something./50d But Cyrano knew it too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/026: I never understood why Mercedes invited Cyrano alone,/40d nor why he accepted and went into such danger by himself.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/027: I suspect they shared a bond from the past that was far from simple.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/028: Even so.../20d Why would he give his own life to save me...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/029: I don't know for certain... But he even asked me to look after you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/030: It seems Cyrano thought of you as more than a stranger.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/031: ...Grandfather must know the truth behind all of this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/032: And for Father's sake, Mother's, and Cyrano's, I have a duty to stop Grandfather's futile ambition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/033: Cardinal Cesare has probably gone himself to ask Bifrost for reinforcements again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/034: To defend this land against another Bifrost invasion, you must carry on Lord Alfred Frederick's wishes. As the rightful heir of the Frederick family, Lady Christina, you must join forces with the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/036: Then we must first find Meditch and reunite the scattered Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl18_s05/038: Well... Knowing him, he's probably going from tavern to tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/000: This is Antananarivo,/na village on the border between the imperial territories and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/001: The people here live under the constant threat of war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/002: Mount Mantigoa lies to the north. Cross it, and you're in Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/003: More and more soldiers have been coming down from the north and passing through our village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/004: This has long been a strategic crossroads.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/006: Ah... Cerepus is so far away... I'd love to see Nikacha in person...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/008: Welcome to the Mountain Inn. A stay costs 85 Eld. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/010: Do stay with us next time!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/012: Welcome to the inn. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/013: Hmph! I'd like to see anyone who works as hard for this inn as I do!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/014: I work so hard, but the owner is terribly stingy with me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/015: Only someone like me would still be here. Who else would stick with an inn in a backwater village like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/016: A good place to rest a weary body and mind... So quiet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/017: I was once an Astanian Templar. The memory of Shuri and Kaza falling heroically in the war against the Tuer still lies deep in my heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/020: Welcome. This is the only tavern in Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/021: Our village lies on the frontier of the imperial territories. Foreign armies have invaded us many times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/022: But there haven't been any such armies lately, so it's fairly quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/024: Our village's beautiful scenery has drawn many visitors seeking rest. Yet endless wars have also drenched it in blood.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/025: They say His Majesty the Black Prince once stayed here too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/026: Nothing tastes better than a beer on the job.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/027: What mission?/10d Hmm, that's a secret.../30d Actually, I was fired. I'm unemployed now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/028: Anyone you'd like disposed of?/20d I'll do it for a special low price.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/029: Heh, I'm a nobleman on my travels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/030: I've seen women from all over, but none can match Sharon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/031: Where on earth has she gone?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/032: I'm a ship's captain./10d I ought to be by the sea now. Do you know why I'm in a mountain village like this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/033: I was fired. I had to leave the ship I'd sailed for decades. Shipowners prefer younger captains these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/034: You couldn't know how it felt to leave a ship that was like a wife to me...!/15d My heart tore apart, and resentment choked my throat.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/035: [Cole]/nWelcome. We may be on the frontier, but we stock fine spears.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/037: Spears are the finest of weapons. We'll have more excellent stock for you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/038: [Hilde]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/040: Thank you for stopping by. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/041: The man at our village's weapon shop has lots and lots of spears.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/042: He once showed me a really fine spear. It was beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/044: Both the number of soldiers coming down from the north and the weapons they carry are increasing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/045: I used to be in the Zephyr Falcon. But in my very first battle, I was so frightened...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/046: I ran away... I'm a coward. A miserable coward...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/047: The threat of war is growing here in Antananarivo...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/048: Wherever people meet these days, they talk of war. They say Bifrost may push south...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/049: Not long ago, a friend stood beneath a tree with a strange look in their eyes...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/050: /2c"I've realized it. I must leave on a journey now."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/051: Then they left the village, leaving their family behind... Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/052: My home is by the sea, far away. Many people who can no longer sail have come to live here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/053: Former seafarers often settle far inland like this, trying to forget their longing for the sea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/054: [Gina]/nOh, so you think you did nothing wrong?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/055: [John]/nOh, come on... Why make such a fuss over that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/056: [Gina]/n"That"?! "That"?! Are you even in a relationship with me?! How can you go seeing another woman?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/057: [John]/nNow, now... We only met for lunch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/058: [Gina]/nLunch! Ha! Just lunch, was it?!/nMy friend Jane says she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/059: [John]/n(Gulp)!!/nShe saw me?/10d Saw me?/10d Where?/10d Where did she see me?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/060: [Gina]/nThat was.../20d I can't even bring myself to say it! Honestly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/061: [Gina]/nYou there!/15d Do you think it's acceptable to date someone else when you already have a partner?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/063: It can be. Love doesn't mean being bound to someone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/064: No. That would betray your partner.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/066: [Gina]/nHa!/10d Ha!/10d Men!/20d Fine, then./10d Here, take this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/068: [John]/nHuh? That's the birthday present I gave you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/069: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away./10d What are you going to do about it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/071: I'd better get out of here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/072: You couldn't do that to someone you truly cared about.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/073: [Gina]/nSee?! They say you're in the wrong!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/074: [John]/nFine... Fine. Is that how it is?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/076: [Gina]/nOh! What are you doing?! I scraped and saved to buy you that spear...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/077: [John]/nWell... I got another gift from her, so I don't need this spear anymore...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/078: [Gina]/nHa!/10d Ha!/10d So that's how you want to play it!/10d We'll settle this today!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/079: Mind your own business and get lost!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/082: Please, you can't come this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/083: Perhaps. People aren't each other's possessions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/087: There are plenty of unpleasant rumors about Jean, who works at the inn.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/088: [Jackie]/nI've got some fine wares. Care to take a look?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/091: It really looks like war is coming, just as the grown-ups said. If it threatens our village, I'll give my life to defend it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/092: Even this place seems unable to escape the threat of war... Is there nowhere in the old imperial territories to live in peace?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/093: The village elders say we've never gone this long without war./20d I've grown up without knowing it.../15d But I'm so afraid.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/094: ...So you've met that child./nI'm waiting for him to return someday. But... but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/095: War seems to be brewing here too. I suppose it's time to move on... But where can I go now...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/096: I'm sick of war. Why else would I come so far to live here...?/30d But even this little peace may end soon./10d Ah... Shuri...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/000_3: This is Antananarivo,/na village on the border between the imperial territories and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/001_3: The people here live under the constant threat of war.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/002_3: Mount Mantigoa lies to the north. Cross it, and you're in Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/003_3: Have you heard of Sharn Hoiste, the phantom thief?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/004_3: This has long been a strategic crossroads.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/008_3: Welcome to the inn. A stay costs 85 Gold. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/010_3: Do stay with us next time!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/012_3: Welcome to the inn. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/014_3: Even so, the owner is terribly stingy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/016_3: A good place to rest a weary body and mind... So quiet...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/017_3: I was once an Astanian Templar. The memory of Shuri and Kaza falling heroically on the battlefield still lies deep in my heart.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/020_3: Welcome. This is the only tavern in Antananarivo.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/021_3: Our village stands on the road into Bifrost. Foreign armies have invaded us many times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/024_3: There are plenty of unpleasant rumors about Jean, who works at the inn.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/025_3: You can't put much trust in what she says.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/027_3: What mission? Hmm, that's a secret... Actually, I was fired. I'm unemployed now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/028_3: Anyone you'd like killed? I'll do it for a special low price.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/032_3: As you can see, I'm a ship's captain. Do you know why I'm in a mountain village when I ought to be by the sea?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/034_3: Do you know how it felt to leave a ship that was like a wife to me?! My heart tore apart, and resentment choked my throat. I'll have my revenge... That bastard shipowner...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/035_3: [Mr. Cole]/nWelcome. We may be on the frontier, but we stock fine spears.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/038_3: [Miss Hilde]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/044_3: They say he takes money from the rich and gives it to the poor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/047_3: It isn't Sharon's songs or her voice that make her performances so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/048_3: It's her sincerity, and the way she truly cares about her fans.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/050_3: "I've realized it. I must leave on a journey now."
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/051_3: Then they left the village, leaving their parents behind... Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/052_3: My home is by the sea, far away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/053_3: Unfortunately, I no longer have a ship to sail, so I've come here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/054_3: [Gina]/nOh, so you think you did nothing wrong?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/055_3: [John]/nOh, come on... Why make such a fuss over that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/056_3: [Gina]/n"That"?! "That"?! Are you even in a relationship with me?! How can you go seeing another woman?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/057_3: [John]/nNow, now... We only met for lunch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/058_3: [Gina]/nLunch! Ha! Just lunch, was it?!/nMy friend Jane says she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/059_3: [John]/n(Gulp)!!/nShe saw me? Saw me? Where? Where did she see me?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/060_3: [Gina]/nThat was.../nI can't even bring myself to say it! Honestly!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/061_3: [Gina]/nYou there! Do you think it's acceptable to see someone else when you already have a partner?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/066_3: [Gina]/nHa! Ha! Men! Fine, then. Here, take this!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/068_3: [John]/nHuh? That's the birthday present I gave you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/069_3: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away. What are you going to do about it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/071_3: I'd better get out of here, quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/072_3: Could you really do that to someone you cared about?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/073_3: [Gina]/nSee?! They say you're in the wrong!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/074_3: [John]/nFine... Fine. Is that how it is?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/076_3: [Gina]/nOh! What are you doing?! I scraped and saved to buy you that spear...!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/077_3: [John]/nWell... I got another gift from her, so I don't need this spear anymore...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/078_3: [Gina]/nHa! Ha! So that's how you want to play it! We'll settle this today!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat01/082_3: Please, you can't come this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/005: Would Meditch really be here already?/15d /nHe's probably caught up in some nonsense again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/006: More importantly, Kana, what were you thinking?!/10d /nLeaving your troops behind like that!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/007: Sigh.../15d /nI never expected Duke Ruben to return so soon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/008: It seems he went to see General Irus, who happened to be stationed nearby.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/009: I don't think Kana could have predicted that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/010: Kana! However it happened, a commander is responsible for the loss of her troops.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/011: Clausewitz,/10d /nonce this is resolved, there must be an appropriate reprimand.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/013: And who are the people behind you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/014: Ah, they've been a tremendous help to us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/015: Kana! Bringing outsiders here.../15d /nAre you out of your mind?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/016: But thanks to them, we were able to liberate Viscount Ramon's lands!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/017: I've heard the story too, but.../nIs it true that the three of you devastated the Viscount's mansion?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/018: They're extraordinary./nEvery one of them is a first-rate fighter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/019: Even so, bringing outsiders to our secret meeting place was reckless.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/020: Hmph! I don't know what's so impressive about you, but this is an ugly sight.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/021: Settle your own squabbles. We have no desire to stay here. Let's leave!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/024: Esmeralda, I think you should stay here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/025: No. If it's no trouble, I'd like to stay with Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/026: Could you be Esmeralda, the famous saint of Pretoria?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/027: A saint? I'm merely a doctor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/028: Not merely a doctor. You're the finest physician in the imperial territories. We've tried to invite you several times.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/029: I never expected to meet you here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/030: I'm sorry./nI've received several letters from Clausewitz, but I had too many patients to leave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/031: Now that you're here, perhaps you could join us...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/032: But I owe these people a great debt.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/033: I'm sorry, but I must leave with them too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/034: There's no need, Esmeralda./nDon't concern yourself with us. Stay here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/035: Anyone traveling with Esmeralda, the saint, can be trusted./nYou should join the Zephyr Falcon too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/036: Tch. Your attitude changed rather quickly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/037: I'm sorry, but we have things to do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/040: It was dangerous again!/nHe went into a burning house and rescued four siblings!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/042: Meditch, you're the Zephyr Falcon's real leader. If something happened to you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/043: Well, I can't just turn a blind eye to people in trouble, can I?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/044: That's just what I'd expect from Roberto de Meditch.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/046: Yes.../10d Roberto de Meditch.../10d The Zephyr Falcon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/049: Anyway, I hear Kana's troops are in trouble?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/050: It seems General Irus has intervened./nHe's the empire's fiercest general, a legendary warrior once counted among its Four Heavenly Kings.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/051: Hmm. If it's that Irus, perhaps it's just as well Kana wasn't there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/052: Meditch, I think we'll need you to take on General Irus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/053: Hmm.../10d I'm not sure even I can match him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/055: Hahaha! Still, we can't abandon Kana's troops./nAll right, let's teach General Irus a lesson!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/056: But.../10d I see some unfamiliar faces.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/057: They're accompanying Esmeralda, whom we've been trying to recruit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/058: Would you help us with this operation too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/059: Please accept my apology for earlier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/061: Very well./nFor now, we'll work with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/063: Wonderful!/nCyrano, join our Fourth Unit and work with us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/064: Wonderful!/nCyrano, join our Fourth Unit and work with us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/065: Then I'll explain the plan for the attack on Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/066: First, Isabele's Second Unit and Rhidelhard's Third Unit will attack opposite sides of the village simultaneously to throw the enemy into confusion.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/067: Once we've infiltrated, Meditch, attack the lord's mansion from the front.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/068: While Meditch engages General Irus, Kana will use the underground waterway to enter the mansion's basement and rescue the prisoners.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl08_s01/069: Well, shall we take on one of the old empire's Four Heavenly Kings?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/001: This is a quiet village surrounded by forests.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/002: Have you been to Geysir City, south of here? I went once. It's a wonderful place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/003: Karg, our tavern's chef, is rather eccentric./15d He's always traveling in search of ingredients for new dishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/004: General Kars of the old empire defeated the mightiest Dark Dragon and earned the title "Dragon Slayer," didn't he?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/008: It's easy to get lost in the desert, but very hard to find your way again. Especially without a good guide...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/009: Have you ever seen Irus wield a sword? He's so powerful!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/011: David? They say he was caught hiding an evil demon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/012: The dungeons throughout the old Geysir territories hold many treasures hidden by nobles long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/013: Perhaps we'd be better off with a church. Right now, Lord Ruben seems to do whatever he pleases.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/015: Churches usually aren't near villages. They tend to build monasteries deep in the mountains.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/016: What difference does that make? Most priests still come and go, meddling in village affairs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/017: Shh... Get on the Church's bad side, and you won't survive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/019: Culture and romance are the true joys of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/020: Ruben's men are cowards. They target the opponent with the lowest HP first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/022: They say the desert sun stays up so long that it seems fixed in one place. Is that true?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/023: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, is famous for his strange behavior. Duke Ruben here is hardly any better...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/025: That's why he often leaves the shop empty. But his cooking is truly delicious.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/026: [Chef Karg]/nTrue cooking comes from fine ingredients, a chef's skill, and dedication. Bring me good ingredients, and I'll reward you generously.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/027: [Chef Karg]/nEven the finest cooking skills are useless without good ingredients.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/028: [Chef Karg]/nYou still haven't found any good ingredients? Honestly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/029: [Chef Karg]/nI come from a family of chefs. My brothers are scattered far and wide. If you meet them, give them my regards.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/030: Isn't it amazing? Killing a Dark Dragon with a single sword!!/20d I'll study swordsmanship hard and become a great swordsman like General Kars someday!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/031: But... Don't dragons hoard marvelous gems?/20d I wonder if General Kars found them too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/032: My father's a traveling merchant, so I go from place to place a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/033: Keep heading northeast and you'll reach a city called Libreville. It's a rather strange place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/034: Hehehe... Did you know? I once found an incredible treasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/035: But after going there once, I could never get back!/15d What do I do?/5d What do I do?/5d What do I do?/5d My treasure!/5d My treasure!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/036: I'm sure.../10d I'm sure/10d it was somewhere near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/037: Trust yourself in the desert./10d Once you start doubting yourself, you won't survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/039: [Jane]/nUgh... I hate being nagged. I do what needs doing, whatever you think. Don't worry...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/040: [Jane]/nShh! I think there might be an opportunity today...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/041: [Jane]/nWho are you? If you've come to nag me about being in a place like this, get lost!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/042: Jane? They used to be such a good kid. Ever since their mother disappeared, they've been like this. Poor child...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/043: You risk your life going into that cave. It's terribly dangerous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/044: Running out of equipment is far scarier than the enemies in the dungeon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/050: Catalina, the swordswoman from Bifrost, is a distant relative of ours.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/053: Bring me something good, and I'll give you something good in return.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/054: I only trade one item for one item.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/055: The forest near our village leads to many other villages.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/056: There's even a route across the desert to Cerepus. But I'd stay out of the desert. It's a good place to get yourself killed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/057: Libreville is a strange city. Despite being so far north, its weather is always mild.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/059: Welcome to Caracas Inn. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/060: Thank you. Have a restful stay...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/061: Why talk to me if you aren't going to stay? Are you interested in me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/062: Thank you for your custom. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/063: Oh... An Ultimate Mushroom! The kind that grows only deep in caves untouched by human hands!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/064: Thank you, thank you so much! Let's see... I must give you something in return...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/068: [Chef Karg]/nOh... Isn't this Love Herb?! A precious spice that sprouts only where true love blossoms, nourished by its essence!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/069: [Chef Karg]/nThank you, thank you so much! Here, take this in return!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/070: Ah! This is... the ultimate spice, Higashi! The Tuer's legendary spice! Where did you find something so precious?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/071: Thank you so much for finding it... I must give you something in return...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/072: Plenty of edible fruit grows around here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/073: John brought back an unusual mushroom recently. He says he picked it deep in a cave near the village... It smelled wonderful!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/074: I think I'll have to stay in this village a little longer...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/076: [Miss Moncrief]/nWelcome to our inn. Would you like a room? A stay costs 80 Eld.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/078: Oh... Please stay with us another time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/079: Thank you for staying at our inn. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/080: [Elgi]/nWelcome. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/082: Thank you for shopping with us. Please come again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/083: [Mr. Joseph]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/086: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome. Our specialty is the Swordbreaker. It offers excellent value for its price, so be sure to buy at least one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/087: One Thousand and One Nights Weapon Shop
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/088: A good weapon is essential to a warrior. Thank you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/089: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our shop. If you're looking for spears or swords, speak to my wife.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/090: One Thousand and One Nights Weapon Shop
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/091: You can rely on our wares. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/092: Is there anything else to eat?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/094: [Arena Owner]/nHahaha! A man should build his strength! Try our arena! But it's real combat, so if you die, don't blame me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/096: All the wares we had for sale have been moved to the accessory shop.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/097: [Mr. Hercule]/nHahaha! Our village arena is the finest place for real combat training! A man ought to be strong, wouldn't you say?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/099: Thank you! If you get the chance, visit the arena my older brother runs in Ron!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/101: Give your ticket to that fellow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/102: A single-use pass. Go right in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/103: A lifetime pass. Go right in.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/104: As XP rises, a character's Attack and Defense increase together. Defending also raises XP, so if a battle turns against you, defend and hold out./n- Tactical Research Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/105: Weapons can break easily, depending on their characteristics. Always carry spares./n- Tactical Research Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/106: Current maps of the old imperial territories are inaccurate. Always make your own maps when traveling forest paths or mountain trails./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/107: Poor David... He's the one suffering. Burned at the stake...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/108: David has been sentenced to burn at the stake for sheltering the Zephyr Falcon. Poor man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/112: You can't enter without a ticket.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/113: Your ticket, please. No ticket, no entry.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/114: Here's what the weapon information means./nWeapon HP: The weapon's own HP. If the damage it takes exceeds its Weapon Limit, it loses 1 HP. When its HP reaches 0, the weapon is destroyed. Repairs restore its HP.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/115: Attack: The weapon's Attack. A character's Attack combines the weapon's Attack with the character's Strength.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/116: Defense: When the weapon blocks an attack, it reduces the damage by this percentage. Remember, it's a percentage, not a fixed amount!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/117: Has the person over there explained the earlier details? Then I'll explain the next stat. Weapon Limit is the maximum damage a weapon can withstand without losing its own HP. Its Defense, Weapon Limit and HP together determine how long it lasts.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/118: Next is Hit Rate, the weapon's chance of landing an attack. Weapons also have an unlisted Block Rate, so their chances of blocking differ. When you block, the weapon takes the damage. Weapons with high Block Rates therefore tend to break more easily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/119: Our branch of the Geysir Academy's Sword Research Society is in western Caracas. Pay us a visit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/120: Let's restock at the weapon shop here first.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/121: Hmph... Ruben's men are all cowardly scum.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/122: In battle, they target the weakest members of our party. Cowards.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/123: Though you can turn that against them and beat them...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/001_3: It's a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/002_3: Have you been to Geysir City, south of here? I went once. It's a beautiful place!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/003_3: Karg, our tavern's chef, is rather eccentric. He's always traveling in search of ingredients for new dishes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/004_3: Have you heard that our Lord Kars once killed a dragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/007_3: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/008_3: It's easy to get lost in the desert, but very hard to find your way again. Especially without a good guide...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/016_3: What difference does that make? Most priests still come and go, meddling in village affairs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/017_3: Shh... Get on the Church's bad side, and you won't survive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/019_3: Culture and romance are the true joys of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/021_3: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/023_3: Ramon, the lord of Pretoria, is famous for his strange behavior. Duke Ruben here is hardly any better...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/030_3: Isn't it amazing? Killing a dragon!! I'll study swordsmanship hard and become a great swordsman like Kars someday!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/031_3: But... Don't dragons hoard marvelous gems?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/032_3: My father's a traveling merchant, so I go from place to place a lot.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/033_3: Keep heading northeast and you'll reach a city called Libreville. It's a rather strange place.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/034_3: Hehehe... Did you know? I once found an incredible treasure.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/035_3: But after going there once, I could never get back! What do I do? What do I do? What do I do? My treasure! My treasure!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/036_3: I'm sure... I'm sure it was somewhere near here...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/037_3: Trust yourself in the desert. Once you start doubting yourself, you won't survive.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/043_3: I think you'd have to risk your life to enter that cave... It's terribly dangerous.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/057_3: Libreville is a strange city. Despite being so far north, it's remarkably warm.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/068_3: Oh... Isn't this Love Herb?! A precious spice that sprouts only where true love blossoms, nourished by its essence!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/069_3: Thank you, thank you so much! Here, take this in return!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/076_3: [Miss Moncrief] Welcome to our inn. Would you like a room? A stay costs 80 Gold.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/080_3: [Elgi]/nWelcome. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/086_3: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome. Choose whichever weapon you like. We offer fine weapons at low prices.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/089_3: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our shop. Take your time choosing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltka01/091_3: You can rely on our wares. Come again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/001: To have you here beside me... It feels like a dream.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/003: But true beauty is more than appearances.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/004: Mercedes, more than your looks, it's your kind heart that makes you so lovely, so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/006: You're the only one who says such things to me.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/007: No one understands my heart. Not even Father...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/009: If only our time together, like this today, could last forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/010: Don't worry. Not even death can part us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/011: If we trust in our feelings for each other and cherish them forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/012: Will you trust me and follow me, Mercedes?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/013: Cyrano, you're all I have. Stay by my side forever.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/014: Yes. Let's be together forever, whatever happens...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/016: I love you, Mercedes. More than anyone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/019: To have you here beside me... It feels like a dream.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/022: But your beauty is more than your appearance,/10d Mercedes.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/023: Mercedes,/15d /nyour heart aches for others' misfortunes as though they were your own.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/025: Don't look at me with those eyes./10d./10d./10d Please, not like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/028: Do you know how that kind heart makes you all the more lovely and beautiful?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/029: Your father's affairs.../8d./8d./8d have always brought you pain./15d I know that well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/031: No one understands my heart./10d Not even Father...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/033: If only our time together, like this today, could last forever...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/034: Will you trust me and follow me,/15d Mercedes?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/035: Cyrano, you're all I have./15d /nStay by my side forever.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/036: Yes. Let's be together forever./10d /nWhatever happens.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/038: I love you, Mercedes./18d/nMore than anyone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl00_s09/039: [Butler]/nYoung master, miss./nThe engagement ceremony is beginning. Please come into the hall.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka08a/000: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/001: Come on, let's head to Esther Dodd's Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/002: I don't know what's got into Meditch!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/003: ...? /nDidn't you say we were leaving for Libreville?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/004: When will you finally find peace of mind?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/005: Lady Esther Dodd seems to be no ordinary ruler.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/007: Eddster Dodd... Esther Dod... Dodster.../15d /nArgh... I can't remember the name.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/008: They say Libreville is strangely warm, despite lying at the northern tip of the imperial territories.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/010: Esther Dodd.../10d I wonder if she's really so beautiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/012: This is the Zephyr Falcon's strategy room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/013: Let's set off as soon as we're ready.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/014: Have you heard of the Secret Records of the Creation War? It's a fascinating book.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/016: You're all here./15d /nThen let's begin the meeting.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/017: A messenger from Lady Esther Dodd arrived a moment ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/020: Libreville is in the north of the empire, near Bifrost, where the Church's influence is relatively weak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/021: Then what does Libreville's ruler want?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/022: As you know, Bifrost's Grand Duke is a very ambitious man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/023: He began building up his army some time ago. Now he seems to be using it to pressure the lesser lords of the imperial territories near Bifrost.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/025: So she asked the Zephyr Falcon for help!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/027: Hmm... An imperial lord asking the Zephyr Falcon for help? Isn't that rather strange?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/028: Hmm... An imperial lord asking the Zephyr Falcon for help? Isn't that rather strange?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/029: I investigated from several angles for that very reason. I don't believe it's a trap.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/030: Lady Esther Dodd seems to have few ties to either the Church or Geysir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/031: Hahaha! What man could ignore a beautiful lady's plea?/15d /nCome on, let's be off!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/033: We'll discuss the details in Libreville.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/036: That's not what I mean.../15d There's/5d no key, so it can't be opened.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/038: Would you travel with our Fourth Unit as far as Caracas Forest?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/039: Travel to Caracas Forest with Kana's unit?/n(Traveling together will move you/nto Caracas Forest automatically.)
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/042: All right, let's head to Caracas Forest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/043: Shall we go as far as Caracas with Kana?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl10_s02/044: We'll go separately and get to know the terrain.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat02/000: The fortress here has been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltat02/000_3: The fortress here has been destroyed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/001: This is the Pendragon ferry bound for Storm Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/002: I'm sorry, but you can't board.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/003: This is the ferry to Storm Island.../10d What do I do now...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/007: How are the preparations for departure?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/008: Everything's going smoothly./nWe should be able to sail around dawn tomorrow.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/010: By the way, has everyone eaten?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/012: I thought as much./nI'll treat you all to a feast to celebrate our departure. Come to the tavern.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/014: Hahaha, don't worry. Who would want to go to Storm Island?/nIt'll be fine. Come along, everyone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/016: This is the ferry to Storm Island.../10d What do I do now...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/018: Explain the situation to a sailor.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/019: Hide and wait for a chance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/020: I have no choice.../10d Perhaps if I explain the situation, the sailor will let me aboard...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/021: Excuse me, could you take me to Storm Island?/30d I must get there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/022: Huh?/15d You want to board this ship?/20d /nNo. This ship is for... on Storm Island...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/023: Wait, I was getting bored anyway./15d Let's give this fellow a chance.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/024: A chance?/15d What do you mean?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/025: I'll ask a few questions. Think you can answer them? Get them right, and I'll take you to Storm Island.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/026: I haven't much choice, have I?/20d If you'll take me there, I'll try anything.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/027: Hmm... That's not a bad idea.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/028: All right! Answer correctly, and the two of us will make sure you get to Storm Island!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/029: Let's begin! Listen carefully and give your answer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/030: During the Creation War, what was the name of the alliance of the four eastern nations: Pendragon, Astania, Dagar and Curtis?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/033: I'll ask the second question./15d Choose one of these three answers.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/034: Beladin, the instigator of the Creation War, was a Dark God's heir./20d What did that god preside over?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/038: Oh dear, wrong answer./20d Dark Armor was the imperial alliance of the three western nations: Geysir, Trisis and Galad./20d It was also called the Black Flag.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/039: The four eastern nations formed Silver Arrow, an alliance led by Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/040: You didn't know that? It's common knowledge./nThink carefully about the next question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/041: Correct, as expected./15d Though it was an easy question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/042: Of course, you also know Dark Armor was the imperial alliance of the three western nations: Geysir, Trisis and Galad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/043: We'd better make the second question a little harder.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/044: Oh, right on the first try!/20d Yes, Beladin was the heir of Beramode, the Dark God of Conspiracy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/045: Was that a little difficult?/15d The Dark God who governs destruction is Eustacia of Destruction. Eustacia has nothing to do with Beladin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/046: The next question will be easier.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/047: Oh dear... The Dark Goddess of War was Shakbari./20d She had nothing to do with Beladin.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/050: Curtis is the continent's only republic. What was the name of its first president?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/055: Hmm, you know your history. Curtis's first president was Arcia./20d Ariana and Ariana Jr. supported him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/056: Ariana, known then as the Divine Archer, helped lay the foundations of the Curtis Republic./30d But Ariana never became president.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/057: I thought modern history would be easy. Did you get confused?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/058: Ariana Jr. was the son of Ariana, the Divine Archer, and a leading figure in the Curtis republic. But he was too young when it was founded.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/060: Pfft, hahaha! I didn't expect you to fall for that!/20d There was no such person as Arcia Jr.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/061: Perhaps you got mixed up, but it's wrong all the same.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/062: If you don't know this one, I'd hesitate to take you to Storm Island./20d Be sure to get it right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/063: How is Lady Eoline, who lives on Storm Island, related to His Majesty Rashid of Pendragon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/068: Correct, as expected./15d Few people don't know that Lady Eoline is His Majesty Rashid's elder sister.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/069: Now do your best on the final question.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/070: Tsk, tsk... His Majesty Rashid's daughter couldn't have been on Storm Island for 50 years./30d His eldest daughter isn't even 40 yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/071: You don't seem to know much about Lady Eoline.../20d That makes me hesitate to take you to Storm Island...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/072: Oh dear... His Majesty Rashid's parents both fell in the Battle of Glates early in the Creation War. Neither is alive today.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/074: Correct./10d Arcia was the first president of the Curtis Republic./15d Ariana and Ariana Jr. supported him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/075: You know modern history better than I expected.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/076: Hmm... They are siblings, yes.../20d But Lady Eoline is the older one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/078: This is the final question./15d It won't be easy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/079: During the Creation War, four swordsmen were known as the strongest on the continent.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/080: The Black Prince of the Geysir Empire, Rashid Pendragon of the Pendragon Kingdom, General Kars, one of the empire's Seven Warriors and Four Heavenly Kings, and Crow, the wandering swordsman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/081: People gave each of these four a title suited to his character and swordsmanship./30d Now, here's the question!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/082: What was General Kars's title among the four great swordsmen of the Creation War?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/087: Goodness! The Sword Emperor was the Overlord, the Black Prince./20d General Kars was his pupil and subordinate. Could a man serving a monarch be called an emperor?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/089: Sword Ghost.../15d No.../20d That was Crow, the elusive wandering swordsman.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/090: The final question... Sadly, you got it wrong.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/091: Tsk.../10d Surely Sword Saint was a title made for His Majesty Rashid, our Holy King.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/092: Kars was a great swordsman, but no saint./20d If anything, he leaned toward the sinister.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/093: Sword Demon!/15d Yes, correct!/nKars had reached the realm of a demonic blade, beyond the swordsmanship of mere mortals.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/094: His sword bore the fearsome name Gigadeth.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/095: They say more than its name was fearsome./20d Alongside the Black Prince's Asura, it was a legendary demon sword.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/096: In any case, you got the final question right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/097: Well, then.../20d You answered at least 3 questions correctly.../15d We'll let you aboard, as promised.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/098: We'll take responsibility for what comes next!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/100: Not at all. We enjoyed ourselves too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/101: Now, hurry into the hold./20d Before our captain returns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/102: Uh... Well.../20d Oh dear, you couldn't even answer 3 common-knowledge questions correctly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/106: Your situation seems desperate.../20d And you helped us pass the time. Why not give you passage in return?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/107: I agree./20d We could take you anyway. Getting a few questions wrong doesn't change that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/109: Thank you so much for taking me aboard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/110: All right, leave the rest to us. Get into the hold before our captain returns.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s06/112: Better to slip through when the watch is lax than confront them directly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltbo03/000: Who are you?!/nIf you have no business with the lord, get out!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldro09/000: This is one of the few rough-diamond mines in the imperial territories. We sell diamonds far below market price. Care to choose one?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldro09/002: Farewell. The way out is dangerous, so take care...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwga03a/000: North - Geysir City/nSouth - Nicosia, Memphis Region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfldin07a/000: At last, I've found Deimos' cave.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/001: Young master, I'm cleaning at the moment.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/002: Oh... Your engagement ceremony is today, young master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/003: ...My warmest congratulations on your engagement. As a woman, I can't help envying Mercedes. I wish you every happiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/002_3: Oh... Your engagement ceremony is today, young master.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflber03/003_3: ...My warmest congratulations on your engagement. As a woman, I can't help envying Mercedes. I wish you happiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/000: I'd like to go with you.../nI'll worry if you go alone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/001: It's been a long time since I led a team into the field...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/002: This mission is vital. You must succeed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/003: This is the Zephyr Falcon's strategy room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/004: Please make sure the mission succeeds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/006: I never expected to work alongside Cyrano.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/007: Is there really treasure to be found?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/009: I'm entrusting this to you./nI hope you succeed...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/010: Treasure hunting.../10d Well, it might make a nice change.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/015: Something has come up./nCardinal Cesare seems to be up to something in the Nicosia region.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/017: Our information suggests he's built a fortress in Nicosia and is plotting something there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/018: But it's heavily guarded. We haven't managed to get our agents inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/019: Your mission is to go there with me and find out what he's doing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/020: Nicosia is a small region south of Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/021: Then we'll have to head south through Geysir City./15d/nIt's quite a journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/023: Have you been there?/15d/nIt was the old empire's capital. Even now, it's the empire's foremost city...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/024: Lord Frederick's Ron seems livelier these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/025: It is the domain of Lord Frederick, the empire's strongest man, after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/026: The Zephyr Falcon's reach doesn't extend there yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/028: If anything changes here, we'll send a messenger to let you know.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/032: ....../20d All right./nI won't open the drawer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/033: Anyway... Th-that drawer.../120d/nYou mustn't open it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/037: Will we really find the treasure?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/040: May you find peace in your heart too...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/041: So, Advisor, you're saying Cesare plans to bring in Bifrost's army?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/042: I'm almost certain of it./nWe've long detected secret dealings between Bifrost and the Church. But Cesare's right-hand man, Machiavelli, heading there himself is especially alarming.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/043: Cesare's right-hand man, Machiavelli, heading to Bifrost himself this time is especially alarming.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/046: Machiavelli is a very well-known name among scholars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/047: Machiavelli is a very well-known name among scholars.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/048: He's made a name for himself by studying new ideas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/049: ...He was my closest friend as a child./nTo think he's working for Cesare...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/050: He and our Advisor are now famous as the empire's two sages.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/052: In any case, he is known for philosophy and history. My strengths lie in strategy and military history.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/053: He was a genius even as a child. But he came from a poor family and burned with ambition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/054: Whatever the case, with him heading to Bifrost himself, we cannot sit idly by.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/057: No, Kana. I have a separate task for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/059: I happened to obtain a treasure map recently./nExamination has confirmed it's a genuine map left by the old mercenary company, Cashmir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/060: That treasure could solve our funding and equipment problems after the blow Lord Frederick dealt us recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/062: He was a genius even as a child. But he came from a poor family and burned with ambition.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/063: What... I have to go too?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/064: Yes, please accompany Kana this time./nIsabele and Meditch, you as well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/065: So while Cyrano pursues Machiavelli, we're supposed to go treasure hunting?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/066: Yes!/nWith you coming too, we won't have any trouble!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/067: ...../25d Well, a little break now and then might be nice.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/068: And Rhidelhard, help Cyrano pursue Machiavelli.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/070: This mission is important to us. Put your personal feelings aside and make sure it succeeds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/076: To reach Bifrost, you must pass through Libreville./nShall I see you as far as Caracas Forest for now?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/077: Travel to Caracas Forest with Kana and the others?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/080: All right, let's head to Caracas with Kana and the others!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/082: I'm sorry, but I'd like to explore the nearby dungeons a little more.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/083: There is nothing we can do...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/084: They say a unicorn spirit is sealed in a cave on Mount Mantigoa, near the Bifrost border.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/085: Have you heard about the new sword recently developed by Pendragon's Chrysaor Company?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/086: I hear it outperforms existing mass-produced swords at a reasonable price, so the Pendragon army has adopted it as its standard sword./nIt hasn't reached the imperial territories yet, but swordsmen are already talking about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/087: Pendragon's new sword? You mean the PS-7 'Blitz'?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/088: I hear it was designed to counter the Tuer lightsabers./nIt's made from a special alloy rather than ordinary metal, making it resistant to heat and impact. They say its outstanding Attack and Defense make it a superb weapon...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s02/089: I think we'll need Silver's help with this mission.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/001: This is Paro Village. We're fairly close to Geysir City, but our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/002: Unlike the noisy world outside, our village is peaceful and quiet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/003: It's terrible. The most handsome man in the village has fallen mentally ill... And he even has a fiancee.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/004: This village is quite remote, so we don't get many visitors.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/005: But a chef from out of town moved here recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/006: He was looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine. Apparently, he liked how clean it is here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/007: I was invited to Geysir City once before.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/008: The wide streets, beautiful buildings and splendid people were dazzling.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/009: Living in a city must be so much more wonderful than living in a country village like this...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/010: Our village is so small that even the lord pays it no attention.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/011: Hehe... Thanks to that, we can live freely here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/012: Geysir City? Hah, city life is an illusion. It looks splendid on the surface, but there's no real freedom there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/013: I told you I was right! That engagement was a mistake! That family should never have allowed anyone to marry at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/014: I'm sorry to say this about Brian, but didn't both sides end up unhappy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/015: That family is cursed... They may be the richest family in Paro, but they have nothing to do with our village's peaceful life.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/016: Our lord must really like children. There are quite a few of them in his house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/018: The lord likes flowers, too. I hear his garden is full of them.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/019: I've seen Sharon perform too./20d She was so beautiful... And such a good dancer.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/020: I wanted her autograph, but all the older boys pushed ahead of me. I never got one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/021: If you meet Sharon, could you get her autograph for me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/022: [Dan Waring]/nOur family is cursed./15d I was against my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/023: [Dan Waring] /nAfter everything that's happened lately, my son seems to have realized what runs in our family's blood./10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/024: [Dan Waring] /nNow this cursed bloodline will come to an end.../10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm finished. To have done something so terrible with my own hands.../20d Marriage?/10d I was a fool to hope for that!/15d Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need your sympathy. Don't try to persuade me./20d All that's left for me is death...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/027: [Diana] /nNo, he can't have gone mad. He really can't.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/028: [Diana] /nSomething is wrong here.../20d Brian has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/030: [Haisen]/nMy name is Haisen. Dan and I are old friends.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/031: [Haisen]/nI'm trying to persuade Diana, to keep my friend's son from becoming unhappy...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/033: The strange thing is that there's been no news at all about the singer Sharon lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/034: She's a popular singer with plenty of fans. Why has all news of her suddenly stopped?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/035: What's even more shocking is that those pieces were found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/036: Welcome. Whatever else you may think of us, we certainly serve generous portions.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/037: Where on earth has Rashid III, first in line to the Pendragon throne, gone into hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/038: Well, King Rashid is still hale and hearty, so he won't inherit the throne soon... But if he ever visits my place, I'll give him plenty of snacks on the house...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/039: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant in Caracas, near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/040: He's a fine cook, but far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/041: Whenever he gets the chance, he pesters me to find good ingredients for him too. Ha ha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/042: Ho ho ho... Do you think someone who can rule the Empire will truly emerge soon?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/043: Wouldn't anyone seeking supremacy over the empire need enough power to defeat Cesare Borgia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/044: They say someone has drawn Asura, the sword that decides who will rule the empire... But rumors are only rumors, aren't they? Hohoho.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/046: I got Sharon's autograph at her last performance. Heh heh heh... I'm the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/047: I won't sell this, no matter how much money you offer./15d I'm going to pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/048: Hmm... I might consider it if you brought something truly special. A fragment of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/049: Diana is the most beautiful woman in the village. All the men here admire her.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/050: Brian was admired by all the women here, too. You wouldn't believe the gossip when Diana announced she was going to marry him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/051: In a way, nobody welcomed the engagement except the couple themselves.../20d Everyone was jealous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/052: Welcome. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/054: Thank you for shopping with us. Goodbye.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/056: You're giving it to me, aren't you?/10d Oh, I'm so happy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/057: I'll give you something in return!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/059: I found this ring in the forest recently! Isn't it pretty?/20d Thank you for the autograph!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/060: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/061: It's a flower said to bloom only where true love takes root. The herb is very rare, so keep it safe and deliver it to my younger brother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/063: Would you like to stay the night? Our master offers hospitality to guests who visit the house.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/069: I'll have more fine goods for you next time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/070: Wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCrimes: Arson and murder/nBounty: 1,000,000 Eld
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/071: Will you agree to get Sharon's autograph for the girl?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/072: If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/073: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/074: All right. If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/076: I'm sorry, but I'm too busy to help.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/077: Besides, an autograph means more if you get it yourself./20d Don't ask someone else. Go and find Sharon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/078: Aww... That's mean.../10d I'm too young to travel!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/079: Thank you./nDon't forget your promise to get the autograph for me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/081: Our lives may not be glamorous, but we take pride in living peacefully and quietly.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/082: [Brian Waring]/nGet out of my way! Go away! Please, just leave me alone!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/083: Did she quit, or is there some other reason...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/084: [Brian Waring]/nMy symptoms first appeared last autumn. On the evening of the village festival, I got terribly drunk./10d I ate and drank without thinking, and when I came to, I was at home./10d I went to the bathroom to cool my aching head, and there was blood on my hands...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/085: [Brian Waring]/nI thought I must have hurt myself, but I checked my whole body and found no wounds. The next day, I heard that a wolf had broken into a farm in our village, killed chickens and livestock, and fled./10d But... but I had a feeling it hadn't been a wolf.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/086: [Brian Waring]/nAt first, I convinced myself it had only been a nightmare. But the symptoms continued after that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow I'm afraid to wake up. When I find my room in disarray or my hands covered in blood, I'm terrified... terrified of myself./10d I'm afraid.../10d Afraid... Now I'm even afraid to sleep.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/088: [Brian Waring]/nMarriage! Ha... ha ha ha! One day I might wake to find my beloved Diana, with my own hands... No! No, never that! I cannot marry./10d Not while this cursed blood flows in me. Heh... heh heh...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/089: [Dan Waring]/n... Mental illness has run in our family for generations. It's the price of our ancestors' sin: marrying relatives to preserve the bloodline... A bloodline like ours should disappear from this world. Don't you agree?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/090: [Diana]/nBrian has gone mad? That's impossible! Just a year ago, there was absolutely nothing wrong with him!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/091: [Diana]/nWe first met at Geysir Academy. I was looking for a quiet country village myself, so I moved here. We got engaged about a year after I arrived.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana, people with mental illness aren't always like that. They have episodes from time to time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If something really, really is wrong with him, why won't he even let a doctor examine him? If it's an illness, can't it be cured?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/094: [Haisen]/nIt isn't an illness that can be cured. It's inherited in that family... Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/095: [Diana]/nNo, no. That can't be true! I'll... I'll cure him, whatever it takes. I will!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/096: The Warings? That family has been cursed for ages. No one in it has ever died a normal death.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/097: For instance, Dan's parents went missing, and his wife died when their boat capsized while they were out together.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/098: When Dan's wife died, a rumor spread through the village that he'd pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/099: Now it's his son's turn? Poor fellow...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/100: It seems that family really does have some hereditary problem.
