Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/101: You could see it that way. But perhaps the real cause is that the family is so wealthy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/102: You mean their wealth made them mentally ill?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/103: Not exactly... That family has always been full of plots over inheritances and succession rights. Perhaps that's why its members are so strange?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/104: Come to think of it, wasn't there once some doubt about whether Brian really was Dan's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/106: So they tried to reduce disputes by marrying relatives, and that led to mental illness running in the family...? When you think of it that way, having a lot of money doesn't seem so wonderful after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/107: [Dan Waring]/nI opposed my son's marriage from the very beginning. It was absolutely out of the question. Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/108: Excuse me. I'm going to visit Dan and would like to bring him something. What would you recommend?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/109: A family full of plots... I'd like to learn more about them. Perhaps other people could tell me more?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, Dan Waring? He says his eyesight has been poor lately, and he's taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/111: [Pharmacy Owner]/nPerhaps he's been distracted by what's happening with his son, but he hasn't come back even though it's time to buy more. It would be good if you bought some for him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/112: Datura... Isn't that a dangerous poison?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt's all right. He's been taking that medicine for a long time, so he knows the dosage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/117: So... he was behind all this. Let's go to the Waring house... I have to settle this.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/118: Excuse me. Do you know anything about the Warings?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/119: The Warings? Of course! They've always been trouble. I knew it when Rachel married into the family. Their marriages have never felt right... Even this one...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/120: (She'll never stop if I let her keep talking.)/nAh... ma'am. Who is this Rachel?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/121: Rachel? Dan's wife, of course. Haisen liked her, too. When Dan and Rachel got married, Haisen was heartbroken and went traveling far away. He only returned recently. But not long after he left, trouble started.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/123: Rachel gave birth to Brian, a little earlier than expected. People whispered that he might not really be Dan's son. Dan did publicly acknowledge him later, but...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/124: People suspected there was something between Rachel and Haisen, but since Haisen himself wasn't around, the matter eventually faded away.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/125: Well, I'm not saying it happened... Only that it could have, you know? Oh dear, listen to me gossiping like this to a stranger... Well then.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/126: Interesting. A family plagued by madness, with such a tangled history... Now the father seems suspicious. Let's investigate further.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/127: [Brian Waring]/nWhat do you want from a lunatic like me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/128: A lunatic... In a way, is anyone in this world truly sane? But there's nothing wrong with you.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat... what do you mean, there's nothing wrong with me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/131: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWelcome. What can I get you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/132: So this is the village pharmacy. If someone deliberately caused Brian Waring's condition, perhaps I can find a clue here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/134: I haven't seen you before. Is this your first visit to our village?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/135: Yes, this is my first time here. But...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/138: [Diana]/nIt's true that he started growing depressed about a year ago, and eventually began saying stranger and stranger things. But to me, he seems perfectly normal.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/140: Ask about the background of the incident.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/141: Are you saying Brian Waring might not be Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/142: What is it? I'll help however I can.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/144: Ask who has bought potent poisons recently.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/145: Ask what gift Dan Waring would like.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/146: I know it's an imposition, but could I have a list of people who've bought potent poisons recently?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Do you look down on us because we're a small village pharmacy? We have professional ethics too. Do you expect us to hand over such information to a complete stranger?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf that's the sort of question you're going to ask, get out of here!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/150: Well... They're giving me the cold shoulder because I'm from out of town... Still, why am I meddling in someone else's business? I should get on with my own affairs.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/151: [Mr. Haisen]/nDiana, you mustn't do this. Let's go home at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/152: No, this is actually perfect. Please listen to what I have to say here, Mr. Haisen and Miss Diana.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/153: First, let me make this clear: Brian Waring is not mentally ill. He has been caught in a trap set by someone who wanted him to appear mad.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/155: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you talking about?! My son needs complete rest!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/157: I hear you've spent a long time traveling, Mr. Haisen. You must have heard of datura on your travels, haven't you?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/158: [Mr. Haisen]/nDatura? Isn't that a deadly poison that causes hallucinations? Taking too much can even kill you...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/159: [Brian Waring]/nI can't taste anything I eat or drink anymore. My head always feels heavy, and there's a bitter taste in my mouth...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/160: Exactly. Datura has a bitter taste, and the headaches and dizziness persist even after the hallucinations wear off./nHasn't Brian Waring been complaining of a bitter taste and dizziness lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/162: And you, Dan Waring! Haven't you been taking medicine made from datura lately?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/166: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you talking about...? I do take medicine made from datura, but why would I hurt my own son...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/167: Even if he isn't your son?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/168: [Brian Waring]/nWhat are you saying...?! He is my father!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/169: I think Haisen knows the answer to that better than anyone. Don't you, Mr. Haisen?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/173: [Dan Waring]/nWhy... why do you call me your father? Who could understand my shock and rage when Rachel... when Rachel said she was pregnant?! I couldn't father a child...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/175: [Dan Waring]/nYour mother... your mother, by the lake, with these hands I... No, no! It wasn't me! She jumped in! Yes, she jumped in herself!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/176: Did that resentment drive you to poison your son, make him hallucinate, and stage all of this?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/177: Mr. Haisen, aren't you Brian's real father? Out of jealousy, Dan gave Brian datura to make him hallucinate, then staged things to make him seem mad. His mother's death probably wasn't a simple accident, either. Isn't that right, Dan Waring?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/178: [Dan Waring]/nDamn it, my head hurts! I need to go to the pharmacy and get some medicine!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/181: Dan Waring... has gone to seek his own answer. You mustn't follow him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/182: Then will you be leaving, Brian?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I'd like to travel for a while to clear my head. With my beloved Diana, of course... Oh, one moment. Would you come over here?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is our family heirloom. It holds sad memories for us, but I'm sure it could bring you happy ones. I'd be grateful if you accepted it...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/187: Diana's house. She must be away traveling now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/188: The Waring house. They must be away traveling now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/189: Do you know anything about Diana?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/190: Diana? She followed Brian here about two years ago, after he'd gone to Geysir to study. They seem to have met while he was a student.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/191: Still, her natural beauty and bright, outgoing personality caught every man's attention as soon as she arrived. Well, she wasn't engaged at the time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/192: Hmph... It wouldn't be an exaggeration to say every young man in the village courted her. Men, honestly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/193: [Tavern Owner]/nBut isn't it strange that no one knows anything about Diana's background? She still lives alone...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/194: Come to think of it, I heard a rumor that a young man from the village tried to court her behind the party hall and was coldly rejected. Didn't she say, "I don't want anything to do with a man like you, with no power or money!"?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/195: From what I heard, she rejected him because he tried to drag her away by force. The rumor got twisted, though.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/196: [Tavern Owner]/nWho can tell what goes on in a woman's heart...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/197: I'd like to hear about Brian Waring calling off his engagement...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/198: That? Diana and Brian became engaged about a year ago. Then recently, Brian suddenly called it off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/199: His mental illness was the reason! It caused quite a sensation in the village.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/200: [Tavern Owner]/nHonestly, nobody welcomed that engagement except the couple themselves. His father's madness was well known, and nobody in the village wanted the Waring fortune going to an outsider, did they?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/201: But has Brian really become mentally ill? He has been acting very strangely lately.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/202: It's true that livestock have been killed on farms all over the village lately, and they say Brian did it all. Would a sane person do that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/203: [Tavern Owner]/nIt's true that some things don't quite add up...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/204: Then Brian Waring and his father Dan have always been a little strange?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we'll meet again on our travels.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/206: What a shock. Dan Waring was the culprit all along.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/207: Now, a toast to Diana's newfound happiness...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/208: Welcome. Our mistress, Diana, has asked us to offer visiting guests a free night's stay. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/211: [Diana]/NNow I'll be with him... with him, anywhere in the world...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/212: Thank you so, so much for getting me that autograph!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/001_3: This is Paro Village. We're fairly close to Geysir City, but our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/002_3: Our village has always considered a peaceful, quiet life a virtue.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/006_3: He was looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine. Apparently, he liked how clean it is here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/012_3: Geysir City? Hah, city life is an illusion. It looks splendid on the surface, but there's no real freedom there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/013_3: I told you I was right! That engagement was a mistake! That family should never have allowed anyone to marry at all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/014_3: I'm sorry to say this about Hugh, but didn't both sides end up unhappy?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/015_3: The Warings may be the richest family in Paro Village, but they're terribly unhappy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/018_3: Oh, one of my friends was as pretty as a girl. That friend is at the lord's house now, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/019_3: I've seen Sharon perform, too. She was so pretty... And she danced so well.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/020_3: I wanted her autograph, but the older boys all pushed ahead of me in line, so I didn't get one.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/021_3: If you happen to meet Sharon, could you get me her autograph?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/022_3: [Charles Waring]/nOur family is cursed. I was against my son's marriage.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/023_3: [Charles Waring]/nAfter everything that's happened lately, my son seems to have realized what runs in our family's blood. Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/024_3: [Charles Waring]/nNow this cursed bloodline will come to an end... Hehehe...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/025_3: [Hugh Waring]/nI'm finished. I did something terrible with my own hands... Marriage? What a fool I was to hope for that! Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/026_3: [Charles]/nI don't need your sympathy. Don't try to persuade me. All that's left for me is death...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/027_3: [Diana] /nThis is absurd! He was perfectly fine yesterday, and now he's calling off the engagement because he says he's mentally ill?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/028_3: [Diana] /nSomething is wrong here. Hugh has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/030_3: [ Frobisher ]/nI'm Diana's father. Charles and I are old friends.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/031_3: [Frobisher]/nAs her father, I can't just stand by and watch my daughter become unhappy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/032_3: [Frobisher]/nBut it's difficult to know what to do now. Whether she marries or not, it seems she'll be unhappy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/035_3: What's even more shocking is that those severed pieces were found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/037_3: Where on earth has Rashid III, third in line to the Pendragon throne, gone into hiding?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/038_3: Well, King Rashid has lived so long that inheriting the throne won't be easy... But if he ever comes here, I'd gladly give him plenty of snacks on the house...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/039_3: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant in Caracas, near here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/040_3: He's a fine cook, but far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/041_3: Whenever he gets the chance, he pesters me to find good ingredients for him too. Ha ha...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/042_3: Hohoho... Do you really think someone will rise to rule the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/047_3: I won't sell this, no matter how much money you offer. I'm going to pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/048_3: Hmm... I might consider it if you brought something truly special. A fragment of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/050_3: Hugh was admired by all the women here, too. You wouldn't believe the gossip when she announced she was going to marry him...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/051_3: In a way, nobody welcomed the engagement except the couple themselves. Everyone was jealous...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/055_3: Oh... This is Sharon's autograph! Eeeee!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/056_3: You're giving this to me, right? Oh, I'm so happy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/059_3: I found this ring in the forest a little while ago! Isn't it pretty? Thank you for the autograph!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/060_3: This is the Love Herb I found in the forest near Caracas not long ago.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltfa01/061_3: They say this flower blooms only where true love has taken root. It's a very rare herb, so keep it safe and give it to my younger brother.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/000: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/001: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/002: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/003: I've never seen business this bad in all my life. Hardly any shops are open now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/004: It's all because of failed policies. Those damned Tuer people make it impossible to do business!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/005: Those foolish officials and nobles in the central government ruin even things that should work!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/006: The current difficulties are only temporary. There's no need to get so worked up.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/007: Where did that brat go? How dare he slap a lady's backside and run away?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/008: Just let me catch him! I'll teach him a lesson so he never does that again!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/009: Aah! What a terrifying woman! She just won't stop chasing me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/010: If every woman in the world were like that, how could I ever get by?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/012: Hmph... Is this really Dakama, the greatest port of all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/013: Every shop is closed, and all we can do is stare at the sky. What on earth is going on?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/014: The wandering merchants all look forward to one day settling down.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/015: But the funny thing is, once they can finally settle down, they can't bear it for long and leave again.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/016: Perhaps they're born to wander... My father shared that fate. I wonder where he is now...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/017: I heard that King Rashid's grandson, Rashid III, has not returned to the palace yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/018: It seems he plans to be away from the palace for quite a while this time. With all those complicated problems, staying there must feel like sitting on pins and needles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/019: Still, his black hair is so attractive...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/020: It is Holy Sabbatical Week. The chapel is closed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/021: Hmph... Is this really Dakama, the greatest port of all?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/022: It's all because of failed policies. Those damned Tuer people make it impossible to do business!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/023: What matters most is doing your best at what you can do now. Nobody knows what the future holds.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/024: Even if there's very little you can do here right now, surely you'll find something more if you look hard enough?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/025: Welcome to our inn. A night's stay costs 100 Eld. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/026: Thank you. Please make yourself comfortable and rest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/027: Business is hard enough already. More customers like this would be trouble.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/029: Our boss is a monster of an old man. At his age, he still gets up at four in the morning and works until midnight!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/030: When the boss works hard, it's the employees who end up exhausted...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/031: ... Honestly, sometimes I wish something would happen to that old man.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/032: I'm a scholar from Bifrost. I've come to Dakama to gather material for my research.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/033: I finally made time to come and do some research, only to find the economy in this state...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/034: Well, it shouldn't affect my research, but people can't live on food alone. There's absolutely nothing to do here except research...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/035: I'm an officer from Curtis. I've come here to contact someone.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/036: The details are military secrets, so I can't tell you. But the information could be decisive in the fight against the Tuer Empire.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/037: I plan to stay a few days, then head straight to Pendragon's capital once my pass is issued.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/038: I'm a Tuer mage who has become a naturalized citizen here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/039: It's been almost a year since I was naturalized. After a year, I'll receive a permit to enter Pendragon.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/040: Why did I leave the Tuer people and become a citizen of Pendragon? For love. I'd give my life for her, let alone my nationality...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/042: This is the finest accessory shop in the world!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/043: I've worked here all my life and saved quite a bit. Now I plan to pass the shop on to my granddaughter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/044: But it's hard for a woman to run a shop alone. I need to find a husband for my granddaughter... Know any good men?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/045: Why is Grandpa so desperate to get my sister married?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/046: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/047: Why does King Rashid send a ferry to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/048: Excuse me, do you know anything about Storm Island?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/049: Storm Island?/nWho are you, and why are you interested in that place?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/050: Storm Island?/nWhy are you interested in a place like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/051: Because I have a reason I must go there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/052: I hear quite a few people went there chasing vain dreams decades ago...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/053: I didn't know there were still people like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/054: In any case, King Rashid sends a ferry there every year.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/055: I hear there's a ship leaving soon. You should ask about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/056: Hello. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/058: Thank you for shopping with us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/059: The man at the inn knows lots of stories about the old days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/060: I sometimes go and listen to all sorts of stories from him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/061: This door seems to be locked.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/062: The free trade zone ends here. You are not allowed to leave without a permit.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/063: It seems he plans to be away from the palace for quite a while this time. With all those complicated problems, staying there must feel like sitting on pins and needles.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/064: I heard that he used to be a traveling bard.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/047_2: Why does Holy King Rashid send a ferry to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/050_2: Storm Island?/nWhy would someone like you be interested in a place like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/053_2: I didn't know there were still people like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/054_2: In any case, Holy King Rashid sends a ferry there every year.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/059_2: The old man at the inn knows lots of stories about the old days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/060_2: I sometimes go and listen to all sorts of stories from him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/061_2: This place seems to be shut.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/047_3: Why does Holy King Rashid send a ferry to Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/050_3: Storm Island?/nWhy would someone like you be interested in a place like that?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/053_3: I didn't know there were still people like that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/054_3: In any case, Holy King Rashid sends a ferry there every year.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/059_3: The old man at the inn knows lots of stories about the old days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/060_3: I sometimes go and listen to all sorts of stories from him.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltda02/061_3: This place seems to be shut.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflck02/000: This path doesn't seem to lead this way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/000: Not just anyone can enter the cathedral!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/001: Entry to the cathedral is restricted at present.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/002: The cathedral is sacred ground. It is certainly not a place just anyone can enter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/003: Dear me... The trouble with people these days is that their faith is so weak.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/004: Divine power must manifest itself strongly, so that their faith grows stronger.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/005: Anyone who doubts the faith proves they have none! They have already been led astray by evil!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/006: Unconditional faith is true love for God! You must believe!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltga03/002_3: The cathedral is sacred ground. It is certainly not a place just anyone can enter.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/000: Come on, everyone, keep going. We're almost at Cerepus.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/001: Hey, newcomer. Did you say this was your first trip through the Trisis Desert?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/003: Hehe, trading across Trisis is one of the best ways to make a fortune from nothing. But for a newcomer to the desert, it's also a fine way to get killed.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/004: You're lucky you found companions like us.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/005: Don't waste your strength on idle chatter! If we run into desert bandits, we'll have to run for our lives. Save your energy!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/011: Damn... I lost the bandits, but I got separated from my companions.../30d Where do I go now...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/012: Cerepus should be to the southeast./30d They said it wasn't far, so I have no choice but to keep walking.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl03_s01/013: Ugh... I can't go on.../30d Is this as far as I can get...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/002: Hoho, you haven't changed either./15d My learned friend!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/003: His Excellency Cesare certainly has an eye for talent./15d/nTo think he transformed a mere country farmer's daughter into what you are now.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/004: Hmph, we simply have an arrangement.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/005: You get what you want, and I get what I want. That's all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/007: Don't worry. The Grand Duke has already made up his mind.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/008: Oh? Then he'll send troops to the empire?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/009: The Grand Duke himself suffered humiliation at the empire's hands when he was young.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/010: The old senators' conservatism held him back all this time. But now that the assassins you sent have eliminated the senior senators,/15d nothing stands in his way.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/011: Good./10d Then tomorrow's talks should be easy.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/012: And that excavation you mentioned last time...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/013: You mean Ascalon./15d/nThat's still a long way off.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/014: They seem to have roughly located it, but apparently the excavation will take enormous time and manpower.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/015: Well, with Bifrost's great army, we may not even need a magic machine.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/016: If the Valkyries are deployed, they'll easily deal with the Zephyr Falcon or Frederick's artillery.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/017: You may have to work harder to keep them from taking the entire empire for themselves.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/018: Hehe, His Excellency the Cardinal already has a plan for that.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/021: Hohoho,/15d those fools don't realize that Bifrost's deployment will mean the empire's downfall./30d How pitiful.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/022: Hehe, these troops are being sent at the imperial cardinal's request, so Pendragon won't be able to do anything about it.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/023: For a nation that professes neutrality, this is an ideal opportunity.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/024: But Cardinal Cesare isn't a man to underestimate./15d/nYou should be careful too, Your Majesty.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/025: Haha, do you really think so little of me?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl12_s07/026: Well,/10d shall I show you whether I'm so easily dismissed?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss52/000: The road is cut off here.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/001: So it was you, Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/002: The man who destroyed our supply base and disrupted our forces from the rear...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/003: Hehehe. But Lady Luck is on my side.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/004: This bridge is the Zephyr Falcon's lifeline. Once we seize it, victory is ours!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/005: Come, let's settle this again!/10d/nI'll avenge my humiliation last time.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/006: H-how can this be...?/nTo lose... twice...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmiss71/010: Do not run on the bridge.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy04/000: The meeting room is always kept ready for use.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfltzy04/001: The meeting room is the heart of the Zephyr Falcon. I put all my effort into keeping it clean.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflwka03a/000: North - Caracas Region/nSouth - Paro Region/nWest - Geysir City, Pretoria Region
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/001: The only God of Destruction left on the surface is sealed in this underwater city. You're very lucky.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/002: Hehe, calling it luck is a bit much. You have no idea how much effort I put into finding this God of Destruction.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/003: But be careful. The God of Destruction has immense power, and even we can't control it properly. One mistake, and we could become its victims.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/004: That's why I'm here, isn't it?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/006: Still, I really didn't expect you to agree to my request so readily.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/007: I'll do anything if it lets me kill that enemy of mine, Cyrano, with my own hands.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/008: I don't want to waste another moment. Let's begin the ritual at once.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl17_s04/009: That's the spirit. Shall we begin?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/000: Nicosia, where the Church fortress stands, is at the southern tip of the continent, beyond Geysir City in the center.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/001: They say Libreville lies north of Caracas Forest.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/002: Our destinations are nearby Pretoria, Memphis at the southern tip of the continent, and Bordeaux north of Ron City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kflmzy06/003: We must pursue Machiavelli, who is heading for Bifrost through Libreville, north of Caracas.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/001: If you work hard, you can be like me, too.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/002: Please go to the Nicosia region and assess the military situation.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/003: This is the Zephyr Falcon's strategy room.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/004: Nicosia is a small city south of Geysir.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/005: Ugh... I haven't been out on a mission lately. I'm itching for action.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/006: I hear you're leaving for Nicosia?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/007: Somehow, I feel safer with you around, rookie.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/008: Our mission this time is to gather intelligence.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/009: Hmph, let me make this clear: I don't like you!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/010: You're annoying me! Please stop pestering me and go away!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/011: ...Isabele really is beautiful.../15d/nHuh?/10d What are you doing here?!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/015: Something has come up./nCardinal Cesare seems to be up to something in the Nicosia region.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/017: Our information suggests he's built a fortress in Nicosia and is plotting something there.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/018: But it's heavily guarded. We haven't managed to get our agents inside.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/019: Your mission is to go there with me and find out what he's doing.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/020: Nicosia is a small region south of Geysir City.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/021: Then we'll have to head south through Geysir City./15d/nIt's quite a journey.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/023: Have you been there?/15d/nIt was the old empire's capital. Even now, it's the empire's foremost city...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/024: Lord Frederick's Ron seems livelier these days.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/025: It is the domain of Lord Frederick, the empire's strongest man, after all.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/026: The Zephyr Falcon's reach doesn't extend there yet.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/028: If anything changes here, we'll send a messenger to let you know.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/033: Anyway... Th-that drawer.../120d/nYou mustn't open it!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/036: Geysir City.../10d/nHas it been fifteen years...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl09_s01/038: You left me behind.../nWait for me!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/001: Ugh... I need to get out of here quickly...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/005: Hehehe... So you were here after all, Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/006: Damn it... Why now, of all times...?
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/007: Lord Cesare has ordered me to take your life!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/010: ...Well, that was disappointing. You've collapsed already.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/011: Hehehe... Just hold on a little longer. I'll put an end to your pain...
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/013: We're the ones you'll be fighting!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/017: We don't have time to explain everything. Come on, then!
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/019: He seems to have drunk poison... but something isn't right.
Lines.text.ko/art_|@kfl16_s02/020: .../10d Let's get out of here first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber02/001: Hehe, Cyrano./15d/nI'm sorry, but would you mind leaving?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber02/001_3: Hehe, Cyrano./nI'm sorry, but would you mind leaving?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/010: Please don't say that.../35d/nPlease make a serious effort to find Christina./45d/nYou could find her easily if you tried.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/020: The one who brings glory to the Frederick family/45d/nwill probably be Christina Frederick,/30d rather than me, Alfred Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/021: Is there still/20d no news of Christina?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/023: Our daughter has been away from home for three months.../45d/nAnd you/20d are so unconcerned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/024: Haha,/50d when I was her age,/20d/nI traveled the world to broaden my horizons, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/025: This trip will be/30d a good experience for Christina,/nso please/35d don't worry too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/026: How can you say that?/35d/nShe's only fifteen!/35d And she's a girl!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/027: But/30d I do understand how she feels./45d/nShe's only fifteen,/30d and we told her to marry a man she's never met...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/028: But to run away from home.../45d It's your fault!/30d/nFrom her childhood,/20d you taught her martial arts as if she were a boy!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/029: Haha!/50d Don't worry./40d/nShe may be my daughter,/30d but she really was born with extraordinary talent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/030: If she/50d comes to any harm,/15d I...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/031: .../70d I didn't realize you were so worried./60d/nVery well./40d I'll look for her while I have the opportunity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/032: In fact,/40d I hear the church my father-in-law/35d recently founded in Nicosia/nwas destroyed/35d by the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/034: Darling.../40d He's the one/25d who raised me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/035: Another rebellion.../55d/nI'm worried my father-in-law is oppressing the common people too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/036: Even if it was her grandfather's wish,/55d/nshe would find it hard to accept.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/037: .../50d I'm sorry./75d/nJust for raising you,/35d your father deserves my deepest gratitude.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/038: In any case,/40d the Zephyr Falcon has been/30d running wild without fear lately./45d/nIt might be good to teach them a lesson.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/039: Then,/15d are you planning an expedition?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s01/040: For now,/30d I'll deal with the Zephyr Falcon/35d/nand seek news of Christina along the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s07/000: So this is.../40d Asura's true nature...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s07/001: .../30dWith my own strength.../30d/nCan I subdue this enormous monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/000: Well.../50d it's time for us to part.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/002: The empire/45d has regained peace thanks to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/003: And yet/30d you, of all people,/40d are leaving us...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/004: I wasn't the one who saved the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/005: It was everyone who stood with the Zephyr Falcon/40d/nand resisted Cesare who saved the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/007: You're a member of the Zephyr Falcon too, aren't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/010: You're a strange fellow, right to the end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/011: There's no better place than the empire, you know.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/013: Rhidelhard,/20d must you be like this right to the end?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/014: Now that the empire is at peace, I can leave without worry./50d/nNow.../30d I have no regrets left here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/016: I'm sorry,/30d for so many things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/017: Don't worry about it./35d It's nothing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/018: I admit that you are the strongest swordsman in the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/020: But/30d when it comes to imperial swordsmanship,/30d Meditch is the greatest!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/021: On that point,/30d I won't give an inch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/024: Rhidelhard,/30d is Meditch all you ever think about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/028: [Christina]/n...Mr. Cyrano./45d Could you tell me why you're leaving?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/030: ...I'm leaving because I want to see a new world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/031: It might be the east of this continent,/45d or a distant island.../35d Perhaps/35d even the Eastern Continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/032: I thought I'd like to see new things/40d in unfamiliar places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/033: No,/30d surely that isn't your only reason?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/034: ...After everything that's happened,/30d I've come to realize something.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/035: Even at the end of revenge,/45d no new hope blossoms.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/036: Only peace of mind that rises above hatred/40d can erase it./80d/nNegative emotions/30d bring us nothing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/037: I've realized that finding forgiveness within myself.../65d/nis the only way/45d to be free of hatred.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/039: So,/40d I wanted to leave the memories of my unhappy past buried in this land.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/040: With only the beautiful memories in my heart,/60d/nI want to experience a new world/45d somewhere no one knows me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/042: If you can break free of revenge/40d and live for your own peace,/50d/nwe can/25d gladly see you off, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/045: [Christina]/nThere's one last thing I'd like to ask...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/050: Haha,/30d sorry about that./25d I'm late again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/053: I'm glad I made it in time...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/054: I was looking for a lost little girl's mother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/059: Well,/15d it's nice to see him as cheerful as ever, isn't it?/40d Haha.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/061: Now that you're leaving,/20d I have to admit I'll miss you./80d/nIt's made me realize again how much we've relied on you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/063: I will never forget your kindness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/064: Without you,/50d I couldn't have done anything./40d/nIt all began with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/065: ...I'll never forget/30d the days we fought side by side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/069: I owe you a great deal, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/070: And Silver and Esmeralda as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/071: ...Um,/15d Cyrano?/30d You're not planning to leave us behind, are you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/072: Surely/30d you aren't planning to leave me behind too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/073: ...I'm setting out with no destination in mind./55d/nThe empire is finally at peace,/55d/nand it's time for you all to enjoy the rewards of your efforts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/074: I appreciate the thought,/40d but there's no need to follow me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/075: Cyrano,/30d you haven't forgotten already, have you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/076: I promised to stand by you,/40d and I'll keep that promise to the end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/077: I've also/30d learned a great deal along the way./60d/nWhen I saw the wounds in your heart,/45d/nI resolved to heal them, and that brought me this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/078: But you/30d found the strength to stand on your own./55d/nFrom your resilience, Cyrano,/50d I want to learn more about what it means to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/080: I/15d haven't thought about anything as grand as the meaning of life,/50d/nbut I want to follow you simply because I like you, Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/081: I'm no longer in the Zephyr Falcon,/30d so I'll follow you if I want to, whether you like it or not!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/084: Cyrano,/25d give in./35d I don't think you can change their minds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/094: There may be/30d difficult times ahead./45d/nBut you/25d must carry on Frederick's legacy/35d and protect the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/096: You're not alone./40d There are people who will stand by you./40d/nI'm sure you'll do well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/098: [Christina]/nThe empire will prosper./40d I'll make sure of it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/099: [Christina]/nFor my father,/15d who died protecting this land./60d/nFor my mother,/30d who loved me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/100: [Christina]/nAnd.../55d for you,/20d who laid the foundation for it all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/102: It's time to set sail./40d Much as I hate to say it,/30d this is goodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/103: Cyrano,/40d I wish you.../30d good luck.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s01/104: ...It's time/20d for us to part./45d Well,/10d then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/001: Cyrano,/40d I've waited a long time for this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/002: I'd like to know why you betrayed me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/003: Seeing an old friend/30d brings back unpleasant memories./55d/nWell,/25d perhaps reminiscing wouldn't be so bad.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/004: But, Cyrano,/45d that must wait until our fight is over!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/005: Come at me, Cyrano!/45d I'll show you my power!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/006: Did you think this would be enough to stop me,/15d Iscariot?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/007: Hehe.../60d So human strength wasn't enough after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/008: But with the ultimate power I've created, it's a different story!/90d/nWatch closely,/45d Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/009: Cyrano.../45d You've obtained the greatest power of all./90d/nFar stronger/30d than the power I created...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/010: Iscariot.../45d/nDid you want power so badly/30d that you'd become such a hideous monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/011: Heh,/30d to hear that from you.../100d/nYes,/60d that is why/30d I betrayed you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/012: But.../30d in the end, you're just like me.../45d a monster.../60d/nUnable to live among ordinary people.../60d an outcast from society...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s04/014: At least I.../45d can die by your hand.../75d/nBut you, poor soul...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/001: Ugh.../45d I have to get out of here quickly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/006: Damn it.../40d Why now, of all times...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/007: On Lord Cesare's orders,/30d I've come to take your life!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/010: Well,/15d how disappointing. You've collapsed already.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/011: Hehehe,/35d just hold on a little longer./35d/nI'll put you at ease soon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/013: But/15d something isn't quite right,/40d so it'll be difficult to treat him properly here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/017: There's no time to explain!/20d Come at us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/019: He seems to have.../30d drunk poison.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s02/020: Let's get out of here, quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/001: This is Paro Village./nWe're fairly close to Geysir City,/nbut our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/002: Unlike the noisy world outside,/nour village is peaceful and quiet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/003: It's terrible./nThe most handsome man in the village has fallen mentally ill.../nAnd he even has a fiancee.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/004: This village is quite remote, so we don't get many visitors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/005: But a chef from out of town moved here recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/006: He was looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine./nApparently, he liked how clean it is here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/007: I was invited to Geysir City once before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/008: It was a dazzling place of wide streets and beautiful buildings,/nwith stylish people living there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/009: It must be far more exciting than life in a country village like this.../nLiving in the city, I mean...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/010: Our village is so small that even the lord pays it no attention.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/011: Hehe... Thanks to that, we can live freely here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/012: Geysir City? Hah, city life is an illusion./nIt looks splendid on the surface, but there's no real freedom there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/013: I told you I was right!/nThat engagement was a mistake!/nThat family should never have allowed anyone to marry at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/014: I'm sorry to say this about Brian,/nbut in the end, didn't both sides/nend up unhappy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/015: That family is cursed.../nThey may be the richest family in Paro,/nbut they have nothing to do with our village's peaceful life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/016: Our lord must really like children./nThere are quite a few of them in his house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/018: The lord likes flowers, too./nI hear his garden is full of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/019: I've seen Sharon perform./nShe danced so well, and she was so pretty and wonderful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/020: I really wanted her autograph.../nBut the older boys all pushed ahead of me in line, so I didn't get one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/021: If you happen to meet Sharon,/ncould you get me her autograph?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/022: [Dan Waring]/nOur family is cursed./15d/nI was against my son's marriage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/023: [Dan Waring]/nAfter everything that's happened lately, my son seems to have realized/nwhat runs in our family's blood./10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/024: [Dan Waring] /nNow this cursed bloodline will come to an end.../n/10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm finished. To think I did something so terrible with my own hands.../20d/nMarriage?/10d What a fool I was to hope for that!/15d Hahaha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need your sympathy./nDon't try to persuade me./20d/nAll that's left for me is death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/027: [Diana] /nNo, he can't have gone mad./nHe really can't.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/028: [Diana] /nSomething is wrong here.../20d/nBrian has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/030: [Haisen]/nDan and I are old friends./nMy name is Haisen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/031: [Haisen]/nI'm trying to persuade Diana/nto keep my friend's son from becoming unhappy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/033: The strange thing is that there's been no news at all/nabout the singer Sharon lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/034: She's a popular singer with plenty of fans./nWhy has all news of her suddenly stopped?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/035: What's even more shocking is that those pieces/nwere found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/036: Welcome./nWhatever else you may think of us, we certainly serve generous portions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/037: Where on earth has Rashid III, first in line to the Pendragon throne,/ngone into hiding?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/038: Well, King Rashid is still in fine health,/nso inheriting the throne won't be easy.../nBut if he ever comes here,/nI'd gladly give him plenty of snacks on the house...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/039: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant/nin nearby Caracas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/040: He's a fine cook,/nbut the trouble is that he's far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/041: He's always pestering me to find good ingredients for him./nHaha...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/042: Hohoho.../nDo you really think someone will rise soon/nto seize control of the empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/043: Wouldn't anyone seeking supremacy over the empire/nneed enough power/nto defeat Cesare Borgia?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/044: They say someone has drawn Asura,/nthe sword that decides who will rule the empire.../nBut rumors are only rumors, aren't they? Hohoho.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/046: I got Sharon's autograph at her last performance./nHehehe... I'm the only one in our village who has it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/047: I won't sell this, no matter how much money you offer./15d/nI'm going to pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/048: Hmm.../nI might consider it if you brought something truly special./nA fragment of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/049: Diana is the most beautiful woman in the village./nAll the men here admire her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/050: Brian was admired by all the women here, too./nWhen Diana announced she was going to marry him,/nyou wouldn't believe the gossip...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/051: In a way, nobody welcomed the engagement./nExcept the couple themselves.../20d/nEveryone was jealous...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/054: Thank you for shopping with us./nGoodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/056: You're giving this to me, right?/nThank you so much! I'm so happy!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/057: Then let me give you something too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/059: I found this ring in the forest a while ago! Isn't it pretty?/nThank you so much for the autograph!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/060: This is the Love Herb I found recently/nin the forest near Caracas./nThey say it blooms only where true love has taken root.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/061: It's a very rare herb,/nso would you keep it safe and give it to my younger brother?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/063: Would you like to stay the night? Our master/noffers hospitality to guests who visit the house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/069: I'll have more fine goods for you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/070: WANTED: Roberto de Meditch/nCharges: Arson, Murder/nBounty: 1,000,000 ELD
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/071: Will you agree to get Sharon's autograph for the girl?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/072: If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/073: Sorry, but I can't promise that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/074: All right. If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/075: Really? Then it's a promise! You mustn't forget!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/076: Sorry, but I can't promise that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/077: Besides, an autograph means more if you get it yourself./nWhy don't you go and find Sharon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/078: That's true, but.../nI'm still too young to travel. Aww...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/079: Thank you!/nDon't forget your promise to get the autograph for me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/081: Our lives may not be glamorous,/nbut we take pride in living peacefully and quietly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/082: [Brian Waring]/nGet out of my way! Go away!/nPlease, just leave me alone!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/083: Did she quit, or is there some other reason...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/084: [Brian Waring]/nMy symptoms first appeared last autumn./nOn the evening of the village festival, I got terribly drunk./10d/nI ate and drank without thinking, and when I came to, I was at home./10d/nI went to the bathroom to cool my aching head,/nand there was blood on my hands...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/085: [Brian Waring]/nI thought I must have hurt myself,/nbut I checked my whole body and found no wounds./nThe next day, I heard that a wolf had broken into a farm in our village,/nkilled chickens and livestock, and fled./n/10d But... but I had a feeling/nit hadn't been a wolf.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/086: [Brian Waring]/nAt first, I convinced myself/nit had only been a nightmare./nBut the symptoms continued after that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow I'm afraid to wake up./nWhen I find my room in disarray/nor my hands covered in blood,/nI'm terrified... terrified of myself./n/10d I'm afraid.../10d Afraid.../nNow I'm even afraid to sleep.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/088: [Brian Waring]/nMarriage! Ha, hahaha! What if I wake one day,/nand my beloved Diana, by my own hands.../nNo, no, anything but that! I can't marry./10d/nNot while this cursed blood flows through me. Never./nHa... hahaha...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/089: [Dan Waring]/n... Mental illness has run in our family for generations./nIt's the price of our ancestors' sin: marrying relatives to preserve the bloodline.../nA bloodline like ours should disappear from this world. Don't you agree?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/090: [Diana]/nBrian has gone mad?/nThat's impossible!/nJust a year ago, there was absolutely nothing wrong with him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/091: [Diana]/nWe first met at Geysir Academy./nI was looking for a quiet country village myself,/nso I moved here./nWe got engaged about a year after I arrived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana./nPeople with mental illness aren't always like that./nThey have episodes from time to time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If something really,/nreally is wrong with him,/nwhy won't he even let a doctor examine him?/nIf it's an illness, can't it be cured?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/094: [Haisen]/nIt isn't an illness that can be cured./nIt's inherited in that family... Diana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/095: [Diana]/nNo, no./nThat can't be true!/nI'll... I'll cure him,/nwhatever it takes. I will!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/096: The Warings?/nThat family has been cursed for ages./nNo one in it has ever died a normal death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/097: For instance, Dan's parents went missing,/nand while his wife was out boating with him,/nthe boat capsized/nand she lost her life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/098: When Dan's wife died,/na rumor spread through the village/nthat he'd pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/099: Now it's his son's turn? Poor fellow...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/100: It seems that family really does/nhave some hereditary problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/101: You could see it that way./nBut perhaps the real cause is that the family/nis so wealthy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/102: You mean their wealth/nmade them mentally ill?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/103: Not exactly.../nThat family has always been full of plots over inheritances and succession rights./nPerhaps that's why/nits members are so strange?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/104: Come to think of it, wasn't there once some doubt/nabout whether Brian really was Dan's son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/106: So they tried to reduce disputes by marrying relatives,/nand that led to mental illness running in the family...?/nWhen you think of it that way, having a lot of money doesn't seem so wonderful after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/107: [Dan Waring]/nI opposed my son's marriage from the very beginning./nIt was absolutely out of the question. Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/108: Excuse me./nI'm going to visit Dan/nand would like to bring him something./nWhat would you recommend?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/109: A family full of plots.../nI'd like to learn more about them./nPerhaps other people could tell me more?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, Dan Waring?/nHe says his eyesight has been poor lately,/nand he's taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/111: [Pharmacy Owner]/nPerhaps he's been distracted by what's happening with his son,/nbut he hasn't come back even though it's time to buy more./nIt would be good if you bought some for him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/112: Datura.../nIsn't that a very dangerous poison?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt's all right./nHe's been taking that medicine for a long time,/nso he knows the dosage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/117: So... he was behind all this./nLet's go to the Waring house.../nI have to settle this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/118: Excuse me./nDo you know anything about the Warings?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/119: The Warings? Of course! They've had nothing but trouble/nfor as long as anyone can remember./nI knew it from the moment Rachel married into that family./nTheir marriages have always made me uneasy,/nand this one is no different...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/120: (She'll never stop if I let her keep talking.)/nAh... ma'am. Who is this Rachel?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/121: Rachel? Dan's wife, of course./nHaisen liked her, too./nWhen Dan and Rachel married, Haisen was heartbroken/nand went traveling far away./nHe only returned recently./nBut not long after he left,/ntrouble started.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/123: Rachel gave birth to Brian,/na little earlier than expected. People whispered/nthat he might not really be Dan's son./nDan did publicly acknowledge him later, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/124: People suspected there was something between Rachel and Haisen,/nbut since Haisen himself wasn't around,/nthe matter eventually faded away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/125: Well, not necessarily... But it's possible, isn't it?/nOh, dear. Here I am telling a complete stranger/nall sorts of things... Well, then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/126: Interesting. A family plagued by madness, with such a tangled history.../nNow the father seems suspicious./nLet's investigate further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/127: [Brian Waring]/nWhat do you want from a lunatic like me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/128: A lunatic.../nIn a way, is anyone in this world truly sane?/nBut there's nothing wrong with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat... what do you mean, there's nothing wrong with me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/131: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWelcome. What can I get you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/132: So this is the village pharmacy./nIf someone deliberately caused Brian Waring's condition,/nperhaps I can find a clue here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/134: I haven't seen you before./nIs this your first visit to our village?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/135: Yes, it's my first time here./nBut...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/138: [Diana]/nIt's true that he started growing depressed about a year ago,/nand eventually began saying stranger and stranger things./nBut to me, he seems perfectly normal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/140: Ask about the background of the incident.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/141: Are you saying Brian Waring/nmight not be Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/142: What is it?/nI'll help however I can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/144: Ask who has bought potent poisons recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/145: Ask what gift Dan Waring would like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/146: I know it's an imposition,/nbut could I have a list of people who've bought potent poisons recently?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Do you think you can look down on us/njust because we're a small village pharmacy?/nWe have professional ethics, too./nDo you think we'd simply hand that information/nover to someone we've never seen before?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf that's the sort of question you're going to ask, get out of here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/150: Well... They're giving me the cold shoulder because I'm from out of town.../nStill, why am I meddling in someone else's business?/nI should get on with my own affairs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/151: [Mr. Haisen]/nDiana, you mustn't do this. Let's go home at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/152: No, this is actually perfect./nPlease listen to what I have to say here,/nMr. Haisen and Miss Diana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/153: First, I must make it clear that Brian Waring/nis not mentally ill./nHe hasn't gone mad./nHe's simply fallen into a trap set by someone/nwho wanted to make him seem mad.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/155: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you talking about?!/nMy son needs complete rest!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/157: I hear you've spent a long time traveling, Mr. Haisen./nYou must have heard of the plant datura/non your travels, haven't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/158: [Mr. Haisen]/nDatura?/nIsn't that a deadly poison that causes hallucinations?/nTaking too much can even kill you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/159: [Brian Waring]/nI can't taste anything I eat or drink anymore./nMy head always feels heavy, and there's a bitter taste in my mouth...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/160: Exactly. Datura has a bitter taste,/nand the headaches and dizziness persist even after the hallucinations wear off./nHasn't Brian Waring been complaining lately/nof a bitter taste and dizziness?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/162: And you, Dan Waring!/nHaven't you been taking medicine made from datura lately?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/166: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you talking about...?/nI do take medicine made from datura,/nbut why would I hurt my own son...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/167: Even if he isn't your son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/168: [Brian Waring]/nWhat are you saying...?!/nHe is my father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/169: I think Haisen knows the answer to that better than anyone./nDon't you, Mr. Haisen?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/173: [Dan Waring]/nWhy... why do you call me your father?/nWhen Rachel... when Rachel said she was pregnant,/nwho could understand my shock and rage?!/nI couldn't father a child...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/175: [Dan Waring]/nYour mother... your mother, by the lake, with these hands I.../nNo, no! It wasn't me!/nShe jumped in! Yes, she jumped in herself!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/176: Did that resentment drive you to poison your son, make him hallucinate, and stage all of this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/177: Mr. Haisen, aren't you Brian's real father?/nOut of jealousy, Dan gave Brian/ndatura to make him hallucinate,/nthen staged things to make him seem mad./nHis mother's death probably wasn't a simple accident, either./nIsn't that right, Dan Waring?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/178: [Dan Waring]/nDamn it, my head hurts!/nI need to go to the pharmacy and get some medicine!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/181: Dan Waring.../nhas gone to find his own solution./nDon't go after him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/182: Then will you be leaving, Brian?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I'd like to travel for a while to clear my head./nWith my beloved Diana, of course.../nOh, one moment. Would you come over here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is our family heirloom./nIt holds sad memories for us,/nbut I'm sure it could bring you happy ones./nI'd be grateful if you accepted it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/187: Diana's house./nShe must be away traveling now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/188: The Waring house./nThey must be away traveling now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/189: Do you know anything about Diana?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/190: Diana?/nAbout two years ago, she came to this village with Brian,/nwho had gone to Geysir to study./nShe seems to be a girl he met while studying there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/191: Still, her natural beauty/nand bright, outgoing personality/ncaught every man's attention as soon as she arrived./nWell, she wasn't engaged at the time...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/192: Hmph.../nIt wouldn't be an exaggeration to say/nevery young man in the village courted her. Men, honestly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/193: [Tavern Owner]/nBut isn't it strange that nobody/nknows anything about Diana's background?/nShe still lives alone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/194: Come to think of it, I heard a rumor that a young man from the village/ntried to court her behind the party hall/nand was coldly rejected./n"I don't want anything to do with a man like you, with no power or money!"/nWasn't that what she said?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/195: From what I heard, that happened/nbecause he tried to drag her away by force,/nso she rejected him./nThe rumor got twisted, though.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/196: [Tavern Owner]/nWho can tell/nwhat goes on in a woman's heart...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/197: I'd like to hear about/nBrian Waring calling off his engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/198: That incident?/nDiana and Brian had been engaged for about a year./nThen, not long ago, Brian suddenly called it off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/199: His mental illness was the reason!/nIt caused quite a sensation in the village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/200: [Tavern Owner]/nHonestly, nobody welcomed that engagement except the couple themselves./nHis father's madness was well known,/nand nobody in the village wanted the Waring fortune/ngoing to an outsider, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/201: But has Brian really become mentally ill?/nHe has been acting very strangely lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/202: It's true that livestock on farms all over the village/nhave been killed lately,/nand they say Brian did it all./nWould a sane person do that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/203: [Tavern Owner]/nIt's true that some things don't quite add up...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/204: Then Brian Waring and his father Dan/nhave always been a little strange?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we'll meet again on our travels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/206: What a shock./nDan Waring was the culprit all along.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/207: Now, a toast to Diana's newfound happiness...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/208: Welcome. Our mistress, Diana, has asked us/nto offer visiting guests a free night's stay./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/210: You're finding fine ingredients for a chef named Karg?/nAs it happens, I'm his older brother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/211: [Diana]/nNow I'll be with him.../nwith him, anywhere in the world...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/212: Thank you so, so much for getting me that autograph!/nI'll treasure it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/001_3: This is Paro Village./nWe're fairly close to Geysir City,/nbut our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/002_3: Our village has always considered/na peaceful, quiet life a virtue.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/006_3: He was looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine./nApparently, he liked how clean it is here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/012_3: Geysir City? Hah, city life is an illusion./nIt looks splendid on the surface, but there's no real freedom there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/013_3: I told you I was right!/nThat engagement was a mistake!/nThat family should never have allowed anyone to marry at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/014_3: I'm sorry to say this about Hugh,/nbut didn't both sides end up unhappy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/015_3: The Warings may be the richest family in Paro Village,/nbut they're terribly unhappy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/018_3: Oh, one of my friends was as pretty as a girl./nThat friend is at the lord's house now, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/019_3: I've seen Sharon perform, too./nShe was so pretty... And she danced so well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/020_3: I wanted her autograph,/nbut the older boys all pushed ahead of me in line, so I didn't get one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/021_3: If you happen to meet Sharon,/ncould you get me her autograph?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/022_3: [Charles Waring]/nOur family is cursed./nI was against my son's marriage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/023_3: [Charles Waring]/nAfter everything that's happened lately, my son seems to have realized/nwhat runs in our family's blood. Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/024_3: [Charles Waring] /nNow this cursed bloodline will come to an end.../nHehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/025_3: [Hugh Waring]/nI'm finished. To think I did something so terrible with my own hands.../nMarriage? What a fool I was to hope for that! Hahaha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/026_3: [Charles]/nI don't need your sympathy./nDon't try to persuade me./nAll that's left for me is death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/027_3: [Diana] /nThis is absurd!/nHe was perfectly fine yesterday, and now he's calling off the engagement because he says he's mentally ill?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/028_3: [Diana] /nSomething is wrong here./nHugh has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/030_3: [ Frobisher ]/nI'm Diana's father./nCharles and I are old friends.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/031_3: [Frobisher]/nAs her father,/nI can't just stand by and watch my daughter become unhappy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/032_3: [Frobisher]/nBut it's difficult to know what to do now./nWhether she marries or not, it seems she'll be unhappy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/035_3: What's even more shocking is that those severed pieces/nwere found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/037_3: Where on earth has Rashid III, third in line to the Pendragon throne,/ngone into hiding?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/038_3: Well, King Rashid has lived so long that inheriting the throne won't be easy.../nBut if he ever comes here, I'd gladly give him plenty of snacks on the house...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/039_3: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant/nin nearby Caracas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/040_3: He's a fine cook, but far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/041_3: He's always pestering me/nto find good ingredients for him. Haha...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/042_3: Hohoho.../nDo you really think someone will rise to rule the empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/047_3: I won't sell this, no matter how much money you offer./nI'm going to pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/048_3: Hmm... I might consider it if you brought something truly special./nA fragment of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/050_3: Hugh was admired by all the women/nin the village, too. You wouldn't believe the gossip/nwhen she announced she was going to marry him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/051_3: In a way, nobody welcomed the engagement./nExcept the couple themselves. Everyone was jealous...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/056_3: You're giving this to me, right? Oh, I'm so happy!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/059_3: I found this ring in the forest a little while ago! Isn't it pretty?/nThank you for the autograph!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/060_3: This is what I found in the forest near Caracas recently:/nthe Love Herb.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01/061_3: They say this flower blooms only where true love has taken root./nIt's a very rare herb, so keep it safe and give it to my younger brother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx23/000: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx23/001: << Phoenix Cave >>/nOnce every thousand years,/nthe phoenix burns its own body/nto bring forth new life./n/nTo obtain what is most precious,/none must sacrifice what one holds dearest.../n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/001: This is the entrance to the meeting room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/002: There's a strange drawer in the meeting room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/003: The meeting room is the most lavishly decorated room/nin our Zephyr Falcon base.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/004: The entrance on the left leads to the shop and officers' quarters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/005: Zephyr Falcon morale is at its peak,/nbut our enemies seem to be growing stronger, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/006: General Frederick's army in Ron/nis especially difficult to fight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/008: Sometimes strange sounds/ncome from one of the tavern walls./nAm I drinking too much?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/009: Before joining the Zephyr Falcon,/nI was a petty thief in Caracas./nBut I've gone completely straight now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/010: Hmph... I don't believe that fellow has gone straight./nI wouldn't believe him even if he told me the sun rises in the east.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/011: I'm sure he's selling off the things/nthat have been going missing from the barracks lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/012: The Zephyr Falcon's fame has spread far and wide,/nand our morale is sky-high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/013: We're more than a band seeking revenge or robbing from the rich now./nWe're an organization working to transform this empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/014: Lord Frederick's army in Ron is one I really hate to face./nHis elite marksmen shoot with deadly accuracy,/nand his swordsmen are formidable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/015: In truth, if other lords were like him,/nthere'd be no reason for us to exist./nWould there...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/016: I joined because my entire family... was slaughtered./nBy our lord, no less...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/017: The thought of revenge is all that keeps me going./nWithout even that, I'd have no reason to live here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/018: As the Zephyr Falcon's reputation grows,/nmore and more people try to keep us in check./nThat's becoming a problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/019: Perhaps our reputation/nhas outgrown our actual strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/020: I sometimes hear strange sounds in the tavern./nAnd I'm not even much of a drinker...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/021: Sometimes I feel as though/nthere's something beyond the tavern.../nStrange, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/022: These are Zephyr Falcon's women's barracks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/023: We women do our full share as members of the Zephyr Falcon./nThere's no discrimination between men and women here./nAfter all, half our unit commanders are women, aren't they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/024: Come to think of it, nobody knows anything about/nthe leader who founded the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/025: What sort of person could the leader be?/nA fallen noble whose family was destroyed by the Church?/nOr someone born a commoner?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/026: When I went into the barracks yesterday,/nI found some of my belongings missing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/027: After searching for a while, I found out those things/nwere being sold on the barracks black market.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/028: Damn it... I think I know who stole my things and sold them,/nbut I have no proof.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/029: What on earth does Clausewitz write in his notebook?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/030: He always seems to be writing something...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/031: Clausewitz's famous notebook?/nNobody knows what's written in it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/032: Surely he isn't keeping a list/nof personal details about our female members?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy01/034: Looking closer,/35d it's a monument bearing the names of comrades who served the Zephyr Falcon with distinction./n/70d To think so many people shared the same purpose...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/000: Oh... Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement./nMercedes is the perfect bride for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/001: Still, even after you marry,/nyou won't forget our club, will you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/002: Hahaha! How about celebrating your engagement/nwith a good drinking session next weekend?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/003: Hmph! You're getting married before me? Honestly.../nWell, I suppose it can't be helped, if it's Mercedes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/004: It's a shame you're spoken for,/nbut Mercedes will no longer be the object/nof every Geysir man's attention.../nSo it's hardly a total loss.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber09/005: Hohoho... Who will take Mercedes' place/nas the next belle of society?/nI hear a new beauty salon has opened in town.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/001: This exit seems to be completely blocked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/007: Damn.../40d I feel like I'm going round in circles./60d/nI can't get my bearings at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/008: When the cave collapsed,/30d I escaped here alone.../65d/nI wonder if the others are all right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/009: In any case,/40d I have no choice but to look for a way out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/010: There are plenty of monsters nearby,/40d/nso I'll have to equip at least a pickaxe to fight them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/007_2: Damn it... How many hours has it been?/15d/nI can't tell which way to go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin01a/008_2: The cave collapsed, and I ended up in this strange place...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/000: [Guard]/nThis is Inferno's labor yard, the deepest hell of all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/003: [Guard]/nBring back plenty of sulfur, and I'll let you rest in return.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/004: [Guard]/nHehehe.../nHow many of you will survive today?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/005: [Guard]/nVermin like you should be mining sulfur for the country!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/006: [Guard]/nIf you don't want to work, you can escape./15d/nIf you can manage it, that is. Hehehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/009: Where do you think you're going, No. 102?!
