Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/010: Did you think you could leave without doing any work?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/011: You scum,/25d are you finally all here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/013: If you don't want to end up like those who never returned,/40d/nyou'd better keep moving!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/014: You/15d are traitors to the state./60d/nI'll make sure you pay dearly for your crimes here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/015: Of the twenty men in Group 12 sent to work yesterday,/45d/nonly seven returned alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/017: If you understand, stop dawdling/15d and get moving!/40d/nYou scum!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/018: Tch... Having to deal with scum like this...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/022: You bastard!/20d/nTrying to shirk work again?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/023: Stop pretending to be sick and get up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/028: If he's dead, get rid of him before he starts to rot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s03/032: [Guard]/nStop hesitating and crawl into the sulfur mine, you too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/000: Clausewitz,/60d I have to speak my mind!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/002: Our Zephyr Falcon/15d is dancing like puppets on Cyrano's strings!/15d/nI won't stand by and watch any longer!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/004: Kana,/30d you need to face reality too./30d/nThat man is only using us as tools for his revenge!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/005: I can't deny that Mr. Cyrano/15d has a personal grudge./65d/nBut his goal is to overthrow Cardinal Cesare./n/55dThe fact remains that his aim is the same as ours.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/006: Damn it,/30d everyone's taking Cyrano's side!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/007: I think you've misunderstood./50d/nIt's true that Mr. Cyrano considers revenge important,/60d but he doesn't put it first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/008: Misunderstanding or not,/30d if you're going to let him carry on like this,/45d I'd rather leave the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/009: So would I!/40d/nEither throw Cyrano out/15d or lose both of us./45d Choose!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/011: Meditch is my benefactor./nBut without the Zephyr Falcon's help, I might not be able to defeat Cesare./nWhat should I do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/014: I don't want the Zephyr Falcon to split/15d because of me./60d/nI'll leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/016: Yes,/15d a wise decision./30d/nYou're not as stubborn as I thought.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/017: If Cyrano leaves,/15d I'm going with him!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/018: Kana,/30d that would defeat the purpose/nof my leaving the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/021: I too/15d will follow Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/022: Mr. Cyrano,/15d I'm sorry./40d I never imagined things would come to this...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/023: Things will simply return to how they were before I joined,/45d/nso please don't worry too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/024: I hope you all/30d achieve what you set out to do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/025: I can't do as Meditch asks./45d/nI/25d cannot leave the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/027: Certainly,/30d Mr. Meditch's words go too far./50d/nBut/25d it would also be unfortunate if he and Mr. Rhidelhard left the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/028: Unfortunate,/15d is it?!/20d/nStop talking nonsense!/25d I've never liked you either!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/029: Without Meditch,/45d do you think we could have become such a powerful force?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/030: There's no need to say more, Rhidelhard./40d/nThose who choose Cyrano can stay./30d Anyone who chooses me can come with me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/031: A newcomer driving out the old hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/032: Meditch,/30d if you leave.../45d where will you go?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/035: Isabele,/30d will you come with us too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/038: Well,/30d let's see how well you do without us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/039: If Cesare means to resurrect the God of Destruction,/45d/nwe must head for the underwater city at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/040: The underwater city?/40d Isn't that one of the Seven Wonders near Cerepus?/55d Is there something there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/041: According to the Secret Records of the Creation War,/45d the seal of the last God of Destruction remains there./60d/nHe must be trying to break it and resurrect the God of Destruction.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/043: Understood, Mr. Cyrano./40d/nI'll move our main force to the area around the underwater city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/044: Cyrano,/30d where do you plan to go now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/045: For now,/45d I think I'll return to Geysir City./45d/nPerhaps I can find something I've forgotten there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/049: Whatever I do next.../45d/ngoing there should help me remember something I've forgotten.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/050: Perhaps it's presumptuous of me/15d to say this, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/054: Tsk,/30d you're the same as the rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s05/056: Your next choice will change the course of the story and its ending./nWould you like to save here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro04b/000: We have to get out of here, quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/000: The free trade zone ends here./nYou cannot leave without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/001: The free trade zone ends here./nYou cannot leave without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/002: The free trade zone ends here./nYou cannot leave without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/003: I've never seen business this bad in all my life./nHardly any shops are open now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/004: It's all because of failed policies./nThose damned Tuer people/nmake it impossible to do business!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/005: Those foolish officials and nobles in the central government/nruin even things that should work!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/006: The current difficulties are only temporary./nThere's no need to get so worked up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/007: Where did that brat go?/nHow dare he slap a lady's backside and run away?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/008: Just let me catch him!/nI'll teach him a lesson so he never does that again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/009: Aah! What a terrifying woman!/nShe just won't stop chasing me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/010: If every woman in the world were like that,/nhow could I ever get by?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/012: Hmph... Is this really Dakama, the greatest port of all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/013: Every shop is closed, and all we can do/nis stare at the sky. What on earth is going on?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/014: Merchants who wander from place to place/nall dream of settling down one day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/015: But the funny thing is, once they can finally settle down,/nthey can't bear it for long and leave again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/016: Perhaps they're born to wander.../nMy father shared that fate./nI wonder where he is now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/017: I hear King Rashid's grandson, Rashid III,/nis still away from the palace.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/018: It seems he plans to be away from the palace for quite a while this time./nWith all those complicated problems,/nstaying there must feel like sitting on pins and needles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/019: Still, his black hair is so attractive...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/020: It is Holy Sabbatical Week. /nThe chapel is closed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/021: Hmph... Is this really Dakama, the greatest port of all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/022: It's all because of failed policies./nThose damned Tuer people/nmake it impossible to do business!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/023: What matters most is doing your best at what you can do now./nNobody knows what the future holds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/024: Even if what you can do here right now/nis very limited,/nsurely you'll find something more if you look hard enough?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/025: Welcome to our inn./nA night's stay costs 100 ELD./nWould you like a room?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/026: Thank you. Please make yourself comfortable and rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/027: Business is hard enough already. More customers like this would be trouble.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/029: Our boss is a monster of an old man./nAt his age, he still gets up at four in the morning and works until midnight!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/030: When the boss works hard, it's the employees who end up exhausted...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/031: ... Honestly, sometimes I wish something/nwould happen to that old man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/032: I'm a scholar from Bifrost./nI've come to Dakama to gather material for my research.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/033: I finally made time to come and do some research,/nonly to find the economy in this state...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/034: Well, it shouldn't affect my research,/nbut people can't live on food alone./nThere's absolutely nothing to do here except research...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/035: I'm an officer from Curtis./nI've come here to contact someone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/036: The details are military secrets, so I can't tell you,/nbut the information could be decisive in the fight against the Tuer Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/037: I plan to stay a few days, then head straight/nto Pendragon's capital once my pass is issued.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/038: I'm a Tuer mage who has become a naturalized citizen here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/039: It's been almost a year since I was naturalized. After a year,/nI'll receive a permit to enter Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/040: Why did I leave the Tuer people and become a citizen of Pendragon?/nFor love. I'd give my life for her,/nlet alone my nationality...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/042: This is the finest accessory shop in the world!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/043: I've worked here all my life./nI've saved quite a bit, and now I plan/nto pass the shop on to my granddaughter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/044: But it's hard for a woman to run a shop alone./nI need to find a husband for my granddaughter.../nKnow any good men?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/045: Why is Grandpa so desperate to get my sister married?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/046: The free trade zone ends here./nYou cannot leave without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/047: Why does King Rashid send a ferry/nto Storm Island every year?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/048: Excuse me./35d/nDo you know anything about Storm Island?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/049: Storm Island?/nWho are you, and why are you interested in that place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/050: Storm Island?/45d/nWhy are you interested in a place like that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/051: I have a reason/30d I must go there, whatever it takes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/052: Decades ago,/30d quite a few people chased vain dreams/30d/nand went to that island...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/053: I didn't know there were still people like that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/054: I'm not certain,/30d but I hear the Pendragon royal family/35d occasionally sends a ferry/25d/nto that island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/055: There seems to be a ship leaving soon./40d/nYou should ask about it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/056: Hello. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/058: Thank you for shopping with us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/059: The man at the inn/nknows lots of stories about the old days.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/060: I sometimes go and listen/nto all sorts of stories from him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/061: This door seems to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/062: The free trade zone ends here./nYou cannot leave without a permit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/063: It seems he plans to be away from the palace for quite a while this time./nWith all those complicated problems,/nstaying there must feel like sitting on pins and needles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda02/064: I hear he used to be a bard/nwho traveled from place to place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr98/000: They say the basement was sealed off after the last incident.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr98/001: Come on, let's hurry and rescue Esmeralda.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmfre04/000: There's no path down from here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/001: [Meditch]/nI'm glad to welcome such a capable companion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/002: [Clausewitz]/nI warmly welcome you to the Zephyr Falcon./50d/nI look forward to seeing what you can do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/003: [Bors]/nThis is the Zephyr Falcon's operations room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/004: [Louis]/nNicosia is a small village south of Geysir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/005: [Rhidelhard]/nThanks for helping us,/20d/nbut don't get conceited just because you've done something useful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/006: [Rhidelhard]/nWell,/20d I still hope your Nicosia mission goes well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/007: [Kana]/nSomehow, with you around,/25d I feel safer./20d Rookie!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/008: [Clausewitz]/nYour first mission is to gather intelligence in the Nicosia region.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/009: [Isabele]/n...Let me make this clear:/40d I don't like you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/010: [Isabele]/nUnless it's about the mission, would you please not speak to me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/011: [Rhidelhard]/n(...Isabele really is beautiful...)/60d/nHuh?/20d Why are you eavesdropping on me?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/014: Ah,/15d Mr. Cyrano./10d You've arrived./35d/nNow we're all here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/015: Everyone,/15d something has come up./40d/nCardinal Cesare/15d seems to be plotting something in the Nicosia region.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/017: Our intelligence says they're building a fortress in Nicosia/30d/nand preparing something there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/018: But the security is so tight/35d/nthat we failed to get our informants inside.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/019: Your mission is to go there with me/25d/nand investigate what they're up to!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/020: Do you know the Nicosia region?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/021: The Nicosia region lies/15d south, beyond Geysir City./45d/nIt'll be quite a journey.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/023: Have you been there?/30d It was the capital in the days of the old empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/024: It's still the empire's greatest city,/40d/nbut Lord Frederick's Ron seems more lively lately, doesn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/025: The Ron region/20d is Lord Frederick's territory,/25d and he's the strongest power in the empire today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/026: Even the Zephyr Falcon's intelligence network/35d doesn't reach there yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/028: If anything changes,/20d/nI'll contact you through a messenger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/031: That drawer.../45d you mustn't open it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/033: Anyway!/35d Whatever you do.../20d don't open that drawer!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/036: Geysir City.../65d Has it been fifteen years...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/038: You went off alone without a word.../30d Wait for me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/039: [Kana]/nIsabele and Rhidelhard/20d don't seem too fond of you, Cyrano.../nBut/50d don't let it bother you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/040: [Meditch]/nAnd thank you for helping Kana, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/041: [Meditch]/nHaha,/45d I'm sorry we seem to be accepting so much help from you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/042: [Clausewitz]/nPlease go to the Nicosia region and assess the military situation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/043: [Louis]/nIt's easy to get lost in the forest, but its paths lead to many places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/044: [Louis]/nIf you follow the signs to Nicosia,/nyou shouldn't get lost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/045: [Bors]/nEveryone is busy, so we don't/nget together here very often...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/046: [Bors]/nBut missing a meeting can disrupt an operation,/nso please attend whenever you can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/047: [Silver]/nI haven't spent this long on land in ages.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/048: [Silver]/nI used to spend all my time aboard ship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/049: [Silver]/nI don't regret leaving the ship. /50d/nI'm just not used to life ashore yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/050: [Esmeralda]/nI've always sympathized with the Zephyr Falcon's ideals...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/051: [Esmeralda]/nBut I/25d never imagined I'd leave the hospital/25d/nand join you like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/052: [Esmeralda]/nI suppose it's thanks to Mr. Cyrano saving me, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/055: Understood./40d I need to investigate the fortress in Nicosia, correct?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl09_s01/056: I'm counting on you/20d for this mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst02/000: I don't know whether coming this far is enough training./15d But I'd better return for the third stage before going any further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss52/000: The road is cut off here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy09/001: This way leads toward the Dragon Breath Mountains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/000: Like the people in that passage, aren't you deceived by appearances/nand unable to see the truth? People/ncriticize the Church, but the reality is different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family,/nonce the empire's foremost servants.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/002: Nobody has lived in the Bernstein ruins next door/nfor ten years now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/003: Learn to see everything from several perspectives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/005: A strange cloud hangs over your head.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/006: Hey, that man looks so much like/nsomeone I saw ten years ago!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/007: Bands of brigands have been running wild in the desert lately./nI nearly died several times on this trip myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/009: To reach Cerepus,/nyou must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/010: How could anyone enter a place/nwhere an entire family was slaughtered?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/011: There's a rumor that a strange sword is embedded somewhere/nin the forests and mountains near Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/013: Head a little south from Geysir,/nand you'll reach Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer people/nhas entered a lull lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/015: The Church has always been/nparticularly powerful in Nicosia.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/016: I am on a secret mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/017: My ability to remember events from ten years ago/nappeared after I suffered a blow to the head recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/019: Even though the people there suffer greatly, they still follow the Church/nwith strange devotion. I wonder why.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/024: All that glitters is not gold./nIt's a line from my favorite book.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/026: My engagement was broken off recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/027: Simply because a relative of mine/nhad been accused of witchcraft.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/029: The Church seems to make plenty of money without doing anything./nDoes it actually produce anything?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/030: A relative of mine lives in Caracas,/nand seems to be suffering terribly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/031: Nobody sees the truth clearly./nPeople see only their own version of it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/032: Geysir City, the center of Church territory, is peaceful,/nand people are relatively free to criticize the Church./nBut is that the whole truth?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/033: There's a strong sense of unease and foreboding beneath it all./nWhat's going on...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/034: Would you like a useful piece of information?/nEven here in Geysir City,/nthe Church's watchful eyes are everywhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/035: It looks quite free at first glance,/nbut in reality, you must be careful here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/036: That singer Sharon seems very popular.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/037: My son is a fan of that singer./nI saw her near here not long ago./nShe seemed to be heading south.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/038: Sharon, Sharon! Oh, she's my idol!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/039: Just seeing her the other day was enough to make me... Sob...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/041: People don't realize that the Church/nhas already taken control of this place in secret.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/042: Not long ago, a friend of mine suddenly disappeared.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/043: That fellow used to go around/narguing against the Church...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/044: My mother once told me/nabout Cardinal Cesare's wife.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/045: I think she said the woman died unjustly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/046: My mother and Cardinal Cesare/nwere very close.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/047: They seemed to have known each other for a long time,/nbut she never told me the details.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/048: I know I was ordered to kill someone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/049: But since I injured my head in that accident,/nI can't remember who it was.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/050: Who was it?! Could it be you?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/052: I rescued that strange assassin from the river/na few days ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/054: To achieve that, surely Lord Cesare/nmust take power, mustn't he?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/055: But Lord Frederick of Ron has a troublesome attitude...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/056: Sob... My friend stole my boyfriend from me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/057: I will have revenge. I swear it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/058: Hmph... He chose me/nsimply because he likes me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/059: It's ridiculous to say I stole my friend's boyfriend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/060: Please... Don't talk about those two women./nThey give me a headache.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/061: They both insist I belong to them.../nI can't think straight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/062: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/063: Bernstein Mansion: Once home to the Bernstein family, lords of Geysir City, this grand residence combines classical elegance with modern design. It is now uninhabited. Despite its historical value, accusations of demonic involvement made when the family was wiped out prevented it from being designated a historic site./nAs a result, the building has received no preservation work.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/064: WANTED: Kana Milanovich/nBounty: 10,000 ELD/n- Cardinal Cesare -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/065: The son was punished for devil worship,/nand the father died in a duel with Lord Frederick.../nThe Bernstein family met a truly tragic end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/066: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen fighting, pay close attention to enemies' elemental affinities. Especially when using elemental weapons or casting/nmagic, study their appearance and remember what experience has taught you about their affinities before attacking.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/067: [Member of the Tactics Society]/nWhen an unfamiliar monster appears,/nmake sure you learn its characteristics./nThat will help you progress through the game smoothly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02/076: We're here to find treasure./35d/nWe need to go to the Fire Dragon Cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s00/000: Cerepus, entrance to the underwater city
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s00/009: The last I saw of him,/30d he was standing in the collapsing underwater city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl24_s00/010: Even if he tried to escape,/40d he probably couldn't have survived./40d I suppose...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/001: This is the Bifrost army's logistics base, the one Clausewitz mentioned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/005: [Bifrost Officer]/nDamn... The enemy has reached us here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/007: Come on. Let's take this base at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/008: So/25d is everything settled on this side?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/009: Yes,/25d the enemy appears to have withdrawn completely.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/010: Should we/20d wait here on standby now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/011: I'm a messenger from Mr. Clausewitz.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/012: Because of Rhidelhard and Meditch's unexpected actions,/35d/nthe Bifrost army has seized our supply route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/013: He asks Cyrano and Kana to return to our lines at once/15d/nand retake the supply route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/015: Meditch and/20d Rhidelhard...?/25d/nWhat have they done now...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/016: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/018: The quickest way to our supply route/40d is around the northern mountains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/019: I've come to deliver supplies on Clausewitz's orders.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmi41/021: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme03/000: I have no business here right now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/000: Come on,/30d let's take on General Irus!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/001: [Isabele]/nKana,/20d leave this to me and hurry to rescue the prisoners!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/002: [Clausewitz]/nWe'll need Mr. Meditch to take on Irus...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/003: [Clausewitz]/nEven Mr. Meditch, the empire's finest swordsman.../45d/nCan he really match a fearsome warrior like Irus...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/004: We'll protect Clausewitz with our lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/007: We'll protect Clausewitz with our lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/008: We're the Zephyr Falcon's supply troops./nTake whatever you need.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/009: The supply officer is to my left.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/010: We're the Zephyr Falcon's supply troops./nTell us what you need.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/012: We'll protect Clausewitz with our lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/013: [Isabele]/nYour troops are waiting for your help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01b/015: [Clausewitz]/nIt's not that I doubt Mr. Meditch's skill.../45d/nBut somehow, I have a bad feeling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s2b/000: I'd better go up on deck and see what's happening.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/005: It's still/20d at the summit of Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/008: Lord Vincent Bernstein, who/15d fought beside you in the War of the Gods.../65d/nHe was/60d my great-uncle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/009: Oh.../45d So you're a descendant of the Bernstein family.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/011: ...The blood of Deimos/35d flows in you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/012: But/35d even so, Asura/30d/nwould not acknowledge you as its master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/014: You/30d still seem not to know/10d the fundamentals of swordsmanship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/015: Storm Island/45d is home to many monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/017: I/30d will teach you the secrets of swordsmanship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/019: I'm not doing it for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/020: ...Or perhaps/40d I'm doing it for myself...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/022: To repay the debt/35d I owe Lord Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/024: I haven't found the sword yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s05/025: All right, time to go outside and start training.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/004: The sky looks ominous.../45d/nHow is the voyage going?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/005: [Navigator]/nWe should arrive/20d at Storm Island/25d in about eight hours.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/006: [Navigator]/nI hope/30d the weather holds until then, at least...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/007: Hmm.../25d We ought to be seeing gulls by now./75d/nIt's far too quiet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/016: [Crewman]/nThe sea monster Kraken/15d has appeared behind us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/020: Wh-what.../20d What are we to do...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s07/024: What now?!/nDidn't you hear the order to turn back?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflxca06/000: So this is the Church's secret passage./75d Where is Cesare?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/001: As for the person who cast me into this abyss...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/002: I/20d suspected it was someone who could not tolerate/20d/nmy research into the Creation War.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/003: According to Deimos,/30d/nsomeone must have sought/25d the ultimate power used in the Creation War./60d/nPerhaps.../30d that person imprisoned me/35d to keep the world from learning of that power.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/004: To me,/20d the Secret Records of the Creation War/40d were only an account of an ancient conflict./60d/nBut could there be someone/25d who would suffer if their contents became known...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/005: Ruben...?/30d No.../30d Iscariot...?/30d Or/20d someone at the Imperial Academy...?/60d/nFor now,/30d I have no way to find out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/006: Deimos/30d not only analyzed why I had been framed,/40d/nbut also taught me history, logical reasoning,/30d and much else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/007: Deimos' presence,/40d and/20d my fixation on Mercedes./45d/nThose two things/20d helped me endure this hellish life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/008: But/30d one day, a year after I met Deimos,/40d/nmy body reached its limit,/45d and I stood on the brink of death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/010: N-no.../25d I can't.../35d/nI can't.../45d collapse/20d here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/017: [Guard]/nLooks like it./40d/nHe's not moving at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/018: [Guard]/nHe was a tough one./30d Lasted four whole years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/019: [Guard]/nLet's get rid of the body quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/020: [Guard]/nHuh...?/30d/nThis fellow.../20d he's still alive./30d What should we do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/021: [Guard]/nWhat do you think?/30d Just get rid of him. He's a nuisance./40d/nYou know,/20d that pit the earthquake opened last year.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s07/022: [Guard]/nWhy do I have to do it?/15d What a bother.../10d/nTsk.../25d Then give me a hand, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/003: Captain Meditch,/20d we don't have a key that fits this door!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/004: What are you saying?!/30d/nEven if they aren't our comrades,/20d/nwe can't come this far and pretend we didn't see them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/005: Hmm?/40d By the look of you,/15d you're a noble./60d/nTo think they'd imprisoned an innocent old man like you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/006: ...Can I still call myself a noble,/50d/nreduced to imprisonment in a place like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/010: There's no time,/30d so go ahead to the rendezvous point./30d/nI'll rescue him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/012: ...The captain's stubbornness.../70d/nUnderstood./35d We'll go ahead and wait.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/013: I'll get you out soon,/10d so wait just a little longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/015: .../45d Don't waste your effort./40d/nNot even gunpowder can break this door.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/016: Heh,/40d gunpowder might fail,/30d/nbut this sword will do the job!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/018: Heh,/30d you can admire it later./45d/nCan you walk?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/019: Good,/10d it's open!/25d Let's get out of here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/020: [Kain]/nYou've come to rescue us,/20d Captain Meditch!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/021: Miller,/10d I've come to rescue you./25d Hurry and get out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/023: They're planting explosives in the prison./30d Let's get out, quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/025: [Kain]/nGo on ahead./25d I'll get out shortly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/026: [Miller]/nKain and Owen are/15d in the next cell too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/027: [Owen]/nPlease rescue the white-haired prisoner/15d in the cell just to the west, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/028: There are/20d so many of them coming!/30d/nWe can't get through this way!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/029: No,/15d we can't go this way!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/036: Come on,/15d let's rescue our comrades!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/045: Thirteen years of suffering in the sulfur mines/45d may make me look old.../45d/nBut I'm not that old.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/047: The demolition time is approaching,/20d/nso I'm afraid/15d we'll have to abandon the prisoner in this cell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s04/054: The Church has really outdone itself.../60d/nCome on, let's get out of here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/000: [Kana]/nThen/10d we'll meet up over there./25d/nDon't get lost on the way!/25d Hehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/001: Come on,/30d let's set out for Lady Esther Dodd's Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/002: [Isabele]/nMeditch, honestly.../50d Getting so excited just because a beautiful woman hired us...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/003: [Isabele]/nWe're not going there for fun,/30d so don't let it interfere with the mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/004: [Esmeralda]/nWhen will you finally find peace of mind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/005: [Clausewitz]/nSet out as soon as you're ready./45d/nWe'll meet at Esther's mansion in Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/006: [Esmeralda]/nI always pray that you'll find peace, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/007: [Rhidelhard]/nEddes Tedo.../25d Eddo Stedo.../30d Esther Do.../40d/nAargh,/45d I can't remember her name.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/008: [Silver]/nI hear Libreville/10d is surprisingly warm for a town on the empire's northern border. /55d/nIt sounds like a good place to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/010: [Rhidelhard]/nEsther Dodd.../50d/nIf she's so famous for her beauty, just how beautiful must she be?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/012: [Louis]/nIt's a long way to Libreville./35d/nCheck the map and signs carefully so you don't get lost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/013: [Clausewitz]/nLady Esther seems quite remarkable herself./60d/nTo think of involving the Zephyr Falcon...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/014: [Clausewitz]/nBy the way,/40d have you heard of the Secret Records of the Creation War?/65d/nIt's a fascinating book.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/016: Everyone is here./35d Before we begin the meeting...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/017: As you may have guessed,/30d/nwe've decided to welcome Chris here/30d as a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/018: Esther...?/40d/nLady Esther Dodd of Libreville,/35d famed for her peerless beauty?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/020: Libreville/25d lies in the north of the empire,/30d near the Bifrost border./35d/nThe Church has little influence there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/021: What does Libreville's ruler want with us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/022: As you know, Bifrost's Grand Duke/25d is an ambitious man./40d/nOur intelligence says he's been steadily expanding his armaments lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/023: He seems to be using those troops/35d to pressure the minor imperial lords/30d near Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/024: For Libreville,/40d invasion by a neighboring country/30d poses a greater threat/25d than the Church's influence.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/025: So/20d she asked the Zephyr Falcon for help?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/028: Hmm.../50d An imperial lord asking the Zephyr Falcon for help.../65d Isn't that strange?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/029: That's why I/15d investigated from several angles,/40d and concluded that it wasn't a trap.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/030: Lady Esther/30d isn't particularly close to the Church or Geysir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/031: Hahaha,/40d we can't ignore a beautiful ruler's request./35d/nShall we set out at once?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/033: Then/15d let's discuss the details/25d/nonce we've reached Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/034: That drawer must never.../35d never be opened!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/036: Ah,/15d well.../30d/nI don't have the key.../30d so I can't open it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/038: Would you like to join our Fourth Unit/20d on the way to Caracas Forest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/039: Travel with Kana's troops to Caracas Forest?/n(Choosing to go together will take you there automatically.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/043: Then/20d let's go to Caracas with Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/044: This time,/20d I'll travel separately so I can investigate the area too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/045: [Chris]/nOn Strategist Clausewitz's orders, /30d/nI'll be working with Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/046: [Chris]/nI look forward to working with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/047: I'm Chris./35d I look forward to working with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/049: [Meditch]/nThey call her a peerless beauty,/35d so I'm looking forward to meeting her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/051: [Kana]/nJust pay attention to the road signs and you'll be fine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/052: [Kana]/nWhat sort of person is Lady Esther, the famous beauty?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/053: [Esmeralda]/nSilver is such a wonderful person./50d/nI often find myself relying on her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/056: [Meditch]/nI feel even more energetic than usual!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/057: [Bors]/nIf no one keeps an eye on him,/25d/nhe soon wanders off to do things unrelated to the mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/058: [Bors]/nBut since he's helping people,/40d I can't really stop him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/059: [Rhidelhard]/nNo,/25d I'd better not expect too much./45d/nBeauty comes in many forms.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/060: [Isabele]/nDidn't you say you were leaving for Libreville?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/061: [Louis]/nBy the way.../15d/nHave you heard of Bifrost's finest swordsman?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/062: [Louis]/nThey say she's a swordswoman named Catalina./30d It has me concerned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/063: [Chris]/nEveryone seems so capable,/30d which is reassuring.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/064: Kid,/15d please stay out of the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/065: ...Well,/30d he seems a much more serious boy/25d than Rhidelhard, doesn't he?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/067: Thank you sincerely/35d for accepting me into the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/069: A messenger from Lady Esther of Libreville/25d arrived a short while ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/070: Haha,/35d Isabele's blunt words may sting,/20d/nbut she's always right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s02/072: Chris,/35d I'm glad such a capable young man/25d is willing to share our cause./40d/nI hope you'll bring/15d new energy to the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr03/000: I have no business here right now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/001: Only three of you have come here.../40d/nI can more or less guess why.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/002: We're looking for Esmeralda. Viscount Ramon has taken her prisoner.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/003: This is Sharn Hoiste,/30d/na phantom thief who targets only wicked lords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/004: Since we're here,/25d why not work together inside the mansion?/50d/nOur objectives seem much the same.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/006: I/15d have opened this door./45d/nThe torture chamber is just below. Let's hurry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/008: [?????]/nAren't you making rather too much noise?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp108/009: Oh,/30d Miss Kana Milanovich/25d of the Zephyr Falcon, isn't it?/35d/nWe meet again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka12e/001: We must go and find the treasure./nGeysir Forest lies farther south.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/000: This is.../30d Grima?!/40d/nSo Irus is one of the Dark Gods/30d who survived the Creation War!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/001: So this is why Deimos' soul/40d/nwas drawn here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/003: [Irus]/nMy overwhelming power/60d/nwill leave you floundering in despair.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/006: [Irus]/nWhat?/30d/nTo think a human could breach my barrier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/009: The moon sinks over the blade,/55d and the Black Shadow in darkness/25d lays waste to the world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/010: Let me make this clear:/40d Irus's life is mine to take./45d/nI'll avenge Deimos with my own hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/012: [Irus]/nHow dare you speak so freely before a god!/70d/nI'll show you a god's power!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/014: I am the last heir of the Black Shadow,/45d Sharn Hoiste!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflvsirus/001_3: So Irus was... a God of Destruction!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy04/000: The meeting room is always kept ready for use.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy04/001: The meeting room is the heart of the Zephyr Falcon. I put all my effort into keeping it clean.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx05/001: Our information says Machiavelli/25d passed through Libreville/25d and headed toward Antananarivo.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s04/001: Fortunately, he survived.../45d/nBut the poison was so powerful/25d that even after I removed it completely...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s04/002: It probably.../35d took a heavy toll on his body.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s04/004: We seem to have/35d shaken off all the pursuers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s04/011: As I thought.../40d you won't answer me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s04/013: Back then.../30d I should have stopped him, whatever it took...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/004: Here you are,/15d Cyrano./25d I've been waiting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/009: I'm sorry, Esmeralda.../30d I got lost in my memories for a moment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/010: Cyrano,/20d so much has collapsed/nthat we can't get to the second floor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/013: If I could reach my room upstairs,/30d I should find/na copy of the Secret Records of the Creation War...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/014: No way around it./30d Where are the remaining books...?/45d/nThere should still be something that could serve as a clue...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/015: What remains.../45d what was left behind...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/016: So that's what Cesare was after!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/017: The God of Destruction Beladin left behind?/50d/nThe underwater city,/25d in the lake near Cerepus...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/018: .../40d Yes./30d Cesare/15d feared that I would learn of that God of Destruction/30d/nand its existence would become known!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/019: Cerepus/40d would have been beyond Cesare's reach/nat the time...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s01/025: Yes, that's it!/40d/nBeladin/15d left a God of Destruction in the underwater city,/15d the last of the Seven Wonders!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/001: Ah,/20d you're safe!/35d/nWhat happened to Duke Ruben?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/003: Your skill is as impressive as they say!/35d/nThank you for saving my life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/004: You're welcome./45d I was only lucky.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/005: Hmph!/25d Don't think you can boast/15d just because you saved Meditch!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/006: I only gave Mr. Meditch a little help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/008: Without you and the phantom thief Sharn Hoiste,/15d the Zephyr Falcon/35d/nmight have been wiped out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/012: Ah.../35d So Sharn Hoiste appeared again?/40d/nThat means most of us have received his help now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/013: What,/25d then, do you plan to do next,/20d Mr. Cyrano?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/015: Given the circumstances,/30d I think joining forces with the Zephyr Falcon/40d/nwould be in your interests too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/016: After this incident, the Church/30d will likely regard you as one of the Zephyr Falcon./65d/nYou've been branded a traitor, just like us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/017: I have long been branded a traitor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/018: And/15d the Church will be desperate to hunt you down,/60d/nto uncover the nature/30d of the magic in your body and sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/019: If you try to evade the Church's pursuit,/40d your small group will face many restrictions on its movements.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/021: What do you think?/50d/nWouldn't this be a good opportunity/30d to join forces with us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/022: The Zephyr Falcon's intelligence network/45d would certainly help you achieve your own objectives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/025: Whatever our respective goals,/45d we're in the same position/25d as enemies of the cardinal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/027: Excellent./40d/nFor now,/15d would you join Kana's Fourth Unit,/30d whose strength was reduced in this incident?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s04/028: Great!/20d/nNow we can officially work together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga10a/001: Memphis, one of our operation's objectives,/30d is nearby.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02b/000: At this rate,/15d Mr. Cyrano will be in danger./25d But/10d Silver...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02b/007: Why have you only come now?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02b/008: If only.../30d if only you'd come a little sooner.../25d Silver would...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02b/010: What happened to the promise to wait...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02b/012: First, we must/25d get out of Ron quickly./35d/nThe pursuers are after us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/000: Miss Esmeralda's clinic is in our village./nThe famous one... You know it, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/001: People have long come to see her beauty/nor witness her true spirit of service.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/003: Heh, the more I think about it, the more I like this place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/005: Maybe I should settle down here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/006: This is terrible./nPrices have been rising so much lately...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/007: It's hard enough to make ends meet.../nI may have to sell the only clothes I own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/008: Oh... My older brother is very popular with the girls.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/009: My brother was studying medicine at Esmeralda's place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/010: Miss Esmeralda really is like an angel!/nHer voice, her appearance,/nand the way she heals the sick!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/011: When I grow up, I want to be a doctor like Esmeralda too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/012: Miss Esmeralda, it's been a long time since you visited./nEverything is fine at the hospital./nSince we're no longer treating patients, there isn't much to look after...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/013: They say Mom and Dad/nwent to heaven together not long ago./nMy uncle told me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/014: When I told my uncle I wanted to go/nwhere Mom and Dad were,/nhe scolded me. I hate him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/015: Adults are strange./nWhy do they always stop us from doing what we want?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/016: It's fair to say Viscount Ramon/nkilled that child's parents./nPoor little thing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/017: But I'm not even married yet, and now I've been left to raise a child.../nWhat a damned world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/018: Why must parents die and leave a child like that behind?/nDo the powerful really have the right to torment the powerless/nand even kill them?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/019: I think it's true what they say: Esmeralda is God incarnate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/020: She's beautiful and kind, and she even treats/npeople who have no money for free, doesn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/021: Some people in our village love maps./nI love them too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/022: Have you heard of Largo, the legendary geographer?/nThough he was from Silver Arrow, he spent his later years in the old imperial territories,/ndevoting himself to mapping them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/023: It's fair to say he drew the first drafts/nof the maps known throughout the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/024: All of Miss Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns/nand are putting her ideals into practice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/025: Her students are scattered across the country/nproviding care, so you can visit the nearest one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/026: Though she isn't here now.../nher spirit of compassion lives on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/027: It's all because the whole Geysir region has become unstable./nWhy is the Zephyr Falcon unsettling the entire country?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/028: She's no longer here./nShe's gone to Pendragon/nto study advanced medicine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/029: The children at our school all skipped class yesterday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/030: The student council president led the whole school in protest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/031: But there was quite a scolding at school today...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/032: Doctor Esmeralda, how have you been?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/033: The other students have all returned to their home regions./nThey've sent word that they arrived safely and are doing well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/034: I... I... will wait here/nuntil our teacher returns to this village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/035: Welcome, Miss Esmeralda./nI'll offer a special discount to everyone with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/037: Goodbye, Miss Esmeralda./nPlease take care of yourself.../nI'll be waiting for your return someday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/039: People who know how to survive don't turn their noses up at work.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/040: There's a Zephyr Falcon base nearby.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/041: The forest below the Zephyr Falcon base/nhas long been famous for strange happenings.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/042: There are many caves around here./nEach has its own legends,/nand every one of those legends concerns treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/043: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/044: All of Miss Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns/nand are putting her ideals into practice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/045: All of Miss Esmeralda's students have returned to their hometowns/nand are putting her ideals into practice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/046: People throw themselves into any kind of work/nto earn money.../nThis town really is terribly poor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/047: Imperial Geographical Society, Pretoria Branch/nWe help anyone unfamiliar with geography./nWe belong to the Imperial Academy Foundation,/nwhich is supported by public funds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/048: To travel through the old imperial territories without getting lost,/nyou must learn the forest paths./nIf you know those paths, it's fair to say/nyou know half the empire's geography.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/049: For example, the forest between Ron and Bordeaux/nconnects to the cities to the north and south./nBut take the path to the right, and you'll enter/nthe maze known as the Demon Sword Forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/050: A confusing forest lies between Geysir and Ron./nThere are few signs in Geysir Forest,/nand its paths connect east to Nicosia and south to Memphis./nHead west toward Ron,/nand you'll have to cross mountains along the way. It's a difficult route...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/051: The forest near Caracas is notable/nfor connecting to so many regions./nLibreville lies north, Geysir City south,/nParo Village and the Trisis Desert east,/nand Pretoria, here, west./nThink of it as a major transport hub/nnorth of Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/052: In the forest near Caracas, then,/nyou can assume that each branching path/nleads to a different region.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/053: Leave Caracas and keep south to reach Paro./nFor Geysir City, head south, then west, then south again./nFor Libreville, head south, then west,/nthen north and northeast./nOf course, you know the route between Caracas/nand Pretoria here, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/054: Leave our village and keep heading north,/nand you'll find Phoenix Cave. The famous one...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/055: Leave the village heading west, then turn southwest,/nand you'll reach the southern Dragon Breath Mountains./nResistance groups have long been active there./nAt the southern end of those mountains,/na path leads to a nameless cave./nThey say it holds many valuable treasures.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/056: That cave is said to lie at the western edge/nof the southern Dragon Breath Mountains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/057: Geysir Forest, south of Geysir City,/nhas few signs because the city has neglected it./nBut it's vast, with paths leading to many places,/nmaking it a major transport hub in the south.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/058: From Geysir City, keep south to reach Memphis Village./nHead south, then turn northeast to reach the Nicosia/nChurch fortress. Head south, then northwest/nto go toward Ron. Though you might confuse that route/nwith the one to the Fire Dragon Cave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/059: It's not easy to reach Ron from Geysir./nHead south from Geysir City, then northwest at the second fork./nAfter that, keep heading west/nthrough the forest./nThose paths are quite confusing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/060: I belong to the Geographical Society./nI earned my doctorate with a thesis titled "A Differential Study of the Geography of the Bifrost Borderlands/nand Changing Patterns of People's Lives."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/061: Keep heading north from Geysir City,/nthen cross the bridge to the east and go north again to reach Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/062: Antananarivo lies northeast of Libreville,/na remote mountain village. To reach it from Libreville,/ngo north through the nearby forest. At the first fork in the mountains,/nhead west, then immediately turn north/nand keep going.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/063: Ah, Miss Esmeralda./nPeople still come here/nlooking for you./nEven when I tell them to visit a nearby charity hospital run by your students,/nmany simply won't listen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/064: You aren't planning to return just yet...?/nI did hope you'd try living/nfor yourself for a change, Miss Esmeralda...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/065: Please follow your heart/nand make choices you won't regret./nI'll continue looking after this place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/066: Oh! Esmeralda, my teacher!/nFollowing your ideals,/nI returned to my hometown and opened a charity hospital./nBut perhaps my skills weren't good enough,/nbecause no patients came...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/067: Above all, I had far too little funding/nto keep the charity hospital running,/nso it's closed now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/068: Now I truly appreciate how remarkable you are./nBoth your spirit of service and your business skills...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/012_3: This is Miss Esmeralda's hospital./nHow can I help you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/020_3: She's beautiful and kind, and she even treats/npeople who have no money for free, doesn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/021_3: Dad went to the village down below.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/022_3: She told me to keep the door shut so bad people couldn't get in.../nWhy isn't it shut?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/023_3: You're not a wolf, are you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/024_3: While Miss Esmeralda is away,/nwe are no longer treating patients here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/027_3: It's all because the whole Geysir region has become unstable./nWhy is the Zephyr Falcon unsettling the entire country?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/032_3: I'm a nurse at Esmeralda's hospital.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/033_3: The others have all gone back to their hometowns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/034_3: I intend to stay here/nuntil she opens this place again someday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/035_3: We're selling off Miss Esmeralda's remaining medicines./nWould you like to choose one?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr02/040_3: There's a Zephyr Falcon base nearby.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/000: [Lord of Bordeaux]/nI'll give you credit for making it this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/001: [Lord of Bordeaux]/nBut I hired Tuer soldiers as my private guard/45d/nfor just such an occasion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/002: [Lord of Bordeaux]/nHehehe!/60d Seize them at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/003: Where are you holding the Zephyr Falcon prisoners?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/004: [Lord of Bordeaux]/nOh.../25d In the prison on the roof...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcbo09/005: My lord,/35d I'll give you one hour./35d/nRelease the prisoners at once and leave this territory!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/004: Near the entrance,/20d the Second and Fourth Units/20d/nhave begun engaging the enemy!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/005: The enemy/20d doesn't seem to have noticed our diversion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/006: Good!/25d We'll begin our operation too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/007: Zephyr Falcon, First Unit!/40d Begin the operation!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/008: An impregnable fortress/30d and a prison from which escape is said to be impossible.../30d/nInferno.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/011: Everything/25d is going as Strategist Clausewitz predicted.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s01/012: We'll slip into the fortress while the enemy is distracted/20d/nand rescue the prisoners.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw06/000: We have no further business here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw06/001: Outskirts of the Demon Sword Forest
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/001: As expected,/40d it's Bifrost's first-class magic machine,/30d Ascalon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/002: That's.../35d the legendary magic machine,/35d Ascalon...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/003: We have to fight that monster...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/004: Don't worry, Mr. Meditch./40d/nEven a magic machine of legendary power/45d can't reach its full potential/30d/nif its pilot lacks the skill.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/005: Its pilot/25d must be/25d Bifrost's strongest warrior,/40d Catalina, commander of the Valkyries./45d/nBut she/30d has never piloted a magic machine before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21a/006: We stand a chance against her./40d Besides...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka17a/000: This isn't the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka17a/003: << Geysir City >>/nYou are entering Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/000: Then I suppose I must be on my way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/002: [Frog Merchant]/nHumans keep coming to such a dangerous place, don't they?/nBuy my goods if you want to live!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/003: Frog Weapon Shop - Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/005: [Frog Merchant]/nIn a dangerous place, you need the best medicine/nand equipment to survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/006: Frog Accessory Shop - Underwater City Branch
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/007: [Frog Merchant]/nJust make it out of here alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/008: [Frog Innkeeper]/nWelcome. If you sleep here,/nour companions will protect you./nOnly 100 ELD! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/009: [Frog Innkeeper]/nHohoho, fooled you!/nI'm actually taking 10,000 ELD!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/010: Hmph... Leaving without even staying the night./nI hope you get a game over on the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn35/011: [Frog Innkeeper]/nWe won't be seeing you again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/000: Phew.../45d Come on, everyone,/20d keep going./35d/nWe're almost at Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/001: Hey,/15d newcomer./20d/nDid you say this was your first trip through the Trisis Desert?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/003: Hehe,/45d trading across Trisis/30d is one of the best ways/20d/nto make a fortune from nothing./45d/nBut for a newcomer to the desert,/30d it's also a fine way to get killed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/004: Ha,/40d you were lucky./35d You found merchants like us,/30d/nwho specialize in cross-desert trade.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/005: Don't/25d waste your strength on idle chatter./55d/nIf we run into bandits,/30d we'll have to run for our lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/011: Damn.../45d I escaped, but lost the merchants too./45d/nWhich way should I go now...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/012: Cerepus was to the southeast./50d/nThey said it wasn't far,/25d so I have no choice but to keep going.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s01/013: (.../50d So/35d crossing the desert was too much for a novice after all.../65d/nI can't/10d go on...)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/000: There are rumors of suspicious movements in Bifrost. Their current ruler, Grand Duke Moser II, seems far too ambitious.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/001: It began under the previous Grand Duke, but by now Bifrost's Senate system has effectively collapsed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/002: An ambitious man who trusts in his own abilities can easily shake the Senate system. All the more so when people are looking for a hero...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/003: We'll have to face Lord Frederick. He stands at the head of Geysir's lords. Until we've defeated him, we cannot subdue the others.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/004: Lord Frederick's strength comes from his sound governance. His people trust him, and his soldiers' morale is high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/005: To the empire's everlasting glory and prosperity! We can be the heart that brings everyone's strength together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/006: To the prosperity of the empire and its people!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/007: Hmph... Can we really change the course of the empire's history?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/008: I'm only part of this group to pursue my own revenge. For the people of the empire? Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/009: Sometimes I hear strange noises around here. Am I imagining them...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/010: I must be drinking too much lately. Whenever I leave here after a drink, my ears ring and I feel strange...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy03/011: I once saw a friend get sucked through the wall. Of course, I must have been so drunk I imagined it... but it looked so real...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02b/001: [Priest]/nPlease, spare my life!/nI'll sell everything you tell me to!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga02b/004: [Priest]/nAaaah! H-help!/nI'll give you anything, just spare my life...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/001: Helping Zephyr Falcon. That's what got him into trouble.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/002: Damn it,/30d the Zephyr Falcon humiliated them,/30d and now they're taking it out on us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/003: Shh!/40d What if someone hears you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/004: If only/20d the Zephyr Falcon would come to our village too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/006: The Zephyr Falcon?/60d/nA rebel group that's been active in imperial territory for several years,/30d and seems to have become famous lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/007: ...A name I haven't heard in a long time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/012: All right, Silver. We break through head-on!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/013: Not yet. Let's watch the situation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/014: Fool,/35d to sympathize with the rebels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/015: Such high treason/25d cannot be forgiven!/35d/nThe harshest punishment will show them the terror of the law.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/016: Duke Ruben,/30d the preparations for the burning are complete.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/017: Good./25d Now, Silver./20d We break through head-on!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/018: Not yet./45d/nLet's wait until the burning begins/35d and he lets his guard down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/022: You wicked lord, tormenting innocent people!/45d/nDuke Ruben,/25d did you think the Zephyr Falcon would stand by and watch your tyranny?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/026: What are you doing?!/40d Stop them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/027: Good heavens,/25d that girl again?/50d/nCome to think of it,/20d when we met yesterday,/20d she said she was Kana of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/028: She beat us to it./40d/nWell,/10d never mind./25d Let's go!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s03/029: The next day, the execution ground
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/006: This is.../30d the entrance to the underwater city?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/007: There's no need to hide my identity any longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/009: Good heavens.../35d Clausewitz/15d was the phantom thief Sharn Hoiste!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/010: .../45d Circumstances/35d forced me to conceal my identity while I worked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/011: Did you rescue me/20d from the underwater city?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/013: After being absorbed by the God of Destruction.../50d/nI remember attacking Mr. Cyrano, but nothing beyond that...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/014: You/40d were separated from the God of Destruction/30d through Miss Esmeralda's sacrifice,/45d/nthen saved through Mr. Cyrano's sacrifice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/015: For me.../35d Miss Esmeralda and Mr. Cyrano...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/016: But.../40d why on earth...?/35d/nWhy did Mr. Cyrano/10d save me after I tried to kill him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/017: I/25d don't know the reason either./45d/nBut/30d one thing is certain./55d/nMr. Cyrano/20d harmed neither Lord Frederick/20d nor/20d Lady Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/018: A careful examination of Lord Frederick's body/55d/nrevealed traces of an attack by/30d Dark Assassins/nin Cardinal Cesare's service.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/020: We also have reports/30d that Lady Frederick/20d died/15d/nfrom poisoning.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/021: Even if he went there for revenge.../50d/nIt is hard to imagine someone like Mr. Cyrano/25d resorting/15d/nto poison.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/023: With Mr. Cyrano dead,/30d we cannot learn the full truth.../40d/nBut one thing is certain:/35d Cardinal Cesare/25d was involved in this affair.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/024: ...Mother too.../40d seemed to know Mr. Cyrano well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/025: When Mother taught me that song,/60d she said the only people who knew it now/40d/nwere the two of us./70d/nShe looked/40d as though she were longing for something...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/026: I/30d could not understand why Lady Frederick invited Mr. Cyrano,/45d/nor why he accepted and went alone/30d/ninto mortal danger/20d either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/027: My guess is/50d that the two of them shared some.../50d/nconnection in the past.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/028: Even so.../45d/nTo give his own life/15d for me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/029: It seems that Miss Christina/35d was/35d/nvery precious to Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/030: He even/30d left me instructions to look after Miss Christina/30d after he was gone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/031: ...Grandfather/40d must know the truth behind everything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/032: And I/15d have a duty to stop Grandfather's ambitions,/30d/non behalf of Father, Mother,/30d/nand Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/033: Cardinal Cesare/40d has probably/25d gone in person/nto request reinforcements/35d from Bifrost again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/034: To defend this land/45d against another invasion from Bifrost,/40d/nChris.../10d as the rightful heir to the Frederick family.../40d/nNo,/30d Christina,/30d you must rise to the challenge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/036: Then,/40d to reunite the divided Zephyr Falcon,/20d we must/35d/nfirst/15d find Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/038: Knowing him,/50d/nhe may be drifting/25d from one tavern to another.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/039: Besides, he himself had already drunk a considerable amount of poison.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/040: That can't be!/40d/nMother is Grandfather's only daughter!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/041: But/40d Mr. Cyrano knew that song too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/047: And there was that incident with the piano music last time...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/052: You must carry on Lord Alfred Frederick's wishes/50d and join forces/30d with our Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s05/058: And Sharn Hoiste... why are you here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma02a/000: There seems to be no road ahead.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma02a/001: We have to pursue Machiavelli at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/001: This court convenes/30d to investigate and judge the defendant,/15d Cyrano Bernstein,/35d/non charges/15d of devil worship./45d/nIt is now eight o'clock. The trial is in session.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/002: I declare the court in session.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/003: The Church/30d has received an anonymous tip/35d/naccusing the defendant of devil worship./50d/nDo you admit to this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/005: On an unspecified day last month,/40d you are said to have studied a forbidden demonic book./45d/nDo you admit to this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/006: A forbidden demonic book?/40d I know nothing of such a thing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/008: Calm yourself./45d/nThe defendant/15d may be unaware of his own wrongdoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/009: /30dDefendant,/30d have you heard of a book entitled/15d/n"Secret Records of the Creation War"?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/010: Yes,/25d I know it./35d/nI have been studying it recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/012: "Secret Records of the Creation War"/30d was written by the self-proclaimed sage,/30d/nGishne, a demon of the old empire!/50d/nSo/20d the defendant has indeed been studying demons!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/015: That is not a demonic book!/30d/nIt is/20d what the sage Gishne recorded for future generations...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/016: You/30d clearly intended to embrace/30d/nthose demonic ideas!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/020: Silence!/55d/nReading a forbidden book is a grave offense,/50d but that alone/20d/nis not grounds to accuse someone of devil worship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/021: However,/25d we have a crucial witness/15d/nto the defendant's devil worship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/023: I request that the witness be called.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/025: Cyrano Bernstein/25d tried to persuade/25d me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/027: He recommended that book to me,/30d urging me to learn more/30d about the devil's teachings...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/029: You/25d seem to be close to the defendant.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/030: We are as close/10d as brothers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/033: .../40dEven within the Academy, he.../45d rituals of devil worship...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s11/037: If someone who does such things is allowed to continue.../50d/nWho knows what might happen...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldpr13/000: [Pirate Kidd]/nHeh heh heh... Is it you who disturbed my slumber?/nI'll let it pass up to three times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldpr13/002: [Pirate Kidd]/nFarewell. Once you leave, returning won't be easy. Heh heh heh...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldpr13/003: [Pirate Kidd]/nI'll only let it pass three times. Don't disturb my slumber again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni09/001: All right, let's infiltrate the west side of the fortress!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/000: [Kana]/nI/15d want to go with Cyrano too.../50d/nWill you really be all right without me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/001: [Meditch]/nIt's been a while/15d since I got to lead the team.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/003: [Bors]/n.../15dThere are also plenty of people/35d among the troops/nrooting for Miss Esmeralda...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/006: [Rhidelhard]/nTo think I'd have to go on a mission with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/007: [Kana]/nStill,/15d a treasure hunt/25d does sound exciting!/15d Hehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/008: [Clausewitz]/nOn the border with Bifrost,/20d Mount Mantigoa is said to have/35d/na cave where a unicorn spirit is sealed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/009: [Isabele]/nI'm counting on you for this./35d/nPlease make sure you succeed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/010: [Isabele]/nI'm not so petty/15d/nthat I would disregard your abilities.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/011: [Rhidelhard]/nWell,/25d I suppose it's better than something as dull as a treasure hunt?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/035: [Isabele]/nA treasure hunt.../50d/nWell,/25d I suppose you could call it a mission...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/037: [Silver]/nOur strategist/20d certainly knows how to handle people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/038: [Silver]/nTreasure hunting.../45d/nIt's been ages since I felt my pirate blood stir. /45dHa ha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/039: [Chris]/nA treasure hunt.../30d I'm a little jealous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/040: [Esmeralda]/nMay God's guidance and blessing/35d accompany you in all that lies ahead...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/041: Then.../15d/nYou mean,/30d Cesare plans to bring Bifrost's army/25d into the empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/042: Judging by the intelligence gathered so far,/30d it is almost certain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/043: We have long/40d known of secret dealings between Bifrost and the Church,/30d but/35d/nnow Cesare's right-hand man, Machiavelli,/50d has left for Bifrost. That is an ominous sign.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/046: Machiavelli/30d is a well-known name among scholars.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/048: He has made his name/30d researching new ideas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/049: .../30dWe were close friends as children./45d/nTo think he is working for Cesare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/050: Along with our strategist,/25d he is renowned as one of the empire's two sages!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/051: Me, a sage?/30d You flatter me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/052: I/25d am interested in strategy and military history,/45d/nwhereas he is an authority on ideas and history.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/053: [Esmeralda]/nOur strategist Clausewitz/25d really is a humble man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/054: Since a man like him/35d is heading to Bifrost in person,/35d/nwe cannot stand idly by.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/057: No./30d/nMiss Kana,/25d I have a separate request for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/059: Not long ago,/35d I happened upon a treasure map./40d/nOur examination/35d confirmed it as a genuine map left behind/45d/nby the old mercenary company Cashmir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/060: If we find that treasure,/40d we can resolve the shortage of funds and equipment/20d caused by Lord Frederick's recent attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/062: He came from a poor family and burned with ambition,/55d/nbut people had called him a genius since childhood.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/063: Huh? /25d I have to go too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/064: Yes,/30d this time,/25d please accompany Miss Kana./35d/nYou're familiar with treasure hunting, aren't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/065: So while Cyrano pursues Machiavelli,/45d we're supposed to go treasure hunting?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/066: I'll feel much safer/20d with you along!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/067: ...Well,/20d I suppose a break now and then wouldn't hurt.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/068: And Mr. Rhidelhard,/25d please accompany Mr. Cyrano/25d/nin pursuit of Machiavelli.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/070: Captain Rhidelhard,/40d this/25d is an important mission for us./45d/nPlease put your personal feelings aside/36d and make sure it succeeds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/074: To think Machiavelli/15d has been working for Cesare...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/076: To reach Bifrost,/15d you must pass through Libreville./30d/nShall I accompany you as far as Caracas Forest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/077: Travel to Caracas Forest with Kana?/n(Choosing to travel together will take you to Caracas Forest automatically.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/080: All right,/30d I'll go as far as Caracas with Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/082: I/25d will explore the nearby dungeons/25d a little more before leaving.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/083: Really...?/35d Then/10d good luck with your mission!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/084: [Clausewitz]/nIf you find the time,/35d/nit may be worth exploring.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/085: [Louis]/nHave you heard about the new sword/30d/ndeveloped by Pendragon's Chrysaor company?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/086: [Louis]/nDespite its affordable price,/20d it outperforms existing mass-produced swords,/35d so it has reportedly become Pendragon's standard issue./30d/nIt has yet to reach imperial territory,/35d but swordsmen are already talking about it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/087: [Meditch]/nPendragon's new sword?/40d You mean the PS-7 "Blitz"?/40d/nI hear it was made to counter the Tuer tribe's light swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/088: [Meditch]/nIt's made of a special alloy rather than ordinary metal,/35d/nso it withstands heat and impacts./35d With excellent attack and defense,/15d/nit's said to be a superb weapon...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/089: Besides,/30d/nI believe this mission/20d would benefit most/25d from Miss Silver's assistance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/090: [Chris]/nI'd be excited/15d to see what treasure awaits./20d Haha.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/091: [Chris]/nBut your mission is important too!/35d Please set out soon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/092: [Silver]/nBut.../40d will you really be all right without me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/094: [Esmeralda]/nBeing able to work with such remarkable people,/45d/nI am learning a great deal myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/096: [Bors]/nAh!/15d That's right./20d When it comes to Bifrost,/30d the elite unit/nthe Valkyries is particularly famous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/097: [Bors]/nI hear Bifrost's strongest swordsman/30d commands the Valkyries./30d/nDid you know that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s02/098: Miss Isabele/25d and Mr. Meditch, I'm counting on you as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst05/000: I've come quite a way./15d I'd better complete the fourth stage of training before going any further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/003: Bifrost.../25d/nWe have reports that a vast army has crossed into imperial territory!
