Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/004: I see.../25d So they have come after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/005: Furthermore,/25d Cardinal Cesare is behind this deployment...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/009: All troops,/15d prepare for battle!/50d/nWe cannot let Bifrost's army set foot on imperial soil.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/010: We depart tomorrow at noon./40d/nPrepare thoroughly so there are no delays.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/012: So this is why my father-in-law/35d sent Machiavelli to Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/013: Calling on foreign forces/40d tramples on the empire's pride!/55d/nI cannot stand by this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/015: The problem is Bifrost's Valkyrie force...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s01/016: First,/35d I must send a messenger/35d to Clausewitz of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldro09/000: This is one of the few rough-diamond mines in the imperial territories. We sell diamonds far below market price. Care to choose one?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldro09/002: Farewell. The way out is dangerous, so take care...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/003: Seeing you all out here waiting,/40d you must have been worried about the duel's outcome./50d/nNow/15d you can put your minds at ease.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/004: Cyrano,/15d did you/20d really... General Frederick...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/006: You laugh...?/45d Do not dishonor the dead,/15d Cyrano!/35d/nStrength with a sword isn't everything!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/007: The dead?/45d What are you talking about?/30d/nAre you saying I killed Frederick?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/008: What are we talking about?/20d Stop playing games!/30d/nAre you saying/20d the general's body laid out in the tent/25d/nis just a doll?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s03/009: What do you.../40d Frederick is dead?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/001: Heh heh,/65d there's not a trace/35d of the old bookworm left,/35d/nCyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/002: I never thought/35d you would defeat General Irus,/30d one of the Four Heavenly Kings.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/003: Ruben.../45d It's been a long time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/004: Cyrano,/45d I knew a day like this/25d would come eventually./40d/nI've known it for fifteen years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/005: Why did you do it?/35d Why did you lie at the trial?/45d/nYou were like a brother to me./30d Why did you betray me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/008: If you can defeat me,/30d we can continue/nthis conversation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/009: Cyrano Bernstein,/30d/nI've prepared a little toy/30d for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/010: Have you heard of a weapon called a machine gun?/50d/nIt came from the East,/55d and it packs quite a punch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/012: Now,/30d let's see the skill that killed a Dark God.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/013: How did you/15d know Irus was a Dark God...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/014: You underestimated me that much?/55d How disappointing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/015: Well,/25d we've talked long enough./40d/nBe careful,/30d this toy is dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/016: Enough to blast even an immortal body/30d to pieces!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/019: This is.../65d the path I chose...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/020: For fifteen years,/45d I've been waiting for this day.../60d Ever since/25d/nmy father died...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/021: .../60dBrother.../45d I carry/35d Father's blood too.../35d/nThe blood of Luke Bernstein...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/023: You never knew, Brother.../55d We're/40d half-brothers./45d/nWe both/30d share the blood of our father,/30d Luke Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/025: Because.../45d I was of low birth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/028: You.../55d I/40d envied you, Brother./55d/nYou/35d were always in the light,/40d shining so brightly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/029: But/25d I.../50d Simply because I had a different mother,/50d/nI always had to remain in the shadows.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/030: I was jealous.../40d of you.../55d/nSo.../40d I wished/20d you would disappear./45d/nThen/45d Father/25d might see me in a new light.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/031: Back then.../45d that was the foolish thought I had.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/033: Ha.../55d But.../55d now that I'm about to die.../50d/nI wonder why I struggled/30d so desperately to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/034: Brother.../40d did you know?/50d/nFather confronted the Cardinal.../40d to save you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/035: And in the end,/40d in a duel with Frederick.../45d/nhe died.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/037: I was granted a domain.../55d and even the right to use the Bernstein name.../90d/nBut now/30d none of it means anything./60d Death ends it all.../110d It feels so empty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/038: .../45dNow.../35d I just want to rest.../95d/nBrother.../65d I'm sorry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/041: The one who lured you into the trap.../70d/nwas Cardinal Cesare himself...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/042: Iscariot too.../40d and I.../55d/nWe were both/25d his...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/045: .../55dSo Cesare was behind all of this...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/046: Cesare Borgia.../55d/nThis bloody chain of misfortune.../45d I will end it with my own hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s03/047: Yes,/45d if you hadn't been my real brother.../50d/nI would never have betrayed you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/000: [Lord of Memphis]/nI'll give you credit for making it this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/001: [Lord of Memphis]/nBut I anticipated this/35d and hired troops from the Tuer tribe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/002: [Lord of Memphis]/nHeh heh heh!/45d Teach those fools a lesson!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/003: [Lord of Memphis]/nThis can't be.../35d My army...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/004: Where are the prisoners of the Zephyr Falcon kept?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/005: [Lord of Memphis]/nI.../25d In the mansion's basement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcme24/006: My lord,/35d you have one hour./35d/nRelease the prisoners at once and leave this region!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldpx15/001: A phoenix fossil?/30d/nWhat's that shining on top...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldpx15/006: The Phoenix Egg must be a summon sigil.../nDoes that mean whoever holds it can summon the phoenix?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/002: Guards!/20d What are you doing?!/25d/nSeize the intruder!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/004: Miss Esmeralda,/20d are you all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/007: Ramon has been taught a lesson,/35d so he won't be able to trouble Miss Esmeralda now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/011: Can we trust someone who keeps his identity hidden like that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/012: He's already helped us several times, hasn't he?/40d/nNot just me,/15d he helped Isabele last time too.../35d Ah!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/014: I forgot we were supposed to meet the other unit commanders./45d/nWe must hurry to the meeting place!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/015: Ah.../15d Um.../30d/nWhy don't/10d we all go together for now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s06/017: Unit commanders?/30d What do you mean?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/001: So from tomorrow,/25d we'll be fighting alongside Frederick's army...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/002: It feels strange./35d We were enemies only yesterday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/004: Bifrost's Grand Duke has some nerve./45d/nTo think he would dare invade the empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/005: I hear it's all/25d because of a woman named Josephine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/006: Men are all the same, I tell you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/007: Come to think of it,/25d where did Meditch go?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/008: I saw him/15d going out with Esther a moment ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/009: Tsk.../40d So that's how it is after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/012: Chris,/20d can you play the piano?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/014: Oh,/15d yes./25d Though I'm not very good...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/015: Wow!/30d Then play something for us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/016: It's been a while,/10d so I'm not sure how well I'll manage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/023: This piece/10d can only be played this far alone./45d/nFrom the next passage on,/25d it takes two people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/024: Though Mother/10d always played it to the end herself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/027: Cyrano,/20d what's wrong?/25d/nYou look so frightening...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/028: Huff.../60d What happened all of a sudden?/20d/nYou rushed in without a word...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/029: That piano just now.../35d Who was playing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/031: That song.../35d Who taught it to you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/032: Mother taught me.../35d Why do you ask?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/035: ...Forgive me,/40d but could you play it once more?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/042: What?!/30d How do you know this song...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/046: You're/30d good at the piano too, Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/048: How.../35d do you know this song?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/050: This song.../25d I was sure only Mother knew it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/051: Never mind./45d/nI merely heard it once, long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s04/053: What on earth.../45d is going on...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/001: [Maid]/nPlease.../40d you're putting me in a difficult position.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/002: What?/35d A senator wishes to see the Grand Duke!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/003: What right have you to bar my way?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/007: Grand Duke!/30d We need to talk.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/013: Grand Duke,/35d what do you take our Senate for?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/014: You ignored the Senate/30d and increased military spending again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/015: Do you/20d understand your responsibilities/10d as Grand Duke or not?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/017: I believe I explained it sufficiently./45d/nThe reason for increasing military spending...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/018: Enough!/20d Are you going to parrot the same words again?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/019: The real reason is that a woman is manipulating you,/40d and you increased military spending on her orders,/25d/nisn't it?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/024: Drag those two old men/30d out of here at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/027: You.../15d How dare you!/30d/nDo you know who I am?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/028: If you do not withdraw, we will open fire./35d/nThis is your final warning.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/030: Grand Duke!/35d/nYou are making a grave mistake!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/032: Those useless old men in the Senate...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/033: Perhaps we should take this opportunity/30d to shut down the Senate as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s01/034: Why don't you tell the truth?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/001: Me? Well... Who am I, indeed...?/nOh! You have an unusual sword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/003: I sense a strange aura from a sword.../nCould you show me what's in that pack?/n...This is Excalibur! Where did you find such a renowned blade...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/004: It's a fine sword, but it's so worn...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/005: Such a renowned blade... To keep it in this condition!/nWait a moment! I'll repair it for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/007: You... Could you be the man called Paz?/nThank you so much for repairing this sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/008: So you know my name. Think nothing of it./nSimply having repaired such a renowned blade is enough... Farewell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/009: Me? Well... Who am I, indeed...?/nOh! You have an unusual sword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/010: What are you doing... in such a remote, dangerous place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/011: [Paz]/nHmm... Me? My name is Paz./nI spent my life traveling and repairing swords,/nbut the world came to feel empty, so I settled here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/012: But aren't you lonely or afraid... living here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/013: [Paz]/nAm I afraid? Ha ha ha... I was once a renowned swordsman myself./nThe monsters here can never harm me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/014: [Paz]/nBut sometimes... I long to see/na truly fine sword./nEoline Pendragon's Excalibur,/nthe Pendragon family's Barisada,/nor the lightsabers the Tuer tribe is said to use...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/015: Excalibur... You mean that worn-out sword?/nWas it really such a renowned blade...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/017: If by Excalibur you mean that very old sword,/nthen yes, I have it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/018: [Paz]/nIf you have it, could you show it to me for a moment?/nIt's this old man's wish.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/019: Of course. That's no trouble./nIt's so worn out that I no longer use it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/021: [Paz]/nThis is... the legendary Excalibur! By the gods.../nBut it's terribly worn. Would you let me repair it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/022: You want to repair that old sword?/nIt was so worn out that nobody even considered repairing it.../nVery well. I'd be glad if an unusable sword became useful again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/023: [Paz]/nA useful sword... Very well./nI'll show you what a truly "useful" sword means.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/026: [Paz]/nWell...? Look!/nThis is the true masterpiece, Excalibur!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/027: This sword... Its gleaming blade and keen edge! Its radiance promises powerful attacks, and its weight offers reassuring defense! Yet it moves as though I weren't holding anything. This is a truly great blade...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/028: You restored this sword perfectly.../nThat's incredible!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/029: [Paz]/nHa ha ha! That was nothing! Bring me any sword,/nand I'll give it a 120% upgrade!/nPendragon's Barisada, anything at all! Just bring it! Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/030: (Is he really hiding away because he's disillusioned with the world...?)/nThank you, Paz. I'll never forget your kindness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma17/032: I used to be a renowned sword expert, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s03/001: [Zephyr Falcon Marksman]/nThe way ahead has been checked./30d/nThe prison is on the floor below.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s03/003: All right,/30d we've successfully infiltrated the fortress,/30d so we'll split into groups here as planned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s03/004: Louis and Bors,/15d come with me./35d/nThe rest of you, go upstairs/20d and plant the explosives at the designated site.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s03/005: I hope to see everyone/25d safe at the rendezvous point.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s03/007: Our comrades/15d should be in the underground prison.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/002: Honestly,/30d how can anyone drink with all this anxiety?/40d/nThis place isn't worth coming to anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/003: In the end,/10d we've come back to Ron...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/004: Mr. Meditch/35d is unlikely to have left imperial territory.../55d Where on earth is he...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/006: Bah,/15d when luck turns against you, even this...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/008: Come to think of it,/30d we haven't visited the tavern/25d in Ron yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/009: Hey, tavern keeper!/45d Do you know who I am?/15d Well?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/011: [Tavern Owner]/n.../45dHow am I supposed to know/15d who you are, sir?/35d/nI won't charge you,/20d so please calm down/25d and leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/012: What?/55d/nDo you take me, Meditch,/30d for a man who won't pay his debts?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/013: Mr. Meditch!/30d So this is where you were!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/016: Miss Isabele,/35d how is/15d Mr. Meditch doing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/017: As you can see.../45d I can't say he's doing very well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/018: Mr. Meditch,/30d this is pathetic./40d/nAren't you ashamed to bear the name Roberto de Meditch?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/020: Damn it.../60d What do you/25d expect from me now...?/50d/nI'm useless.../45d What could I possibly do...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/021: Cyrano.../50d His death/30d is my fault too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/022: Mr. Meditch,/45d it wasn't your fault./40d/nMr. Cyrano's death/15d was my responsibility.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/023: Consumed by vengeance,/45d I gave myself to the resurrection of the God of Destruction.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/024: I was brought back at the cost of Mr. Cyrano's life,/50d/nso I will do my utmost to live well/20d and ensure his sacrifice was not in vain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/025: Mr. Meditch,/45d it's not too late./40d/nWith our own hands,/25d we can rebuild the Zephyr Falcon together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/027: You/30d are the Zephyr Falcon's true leader,/45d Roberto de Meditch./40d/nOnly you can do this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/028: .../50dAll right,/15d I'll try./45d I cannot let his death/15d be in vain...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s01/029: And to save me.../45d Mr. Cyrano sacrificed himself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/000: [Lord of Pretoria]/nI'll give you credit for making it this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/001: [Lord of Pretoria]/nBut/35d I hired Tuer mercenaries especially for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/002: [Lord of Pretoria]/nHeh heh heh!/30d Give those fools a taste of defeat!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/003: [Lord of Pretoria]/nThis can't be.../40d My mercenaries...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/004: Where are you holding the Zephyr Falcon prisoners?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr113/006: My lord,/35d I'll give you one hour./35d/nRelease the prisoners at once and leave this territory!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/001: Now that everyone seems to be here,/25d let us begin the strategy meeting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/002: The objective of this operation/35d/nis to rescue our prisoners,/15d held by local lords/35d who have enlisted Frederick's forces.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/003: Pretoria,/15d Memphis,/15d Bordeaux./30d/nPlease rescue our comrades/15d held in these three places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/004: Pretoria,/35d as you know, was once under the Zephyr Falcon's influence,/50d/nbut Frederick/30d reportedly installed a new lord there recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/005: Memphis/30d is a village at the continent's southernmost tip./30d You must pass through Geysir Forest to reach it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/006: And Bordeaux/30d lies north of Ron City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/007: Ron City/25d had such strict checkpoints/30d that infiltration was impossible until recently./50d/nLately,/30d outsiders are said to have gained easier access.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/008: Now,/35d let us set out as soon as preparations are complete.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/009: Shall we travel together to nearby Pretoria?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/010: Travel to Pretoria with Kana's 4th Unit?/n(Choosing to travel together will take you to Pretoria automatically.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/012: Travel separately and investigate the surrounding area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/014: Well.../25d then I suppose it can't be helped.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/015: [Meditch]/nGeneral Frederick.../45d/nThis should be a fine contest!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/016: [Clausewitz]/nOnce the operation is complete,/25d we will all regroup.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/017: [Rhidelhard]/nHmph,/20d Ron's army is nothing to worry about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/018: [Isabele]/nHave you heard the rumors circulating among the team members recently?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/019: [Esmeralda]/nPretoria.../30d I could visit my hospital as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/020: [Silver]/nCyrano, /15dmake sure you remember the route. /30d/nI still don't know my way around on land.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/021: [Kana]/nI have another assignment, so I can't go with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/022: All right,/30d I'll go to Pretoria with Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/023: We/15d will explore this area a little more and travel separately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/024: [Isabele]/nI hear there is a strange dungeon/30d beneath this base.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/025: Our last mission,/20d rescuing the missing villagers of Libreville,/40d/nwas completed without any losses,/35d/nbringing the operation to a successful close.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/026: So /30dthe Zephyr Falcon/20d gained a powerful backer./40d/nMeanwhile, /20dFrederick's forces in Ron seem to have made a move.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/028: [Isabele]/nIf there's a good spear to be found,/50d it might be worth looking for.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/029: [Kana]/nDon't forget the objectives!/30d Pretoria,/10d Memphis,/15d Bordeaux.../25d/nYou remember them, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/031: [Silver]/nAre you ready?/35d/nI can set out whenever you like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/032: [Chris]/nI'm/20d a full-fledged member of the Zephyr Falcon now, right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/033: [Chris]/nIf you're ready, let's set out!/45d/nI'll follow right behind you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/036: [Meditch]/nBy the way,/20d/nour strategist sometimes disappears without a word.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/037: [Clausewitz]/nIt will probably/25d be a long journey./35d/nBe careful not to lose your way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/038: [Esmeralda]/nI hope nothing happens to make the people of Pretoria suffer...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/039: Lately,/15d we keep having to travel separately...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/042: [Meditch]/nPerhaps he's/25d secretly going on dates./30d/nHa ha ha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/043: [Clausewitz]/nUntil now,/35d we have avoided clashing with Frederick,/40d/nbut now/25d it seems unavoidable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s02/044: [Rhidelhard]/nIf it's too much for you,/30d leave it to me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s04/000: Th-this.../15d This is/30d the God of Destruction...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s04/002: Attack without hitting the center, where Christina is!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s04/003: We did it!!/20d It won't be able to attack us now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nBy my life, I implore you,/45d awaken,/15d Christina!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s03/000: [Diablo]/nYou have made me reveal my true form after centuries,/35d and for that/75d/nnone of you will leave alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s04/000: Th-this.../40d This is/15d the God of Destruction!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s04/002: Anyone who stands in my way/20d faces only death!/50d/nThere is no need to concern ourselves with Christina!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber03/001: Young master, I'm cleaning at the moment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber03/002: Oh... Your engagement ceremony is today, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber03/003: ...My heartfelt congratulations on your engagement./nAs a fellow woman, Miss Mercedes,/nI envy you more than I can say. May you be happy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber03/002_3: Oh... Your engagement ceremony is today, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber03/003_3: ...My heartfelt congratulations on your engagement./nAs a fellow woman, Miss Mercedes,/nI envy you more than I can say. May you be happy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy05/000: North - Dragon Breath Mountains/nSoutheast - Pretoria Region
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmf05/000: Right, let's use this way to get out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy06/000: Nicosia, where the Church's fortress stands,/35d lies at the continent's southern end, beyond Geysir City in the center.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy06/001: To reach Libreville,/30d you must head north through Caracas Forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy06/002: Our destinations/30d are nearby Pretoria/20d and Memphis at the continent's southern tip,/35d/nas well as/20d Bordeaux, north of Ron City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy06/003: To reach Bifrost,/25d we must pass through Antananarivo,/25d northeast of the Libreville region./45d/nMachiavelli should have gone that way too,/30d so let's hurry after him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat16/000: Hmm?/30d A switch in a place like this./40d/nIt says "East Side of the Fortress"... Could it be...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/000: Our Lady Esther Dodd has a beauty/nthat captivates everyone./nAs residents of Libreville, we cannot help being proud.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/001: The climate here is quite warm for somewhere so far north./nWe citizens say it is thanks to/n"Esther Dodd's wind."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/003: I hear Lady Esther Dodd's family/nhas a long and distinguished history./nHow else could she possess such grace?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/005: Trade between the two countries/nused to be modest, but lately/nlarge quantities of goods have been moving between them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/009: My family runs an inn, so I get to see all kinds of people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/010: They say many people have been traveling to and from the north lately./nMy family runs an inn, and guests from Bifrost/nhave increased considerably.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/012: Have you heard of Josephine,/nthe favored concubine of Bifrost's Grand Duke?/nThere are all sorts of rumors about her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/013: Some say she comes from a common family here,/nothers that she was a streetwalker in Geysir.../nAt any rate, she certainly isn't of noble birth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/015: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/016: The Tuer relied on their superior technology to win the war,/nwhile Pendragon, fighting on its own territory, used its abundant resources/nfor overwhelming numbers and a prolonged campaign./nNow neither side has brought the war to an end,/nand I hear the fighting has entered a lull.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/017: I know Nikacha of Cerepus too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/018: At my age, you start looking back on the life you've lived./nWhat have I done with all those years?/nWhat sort of person am I...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/019: Thinking carefully about it.../nI seem to have heard strange noises/ncoming from beneath the arena lately./nPerhaps I'm getting old...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/020: The people here have little to do with physical training./nThat's what worries me most... If trouble arises,/naren't strength and money what we need most?/nOur citizens are far too weak.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/026: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer/nhas already passed its most intense stage?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/027: Libreville's main source of income is trade between Bifrost/nand the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/028: They say that once a man has seen Lady Esther Dodd,/nhe can never forget her face.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/029: Well, I'm a woman, so I can't speak for how men feel.../nBut our lady is certainly beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/030: Welcome./nOur arena always welcomes you/nat affordable prices...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/031: Of all the kings in history, surely the one with the most legends/nis Yggd Fein, known as the Adventurer King?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/032: The legends our Black Prince left during his journey/nof knightly training are remarkable too,/nbut Yggd Fein seems to have left many tales/nwhile he was still on the throne.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/033: Hmph... Why should a backwater like Bifrost/nbe anything to fear?/nWhen our empire was in its prime,/nthey wouldn't even have been worth a bite!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/034: Besides, throughout their long history,/nhaven't they been a people who know only defense?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/035: Oh my.../nDon't you know the saying that the hardest things break most easily?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/036: Being too rigid is never a good thing./nDon't they say that softness overcomes strength?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/037: [Mr. Emery]/nPlease come in./nWelcome to our shop.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/039: Thank you for purchasing our weapons./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/040: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome./nAre you looking for anything in particular?/nI'll help you find it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/042: Thank you for buying from Libreville's finest shop./nPlease visit us whenever you like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/043: Have you heard the strange noises near the arena?/nCome to think of it, is it even operating these days?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/044: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome./nThe Libreville Inn offers the cleanest rooms/nin northern Geysir./nThe price is 150 ELD! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/045: Thank you. Have a restful night./nThe Libreville Inn always offers the finest service.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/046: The next time you're in Libreville,/nplease visit us whenever you like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/047: Thank you for staying at our inn./nPlease visit us whenever you're in Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/048: They say Lady Esther Dodd's mansion/nonce had a passage leading to a strange cave./nIt has all been sealed off now, though...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/049: I once heard strange noises near the arena/nin the middle of the night./nNobody goes there anymore,/nbut whatever it was still makes me uneasy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/050: The door to this house appears to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/052: Yggd Fein explored the world's remotest places even as a king./nThey say he disappeared in the Demon Sword Tower.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/053: A colleague at work says he likes me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/054: But the problem is, he's younger than I am. Five whole years younger...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/055: I've been troubled by that lately./nTo me, he's more like a younger brother than a lover.../nHow could we have a romance?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/056: The arena door is secured with an unusual lock.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/057: Cheers to peace in beautiful Libreville!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/058: A toast to our beautiful Lady Esther Dodd/nof Libreville!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/059: And a toast to you, my beauty!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/060: [Gustav]/nThe arena in our city?/nI used to go there quite often,/nbut the people here have little interest in physical training,/nso it closed not long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/061: [Gustav]/nWell... Some say they've heard strange noises there,/nbut I don't really believe it. If you're curious, why not/nask the owner?/nHe's close to the weapons shop's owner, so he's often there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/062: [Mr. Emery]/nThe arena's owner?/nHe used to come here all the time, but he's absent today./nSays he's not well? He's been saying a lot of strange things/nlately... Perhaps he's deeply upset about his business/nhaving closed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/064: [Mr. Emery]/nIn the northern block, in the house across from the stairs leading down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/065: Shall I try the key I found on the desk earlier?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/067: Do you know the mysterious story behind the Chaos Cube?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/068: Long ago, the Chaos Cube was a star in the sky. There were many wars then, just as there are now. One day, a young woman whose lover was going off to war stood by a lake and wished upon that star. "Please protect my lover on the battlefield," she prayed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/069: Moved by the young woman's pure heart, the star replied, "I can grant your request, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/070: Do you know the story of the Chaos Cube?/nLong ago, when war never ceased in this land, there was a couple./nThe woman's name was Awen, and the man's name/nwas Al. They had promised to marry,/nbut Al had to go to war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/071: Awen prayed and prayed to the stars for Al's safety./nMoved by her devotion, a star/nonce spoke to her./n"Do you truly have the courage to save him?/nThen enter the lake behind the village."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/072: Someone else will tell you what happened next...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/073: Mr. Jones sent me. Could you give me some liquor for him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/074: [Tavern Keeper]/nJones...? Forget it./nDo you want to ruin my business?/nIf his wife catches him drinking, do you know/nhow much trouble she causes here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/075: But Mr. Jones gave me this...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/076: I placed the Brass Gem on the counter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/077: Ah... Is that a Brass Gem? Ha, ha ha ha!/nWell, he's a pitiful man too, when you think about it./nTo be married to such a dreadful woman.../nIf you take away his drinking,/nwhat pleasure would he have left in life?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/079: Make sure it gets to him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/080: There's a beautiful legend about the Chaos Cube.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/082: But I don't like people from Bifrost./nThose frightening stares of theirs...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/083: Still, her beauty and charm must be remarkable, since she/nand Lady Esther Dodd are called the two beauties of the north./nBut she could never match our lady's grace.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/084: Well, it hardly concerns us here in Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/085: Are the rumors of a Bifrost invasion true?/nI really hate war...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/086: Hohoho! I suppose no man can resist a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/087: Surely Libreville alone could repel/nany mere Bifrost offensive! Ha ha ha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/088: I hear Bifrost is planning to invade Libreville. Is that true?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/089: I'm truly afraid of war./nThat gentleman over there says Bifrost's/nmilitary might is laughable, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/090: What really frightens me is someone like him, full of/npointless bravado. All talk,/nand never doing anything at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/091: Weapons are the same. Being expensive and hard/ndoesn't necessarily make them good. But costly weapons/ndo have the advantage of lasting a long time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/092: The strange noises from the arena first/nbegan just after it closed./nLate in the evening, when everyone/nwas at home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/093: The sound seemed not to belong to this world./nSometimes it sounded like the wind,/nsometimes like a groan,/nringing out ominously.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/094: Could there be another world/nbeneath Libreville?/nI'm truly frightened./nWhat if one day something suddenly/ncomes bursting out of that world?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/095: I've been to Antananarivo./nIt was a small village, but its people were very rough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/096: Perhaps all the endless warfare runs in their blood./nBut after our empire collapsed, even that place/nwas quiet for a while.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/097: With no enemies advancing to attack Bifrost,/nthat place was quite peaceful too... But lately, rumors/nof forces coming south from Bifrost have made me uneasy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/098: I'm sorry./nGuests are not allowed in that area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/009_3: A friend of mine says they're moving to Caracas./nWhat would they do in a rural village like that...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/012_3: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/013_3: Lady Esther Dodd and Josephine of Bifrost/nare considered the two beauties of the north.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/016_3: They say the Tuer's technology is truly remarkable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/020_3: Have you heard of the Chaos Cube?/nThey say it's an extraordinary item.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/031_3: Bifrost's recent movements are quite suspicious./nThe buildup of armaments is especially troubling...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/032_3: Above all, don't Bifrost's suspicious movements suggest/nthat its expansionist policy is becoming increasingly apparent?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/040_3: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome. Is there anything in particular you're looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/042_3: Thank you for shopping at Libreville's finest store.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/044_3: [Mr. Harrison]/nWelcome. Our inn here in Libreville offers the cleanest rooms in northern Geysir.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri01/045_3: Thank you. Have a restful night.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldri01/000: The road lies beneath your feet./n- Largo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldri01/001: To think there's a cave like this beneath the city...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/002: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nWe're surveying the forests and mountains near Ron again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/003: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nLooking for Ron? Head west from here, then south, then keep going west.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/004: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nRon and Geysir are far apart. From Geysir, you must cross Geysir Forest, pass through the Ron mountains, then cross Ron Forest. This is about two-thirds of the way between them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/005: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nFor Geysir, head south, then keep going east until you reach the forest. Continue east inside it. When the way is blocked, keep heading north.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/006: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nKeep heading north from here to enter Ron Dungeon. It's long been famous as a mine for rough diamonds.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro08/007: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nFor Memphis Village, head toward Geysir. At the second fork in the forest, go north, then head straight south at the first fork after that. For Nicosia, go north from the fork for Memphis, then east at the next fork.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga01a/000: North - Geysir City/nSouth - Memphis, Nicosia/nWest - Ron
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga01a/001: << Geysir City >>/nYou are entering Geysir, the largest city in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga01a/002: They said Fire Dragon Cave/20d was in the center of the forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/001: Damn it, as the Church's influence spreads throughout Geysir,/nmerchants like us are the ones who suffer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/002: Those Church fellows do nothing but order everyone around./nThe more you see of them, the more absurd it gets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/003: The mayor and the captain bound for Dakama don't get along./nDidn't they have a huge quarrel not long ago?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/004: Even a wolf must put on sheep's clothing./nThat's the wisdom you need to survive in this wretched world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/005: As more people grow to resent the Church,/nmore will naturally flock to the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/006: The mayor's residence is the first house/nas soon as you enter the city's western district./nMight that house become a Zephyr Falcon target too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/007: How are things lately? Miserable./nPrices keep rising, and thieves are everywhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/008: We're hardly earning anything as it is,/nand now the Church is collecting even more donations.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/009: He usually has a drink at the tavern beside the Granada shop./nFor a politician, he has no airs, so he's easy to talk to.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/010: The desert has been crawling with bandits lately,/nso it's getting hard to make a living at this trade.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/011: Crossing the desert has become harder, so goods cost more./nIf you can just make it across, there's a fortune to be made.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/012: I hear Mayor Charles, whose residence is just inside the western district,/nused to be a desert caravan merchant himself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/013: Think only the desert is crawling with bandits? Think again./nThe pirates prowling the seas now/nare more ruthless than ever!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/014: Isn't it all because of those damned Tuer people?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/015: Unless Mayor Charles, who lives in the city's western district,/ntakes stronger security measures, things will never change!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/016: Dakama? Isn't that where every pirate in the world/nhas gathered to ply their trade these days?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/017: I hear even pirates flee when they encounter a Tuer warship./nHow does Pendragon wage war against people like that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/018: "The pirate who controls Dakama controls the entire sea."/nThat's what pirates have been saying lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/019: How many years has it been since Rashid III,/nRashid II's son and the likely heir to the throne,/nleft Pendragon's royal castle?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/020: The Pendragon royal family has always been famous for its wanderlust.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/021: Rashid III?/nHe's the only grandson who carries both Robin's and King Rashid's blood,/nso it's hardly surprising that the king gives him his full support.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/022: Surely you've heard of Robin?/nKing Rashid's first wife,/nthe woman he is said to have loved most.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/023: King Rashid made Robin his queen despite their difference in status/nand the fierce opposition/nof his senior ministers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/024: They say Queen Robin and King Rashid fell in love/nduring his youthful adventures/nto rebuild Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/026: Surely the best place for trade in all of Geysir/nis Dakama./nThis place was good too, when the old empire still stood...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/027: I truly miss the days of the empire./nWe had hope then,/nand ambition, and people were full of life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/028: Back then, we couldn't even imagine the Church/nthrowing its weight around the way it does now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/030: Have you heard the legend that the dragon on Fire Dragon Mountain wakes once every thousand years?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/031: Never heard it before?/nOf course not! I just made it up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/032: Nearby Lake Cerepus, home to the underwater city,/nis famous for its legends and beautiful scenery.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/033: Ah... My husband proposed to me/nby that lake, where the underwater city can be seen.../nI was so happy then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/034: Even now, I blush just thinking of it. Ho ho ho.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/035: Mother talks about Father every single day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/036: What's so wonderful about a father who abandoned us?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/037: I'll never be like him when I grow up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/038: Oh, is this your first time here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/039: Has something wonderful happened to you?/nIt's written all over your face:/n"I'm the happiest person in the world."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/040: Ho ho ho ho! You must have a wonderful sweetheart!/nAh... How lovely. If only I were that age again.../nWell, what sort of person are they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/041: She's my wife, but honestly, she talks far too much...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/042: How can that mouth of hers/nkeep chattering without a rest?/nI just don't understand...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/043: Look it up in a dictionary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/044: Everyone, including my sister-in-law herself, agrees/nthat she talks rather a lot./nBut she's a good person at heart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/045: All right, all right./nI'll concede that my sister-in-law/not only talks too much, but makes plenty of mistakes too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/046: I know, I know./nIf only I weren't living off this household.../nI could never live with someone like my sister-in-law.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/047: I know Mother's words can be a little excessive,/nbut can't you be understanding about that much?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/048: How would women who run a household relieve their stress/nwithout at least a little gossip?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/049: Whatever anyone says, she's still my mother.../nI can't speak ill of her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/050: Hmph! Who do they think they are, looking down on me?/nBack when the Black Prince was still with us,/nI was a renowned man in the imperial army!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/051: If only the Black Prince were still alive,/nthis place would never have come to this!/nSob... The Black Prince...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/052: My master isn't quite right in the head./nHe's a little senile, I suppose.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/053: But life in this house is comfortable./nI can take my time with the work.../nAnd above all, the pay is generous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/054: The maid in the old man's house nearby doesn't have a good reputation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/055: There are rumors that the maid behaves badly,/nand above all, that she deceives her master...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/056: Standing here like this,/nI find myself looking back on all the years I've lived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/057: I've been to a place called Pretoria/nnear Inferno.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/058: In the nearby mountains, I could feel a strange aura/nflowing out./nThe same was true of the cave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/059: Although Cerepus lies toward the edge of the former imperial territories,/nit is actually very easy here/nto hear news from every region.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/060: Traveling through the former imperial territories/nis much the same as crossing mountains and forests.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/061: Though we have no plains, we can make a living/nthanks to our fairly well-established trade routes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/062: I wonder who'll become mayor of Cerepus City this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/063: Will Ruth finally become mayor on the fourth attempt,/nor will Charles hold on to the office?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/065: By the way, have you heard?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/066: Hmm... Charles, the current mayor, is an unpleasant fellow,/nbut Ruth, the candidate in this election, is a decent person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/067: Mayor Charles's mansion is near the Granada shop./nBut he is someone I do not want to meet. At. All.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/068: Hmm... The two candidates couldn't be more different./nRuth likes meeting people at the tavern,/nwhile Charles stays shut away in his house beside Granada.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/072: This house appears to be unoccupied.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/073: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/074: What! Are you Rashid Pendragon?!/nCome here! I'll show you the taste of my blade!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/076: I... will soon leave this world./nWhat use would jewelry be to me now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/078: Take that gem and make good use of it.../nFarewell, handsome stranger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/079: I waited seven years for the man who left me./nNow I am going to die...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/080: I wish thieves would rob the mayor's residence,/nthe first house as you enter the city's western district.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/081: He betrayed me. He said I was his only love in all the world,/nthen yesterday he married another woman who had been my friend./nI... Is my life still worth anything?/nNow all I have left is death... I want to rest in peace.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/083: Tell her to find another man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/085: What a man.../nBut miss, there are plenty of men in the world./nSurely he isn't your entire world?/nHow can you give up your life over something like that?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/086: Wouldn't living a happier life than his be your revenge?/nYou must find the courage to go on living...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/088: .../30d You're just like all the other men./nI have nothing to say to you. Go away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/089: He... Could he have had some reason for leaving you?/nWhy not let him go and forgive him...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/090: .../30dYou... You seem to carry sorrow in your heart too./nI don't hate him./nNo, I cannot hate him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/091: It's just... Myself. I'm the one I hate.../n/20dAh. Please take this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/093: That gem was a gift I gave him.../nHe called me out and returned it the day before his wedding./nBut I cannot bear to keep it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/094: I will throw that gem away anyway.../nSo leave without another word. Hurry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/095: Even as I say those words, I cannot settle my own heart./nHeh... He must have had some reason, mustn't he?/nHow ridiculous you are, Cyrano Bernstein...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/096: Swords can be classified by size,/nbut also by their characteristics.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/097: For example, swords specialized for particular purposes,/nsuch as offensive and defensive swords, belong to the latter group./nOffensive swords disregard other attributes/nand focus entirely on Attack,/nwhile defensive swords disregard Attack/nand are designed for defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/098: Cassandra and Gramr are typical offensive swords,/nwhile Chrysaor Girium/nand Bastard Sword are typical defensive swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/099: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nCombat is built around attack and defense./nWeapons have the greatest influence on both./nHere's how attack and defense work.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/100: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nFirst, attack./nIts power depends on the attacker's Strength and the weapon's Attack. Naturally, the higher both are, the greater the overall power. Accuracy depends heavily on the weapon's Hit Rate. With firearms, the gun provides the Hit Rate, while the ammunition provides the Attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/101: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nDefense is a little more complicated.../nSomeone else will explain that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/102: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nLet me explain defense./nOnce an attack hits and its power is determined, we check whether the defender blocks it. The chance of blocking comes from the equipped weapon's Block Rate. If the block fails, the defender takes the attack directly. If it succeeds, the weapon's Defense is applied.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/103: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nWhen a block succeeds, the weapon's Defense reduces the incoming attack by that /3cpercentage/5c. The remaining power is applied to the defending weapon. If it is below the weapon's Weapon Limit, the defender takes no damage and loses no HP. For example, an attack of 1000 against a weapon with 30 Defense is reduced by 30%, leaving 700. If the weapon's Weapon Limit is 800, I take no damage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/104: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nIf the power applied to the defending weapon exceeds its Weapon Limit, the attack breaks through. The weapon loses 1 point of Durability; if its Durability reaches 0, it breaks and disappears. The defender takes damage equal to the power applied to the weapon minus its Weapon Limit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/105: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nWould you like to learn about magic?/nIts power depends on the spell's own Attack and the caster's Intelligence. Intelligence is especially important: the same spell can vary greatly in power from one caster to another. Spells also have a minimum Intelligence requirement, so you may be unable to use them until your Intelligence rises.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/106: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nEvery spell has its own affinity: Fire, Lightning, Water, Dark or Light. If an enemy monster also has one of these five affinities, damage is calculated differently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/107: [Member of the Magic Research Society]/nOf course, you can't cast magic without MP./nSome people's MP can never increase.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/108: - Cerepus Branch of the Imperial Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/109: - Cerepus City Guide -/nGranada Trading Company: Western City/nMayor's Residence: Western City
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/110: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nDo you understand attack and defense now?/nThen let me tell you a little about the different types of swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/111: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nThere are four sword types. Rapiers and heavy swords are especially important. Rapiers have high Attack, but poor Defense and a tendency to break, so using them at a low level is dangerous. They make enemies easier to kill, but their Durability is depleted quickly and maintenance costs are high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/112: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHeavy swords have high Defense and don't break easily, but their Attack is low. Still, without at least one heavy sword, you may be unable to keep fighting when all your rapiers have broken.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/113: - Sword Types -/nRapiers: Stiletto, Rapier, Saber/nHeavy Swords: Gladius, Swordbreaker/n/nSwordsmanship Research Association, Imperial Academy
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/001_2: Damn it! As the Church's influence spreads across Geysir, merchants like us have it harder and harder.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/003_2: But what can we do? Who could stop the Church's influence?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/004_2: Even a wolf has to wear sheep's clothing. That's how you survive in this wretched world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/005_2: The more people resent the Church, the more flock to Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/006_2: Without Zephyr Falcon, the Church would act even more as if it owned the world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/008_2: I'm barely earning anything as it is, and now the Church is collecting even more donations!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/012_2: I heard a caravan crossing the desert was attacked by bandits recently. They were wiped out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/015_2: The weather on the Dakama route is perfect, but security is terrible. We risk our lives just to earn a living.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/036_2: What's so wonderful about a father who abandoned us?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/054_2: Have you heard? They say that old man nearby and his maid are... involved.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/055_2: The old man and his maid? Well, there are strange rumors... They say she's poisoning him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy02/065_2: Have you heard? They say that old man nearby and his maid are... involved.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/000: Then,/15d Mr. Cyrano,/20d please go to Antananarivo and investigate the lord's mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/001: Please give priority to rescuing the missing villagers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/002: Have the others/20d gone somewhere?/35d/nI haven't seen any of them since this morning...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/003: Mr. Rhidelhard and Miss Isabele have gone to scout the eastern road.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/004: Kana says she feels unwell/30d and won't leave her room./60d/nEven when I offered to examine her, she said she was all right...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/005: Did she get frightened by the lord who commands monsters?/45d/nCould she be feigning illness?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/006: .../30dWell,/5d never mind./30d/nLet's hurry to our destination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/008: Clausewitz,/40d did you say Antananarivo lies on a plateau beyond the mountains to the northeast?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/009: Yes,/10d that's correct./35d/nIt is almost on Bifrost's border.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/010: According to my investigation,/30d/nthe entire territory is fortified, so caution is necessary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s07/011: Understood./35d/nThen I'll be on my way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/000: ...And so,/40d I leave things here in your hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/001: [????]/nDon't worry./40d/nThe Grand Duke is waiting,/30d so hurry on your way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/004: [????]/nYou're a step too late./45d/nAre you/20d Cyrano Bernstein?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/005: ...So you know me./30d Who are you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/006: My name is/25d Catalina./45d/nI command Bifrost's Valkyries.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/007: I/30d have taken an interest in you for some time./60d/nI hear/30d you're the empire's strongest swordsman?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/008: Heh,/35d but/15d if you wish to pass,/35d/nyou must first face Bifrost's strongest swordsman,/30d and/35d defeat me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/010: I'm pressed for time,/35d so I'll make this quick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/011: Th-this.../10d How.../30d How could I lose...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/012: All that boasting, and look at you now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/016: [Catalina]/nCyrano Bernstein!/60d I will never/40d forget today's humiliation!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/019: That took longer than I expected./45d/nIf we don't hurry,/20d we won't catch Machiavelli.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/021: Passing this point will prevent you from completing the following side quest./nDo you wish to continue?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma13a/022: Skip the side quest and move on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber07/000: During the three days Sid was missing, his mother/nJean was beside herself./nWhy was Sid kidnapped in the first place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber07/001: The kidnappers never sent a ransom letter or anything of the sort,/nand there was no apparent reason to abduct Sid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber07/002: There must be some other conspiracy behind this./nThough I don't know what it is...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber07/003: Sid still hasn't regained consciousness./nHe just keeps sleeping./nThe doctor thinks he was given some kind of drug.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber07/004: Sid has always been a curious child./nHe respects you more than anyone, young master./nHis dream is to become a scholar like you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/000: Lately, there have been people wearing dark glasses around here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/001: To the north lies the Antananarivo region./nIt borders Bifrost, so it is a very unsettled place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/003: I hear Lady Esther Dodd comes from an old, distinguished family...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword?/nSuch tremendous force!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/013: Lady Esther Dodd and Josephine of Bifrost/nare considered the two beauties of the north.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/015: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/017: I know Nikacha of Cerepus too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/019: Refinement and romance/nare the true pleasures of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/020: I don't share Ruben's hobby/nof building secret passages everywhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/027: They say Lord Kars's sword is hidden in Demon Sword Forest.../nBut it's dangerous there...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/028: Bordeaux is a village north of Ron./nIt has beautiful scenery.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/029: Recently, near Bordeaux, I saw people wearing strange glasses/npassing through.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/030: There is a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux./nStrange legends about it have been passed down since ancient times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/031: Now there's a rumor that Lord Kars's sword is hidden there.../nWell, when I first heard it, I did think, "Again?"
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/032: I hear fighting between the Zephyr Falcon and the local lords/nhas been growing more intense throughout the country lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/033: Isn't the Zephyr Falcon a band of thieves who target only the wealthy?/nIt's alarming... To think people like that are running rampant./nLord Frederick keeps Ron well protected, though...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/034: Mother has been away from home a lot lately./nShe used to make all sorts of delicious food/nand smile so often.../nNow she neither cooks nor smiles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/035: It all began after Father was shot and killed/nby Pendragon's border guards./nHe used to trade at the Pendragon border...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/036: I want to see Mother smile./nI want to see Father again./nI hate Pendragon. I truly hate it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/037: The forests around here are rather dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/038: Their clothes and glasses were unlike anything I'd seen,/nand so were their hairstyles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/039: Seeing how many people/nare desperate to find that sword,/nit does seem to be hidden there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/040: Those people do nothing but obstruct our empire's reunification./nEvery last one of them should be arrested!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/041: Hmph... The people here trust Lord Frederick too much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/042: Why won't people face the fact/nthat he too is just a lord and a landowner?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/043: Though conditions here are better than elsewhere,/nthe lords still possess/nfar too much of everything./nThat must change!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/044: Young man, I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/045: Have you ever heard of Lord Kars?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/047: No, I haven't heard of him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/048: So you've heard of Lord Kars.../nA fine young person indeed. Tell me,/ndo you know what sword Lord Kars used?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/049: Awen prayed to the heavens again./n"Heavens, you gave me this shining gem. If in giving it/nyou truly understood/nmy love for him, please help me."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/050: Then she heard the heavens answer within her heart./n"I understand your wish. But to save him,/na sacrifice is necessary."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/051: She closed her eyes and replied./n"O God, I offer you my voice./nPlease let me rise to where he is."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/052: When she opened her eyes, she realized/nthat she was rising into the air./nWhile the enemies pursuing them stood frozen in astonishment,/nshe rose to Al's side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/053: When she reached Al, he said,/n"O merciful one, you seem to come from my homeland,/nbut there is no need to risk yourself/njust to save me. Leave me and preserve your precious life."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/054: Awen wanted to answer, but her voice/nwould not come./nSilently, she tried to free him from his chains./nBut the chains binding Al were so strong/nthat even she could find no way to release him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/055: Awen saw enemy soldiers putting up ladders and climbing/nfrom below. She grew desperate./nAt last, she placed her blade against Al's arm./nThere was no way to free him from his chains/nwithout cutting off that arm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/056: Al nodded./n"Cut it off. There seems to be no other way."/nWith tears in her eyes, Awen cut off Al's arm./nThe shock made him lose consciousness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/057: Awen had freed Al from his chains, but had no way down./nWorse, the enemies were climbing the cliff on ladders./nShe had to pray to the heavens once more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/058: "Heavens, merciful heavens! I will give this gem/nto him. Protect him as you did/nwhen you first granted my wish. And I offer you my life./nThis time, please let him escape from this place."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/059: She placed the gem on Al's chest/nand ran to the cliff, leaping over the edge!/nAt that moment, Al opened his eyes at the cold touch/nof the gem resting on his chest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/060: At that moment, Al saw her hairband come loose, revealing hair like brilliant morning sunlight and skin like white morning mist./nAwen, whom he had missed even in his dreams, was giving her life/nfor him... He cried out, "Awen!"/nBut Awen did not answer. She only fell farther/nand farther below.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/061: Then everyone there heard God's voice./n"I understand your love for Al. I will take your life/nand transform it into new life. Now go/nand save Al."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/062: Al saw the gem on his chest shine so intensely/nthat he could not keep his eyes open. When he opened them again,/na huge bird he had never seen before stood before him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/063: Al gazed into the bird's eyes and said,/n"Awen, Awen. Is it you?"/nThe bird leaned forward as if in answer./nAl climbed onto its back, and it flew into the sky!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/064: The people of Al's hometown were startled that he returned/nwith one arm missing, but even more amazed/nto see him accompanied by a strange bird./nAfter returning, Al became quiet./nHe built a hut in a remote place, lived with the bird,/nand devoted himself to carving stones.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/065: Al spent his life trying to recreate the gem/nthat had rested on his chest. At last, he developed/na completely new kind of gem./nThat was the Chaos Cube./nAfter Al returned to his homeland,/nbrave, enormous birds like the one that saved him/nbegan appearing throughout the land./nPeople called those birds falcons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/066: Well, did you enjoy it?/nFor listening to such a long story, I'll give you a reward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/068: May Al and Awen bless the journey ahead of you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/069: - Ron Branch of Geysir Academy -/nWe have answers/nto the questions you wish to ask.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/070: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nPrices in Ron City are rather high,/nbut its strong army and well-maintained security/nallow people to lead stable lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/071: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nDemon Sword Forest lies north of Ron, with Bordeaux farther north. Despite its name, the forest is easy to cross if you only intend to reach Bordeaux:/njust keep heading straight north./nBut if you turn east toward the demon sword,/nyou will enter a very complicated part of the forest...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/072: [Member of the Tactical Research Society]/nEvents are becoming quite urgent./nSudden changes leave no time to maintain your weapons,/nso it would be wise to gather as much equipment as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/073: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nWe once had a member named Paz./nHe was an excellent swordsman,/nknown as 'Paz the Swift'...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/074: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nBut what made him even more famous/nwas his mastery of sword repair./nNo one could match him/nat maintaining or repairing blades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/075: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHave you heard of Pendragon's standard-issue swords?/nThe SP-7 "Blitz" is said to be excellent.../nOn a par with a mass-produced holy sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/076: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon has two renowned swordmaking houses./nOne is the famous Chrysaor;/nthe other is Moglai, less well known in the empire./nMoglai is said to be secretly developing a standard-issue sword/nto rival Chrysaor's "Blitz."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/077: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/n"Blitz" and Moglai's rival sword.../nWhich will prove superior?/nUnfortunately, the Pendragon royal family's orders/nmake these standard-issue swords very hard to obtain./nSecurity is so strict that outsiders cannot take them away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/078: [Swordsmanship Research Association]/nHis one fault was that he often coveted swords/nfar too much./nHe was last seen near Antananarivo,/nand we haven't heard from him since. I wonder what he's doing now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/030_3: There is a deep forest on the road to Bordeaux./nStrange legends about it have been passed down since ancient times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/031_3: Now they're saying Kars' sword is hidden there...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/032_3: I hear Lord Frederick recently attacked/nthe Zephyr Falcon throughout the country.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/033_3: I hear the Zephyr Falcon are thieves who only target the wealthy. Is that true?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/034_3: Mother is away from home a lot these days.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/035_3: They say Father went to heaven three years ago./nMother hasn't smiled at all since then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro02/036_3: I want to see Mother smile.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst16/000: Good, I've reached the cave entrance./10d That should be far enough./15d There's not much of my training left now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro00/000: East: Ron Forest/nNorthwest: Ron City/nNorth: Demon Sword Forest
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw02/000: North - Bordeaux/nEastern road unsafe. Take the western route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/000: Damn,/35d he escaped while we were dealing with the guards...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/002: It can't be helped./35d/nHe probably took refuge in the mansion,/25d so we'll go there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/003: A frontal assault on the duke's mansion/30d is not a good idea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/004: Hmph,/30d don't tell me you're about to say something obvious.../20d/nlike/15d "because it's guarded"?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/005: Well,/15d with your skill,/20d the guards may be no trouble./35d/nBut/15d while you're fighting them,/15d won't the duke escape again?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/006: So,/30d what do you want, young lady?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/007: Our informant/15d discovered a passage/10d/nthat leads secretly into the mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/008: If we sneak in that way,/35d/nDuke Ruben won't have time to escape!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/009: Since we share the same goal for now,/35d/nI'll show you the secret passage/15d if you help us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/010: That should be no trouble./45d/nThen/15d please lead the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/012: Once you're past this tree, go around the back./25d There's a sewer there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/014: Hehe,/30d now we're finally getting somewhere!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s05/015: But/15d only if we act together!/30d/nAgreed?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/003: A little while ago,/30d a letter addressed to Mr. Cyrano/25d/narrived from Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/005: No./35d The letter is from General Frederick's/15d wife.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/008: Yes,/30d but I doubt you need to concern yourself much/15d with its contents.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/010: Of course not./35d/nBut/30d given the circumstances, it is easy to imagine/40d what Lady Frederick would write.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/011: It will be either extremely emotional,/50d or very brief/20d and cold.../50d/nOne of those two.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/014: /2cDear Cyrano/n/n/n/n/n/nI shall be waiting in my salon in Ron./n/n/n/n/n/nMercedes Frederick
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/017: ...I don't know/35d what happened between you and the Fredericks/20d in the past.../50d/nBut this is clearly/15d a trap.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/021: But I have no choice. I must go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/022: Mr. Cyrano,/25d please consider this calmly./35d/nThere is no guarantee Lady Frederick is truly waiting there./35d This must be Cesare's scheme!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/023: I am perfectly calm,/20d Clausewitz./50d/nIf you knew the life I have lived,/55d you would understand too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/024: Even if I lose everything,/55d I have no choice but to go there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/028: .../40dUnderstood./40d I will leave it to/10d your judgment, Mr. Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/029: Mercedes.../65d/nBut/15d Silver, Kana,/25d and Esmeralda, who have stood by me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/032: I cannot leave without saying goodbye to Silver.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/035: There is no need to dwell on anything else./45d/nRight now,/30d meeting Mercedes matters most.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/036: Even if this is Cesare's trap.../65d Even if it costs my life./60d/nI/40d must go and see her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/038: Silver.../55d/nYes,/40d after she has stood by me all this time,/40d I cannot leave without a word to her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/039: She/30d will understand how I feel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/042: Cyrano,/25d I can't let you go to Ron alone!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/044: Why are you trying to leave me behind?/30d/nIf you go there,/20d you surely won't return safely!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/045: I know./45d That's why/30d I cannot take you with me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/046: You must have faced many hardships,/50d yet until now/20d you have stood by me faithfully.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/047: What are you saying?!/35d Are you really/25d going to leave alone?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/048: It's true.../40d There is no guarantee I will return safely./40d/nAnd/30d even if I do return,/45d I/20d have no right to tie you to me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/050: This is my final request,/10d Silver./45d/nDo not hold me back.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/051: That is an order/30d I cannot obey!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/052: If you must go to Ron at any cost,/40d then/30d you'll have to step over my dead body!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/055: Even if you cut me down, I must go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/056: All right, Silver. I won't go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/057: Until now,/25d I have lived to see her again./60d/nEven if you cut me down,/40d I must go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/061: Silver.../60d I never realized you cared about me this much.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/062: I cannot think only of myself/30d and leave you behind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/064: I won't go to Ron./45d I'll stay/20d with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/067: Rude?/35d You did it because you were worried about me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/068: Now,/35d let's prepare for the next operation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/070: Kana.../60d I may never see her again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/071: For Kana's sake too,/40d perhaps leaving her side would be better.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/074: Is it true that you're leaving for Ron/35d after receiving a letter/15d from Lady Frederick?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/076: Why.../30d Why are you walking into it yourself/25d when you know it's a trap, Cyrano?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/077: Because/35d it is the reason I have lived until now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/078: Please don't hold me back,/10d Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/081: Cyrano.../35d Without you.../35d I wouldn't be able to go on living...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/082: I love you.../25d Cyrano./40d/nPlease.../25d Please don't go...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/085: Kana... I'll do as you ask. I won't go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/086: Please move aside, Kana./35d I must go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/088: Loving someone like me/30d will only bring you pain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/091: .../30dYes,/20d Kana./45d I had you by my side all along.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/092: If you need me,/40d I want to stay by your side too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/096: Esmeralda.../65d Another person/15d who saved my life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/097: But/35d I probably won't see her again now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/101: .../40dSo you know I intend to go there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/102: Mr. Cyrano.../60d/nWhat do you seek/30d that would make you go to such lengths?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/104: I/35d can feel the pain and sorrow/30d deep in your heart./55d/nAnd/25d how hard you try to hide those wounds...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/105: Unhealed wounds/20d leave hatred,/45d and hatred/20d eventually becomes a blade of vengeance./90d/nIs that the feeling/30d taking you to Ron?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/107: But Mr. Cyrano,/45d even if you achieve your revenge,/30d your wounded heart/15d will never heal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/108: From the wounds you hide deep within/30d and the bonds of painful feelings,/55d I/25d want to free you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/110: Wounds cannot heal/15d while you keep them hidden./50d Sometimes/15d you need to reveal them./70d/nI will do anything I can/45d to help heal yours.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/111: So please,/35d don't rush to leave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/113: I have made up my mind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/115: My mind is made up./60d/nThe reason I have lived until now is there.../65d I must go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/118: Mr. Cyrano.../55d/nIf you follow only the feelings driving you now,/40d you may regret it someday./65d/nPlease,/30d may that day never come...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/119: And.../40d I will pray/25d for your safe return...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/120: ...Esmeralda,/50d perhaps you're right./45d/nI/25d may have been so consumed by vengeance/35d that I was losing what mattered most...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/122: You are sincerely/40d trying to save me once again./35d How could I turn away from that?
