Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/123: Mr. Cyrano...!/30d/nA day will come/35d when you are certain/20d this choice was right...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s05/124: The next choice will change the story and the outcome./nSave here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga12a/000: East - Memphis Village/nNorthwest - Ron region/nNortheast - Nicosia region
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga12a/005: Our goal is to find treasure./30d/nWe must go to Fire Dragon Cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/003: My child.../25d/nChristina has/30d caused you trouble in so many ways.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/005: That was.../25d a long time ago now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/009: She has all the qualities of a ruler./50d/nMartial skill,/20d eloquence,/30d even leadership...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/010: She is indeed an amazing child.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/011: From her earliest years.../55d he taught her./55d/nFrom beginning to end...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/014: You.../65d What right do you have to speak his name,/25d/nCyrano Bernstein?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/017: Such a good man.../70d So cruelly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/019: You.../45d are not the Cyrano I knew.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/020: Only a beast consumed by the madness of revenge.../60d/nYou are not human!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/021: I.../45d am afraid of you./50d So terribly afraid...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/022: Mercedes,/15d I thought you, at least.../65d/nwould believe me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/023: Give him back.../65d Give Frederick back to me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/032: Heh heh heh.../75d How pathetic you are,/10d Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/033: Have I waited fifteen years/40d/njust to drink poisoned wine...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/034: .../50dWell.../30d so be it./50d If this is fate...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/035: No!/15d If you drink from that glass...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/039: Everything that has happened.../65d/nwas orchestrated by your father,/30d Cesare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/042: Who told you.../45d/nthat Frederick had died?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/044: Who told you.../60d/nthat I was the one who killed Frederick?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/049: May this... bring forgiveness for all I've done...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/050: Mercedes!/50d Surely that glass isn't poisoned too?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/054: [Mercedes]/nFor the past fifteen years.../95d/nI/25d thought only of you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/055: [Mercedes]/nSo when we met a little while ago.../50d/nI was truly.../65d truly glad to see you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/058: [Mercedes]/nBut.../75d after I heard you had killed him.../80d/nFrederick...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/060: [Mercedes]/nHe.../55d loved me sincerely.../70d/neven while I waited only for you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/062: [Mercedes]/nAnd so.../75d before I knew it.../80d I too.../90d/ncame to love him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/072: [Mercedes]/nFifteen years ago,/75d the day you were sentenced to death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/074: [Mercedes]/nAs Father told me.../90d/nI decided to marry Lord Frederick...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/078: [Mercedes]/nFor those fifteen years without you.../100d/nI.../55d was terribly lonely...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl16_s01/079: [Mercedes]/nCyrano.../75d/nFrederick.../65d was truly/40d a good man.../105d/nSomeone like me.../70d and Christina...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/000: This is Antananarivo,/na village on the border between the imperial territories and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/001: People here live constantly/nwith the threat of war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/002: Mount Mantigoa lies to the north./nBifrost is just beyond it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/003: Many more soldiers have been coming down from the north/nand passing through our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/004: This has long been a strategic crossroads.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/006: Ah... Cerepus is so far away.../nI'd love to see Nikacha in person...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/008: Welcome to the Mountain Inn./nA stay costs 85 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/010: Do stay with us next time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/012: Welcome to our inn./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/013: Hmph! Show me anyone who works/nas hard for this inn as I do!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/014: Despite all my hard work,/nmy employer is terribly stingy with me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/015: Only someone like me would still be working here./nWho else would stay at an inn in a rural village like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/016: This is a good place to rest a weary body and mind.../nSo quiet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/017: I was once an Astanian Templar./nThe sight of Shuri and Kaza falling heroically in the war against the Tuer/nstill remains deep in my heart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/021: Our village lies on the edge of imperial territory,/nso we have suffered many foreign invasions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/022: But there haven't been any such armies lately, so it's fairly quiet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/024: The village's beautiful scenery/nonce made it a retreat for many people,/nbut endless warfare has also shed much blood here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/025: I hear His Majesty the Black Prince/nonce stayed here too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/026: Nothing tastes better than a beer on the job.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/027: What mission?/10d Hmm, that's a secret.../n/30dActually, I was fired. I'm unemployed now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/028: Is there anyone you want disposed of?/n/20dI'll take care of it at a special low price.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/029: Heh, I'm a nobleman on my travels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/030: I've seen women from all over, but none can match Sharon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/031: Where on earth has she gone now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/032: I'm a sea captain./10d/nI ought to be by the sea right now,/nso do you know why I'm in a mountain village like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/033: I was dismissed./nI had to leave the ship I'd sailed for decades./nShipowners prefer younger captains these days.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/034: You cannot know how it felt to leave a ship that was like a wife to me...!/15d/nMy heart tore apart, and resentment choked my throat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/035: [Cole]/nWelcome./nWe may be on the frontier, but we carry fine spears.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/037: Spears are the finest weapons./nWe'll have more fine goods for you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/038: [Hilde]/nWelcome./nAre you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/040: Thank you for visiting our shop./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/041: The man at our village's weapon shop has lots and lots of spears.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/042: He once showed me a truly fine spear./nIt was beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/044: Both the number of soldiers coming from the north/nand the weapons they carry have been increasing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/045: I used to be a member of the Zephyr Falcon./nBut in my very first battle, I was so frightened...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/046: I ended up running away.../nI'm a coward. A frightened coward...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/047: The threat of war is growing here in Antananarivo...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/048: These days, wherever people meet, they talk of war./nOf Bifrost advancing south...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/049: Not long ago, a friend of mine was beneath a tree/nwith a strange look in their eyes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/050: "I've realized it. I must leave on a journey now."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/051: Then they left the village./nLeaving their family behind... Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/052: My home is by the sea, far away./nMany people who can no longer sail ships/nhave come to live here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/053: Former sailors often settle so far from the sea/nto forget their longing for it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/054: [Gina]/nOh, so you think you did nothing wrong?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/055: [John]/nOh, come on... Why make such a fuss over that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/056: [Gina]/n"That"?! "That"?!/nAre you even in a relationship with me?!/nHow can you go seeing another woman?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/058: [Gina]/nLunch! Ha! Just lunch, was it?!/nMy friend Jane says she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/059: [John]/n(Caught off guard)!!/nSaw me?/10d Saw me?/10d/nWhere?/10d Where was I seen?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/060: [Gina]/nThat was.../20d I can't even bring myself to say it! Honestly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/061: [Gina]/nHey, you!/15d Do you think you can be in one relationship/nand start another at the same time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/063: It can be. Love doesn't mean being bound to someone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/064: No. That would betray your partner.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/068: [John]/nHuh? That's the birthday present I gave you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/069: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away./10d What are you going to do about it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/071: I'd better get out of here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/072: You couldn't do that to someone you truly cared about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/073: [Gina]/nSee?! They say you're in the wrong!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/074: [John]/nFine... Fine. Is that how it is?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/076: [Gina]/nOh! What are you doing?!/nThat's the spear I saved and saved to buy for you...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/077: [John]/nOh... I received another gift from that friend,/nso I don't need this spear anymore...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/078: [Gina]/nHa!/10d Ha!/10d So that's how you're going to be!/10d/nWe'll settle this today!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/079: Mind your own business and get lost!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/082: Please, you can't come this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/083: That could happen./nPeople aren't another person's property.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/087: There are plenty of unpleasant rumors about Jean, who works at the inn.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/088: [Jackie]/nI've got some fine wares. Care to take a look?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/091: It really seems war will come, just as the adults say./nIf war puts our village in danger,/nI'll give my life to defend it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/092: But even this place doesn't seem free/nfrom the threat of war.../nIs there nowhere in the former imperial territories/nwhere one can live quietly and at ease?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/093: The village elders say/nthis is the first time we've gone/nso long without war./20d/nI've grown up without knowing war myself.../15d/nBut I'm so afraid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/094: ...So you've met that child./nI'm waiting for him/nto return someday. But... but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/095: War seems to be brewing here too./nI suppose it's time to move on.../nBut where can I go now...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/096: I'm sick of war./nWhy else would I come so far to live here...?/30d/nBut even this little peace may end soon./10d Ah... Shuri...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/000_3: This is Antananarivo,/na village on the border between the imperial territories and the Principality of Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/001_3: People here live constantly/nwith the threat of war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/002_3: Mount Mantigoa lies to the north./nBifrost is just beyond it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/003_3: Have you heard of Sharn Hoiste, the phantom thief?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/004_3: This has long been a strategic crossroads.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/008_3: Welcome to our inn./nA stay costs 85 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/010_3: Do stay with us next time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/012_3: Welcome to our inn./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/014_3: Even so, the owner is terribly stingy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/016_3: A good place to rest a weary body and mind... So quiet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/017_3: I was once an Astanian Templar./nThe sight of Shuri and Kaza/nfalling heroically on the battlefield/nstill remains deep in my heart.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/021_3: Our village lies on the route into Bifrost,/nso we have suffered many foreign invasions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/024_3: There are plenty of unpleasant rumors about Jean, who works at the inn.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/025_3: You can't put much trust in what she says.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/027_3: What mission? Hmm, that's a secret.../nActually, I was fired. I'm unemployed now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/028_3: Is there anyone you want killed?/nI'll take care of it at a special low price.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/032_3: As you can see, I'm a sea captain./nI ought to be by the sea right now,/nso do you know why I'm in this mountain village?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/034_3: Do you know how I felt when I left/nthat ship, which was like a wife to me?!/nMy heart tore apart, and resentment choked my throat./nI'll have my revenge... That wretched shipowner...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/035_3: [Mr. Cole]/nWelcome./nWe may be on the frontier, but we carry fine spears.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/038_3: [Miss Hilde]/nWelcome./nAre you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/044_3: They say money is taken from the rich/nand given to the poor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/047_3: It isn't Sharon's songs or her voice/nthat makes her performances truly beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/048_3: It's her sincerity, and the way she truly cares about her fans.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/050_3: "I've realized it. I must leave on a journey now."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/051_3: Then they left the village./nLeaving their parents behind... Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/052_3: My home is by the sea, far away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/053_3: Unfortunately, I no longer have a ship to sail, so I've come here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/054_3: [Gina]/nOh, so you think you did nothing wrong?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/055_3: [John]/nOh, come on... What's all this fuss about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/056_3: [Gina]/n Such a thing? Such a little thing! /nAre you dating me? /nHow can I go see other women?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/057_3: [John]/nNow, now... We only met for lunch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/058_3: [Gina]/nLunch! Ha! Just lunch, was it?!/nMy friend Jane says she saw you somewhere else!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/059_3: [John]/n(Gulp)!!/nShe saw me? Saw me? Where? Where did she see me?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/060_3: [Gina]/nThat was.../nI can't even bring myself to say it! Honestly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/061_3: [Gina]/nYou there! Do you think it's acceptable to see someone else when you already have a partner?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/066_3: [Gina]/nHa! Ha! Men! Fine, then. Here, take this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/068_3: [John]/nHuh? That's the birthday present I gave you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/069_3: [Gina]/nYes, I gave it away. What are you going to do about it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/071_3: I'd better get out of here, quickly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/072_3: Could you really do that to someone you cared about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/073_3: [Gina]/nSee?! They say you're in the wrong!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/074_3: [John]/nFine... Fine. Is that how it is?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/076_3: [Gina]/nOh! What are you doing?! I scraped and saved to buy you that spear...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/077_3: [John]/nWell... I got another gift from her, so I don't need this spear anymore...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/078_3: [Gina]/nHa! Ha! So that's how you want to play it! We'll settle this today!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat01/082_3: Please, you can't come this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/000: Today is your engagement day, young master,/nand everyone in the household is busy preparing for it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/001: You are so composed, young master,/nthat I am sure you will manage without any difficulty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/002: You are a grown man now, young master, responsible/nfor a woman as well. You must take better care/nof yourself than ever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/003: Congratulations, Cyrano./nTo have a wife as beautiful as Mercedes.../nI'm so envious.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/004: When I grow up, I'll marry Lance too./nBy then, Lance will have become a wonderful lady/nlike Mercedes is now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/005: Oh, Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/006: When Joel reaches your age,/nwill he be as impressive as you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/007: Today will be the Bernstein family's/nbusiest and happiest day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/008: We are all excited to welcome/na beautiful new mistress to the household./nEver since our lady passed away,/nthe Bernstein family has needed a lady of the house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/009: Miss Mercedes is renowned not only for her beauty,/nbut for her thorough training in the accomplishments of a lady./nIt will be an honor for us to serve her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/010: Ha ha ha... What a happy day./20d/nYou are finally becoming a true man, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/011: I always thought you looked splendid playing the piano, young master,/nbut never have I seen you/nlook as splendid as you do today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/012: I've never felt so happy and moved.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/001_3: You are so composed, young master,/nthat I am sure you will manage without any difficulty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/003_3: Congratulations, Cyrano./nTo have a wife as beautiful as Mercedes.../nI'm so envious.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/004_3: When I grow up, I'll get engaged to Lance too./nBy then, Lance will be a wonderful lady like Mercedes is now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/005_3: Oh, Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/007_3: Today will be the Bernstein family's/nbusiest and happiest day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/008_3: We are all excited to welcome/na beautiful new mistress to the household./nEver since our lady passed away,/nthe Bernstein family has needed a lady of the house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/009_3: Miss Mercedes is renowned not only for her beauty,/nbut for her thorough training in the accomplishments of a lady./nIt will be an honor for us to serve her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/010_3: Ha ha ha... What a happy day./20d/nYou are finally becoming a true man, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/011_3: I always thought you looked splendid playing the piano, young master,/nbut never have I seen you/nlook as splendid as you do today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber05/012_3: I, Ruth, have never felt so happy and moved.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst12/000: Coming this far should be enough training.../10d Perhaps I should go back for the fifth stage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss27/000: Maze Forest/n1. Never turn back the way you came./n2. Always walk toward the sun./n/nLargo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss27/001: We keep wandering around here.../45d/nIt seems/25d we've been caught in Bifrost's labyrinth trap!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss27/002: All the scenery around us is an illusion./55d/nNever go back the way we came./40d Let's head toward the sun!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/057: I cannot do that, Lady Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/060: Heh heh heh.../85d You've held out well./70d But/30d playtime is over.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/061: Damn.../45d Is this/20d as far as we can go...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/068: Why.../40d Why did you save us?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/069: You/20d are no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/070: Whether I am still a Zephyr Falcon member makes no difference./50d/nWe once fought together, risking our lives as comrades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/071: I cannot turn a blind eye when a comrade is in danger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/073: I.../50d I've been so pathetic/40d that I don't know what to say...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/074: Cyrano,/30d you hadn't abandoned us after all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/075: Set the past aside for now./30d It is time to defeat the enemy before us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/077: Indeed,/30d the one who inherited Deimos' soul/45d/nis no ordinary weakling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/080: Of the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War,/45d Irus.../30d/nNo,/30d Eustacia of Destruction fell by my hand.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/081: The only one left/30d is you, Diablo of the Moon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/082: That man/30d is a Dark God?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/083: And Cesare.../45d the root of all evil!/60d I will destroy you myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/084: That is a bloodthirsty greeting/30d for a reunion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/085: You were nearly reduced to a handful of ashes at the stake./50d/nWasn't I the benefactor who let you keep your life?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/087: I did not come here for revenge./45d/nI came to cut evil off at its roots!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/088: Heh heh,/45d you still cannot escape/nyour foolish fixed ideas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/089: Everything I have done is for my country./70d/nI do not expect your understanding,/45d but I would rather not be misunderstood.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/090: Machiavelli has already told me your ideals./70d/nBut those ideals are wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/091: Unifying the world through wrongful means/40d is meaningless!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/092: Humanity/30d grows by finding success after repeated trial, error and failure!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/093: Forcing history's course/45d only leads to regression in the end!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/094: I never expected to debate ideas with you/nin a place like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/097: There is no time!/15d At this rate, the God of Destruction's resurrection...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/098: Cyrano,/25d let us defeat them together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/102: Isabele, I'll fight at your side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/104: Those are the words/10d I've been waiting for!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/106: All right./20d Cyrano,/20d let's fight together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/107: Good!/30d Cyrano,/20d I'll help you too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/108: Diablo is dead./45d Now this truly/30d is the end,/15d Cesare!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/116: Was driving me, your fiance,/30d into hell not enough for him?/55d/nHe killed your husband/40d and now intends to use your daughter too./30d/nWould you defend him simply because he is your father?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/117: I know he is an evil man, a murderer.../35d and a disgraceful father./20d/nBut.../25d But...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/120: I cannot do that,/15d Lady Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/121: Your father/40d is a murderer who harmed countless people,/15d including your husband./75d/nIf we let such a man live,/40d many more will suffer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/123: But.../30d my father/15d is the only person who raised me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/124: What a shameless woman!/45d/nAsking us to forgive such an evil man just because he's her father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/133: Watch out!/15d The underwater city is starting to collapse!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s02/134: Let's get out of here, quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga21a/000: This way leads to Ron./nNicosia lies to the southeast.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/006: To think you would find me here.../45d/nYou're as formidable as the rumors say.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/007: In that case,/15d there's nothing else for it.../60d/nI'm only a scholar./45d I won't resist. Do as you will.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/008: Hmph,/25d did you think acting that way would save your life?/55d/nI'll send you to the next world without pain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/012: Nonsense./50d/nI know no one among your rabble of rebels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/013: I suppose.../40d It has been fifteen years already.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/014: I/30d am the man once called Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/016: Heh,/45d it seems my luck hasn't run out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/017: But to see you, once my close friend,/50d/nbecome Cesare's pawn/30d is far from pleasant.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/018: I am a scholar./45d/nMy ideas take precedence over personal friendship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/019: I follow His Excellency the Cardinal/20d because of my own philosophy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/020: Cesare's philosophy?/45d/nPlotting to frame his friend's son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/021: Using his own daughter as a tool/15d to seize power?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/022: Or/30d bringing foreign forces into his own country like this?/45d/nAnswer me, Machiavelli!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/023: The empire has no emperor now./50d/nThat is precisely why we need a man like His Excellency.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/024: Only His Excellency the Cardinal/30d can unify the empire./45d/nYou know that as well as I do, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/025: History is not determined by one person.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/026: Why must the empire/30d be unified by him?/25d/nWhy must countless people/20d shed their blood for him?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/028: Of course, after decades,/15d or even centuries,/40d/nthe empire's present turmoil would subside.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/029: But/35d how many wars would be fought before then?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/030: And/25d how many people would be sacrificed?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/031: People today/15d may condemn His Excellency the Cardinal,/35d/nbut historians of future generations/25d will thank him/nfor alleviating/30d the suffering of countless people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/032: Mr. Cyrano,/20d we must hurry./25d/nIf the Valkyries complete their encirclement, we won't be able to escape!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/033: Let's dispose of this man quickly and escape!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/034: I have only remained true to my convictions as a scholar./75d/nEven if my life ends today, I have no regrets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/036: Machiavelli,/50d I understand your thinking./65d/nI will spare you this once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/037: In return,/40d give Cesare this message.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/038: Tell him Cyrano/40d will come to claim his rotten head.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/039: Hey,/10d Cyrano!/20d Are you going to let this bastard live?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/040: Please./45d/nHe is too valuable a man to kill.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/041: Whatever happens,/25d let's get out of here quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/042: We need a ruler who will set personal feelings aside/15d and, even through cruel means,/45d/nunify the empire/20d and restore peace.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/043: That/20d is the greater cause./35d/nIt is meant to prevent further bloodshed./35d/nWhat is wrong with that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s08/044: Cyrano Bernstein?!/60d/nTo think you're still alive...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/001: All right, let's rescue the villagers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/004: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nYes,/20d I am the lord here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/005: Where are the villagers?/35d/nAnd why are Bifrost's troops in imperial territory?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/006: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nA mere mercenary, prying into things that don't concern him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/007: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nFrom what I see,/20d you have considerable skill...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/008: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nWell?/20d I'll pay you twice as much./35d/nWould you work for me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/009: Enough of your nonsense!/50d/nWe are the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/011: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nTsk!/25d Esther Dodd,/30d what a fool./45d/nTo bring in the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/014: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nWe cannot let them leave here alive./45d/nAttack!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/016: Now that we've dealt with the lord,/35d let's find the missing villagers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat20/017: [Lord of Antananarivo]/nIt seems/25d you're mercenaries hired by that fox in Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck02/000: It seems this door won't open.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/000: This is Dakama, trading port of the great Kingdom of Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/001: Foreigners like you probably won't be allowed inside the city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/002: I hope we avoid pirates and storms on this voyage...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/004: I hear I can take a ship to Dakama from here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/006: [Captain]/nThat's right. But the sea route to Dakama/nis extremely dangerous these days, so we/nare postponing our departure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltda01/008: [Captain]/nThat's right. Even we don't know when we'll be able to leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/001: Chris.../25d No,/25d Christina Frederick has/30d succeeded General Frederick/nas supreme commander, according to reports.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/003: And a little while ago,/40d/nshe declared war on our Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/006: As you know,/25d Frederick's forces are the empire's strongest elite troops.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/007: Furthermore,/30d no one knows our internal affairs/30d as well as Christina does.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/008: So if Chris sets her mind to it,/15d she could easily crush the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/009: Therefore,/35d this time/15d we intend to raid the headquarters of Christina's backers, the Church of the Lord God:/45d/nthe cathedral in Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/010: A direct attack on the cathedral...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/011: If we seize their strongholds, the Imperial Academy/15d and the cathedral,/60d we will deal a severe blow to both the Church and Christina's side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/012: So the plan is to strike first/30d rather than defend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/013: Correct./35d This is our only opportunity,/30d so please give it your all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/014: That concludes the meeting./35d We will move to Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/017: General Frederick's death/35d has drastically changed the course of the war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/019: The message is simple./45d/n"Surrender unconditionally unless you wish to be annihilated."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/022: What could be inside that drawer...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/024: Forgive me, but I'll take a quick look inside.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/032: It seems to contain something precious.../50d/nI cannot just open it behind Bors' back.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/033: Hmm?/30d Something's fallen on the floor?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/035: Cesare must have stirred Christina up./65d/nCesare.../50d Using even his own granddaughter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/036: [Meditch]/nTo think Chris would become our enemy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/037: [Clausewitz]/nEven so, I would like to avoid confronting Christina directly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/039: [Isabele]/nEveryone is shaken by this./45d/nOf course,/30d you are the cause...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/040: [Isabele]/nIf you have done nothing wrong,/30d hold your head high.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/041: [Silver]/nIt's not that I can't understand how Chris feels, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/042: [Kana]/nChris.../30d I thought of her as a younger sister...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/044: [Isabele]/nIf you are in the right,/30d I will lend my strength too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/055: [Meditch]/nTo become supreme commander and lead an army at her age...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/056: [Clausewitz]/nShe is burning with hostility toward us now, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/057: [Rhidelhard]/nShe always worked so hard/30d to win everyone's recognition.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/058: [Silver]/nIt hurts to see those blades/30d turned against us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/059: [Kana]/nI never thought things would turn out this way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/061: [Meditch]/nI thought she had talent,/40d but is she a born leader?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/062: [Clausewitz]/nAfter all, she was a comrade loved by everyone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/063: [Rhidelhard]/nTsk,/30d whose fault is it that things ended up like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/064: [Silver]/nIf I meet that girl,/30d/nI too/45d will have to turn my sword against her, won't I?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/065: [Kana]/nThe next time I see Chris,/30d what should I do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/066: [Esmeralda]/nGod stands with the righteous./55d A way will surely open.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s00/068: Those Who Leave, Those Who Stay
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr01/001: Hmm.../20d The treasure map Clausewitz gave us/35d/nsays north/13d-southeast/16d-south/12d-northeast/13d-north/12d-north/12d-northwest/14d-north-/6dnortheast.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmat01/001: Our intelligence says Machiavelli/30d intends to pass through Antananarivo/30d and cross Mount Mantigoa.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/001: Yes./40d/nHe could have wiped out the Zephyr Falcon,/55d/nbut he turned his army back.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/003: Tsk,/40d he was only a mercenary captain,/30d/nand I raised him so high.../40d Yet he shows no gratitude...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/004: As things stand,/20d he can no longer be trusted either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/005: I hear he also opposed/25d marrying Miss Christina into Bifrost,/40d/nand quite strongly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/006: The fool./45d/nDoes he think he can live with his daughter forever?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/007: Daughters/30d are merely tools of political strategy, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/008: As expected, you intend to use Bifrost.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/010: Moser II/30d seems thoroughly infatuated with Josephine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/011: Most of the opposition/40d has been eliminated thanks to the Dark Assassins you sent,/50d/nYour Excellency.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/012: Then I must ask you to take the next step.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/013: So you want me to bring in Bifrost's army.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/014: But/30d wouldn't that be a little dangerous?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/015: It will be fine./35d Moser is easy to manipulate./35d/nIf we use this opportunity well,/30d we can take control of Bifrost too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/016: Lord Frederick's opposition/35d will be difficult to handle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/017: There is no need to worry./35d/nI have already made plans to deal with him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/018: I pray the day when Your Excellency the Cardinal/30d unifies imperial territory/50d/nwill come as soon as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/019: The day we achieve our great cause/25d is not far off now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/020: Foolish people/35d may fail to understand our great undertaking,/45d/nbut history will give our achievements their due.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/022: Then,/30d I will take my leave...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/023: Now.../30d In just a little while,/15d my ambition will be fulfilled.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/024: Whether it's the Zephyr Falcon/15d or Frederick,/25d I need only use Bifrost to dispose of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/025: Once the empire's forces are united.../75d/nThe empire/30d will be the mightiest nation in Antalya!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/026: Ha ha ha ha.../80d Ah ha ha ha ha...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s01/027: Not even knowing how to play that card.../45d/nHe hardly deserves the title of the empire's overlord.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/001: [Deimos]/nToday is not your day to die.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/003: [Deimos]/nThank goodness./35d It is not too late.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/004: .../40dBefore I die.../55d I can still say/25d a final farewell.../75d/nI'm glad...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/005: [Deimos]/nDo not speak so weakly./35d/nYou must not die yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/006: ...But.../45d now.../65d/nMy body.../20d I cannot.../25d even.../60d move it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/008: [Deimos]/nThe last strength remaining to me.../45d/nI will give you/30d the power of my soul.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/010: [Deimos]/nAll the strength/20d of my living body/45d/nI gave long ago/15d to the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/011: [Deimos]/nThis body/15d is little more than an empty shell,/40d/nbut/15d the power of my soul remains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/013: [Deimos]/nWith that power,/25d keeping you alive should/35d/nbe no difficult task.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/015: Deimos.../45d You are/25d a god.../65d/nFor the life/10d of a mere human/20d like me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/016: [Deimos]/nDo not say that./45d For long years,/25d I suffered helplessness and silence./10d/nThe only one/30d who spoke to me was/25d/nyou, Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/017: [Deimos]/nYou inherited my blood/15d and my knowledge,/35d/nso you are like a child of my own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/018: [Deimos]/nOver the years,/10d I have created many lives./40d/nBut among them,/25d there are only/25d/ntwo whom I can call my sons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/019: [Deimos]/nThe Black Prince,/20d Carl Steiner,/25d/nand/30d you,/25d Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/020: But.../50d To preserve/20d this insignificant life.../55d/nI cannot/20d accept/15d yours...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/021: Please.../35d say no more.../55d/nLet my soul.../25d be free.../20d from this.../35d hell.../40d/nAnd bless.../20d that release...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/023: [Deimos]/nMy power/15d went to Carl Steiner,/35d/nand/15d my soul/30d I will bequeath to you,/15d Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/024: [Deimos]/nFind the sword Carl left behind/50d and take up its power./45d/nThat sword/30d holds the strength needed to protect this world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/025: [Deimos]/nWhere and how you use it/30d is your choice./50d/nBut/30d your will/30d is my will.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/027: [Deimos]/nMy soul/40d will remain with you/25d forever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/028: The power left by the Black Prince, Carl Steiner, lies buried on Storm Island at the southern end of the continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s08/029: Asura, on Storm Island!/15d Don't forget Asura!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/000: How long/15d are we going to put up with this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/002: I mean, how long are we to keep/10d that murderous maniac/45d in our Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/003: Meditch,/25d surely.../15d you're not talking about Cyrano?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/004: Who else is a murderer but him?/45d/nIf we let him keep doing as he pleases,/50d/nour Zephyr Falcon's reputation/25d will be dragged through the mud!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/005: The accusation that Mr. Cyrano killed the lord and his wife,/50d both beloved by the citizens,/35d/nis certainly damaging to us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/006: But/35d knowing it is an obvious frame-up,/40d you still intend to hold him responsible,/25d Mr. Meditch?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/007: What do I care whether he's been framed?!/45d/nI/25d cannot stand by and watch our Zephyr Falcon's reputation/30d be tarnished.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/008: Meditch.../30d Since when have you cared so much about that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/009: And Cyrano.../35d has even lost Silver./35d/nYet.../30d even so...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/011: Mr. Cyrano,/30d are you all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/013: Meditch's thinking/35d is something I fully understand./45d/nAnd I/35d can no longer remain in the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/014: Now.../40d I have little time left./45d/nBefore my allotted time ends,/45d I want to settle the debts/25d of my past.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/015: This stubborn, bitter bond with Cesare.../65d/nI will/30d put an end to it with my own hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/016: I/25d intend to support Mr. Cyrano/10d by leading our troops/30d to Geysir Cathedral./45d/nMr. Meditch,/30d what will you do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/017: Whatever anyone says,/25d I will follow Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/018: ...I will stay here./50d/nI'd rather leave the Zephyr Falcon/30d than act alongside that man!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/019: Mr. Meditch,/35d to hear such words/25d from you.../40d is truly regrettable./55d/nI hope you do not regret/20d that choice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/021: Wasn't Cyrano/35d himself responsible/15d for Captain Silver's death?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/022: Cyrano is our comrade./35d/nAre you saying honor/20d matters more than a comrade?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/024: You go too far as well, Strategist Clausewitz./45d You only defend Cyrano/nbecause/30d you need his strength, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/025: How can you be so calculating?/35d/nPeople like you/20d have no right to criticize Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/032: Mr. Meditch.../35d You/15d won't leave too, will you...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s01/039: What are you saying,/20d Miss Kana?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_tem/004: What is this?/40d/nThis trembling.../40d An earthquake?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/058: Everyone,/30d a little while ago,/25d a messenger from Frederick arrived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/060: Why would Frederick/20d send a messenger/15d to the Zephyr Falcon...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/061: The Bifrost army/20d seems to have begun its invasion of the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/063: Surely not.../20d Bifrost, a neutral nation?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/064: It was foreseeable to some extent./45d/nBifrost has been expanding its armaments/35d for quite some time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/065: However,/30d/nthe situation/25d is somewhat unclear at present.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/066: It seems/30d Machiavelli, who was sent/25d as a secret envoy,/nplayed a major part in this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/067: Damn!/35d We should have killed that bastard back then./45d/nThis is all your fault,/20d Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/068: So,/30d what does that have to do with Frederick's messenger?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/069: Frederick/30d seems intent on fighting Bifrost,/35d against Cardinal Cesare's wishes./50d/nSo/25d he is asking the Zephyr Falcon/20d to cooperate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/070: A remarkable man./35d/nTo ask his enemies to fight alongside him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/073: We cannot invite foreign forces into our land./45d/nFrom the empire's perspective,/30d this is a clear act of invasion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/074: What do you all think?/50d/nDoes anyone take a different view?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/076: We cannot let those Bifrost troops/20d take the empire from us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/078: Who here would object?/45d/nCome on,/20d let's crush those Bifrost troops!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/079: Then,/25d I will take that as our unanimous decision.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/082: Two hundred thousand.../45d That's an astonishing number.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/083: Yes. /35dEven if we/15d join forces with Frederick,/35d/nour Imperial army/20d would number only about 130,000./45d/nWe cannot match them in numbers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/085: When outnumbered,/35d the only effective tactics/25d are defense/20d and surprise attacks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/086: We will retake Inferno, a natural fortress,/40d from Bifrost./35d/nThen/20d use it as a defensive stronghold.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/088: General Frederick/30d seems to have the same idea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/090: Now,/35d we move out at dawn tomorrow./35d/nUntil then,/25d please get plenty of rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/091: Ah, one more thing./30d We've acquired a new sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/092: PS-7/25d "Blitz."/35d You're all familiar with it, aren't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/095: Isn't Pendragon strict about taking its standard-issue swords/25d out of the country?!/n/45d And Blitz is a top-class sword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/096: Well.../40d I was just a little lucky./30d/nFor now, Mr. Cyrano and Mr. Meditch/30d should use this sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/097: That's right./30d The PS-7/30d is the latest model in Pendragon's standard-issue/30d/nPendragon Sword series.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s03/098: Power aside,/35d it's light/20d and easy to repair,/25d/nwhich should make it very useful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/008: Now,/30d let's take control of this place at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/010: As expected.../35d Bifrost/30d intended to make Inferno/na strategic base too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/011: [Commander]/nOf course./30d Inferno/15d serves as a link/20d/nbetween Bifrost and imperial territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/012: [Commander]/nThe Grand Duke/25d intends to use this place as a forward base/nfor invading the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/013: [Commander]/nMore importantly.../35d you defeated the Valkyries' commander,/30d Catalina, didn't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/014: [Commander]/nYour swordsmanship seems excellent,/30d but how will you fare against magic?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/017: [Commander]/nYour victory over Catalina.../30d was no fluke...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/018: Now all that remains is to deal with the surviving enemies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/020: I wonder whether the other units/15d have finished their operations safely too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/022: Every unit succeeded in its operation./30d/nInferno/15d has been captured by the combined forces/nof our Zephyr Falcon and Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd18/023: Good./35d All that remains is to wait for Catalina's troops.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/001: Everything is for the greater cause./60d Do not interfere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/002: It is already too late to stop the unsealing ritual./55d/nIf you try to interfere now,/25d you will only endanger Christina's life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/004: Cesare!/25d Step away from the seal!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/005: Hmm,/35d isn't this the rebel leader,/35d Meditch, and his followers?/60d/nYou've done well to make it this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/006: Lord Diablo,/30d I leave the rest in your hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/007: Heh heh heh,/60d shall I play with you/40d for a little while,/30d until the God of Destruction returns?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/008: Mr. Meditch,/15d we must seize that seal first!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/010: No!/20d If you touch Christina now...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/011: Who are you?!/35d Get out of the way!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/018: Mercedes.../55d Were you/30d the one who killed Mercedes...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/026: No!/20d The God of Destruction's resurrection is beginning!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/027: What do I care about a God of Destruction?!/40d It makes no difference what I face!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/028: Mr. Cyrano!/15d Christina is in there...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/029: Oh,/45d Mr. Cyrano has won./40d/nYou really/25d are the strongest swordsman!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/031: If you had not incited Meditch,/55d Mercedes would not have died!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/032: No.../30d Please spare me,/10d Mr. Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/037: Cesare!/45d Cesare!!/35d This is all your fault!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/038: Diablo!/40d Cesare!/40d I will destroy you all!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/039: Heh heh,/65d you're in the grip of madness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s02/110: Good!/25d I've long wanted to settle things with you!/55d/nPrepare yourself,/20d Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/000: Ha ha ha! /75dYou came charging in so confidently,/30d only to fall for such a simple trap.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/001: Those Zephyr Falcon scoundrels/45d are fleeing with their tails between their legs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/002: General,/20d what shall we do?/25d/nShould we send a pursuit force?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/003: There's no need. /45d/nThis defeat will keep them quiet for a while./50dLet them go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/006: We have reports that someone resembling Miss Christina/35d was among the fleeing Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/008: Ha ha ha!/70d That's just like her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s08/009: Good!/30d Our objective is achieved./35d/nAll troops, begin preparations to return!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy08/000: Everyone comes to moments of choice./nThe choice is yours,/nbut gaining what you cherish may mean giving up much else./nLife is fair to everyone./nDo not regret your choice./nOne day, the time will come to look back...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/002: Miss Kana, it's not like you to be late.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/003: Sorry,/5d sorry!/20d So everyone's here already.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/005: How could Meditch be here already?/45d/nHe's probably helping someone in trouble somewhere again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/006: Never mind that.../35d Kana!/10d Have you lost your senses?!/20d/nLeaving your troops behind like that!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/007: Ah.../30d I didn't expect Duke Ruben/15d to return/nso soon...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/008: According to the latest intelligence,/30d/nDuke Ruben/30d seems to have gone to General Irus, who was stationed nearby.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/009: It was unexpected,/30d so Miss Kana alone should not be blamed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/010: Whatever the reason,/20d a captain bears responsibility for losses among their troops.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/011: Once this matter is settled,/20d I will consult the other captains and decide an appropriate reprimand./55d/nYou have no objection, I trust?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/013: By the way,/30d who are the people accompanying you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/014: Oh, of course!/15d/nThey have been a tremendous help in this affair.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/015: Kana!/15d Bringing outsiders here.../20d/nAre you in your right mind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/016: But/25d thanks to them, we taught Viscount Ramon a lesson/40d/nand liberated Pretoria!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/017: I heard about that too.../50d/nIs it true that just three of you/35d raided the viscount's mansion?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/018: They're truly remarkable!/40d/nThey swept the lord's soldiers aside like autumn leaves!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/019: Whatever their skill,/30d/nbringing unknown outsiders to our rendezvous so casually was reckless.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/020: I don't know who you people think you are, /45d/nbut settle your own disputes among yourselves.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/021: We have no interest in getting involved in your affairs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/022: Very well./25d Then I will take my leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/024: Miss Esmeralda,/15d I think you should remain here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/025: No./30d/nIf it would not inconvenience you,/25d I would like to accompany Mr. Cyrano as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/026: Excuse me.../40d/nMight you be/30d Miss Esmeralda,/35d known as the Saint of Pretoria?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/027: A saint?/45d I am merely a doctor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/028: Miss Esmeralda/35d is the finest physician in imperial territory,/25d/nwhom we have tried to recruit several times.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/029: I never expected to meet you here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/030: I received letters from Mr. Clausewitz/20d several times,/40d/nbut I had patients to watch over and could not leave them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/031: Miss Esmeralda,/35d if you agree,/30d we will protect you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/032: Thank you./40d/nBut/15d I owe these people a great debt.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/033: I too/15d will leave with them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/034: Miss Esmeralda,/30d please don't worry about us./20d Remain here./40d/nIt will be safer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/035: If the Saint of Pretoria and Captain Kana/30d trust these people,/nthen/35d we can trust them too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/036: Tsk,/25d what's this?/40d/nSuch a sudden change of attitude.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/037: We have our own affairs to attend to./40d/nForgive us,/25d but we must take our leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/039: You're late again, Meditch!/50d/nWhat happened this time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/040: It was dangerous again./35d/nHe rushed into a house being consumed by flames/15d/nand rescued four siblings!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/042: Meditch,/35d you are the Zephyr Falcon's de facto commander-in-chief./50d/nIf something happened to you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/043: Well,/45d even so,/25d I cannot ignore people in trouble, can I?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/044: Ha ha ha,/50d those are words/25d worthy of Roberto de Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/046: Yes.../30d Roberto de Meditch.../50d/nThe Zephyr Falcon...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/049: By the way,/10d how is Kana's unit?/30d/nDidn't General Irus arrive and put them in danger while they were pursuing Ruben?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/050: Yes,/30d it seems General Irus intervened.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/051: Perhaps/15d Kana's absence at the time/30d was a blessing in disguise.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/052: It seems/25d best for Mr. Meditch/30d to deal with General Irus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/053: Even I/25d am not sure I can match/none of the old empire's Four Heavenly Kings...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/055: Ha ha ha,/45d don't worry about it./40d/nStill,/15d we cannot abandon Kana's troops.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/056: But.../35d I see some unfamiliar faces?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/057: These are/15d Miss Esmeralda, whom we wished to recruit,/30d/nand the people who helped Captain Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/058: Allow me to ask once again./50d/nWould you/30d lend us your strength?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/059: Please accept my apology/35d for what happened earlier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/061: Very well./40d/nFor now, I will act alongside you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/063: Great!/15d/nMr. Cyrano, join our 4th Unit/25d and come with me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/065: There is no time to lose,/30d/nso I will explain the plan to attack Caracas at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/066: First,/20d Miss Isabele's 2nd Unit/20d and Mr. Rhidelhard's 3rd Unit/25d will attack both sides of the village simultaneously/30d/nto throw the enemy into confusion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/067: Once infiltration succeeds,/25d Mr. Meditch's 1st Unit/30d will begin a frontal attack on the lord's mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/068: While Mr. Meditch engages General Irus,/30d/nMiss Kana's 4th Unit/20d will enter the mansion's basement through the underground waterway/40d/nand rescue the prisoners.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/069: As expected of/15d Strategist Clausewitz,/40d an airtight plan!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/070: Now,/30d shall we see what one of the old empire's Four Heavenly Kings can do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/071: That's one of Meditch's good qualities, though.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/072: Kana, /30dare you/20d taking your duties as captain seriously?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/076: What do you say?/40d/nWould you also/30d lend your strength/30d to our Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/078: General Irus/30d is the empire's fiercest general,/45d/nonce/25d counted among its legendary Four Heavenly Kings.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/079: So the legendary/25d General Irus has appeared.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_s01/080: Good,/30d let's show General Irus what we're made of!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/002: Let's ask her to treat the children right away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/003: I'm sorry./20d I hadn't noticed we had visitors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/004: Miss Esmeralda,/20d these children have gunshot wounds.../25d/nPlease treat them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/005: Good heavens,/25d a child has been shot...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/007: The wounds are deep,/15d so I must treat them at once./30d/nQuickly, this way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/008: But/35d how did such young children come to be shot?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/009: The lord's soldiers/30d even branded fleeing children who had lost their parents as rebels/30d and opened fire...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/010: Oh,/35d how could anyone be so cruel...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/015: Will the children be all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/016: Children recover quickly. /30dThey should be feeling better by morning./55d/nA full recovery will take time,/40d but their lives are no longer in danger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/018: Yes,/30d then/15d I'll see you tomorrow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/025: [Nurse]/nThey said she had borrowed the devil's power to heal people...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/026: Why would he do such a thing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/027: [Nurse]/nViscount Ramon/30d had been courting Miss Esmeralda./nHis courtship was entirely one-sided.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/028: Ha,/30d what a petty excuse for a man!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/029: Cyrano,/20d we must hurry to save her./25d/nWho knows what a man like that might do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/030: All right,/30d let's go and rescue her at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/032: I'll rescue her, whatever it takes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/033: Silver, we're heading straight into Viscount Ramon's mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/035: We still need more time to prepare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/036: We can watch Ramon's movements before we attack. There will still be time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/039: It was fortunate that you gave them good first aid./65d/nFor now, I think you can rest assured.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/042: For some reason,/15d you look familiar.../45d/nHave we/25d met somewhere/35d before?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/045: Well.../40d Perhaps you've mistaken me for someone else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/046: Cerepus City.../30d No,/25d I'm Cyrano, the man you rescued in the desert./55d/nThank you so much for what you did then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/047: Yes, /25dyou told me your name was Cyrano./40dIt's been almost two years already./50d/nI'm relieved to see you in good health.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/048: What?/20d You two know each other?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/049: In any case, /30dwe'll take our leave for today./30d/nWe'll check on the children again tomorrow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/050: Well... Perhaps you've mistaken me for someone else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/052: Well.../25d I thought we met about two years ago/30d in Cerepus, perhaps...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/053: I have only visited Cerepus/30d once, recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/054: Then/20d we'll take our leave now./30d/nWe'll return tomorrow to see how things are,/20d so please look after the children.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/058: What's wrong?/20d Has something happened to Miss Esmeralda?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/059: Calm down,/30d and tell me what happened, one step at a time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/060: [Nurse]/nViscount Ramon.../45d/nHis soldiers suddenly came rushing in...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/061: Viscount Ramon/30d is the lord here, isn't he?/25d/nWhy would he go after Miss Esmeralda?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/064: [Nurse]/nThey made absurd accusations/40d/nand falsely branded her a witch!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/066: [Nurse]/nShe rejected him repeatedly,/30d and he bore a grudge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s02/069: To abuse power and torment the innocent...!/40d/nIn the Zephyr Falcon's name, we cannot forgive this!/35d Let's go together!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr104/000: The torture chamber is underground. We need to go down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s02/000: [Diablo]/nYou have made me reveal my true form after centuries,/35d and for that/75d/nnone of you will leave alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/000: .../40dIs this.../25d the God of Destruction's true form...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/002: Attack without hitting the center, where Christina is!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/003: Will the God of Destruction/20d finally be put to rest...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/006: .../40dSo.../35d can we not defeat the God of Destruction/40d/nwhile avoiding Christina in the center?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/008: The time/25d I have spent with all of you.../35d/nI will never forget it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s03/011: [Esmeralda]/nI implore you with my life,/40d bestow/15d a great miracle here...!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcph1/000: The door appears to be locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcph1/001: Esmeralda should be imprisoned somewhere in the mansion. Let's hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcph1/003: This is Ramon's mansion./50d/nNow,/30d let's find Esmeralda.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcph1/004: Come on, let's find Esmeralda quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/000: Father,/30d I'm sorry to have kept you waiting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/002: Tonight we finally/20d announce your engagement formally./40d/nAre you ready?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/003: By the way,/20d I told Ruben to help with your preparations,/35d/nbut he's nowhere to be seen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/007: Seeing you like this/40d/nreminds me of your mother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/009: I haven't even married you off yet,/60d/nand already my heart feels so empty...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/010: Heh heh.../40d I must truly be growing old.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/013: By order of the Church!/35d/nCyrano Bernstein has been charged with devil worship./35d Under this summons,/30d he must accompany us to court at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/015: Sir,/20d what did you just say?/30d/nWho has been charged with devil worship?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/016: Lord Bernstein,/20d your son/20d has been charged with devil worship./nThe Church has requested his appearance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s10/017: Where could he have gone/15d at a time like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmf04/000: We must hurry down the mountain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin03b/001: I have a bad feeling about this way./nAir is flowing in from somewhere else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka08a/000: This way doesn't lead to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma01a/000: We have to pursue Machiavelli at once!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat02/000: There's no need to visit a fortress that's already been destroyed./nLet's hurry after Machiavelli.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat02/003: Passing this point will prevent you from completing the following side quest./nDo you wish to continue?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltat02/004: Skip the side quest and move on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx14/000: What sets humanity above other beings/nis our ability to sacrifice ourselves for others./nEven if today's choice costs you everything, do not grieve or regret it./nWe live by making sacrifices for one another./nThough I may vanish today, does not another life remain?/nA father's will lives on through his son, and a mother's love never changes./nThrough sacrifice and love, humanity may endure forever...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/003: [???]/nYou're on Storm Island./50d/nHow/15d are you feeling...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/005: [???]/nStill,/15d I'm amazed./50d/nYou've recovered so much in just one day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/007: [???]/nHave you come.../35d looking for Asura too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/010: Do you know.../45d where Asura is?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/012: [???]/nThat sword/40d is beyond the reach of ordinary mortals.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/013: [???]/nSo far,/45d so many young people/30d have lost their lives...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/014: But I.../50d/nI have to find it, whatever it takes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/015: [???]/nFor now,/40d rest until you've recovered/30d your strength./45d/nThere's no point going in that condition.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/016: Um,/30d forgive me.../40d May I ask your name...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/021: Eoline Pendragon.../50d She played a central role in the Creation War.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/022: So the Pendragon ferry/50d was for Eoline after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/027: [Eoline]/nI can't tell you/15d where Asura is.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/028: [Eoline]/nNothing you say will change my mind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/029: [Eoline]/nGo home when the next ship arrives./50d/nUntil then,/40d don't set foot outside this house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/035: There's something I must do./50d/nAnd to do it,/30d I need Asura's power.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/039: On this small island,/35d there's only one place big enough/25d/nfor an enormous magic machine...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/042: Oh no.../30d/nI have to stop him...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/043: Asura is/15d where the Black Prince breathed his last...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/044: In other words,/25d where the magic machine Asmod rests.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/045: How are you feeling?/45d You seem a little better.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/047: Put everything else aside/40d and focus on recovering.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/048: This painting.../35d It's the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/049: The Demonic Sword Asura/35d was once the sword of the Black Prince Carl Steiner.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/050: They said that in his final battle,/50d/nthe Black Prince piloted the magic machine Asmod.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/052: Let's think back over what the secret records said.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/053: Then,/20d he died on Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/054: There may be a clue in this mansion./45d/nLet's look around a little more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/056: Storm Island isn't very large./45d/nIt only has one mountain peak.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/057: Hm?/40d Looking closer,/25d/nthe summit is painted rather faintly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/058: Was that just meant to show the mountain mist?/60d/nIf not...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s02/064: [???]/nBesides,/40d there's no other reason/30d/nfor you to come all this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/001: Ah,/35d it's been a long time./35d/nAnd you too, Meditch./25d It's good to see you again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/003: The leader?/45d Of our/10d Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/004: The leader?/45d Your Majesty?/35d What is going on?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/005: [Clausewitz]/nThis is/25d my grandfather,/35d the leader of the Zephyr Falcon,/30d/nand/30d the King of Pendragon,/35d Rashid Pendragon/20d I.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/007: Our leader.../30d/nis the legendary Holy King,/30d Rashid?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/009: I'm sorry/30d I've kept my identity hidden./60d/nMy real name is/30d Rashid Clausewitz Pendragon III./55d I'm the son of Pendragon's/25d first prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/011: Clausewitz,/35d Sharn Hoiste,/15d and now Rashid III.../40d/nWhich one is the real you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/013: Rashid III,/40d you've led things well,/30d but you've taken too many/nrisks./70d This/15d Arondight affair, for example./40d If our war/15d/nhad dragged on,/30d how would you have managed?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/014: And,/35d everyone in the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/016: You may/20d resent finding out that your leader/30d is the king of another/ncountry.../55d But thank you./40d You've led the Zephyr Falcon/20d well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/018: ...But,/20d forgive my asking.../40d/nWhy would the king of the continent's strongest nation/35d form an unofficial group/25d/nto interfere in another country's affairs?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/019: Ho ho,/55d you're just as spirited a young woman as I heard./60d/nBut/25d it's a perfectly fair question.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/020: The airship/30d /15dLin Amadio III is waiting nearby./40d/nLet's go/15d to Pendragon together.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21e/021: Hmm.../55d To explain, I'll have to go back a long way./55d/nWhy don't we/30d head to Pendragon Palace first?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber12/000: They say curiosity killed the cat./20d/nDigging too deeply into anything can be dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber12/001: If you drag up something best left alone and make an issue of it,/nyou'll have to pay a price, one way or another.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber12/002: It's true that when you're young, you can't bear to leave/nanything unexplored. But whatever is meant to come to light/nwill reveal itself in time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/000: This ship is bound for Dakama./nI've sailed this route for decades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/001: Excuse me./40d/nIs this the ship to Dakama?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/002: [Captain]/nIt is, but/35d our departure has been postponed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/004: [Captain]/nAh,/15d don't get me started./40d/nI'm furious too,/40d but there have been so many pirates lately/45d/nthat voyages to Dakama have been banned for now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/005: [Captain]/nClosing the route/25d over a few pirates! It's absurd!/50d/nIt's all because that blasted mayor/25d hates me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/006: Then/25d when will you be able to sail?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/007: [Captain]/nI don't know./35d/nNot unless we tear down that mayor's house/25d/nand elect someone new!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/008: Only the mayor of Cerepus has the authority to permit departures.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/009: As far as I know, the current mayor of Cerepus/nand our captain don't get along.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/010: Well, at least it gives me a little rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/011: [Captain]/nI don't know. His house is two blocks ahead, above the tavern. We may not sail again until we tear it down and elect a new mayor!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/012: Quite different from our current mayor, in many ways.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/013: I believe Charles, the current mayor of Cerepus, lives near/nthe Granada Merchant Group... He and our captain don't get along./nWe need the mayor's approval to lift the sailing ban...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/014: Hmph! There's no point asking that pig!/nHe really can't stand our captain!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/015: Well, at least it gives me a little rest...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/016: [Captain]/nI don't know how to thank you, Ruth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/017: [Ruth]/nNot at all./35d/nI only put things right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/018: [Ruth]/nMayor or not,/30d closing a shipping route over a personal/ngrudge.../50d It's utterly absurd.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/020: [Captain]/nAh,/25d you must be Cyrano./35d/nRuth has told me about you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/021: Thank you for taking us to Dakama.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/022: [Captain]/nDon't worry./30d/nOh,/15d Ruth has paid your fare as well,/40d/nso make yourselves comfortable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/023: Ruth,/35d thank you so much./30d/nI'll never forget your kindness.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/024: [Ruth]/nHehe,/30d if you're really grateful,/30d buy me a drink sometime./60d/nAfter you return from Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/025: [Captain]/nRight,/25d we're sailing for Dakama!/40d/nAll hands, prepare to depart!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/005_2: [Captain]/nWe can't sail this route/nover a few blasted pirates? It's absurd!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/011_2: Ruth, the candidate for mayor of Cerepus, is reasonable./nFor a politician, anyway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/013_2: I believe Charles, the current mayor of Cerepus,/nlives near the Granada Merchant Group...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/017_2: [Ruth]/nDon't mention it. I only put right what was wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/005_3: [Captain]/nWe can't sail this route because of a few pirates? Absurd!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/011_3: Ruth, the candidate for mayor of Cerepus, is reasonable./nFor a politician, anyway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/013_3: I believe Charles, the current mayor of Cerepus,/nlives near the Granada Merchant Group...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/017_3: [Ruth]/nNot at all./nI only put things right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy01/030: [Ruth]/nI'll pray/15d that good fortune/25d follows you on your journey.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr108/000: It looks as though this place was sealed off after the last incident.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka05a/001: Pretoria is northwest of here./35d Let's hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/000: Welcome./10d/nOur tavern serves the finest drinks in the world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/001: The famous doctor/nEsmeralda lives in our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/002: We brew our drinks with mineral water from the valley,/nso nowhere else...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/007: Thank you for visiting our shop./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/011: [Miss Hayden]/nHello./nWelcome to our inn./nA room costs 95 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/012: Thank you. Have a restful night...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/013: Then please come back another time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/014: Thank you for staying at our inn./nPlease visit us again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/015: Honestly, without this water and Esmeralda,/nthere'd be no reason to live in this village...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/016: A family from our village fled some time ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/017: They were in danger of a witch trial,/nbut the main reason was that the wife/ncaught Viscount Ramon's eye...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/018: I won't leave this wretched world as it is. Never!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/019: My relatives abandoned this village to escape/nViscount Ramon... I don't even know if they're alive./nWhy must the powerless suffer like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/020: I... I really hate those people with power!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/021: Who... are you? Who... am I?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/022: Ah... My head. My head hurts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/023: Viscount Ramon is notorious for chasing women./nWhat would become of this village/nwithout Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/024: Not long ago, a whole family fled from Viscount Ramon./nHe sent soldiers after them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/025: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/026: Our village has long been famous for its scenery,/nso many nobles have competed to rule it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/027: This is Pretoria, one of our objectives in this operation./60d/nLet's rescue the prisoners held in the lord's mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/031: Heh heh heh... I could handle a sword in my day too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/032: The important thing in swordsmanship is not to grow/nattached to your weapon. A sword is only a tool/nfor your art, never its purpose.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/033: Surely the highest mastery is to practice swordsmanship/neven without a sword!/nDon't cling to your weapon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/034: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/035: More and more people are learning the Tuer language these days.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/036: The war with them will end someday,/nand then we'll need the Tuer language.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/037: Don't run away./nRunning won't solve anything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/038: Our village's lord is a rather peculiar man.../nThe truth is, life here is difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/039: I kept a rubber band stretched for too long, and it snapped!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/040: That rubber band struck my leg,/nand it stung so badly I nearly cried!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/041: This door seems to be locked from the inside.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/043: You're lucky to have visited our village./nFarewell...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/044: I hear Viscount Ramon has amassed/na vast treasure on the second floor of his mansion...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/045: Some classify swords as rapiers or heavy swords/naccording to their properties... In any case, if you want to survive,/na heavy sword is the safer choice./nWith a rapier, you're as likely to take a hit/nas to land one. Unless your level is high,/nyou'll struggle to survive a battle...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/046: A heavy sword such as Chrysaor Girium or a Bastard Sword/nwill help keep you alive,/nespecially against powerful enemies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/047: Swords broadly fall into defensive and offensive types./nDefensive swords are durable, but have low attack power./nOffensive swords break easily,/nbut strike much harder.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/048: Typical defensive swords are Chrysaor Girium and/nthe Bastard Sword./nTypical offensive swords are Cassandra and Gramr.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/049: The Bastard Sword is very sturdy,/nso its upkeep costs are low.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/050: Gramr is powerful, but fragile,/nso you'll face high maintenance costs./nIt also puts a heavy strain on your party's HP in battle,/nso you'll need plenty of healing potions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/051: Have you heard this story?/nNot long ago, a skilled swordsman went exploring/na dragon's cave, but his weapon broke along the way./nIn the end... he never came back alive./nPerhaps durability really is what matters most in a weapon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/052: In the right hands, Gramr can be the strongest sword./nAs a rapier, it's hard to defend with, and its edge chips easily,/nbut its power rivals that of renowned blades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/053: The academy's Sword Research Society devotes all its passion/nto studying the sword, a weapon gradually being forgotten,/nand showing people its appeal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/054: - Official Meeting Place of the Academy's Weapons Research Association -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/055: The goal of battle isn't to kill your enemy,/nbut to survive yourself./nNow that armor has lost its effectiveness,/nyour sword is what protects you.
