Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/056: Rapiers deliver satisfying attacks,/nbut fighting with them takes a heavy toll on your HP./nYou might say you're gambling with your life...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/057: Rapiers are fragile, too. In a series of fierce battles,/nthey may all break, leaving you to fight your enemies/nbarehanded./nThat would be suicide.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/058: A branch of the Imperial Geographical Society of Geysir Academy/nis located in the western part of this village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/059: Pretoria: An intermediate village with fairly low prices, home to the famous doctor Esmeralda./nThe nearby mountains are known for their vast extent and complex terrain./nThe renowned Phoenix Cave is also nearby, but its exact location is withheld because it is dangerous./nHowever, it is said that the strongest fire magic can be found inside./n- Imperial Geographical Society of Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/060: Have you seen the Geographical Society members in the west?/nThey're strange people who spend all day staring at maps.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/061: Good heavens, even people with so little to do/nmanage to feed themselves.../nWe have to work ourselves to the bone just to scrape by...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/062: It's all proof that since the Black Prince died,/nthis empire has become a miserable place to live./nWe want a strong leader to unite it again...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/063: - Pretoria Village Guide -/nTavern: Northwest/nItem Shop: West/nInn: Northeast/nWeapon Shop: East/nEsmeralda's Clinic: Western village/nImperial Geographical Society: Western village
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/000_3: Welcome. Our tavern's drinks are the finest in the world.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/001_3: The famous doctor Esmeralda lives in our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/008_3: [Miss Barton]/nWelcome to the village where the famous Esmeralda lives. How may I help you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/010_3: Goodbye, and thank you for visiting our shop. May Esmeralda bless you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/011_3: [Miss Hayden]/nWelcome to our inn. Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/014_3: Thank you for staying at our inn. Goodbye...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/017_3: They were in danger of a witch trial, but the main reason was that the wife had caught Viscount Ramon's eye...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/018_3: I won't leave this wretched world as it is. Never!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/023_3: Viscount Ramon is notorious for his womanizing. What would this village be like without Esmeralda...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/024_3: Not long ago, a family fled from Viscount Ramon. He sent soldiers after them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/025_3: High-ranking nobles' carriages sometimes pass along this road.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/026_3: Our village has long been known for its beautiful scenery. Many nobles compete to become its lord.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/031_3: Heh heh heh... I could handle a sword in my day too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/032_3: When wielding a sword, remember not to become attached to the weapon itself. A weapon is merely a tool for swordsmanship, not its purpose.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/034_3: When speaking a foreign language, think and speak like a native of that country.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/036_3: The war with them will end someday. When it does, I think we'll need the Tuer language.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltpr01/038_3: Our lord is rather strange... The truth is, life here is difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/005: What could a child like this.../30d/nhave done to deserve it...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/012: ...Their injuries are severe./30d It'll be difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/013: Damn.../40d Is there no way to help?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/015: In Pretoria, beyond the mountains,/30d/nthere's a famous doctor named Esmeralda!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/016: Esmeralda.../50d/nThe doctor they even call a saint?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/017: Yes!/15d/nI'm sure she can save them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/020: Wrap the child in this cloak/20d to keep them warm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_te1/023: Kana, please show us the way to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx13/000: North - Mountain Summit/nSouth - Pretoria Village/nEast - Caracas, Geysir
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/001: It's even more/15d incredible than I imagined...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/002: The Black Prince/15d controlled this... What kind of man was he...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/007: That sword.../20d/nAsura/20d is beyond human control!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/008: An ordinary human mind and body/20d cannot withstand it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/009: I.../40d/nWhatever happens,/20d I need this sword's power.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s03/010: This is my will,/30d and the will of the Dark God Deimos...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/000: At last, we're back in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/001: Are you planning/15d to go straight to Geysir City?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/002: First,/25d I should find out what happened while I was away from the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/003: If I remember correctly,/25d this is the Caracas region...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/005: Hehehe,/25d you've walked right into our trap.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/006: Kana Milanovich/20d of the Zephyr Falcon!/40d/nA bigger catch than I expected!/65d/nSurrender without a fight!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/007: [??]/nOh no,/30d it was a trap after all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/009: Ah!/20d Hey!/15d Over here,/10d here!/20d/nQuick!/15d Attack these fellows from the side!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/010: What?!/15d More of them over there!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/011: Don't let them escape!/40d Round them all up!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/012: What's/10d that girl doing?!/35d/nDragging innocent bystanders into this?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/013: I doubt they'll believe us if we say we don't know her./60d/nIf they block our way,/35d there's no need to avoid them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/014: Sorry to drag you into this!/25d Are you all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/015: Dragging people who have nothing to do with this into danger.../35d Isn't that going too far?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/016: Sorry!/20d Thank you so much for helping!/25d/nBut/10d I'm in a hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/017: We'll talk later!/20d Bye for now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/020: Heh,/45d let's call it a welcome home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/021: There should be a village nearby./40d/nLet's stay there tonight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s01/023: [??]/nOh,/10d honestly!/25d I can't believe I walked into an ambush!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/011: [Cyrano]/nWhy would you... do something so foolish...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy... Why are you apologizing to me, Mercedes...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/021: [Cyrano]/nMercedes... The more I think of you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/022: [Cyrano]/nHow can I forgive Cesare for causing you such pain...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/023: Cyrano! The God of Destruction is on the move again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/024: You just won't stay down...! This time, I'll finish you for good!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/025: That should have rendered the God of Destruction powerless!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/029: The God of Destruction/nis moving again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s05/030: [Cyrano]/nHow could I forgive Cesare/nfor making you suffer...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/001: Hmph!/25d Duke Ruben, you wicked lord/40d who torments innocent people!/25d/nThe Zephyr Falcon has come/20d to bring you to justice!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/003: Haha!/35d You think there are any guards left?/40d/nWe've already dealt with every guard around here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/007: Just as I thought.../45d We've been fooled.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/012: But,/25d how can you tell?/30d He looks exactly like Ruben./45d/n...Though he does seem to be trembling a little.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/013: That is definitely not Ruben./50d/nOthers may be fooled, /25dbut I won't be!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/014: Silver,/35d there's nothing more for us here./35d/nWe're going after him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/015: Do you have any idea/25d where he might have fled?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/016: He wouldn't go far and abandon his territory./55d/nI'm sure/20d he's gone to a nearby lord for help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/017: That makes sense!/15d/nCome on,/10d let's go after him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/020: From here on,/15d this has nothing to do with the Zephyr Falcon, does it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/021: Ruben has fled his territory,/50d so haven't you achieved your objective?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/023: There's no reason for us to stay together,/45d so we'll part here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/024: What?/20d/nBut/15d we've come this far,/15d so we could go after the real one together...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/029: Fine./30d Go wherever you please./40d/nIt's none of our business in the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/032: And what do you want, Mr. Impostor?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/033: [Luban]/nWell.../10d um.../10d that is.../20d/nWhat/15d should I do...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/034: Stop hanging around where I can see you/30d/nand go home already!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s04/036: So.../30d this has nothing to do with the Zephyr Falcon,/20d does it...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/001: Hehe.../35d Cyrano,/45d sorry I keep taking away what you cherish./110d/nThat woman last time,/35d Silver, was it?/75d She was as inflexible as you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/002: Don't you dare say Silver's name with that filthy mouth!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/003: You haven't changed at all./75d/nTo think/35d you'd really go looking for Mercedes./55d Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/004: Hehehe.../60d Cyrano Bernstein,/60d don't be mistaken.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/005: I've changed!/60d I'm no longer the man/55d who felt nothing but inferiority beside you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/006: Did you think this would stop me,/20d Iscariot?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/007: Hehe.../65d So/20d human strength wasn't enough after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/008: But/15d with the ultimate power I've created, things will be different!/80d/nWatch closely,/40d Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/009: Cyrano.../60d You've gained the greatest power./80d/nFar greater/60d than anything I created...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/010: Iscariot.../50d/nDid you crave power so much/56d that you'd become such a hideous monster?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/011: Heh,/35d to hear that from you.../110d/nYes,/45d that was why/30d I betrayed you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/012: But.../30d in the end, you're/20d just like me.../25d a monster.../60d/nUnable to live alongside/20d ordinary people.../50d an outcast from society...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/014: At least I.../45d can die at your hands.../75d/nBut poor/25d you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/019: He went to the underwater city to resurrect the God of Destruction?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/020: Cesare's dog,/20d Iscariot.../45d/nYour life/40d will be an offering to Silver's departed spirit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s03/021: Cesare.../35d What are you doing?!/50d We're going after him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/001: Mom,/15d why is that man in there?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/004: You must never/15d speak to someone like that again./20d/nDo you understand?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/005: That's strange,/30d/nhe gave me candy not long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/007: That man/10d takes good children away and eats them!/20d/nHe's a terrifying man, like a devil!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/009: To think the eldest son of the distinguished Bernstein family/nis a devil worshipper.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/010: There's a limit to how much shame you can bring on your family!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/013: I never knew/50d/nyou were that kind of person...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s12/019: One more innocent victim/25d has been added to the list...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/000: Is.../30d isn't that Arondight...?/45d That magic machine...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/001: Pendragon is intervening.../55d/nWhat about the war with the Tuer...?/40d You sent/10d Arondight here,/35d Rashid?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/002: It seems the rumors/30d were true.../35d/nThe Tuer Empire and Pendragon/30d have agreed to a temporary truce...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/004: No.../35d It's too soon!/35d/nOur imperial lands/15d aren't united yet!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/005: Your Eminence,/20d we have no time for this./25d/nNow that Pendragon has intervened,/15d your plan...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/006: We have to get out of here quickly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/008: As long as I live,/30d I will unite the empire/20d with my own hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/010: Abandon this futile dream./35d/nA person/15d must know when to give up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/012: I can't stand by while innocent people are sacrificed for your ambition.../45d/nNot anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/014: I cannot./30d You think I'll give up?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/015: Give it up,/10d Christina!/25d/nHe's no longer/10d the grandfather you knew.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/016: He's a demon/10d possessed by ambition!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/017: Who dares/35d call me a demon?!/40d Me!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/022: I'm glad/55d Grandfather has found true peace...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/023: Now.../60d Father and Mother/55d/ncan rest in peace too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/025: They'll all.../40d Christina,/30d seeing how strong you are,/30d they'll all be happy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/026: Kana,/25d Rhidelhard,/10d Silver,/25d Esmeralda.../40d all of them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/027: Come to think of it,/35d where did that Machiavelli fellow go?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/031: All he wants/35d is to use his own ideas/35d to leave an assessment of Cesare and us/20d for posterity./25d/nNothing more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/032: No,/40d I don't care what becomes of him./35d/nMore importantly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/033: Who exactly are you?/55d/nIs Clausewitz/35d even your real name?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/034: As it happens, there's much/40d I need to tell you all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21c/035: But/40d right now,/25d my grandfather is waiting./40d/nWould you all/30d come with me first?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma16a/000: There doesn't seem to be a path here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/001: Damn.../35d The sulfur stench stings my nose.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/003: Prisoners who die in the prison/45d/nare simply dumped here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/005: What should we watch out for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/007: I see.../30d I didn't expect a monster like this to live here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/008: It's not just this one./35d/nInferno's sulfur caverns are a paradise for monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/009: Now,/25d how do we get outside?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/010: For now, our only choice is to go through the sulfur caverns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf2f/011: All right,/15d let's go!/40d/nIt's dangerous, so leave the fighting to me and stay close!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx18/000: Frequent rebel activity. Civilians are forbidden to pass./n/nBy order of the Lord of Pretoria
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme04/001: Leave now, while I'm still asking nicely!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat02/000: This iron door is completely sealed./55d/nLet's find a way to open it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/006: (Is Deimos's soul reacting?/45d/nSomething isn't right./40d I'd better go to Meditch.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/007: Silver,/30d rescue the prisoners with the other two.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck04/009: There's something troubling me.../45d/nI'll join you later.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/002: Will you be heading/10d into the former imperial lands from here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/003: Geysir./50d/nSo/20d I won't need the ship anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/004: You all heard him?/35d He won't need the ship anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/005: Then/35d can we/15d go back to sea?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/006: From now on, you can do as you please./50d/nKeep pirating,/30d start a business with what you've earned,/40d or go to the countryside and farm.../40d/nWhatever you like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/007: I've truly enjoyed our time together./50d/nI hope you all stay healthy/35d and live well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/008: Boss,/10d what are you saying?/25d/nIt sounds as though you're saying goodbye...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/009: You older hands/40d take good care of our foolish youngest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/011: I'll never forget the days we spent together.../45d Boss.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/012: Now that you're leaving.../45d/nperhaps it's time we gave up/15d piracy too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/013: Then/30d this is goodbye./40d/nI'm sure we'll meet again someday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/014: I hope/35d you'll be happy,/20d Boss!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/015: I knew this day would come.../65d/nBut leaving those fools behind/30d has me worried.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/016: I promised to be of help to you./50d/nOnce I/25d give my word,/35d I keep it to the end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/017: You don't have to follow me./45d/nBringing me to Cerepus was enough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/018: .../50dI see./50d/nThen,/20d I'm counting on you from now on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/019: I'm glad to be joining you,/25d Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/020: First,/20d we'll cross the Trisis Desert/30d and head for Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/021: So that man/35d is the one the boss has been waiting for...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/022: The boss said, 'I'm waiting for someone who can beat me.'/40d And now that day has come.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/023: With the boss's skill,/20d I thought that search would take a lifetime...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/024: Then what does that make us, after serving only the Boss all this time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/025: What else?/20d We don't fit in...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s04/028: Oh well,/30d we've got plenty of capital./25d Perhaps we should start a business...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/000: Zephyr Falcon Supply Line, Rhidelhard's Camp
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/001: Rhidelhard,/15d what is it?/30d/nWhy call me away at such a critical time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/002: Could you/40d come over here/15d for a moment?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/005: Don't you/30d think this is unfair?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/006: We used to/20d be on the front lines together./50d Now look at us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/007: Cyrano and Frederick get all the glory,/40d/nwhile we're stuck in the rear,/25d guarding a road!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/008: Rhidelhard,/10d I understand how you feel./30d/nBut you know that nothing matters more in war/20d than securing the supply lines,/25d don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/010: The enemy's supply lines/25d matter just as much./35d/nCut them off,/30d and even a huge army/20d will fall into chaos!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/011: Now that their supply line is cut,/50d this is our chance to strike Catalina's army!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/013: Why/30d are you hesitating?/35d/nLet's take the initiative/30d and put them in their place!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/014: The man I know/30d would never show such weakness!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/017: Yes.../35d We can't stay like this forever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/018: All right!/40d Let's show them what we can do!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s03/019: That's it!/35d Now you sound like yourself!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold00/000: Hee hee! Let's go and find the treasure!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/000: Geysir City was the old empire's capital, after all./nEven though its former glory is gone,/nit still brings in considerable tax revenue.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family,/nonce the empire's foremost servants.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/002: Geysir Cathedral was completed over ten years ago./nI remember it being a vast project/nthat took a long time to finish.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/003: There have been no religious trials here since it became Church territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/005: Sharon's most recent performance/nwas here in Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/006: The young woman next door is a little strange./nSometimes she's endlessly kind,/nand sometimes she turns terribly violent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/007: Bands of brigands have been running wild in the desert lately./nI nearly died several times on this trip myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/010: It's ironic that in the year Geysir Cathedral was completed,/nthe Bernstein family, its greatest benefactors,/nwere wiped out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/011: A path in the nearby forest leads/nto a cave where a dragon once lived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/013: Beneath Geysir Cathedral/nare old underground waterways.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer people/nhas entered a lull lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/015: Well, the underground waterways and the dragon's cave/nare both just places people talk about./nNo one knows if they really exist.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/016: I hear Tuer science and technology are beyond imagination.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/017: Apparently, that young woman's personality/nwas a little strange even as a child.../nThat's what my mother said.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/019: Perhaps the Bernstein family's destruction/nwas inevitable./nThey stood in the way of Lord Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/021: I heard the women saying she's been like that/nsince her stepfather abused her./nI was scolded when I asked what had happened...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/024: Geysir City is ruled by Cardinal Cesare now./nNaturally, it's part of the Church's territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/026: Geysir feels like a city in steady decline./nAbove all, its population isn't growing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/027: Why is that?/nThe Church's forces in Geysir City/nare far less oppressive than elsewhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/028: Perhaps people keep leaving Geysir City/nbecause the city itself has lost its youthful energy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/029: Pendragon and the Tuer have been at war for a very long time./nThey say sheer numbers are what hold back/nthe Tuer's tremendous firepower.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/030: I hear Pendragon's overwhelming numbers/nhave slowed the Tuer offensive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/031: General Sander is retired./nHe moved to Geysir City recently./nRetired soldiers usually go to Ron, the City of Soldiers...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/032: General Sander has four daughters,/nand I hear they're all beautiful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/033: Apparently, the general was very hot-tempered during his army days./nThey say some of that temper still remains...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/034: General Sander's home is famous for its frequent parties./nHe certainly seems suited to this old city/nwith its fine traditions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/035: You really ought to attend one of General Sander's parties...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/036: A great many people gather at his home./nGeneral Sander seems to have acquaintances everywhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/037: Well, if you still enjoy adventures,/nit might be worth looking for that cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/038: When I was a child, I often wandered around/nlooking for the dragon's cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/039: A lot of time has passed since then,/nbut there's been no word of another performance./nI wonder why?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/040: I'd love to see my idol Sharon perform again.../nSurely she isn't giving up singing, as the rumors say?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/041: As a member of the Geysir City garrison,/nmy proudest moment is our annual military parade.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/042: Marching through Geysir's streets, I can really/nimagine what the parades must have been like/nwhen the Black Prince was alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/043: Of course, our small force today/ncan't match the splendor of the army that ruled all Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/045: Subversive groups like the Zephyr Falcon/nstill have very little influence here,/nso you needn't worry about Geysir's security.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/046: The worst unrest was/nwhen the Bernstein family was destroyed over ten years ago./nTheir surviving followers kept resisting...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/047: I was once a soldier who wore the Bernstein crest./nI was on leave when the family was wiped out ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/048: When I heard that the Bernstein family's young master/nwas to face a religious trial,/nI hurried back to Geysir City, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/049: By then, it was all over./nIt was the greatest disgrace of my military career./nI wasn't on the battlefield while my comrades were wiped out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/050: I'm a mage studying at Iscariot's academy./nI went to Dakama, in Pendragon territory, to gather materials.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/051: Visiting Dakama made it clear how badly/nPendragon's economy is struggling./nThe war with the Tuer must be taking its toll.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/052: If only our empire's strength were united at a time like this.../nAh... Black Prince...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/053: General Sander? My brother likes his third daughter./nHis daughters are all beautiful./nThough the general himself isn't much to look at...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/054: Their mother must have been very beautiful, don't you think?/nBut honestly, I don't like General Sander.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/055: My brother's a doctor./nWhen I say things like this, he tells me, 'You're just a kid.'/nBut I pride myself on being a good judge of character./nOne day he'll learn the hard way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/056: [Dustin]/nI'm a doctor./nI've fallen in love with Priscilla,/nGeneral Sander's third daughter, whom I met recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/057: [Dustin]/nBut recently I saw Priscilla/nbeing brought in on suspicion of drug use./nShe was released on my guarantee as a doctor, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/058: [Dustin]/nPriscilla must have fallen/nunder the influence of bad people!/nIsn't there some way to help her?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/059: If our shopkeeper has a fault, it's that almost obsessive/nlove of sweets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/060: This shop has been passed down through the owner's family./nThe current owner doesn't seem as attached to it as the last.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/061: Father's interests aren't really suited/nto running a weapons shop./nWhat he loves most is cooking.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/062: The person at the counter is Father's cousin./nFather is away on business for a while.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/063: Honestly! My son has no attachment to this historic shop,/npassed down through generations of our family!/nAll he thinks about is food...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/064: Do you know about the Fire Dragon Cave,/nwhere Kars killed a dragon and sealed it away?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/065: They say Fire Dragon Cave is south of this city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/066: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome./nOur inn offers spotless rooms and impeccable service./nA night's stay costs 80 ELD./nWould you like a room?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/068: Please visit us again./nWe always provide the finest service.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/069: Thank you for staying at our inn./nPlease visit us again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/070: [Mr. Oldfield] Welcome! We've gathered the finest weapons in the world!/nTake your time browsing!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/072: A good weapon can save your life in a crisis./nPlease visit us again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/073: [Mrs. Oldfield]/nWelcome./nI help my husband by selling firearms.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/075: Thank you for shopping with us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/076: [Raymond]/nWelcome! We only stock the finest goods!/nWhy not try buying something?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/079: There's a dragon's cave nearby. From time to time, someone/nbrings out a precious ancient treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/080: But there are so many rumors that anyone who enters/nnever returns,/nI'd advise you to stay away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/081: [Mr. Durant, Merchant]/nCome on, take these leftover goods off my hands! Clearance prices!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/083: Thank you, thank you./nOn my next trip to Dakama, I'll bring back better goods/nto repay your patronage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/084: Hmph, Durant's prices aren't even that low,/nyet he calls it a clearance sale!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/085: I am traveling in search of enlightenment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/086: Not long ago, beneath a bodhi tree,/na mysterious light spoke to me./nIt said, 'Leave.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/087: I won't return until I've found enlightenment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/088: Young people these days have no spirit!/nIn that respect, Lord Frederick of Ron/nis a fine example for them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/089: Do you neglect your own affairs for other people's sake?/nThe most important thing in life is personal fulfillment./nLive in a way that satisfies you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/090: By that measure, I've lived far too indulgently.../nI miss my hometown, Pretoria...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/091: Iscariot's Imperial Academy seems to be/nresearching the limits of magic lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/092: I know who you really are./nDo you think I've lived this long without learning anything?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/093: You're the one watching a monitor and clicking a mouse./nA wanderer through time, aren't you...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/094: Have you heard the legend of the Geysir mansion?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/095: The Bernstein family lived in that mansion ten years ago./nBut they were wiped out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/096: No one has lived there since. The reason is...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/097: Hasn't the number of wandering merchants/nincreased strangely lately?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/098: As local lords drive more families into bankruptcy,/nmany have turned to peddling to survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/099: Still, things are comparatively good in Geysir City.../nI can't tell you how fortunate I feel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/100: It's rather foolish to come down into a basement/nassuming there will always be something here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/102: Business has been terrible lately./nWhere has everyone's money gone...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/103: Even Geysir City, supposedly one of the better places, is like this.../nImagine how things must be elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/104: The economy wasn't like this when the Black Prince was alive./nAnd now look at it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/105: The empire must be united!/nAnd only our Cardinal Cesare can accomplish it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/106: Hmph... If you want to admire my beauty, bright light won't do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/108: You must never trust a merchant's word!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/109: I'm on leave today and have returned/nto my hometown, Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/110: My unit is stationed on the far side of Caracas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/111: A friend of mine is on duty here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/112: The door to this house is locked.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/114: [Bors's Ancestor]/nYou've entered a room you should not have entered./nIf you wish to leave, answer the following question.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/120: [Bors's Ancestor]/nYou don't even know our family name!/nYou aren't worthy of a longsword!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/122: [Bors's Ancestor]/nIn our family's name, you may leave this room./nPlease take good care of Bors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/123: [Soldier]/nA warrior's greatest asset is stamina!/nRun three laps around the city for two Brass Gems,/nor ten laps for a Diamond Gem!/nBut leave this area and you'll have to start over! Now, go!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/124: [Soldier] Good, you've passed the west gate!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/125: [Soldier] Good, you've passed the south gate!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/126: [Soldier] Good, you've passed the east gate!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/127: [Soldier] Good, you've passed the north gate!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/128: [Soldier] Well done! That's one lap! Keep going!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/129: [Soldier] You've finished all ten laps! Come here and I'll give you your reward!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/130: [Soldier]/nGood! Now you've got some discipline!/nHere, take this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/132: [Soldier]/nWell, you've graduated now!/nDon't forget to keep building your stamina!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/133: The forests of the former imperial lands are very dense./nTravelers should map their route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/134: Central Square of the Great City of Geysir
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/136: [Soldier] Three laps! Come now for two Brass Gems! Keep going for a Diamond Gem!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/137: [Soldier]/nYou've done three laps. Here's your reward, as promised!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/139: [Soldier]/nRight, start again from the beginning! Keep running!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/140: [Soldier] Five laps! Come now and I'll give you a Brass Gem!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/141: [Soldier]/nStamina is the foundation of a soldier's training!/nNever neglect your exercise!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/142: [Soldier]/nLeave this area and you'll have to start your laps over!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/010_3: You can't call it ironic that in the year Geysir Cathedral was completed,/nthe Bernstein family, its greatest benefactors,/nwere wiped out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/066_3: [Miss Lutz]/nWelcome./nOur inn offers spotless rooms and impeccable service./nWould you like a room?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/112_3: There doesn't seem to be anyone in this house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01/144: We're here to find treasure./35d/nWe need to go to the Fire Dragon Cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/000: Our lord is a truly violent man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/001: This was originally the territory of the Bernstein family,/nthe empire's foremost contributors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/002: Our lord is notorious for his violence./nCatch his eye the wrong way, and you're in trouble.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/003: A relative wrote to say they'd settled in Libreville./nI'm thinking of moving there too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/005: Not long ago, I saw a beautiful woman/npassing through here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/006: Whenever our lord goes hunting,/nnot a single animal is left in the forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/010: No one taken prisoner in the castle has ever come out alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/011: The lord of Memphis is terribly violent./nThe safest thing is to stay out of his sight...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/013: Our rice wine is very good./nYou'll enjoy it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer/nhas entered a lull recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/015: Once I've saved some money, I'm thinking of/nmoving to Ron.../nI hate to leave my beloved hometown,/nbut a person has to survive, and this place...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/019: Always stirring up the village, even as a child...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/026: I have no reason to go there right now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/029: Thank you. I hope to see you again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/030: I received a marriage proposal recently./nBut there's something weighing on my mind./nIf we stay here, we'll have to pay the marriage tax...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/031: This used to be a lovely place to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/032: But since the current lord took control,/nhe's hounded everyone so badly we can barely live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/033: Just recently, the lord drove out the tailor's family/nsimply because he didn't like them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/034: Apparently, he beat the tailor so badly he was crippled,/nthen drove him out...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/035: I proposed recently, but she turned me down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/036: What hurts is that she married someone in Libreville and moved away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/037: The women of our village don't want to stay here./nI'm wondering whether I should leave too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/039: I once dreamed of becoming a scholar.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/040: It's been about ten years since I came here, hasn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/041: I barely escaped with my life and fled here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/043: I'm not sure... Who are you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/045: Around the corner, waiting still,/nA new road and a secret door./nThough I have often passed them by,/nOne day, when the time has come,/nWest of the moon, east of the sun,/nI'll walk that hidden path.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/047: [Sid]/nSo it is you... You're well, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/048: [Sid]/nNow that I've seen you again, I could die without regrets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/049: Sid... It really is you. I heard you'd been kidnapped... Are you all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/050: [Sid]/nThe kidnapping... The shock left me unable to remember/nwhat happened while I was held... But I'm all right now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/051: [Sid]/nAh... yes. Young master, I have something to return to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/052: [ Sid ]/nThis... is the treasured sword from your family's home,/nwhich I kept safe during the war./nAt last, it's reunited with its owner...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/054: [ Sid ]/nI pray this sword will be of some/nhelp to you, young master. Farewell...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/057: [Edros]/nI dream of having my own shop.../nLooking for anything?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/059: Thank you./nWhen I open my shop, I'll hold a great bargain sale for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/060: [Linda]/nAre you feeling ill?/nThen you need medicine!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/062: Tell me whenever you're feeling ill!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/063: Sid, the man who lives in the house at the upper left/nof our village, is a little strange.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/064: He lives alone.../nand always looks sad.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/065: The forest seems to be growing denser lately./nSo many people were getting lost/nthat they put up signs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/066: To avoid getting lost in the forest,/nbe sure to follow the signs carefully.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/067: [Guesthouse Owner] Welcome./nOur family takes in travelers,/ngiving them a comfortable place to rest./nOnly 80 ELD! Would you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/069: Hmph... You won't find anywhere cheaper than here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme01/070: Travel safely. May peace and good fortune attend you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/000: It wasn't long ago that a frog came to our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/001: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/002: Ho ho ho... I've been to Geysir before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/003: Keep tormenting frogs, and you'll be punished.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/005: I went to a friend's wedding.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/006: Sometimes, strange sounds/ncome from the nearby forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/009: To reach Cerepus, you must cross the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/010: Geysir City was beautiful, as you'd expect of an old capital./nBut the people seemed somehow oppressed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/011: Have you/10d heard of the sword General Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/012: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/013: Someone says they saw a strange sword/nin the forest near our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/014: I hear the war between Pendragon and the Tuer/nhas entered a lull recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/015: Since the Black Prince's death,/nthe imperial bloodline has effectively come to an end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/016: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/017: The sound from the nearby forest is a humming.../nRather like wind rustling through blades of grass.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/019: I remember it being very different from Ron.../nA strange place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/021: A friend and I went to the place in the forest where the sound came from,/nbut strangely, there was nothing there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha?/nHe's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/024: Most people in our village are devout followers of the Church.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/026: Hello, and welcome to the Bordeaux Inn./nA room costs 100 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/027: Thank you very much. Rest well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/029: Thank you very much./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/030: Lucia's family? They're an odd lot./nHow can people in one family be so distant?/20d/nSomething isn't right...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/031: People are evenly divided over Lucia's family./20d/nSome say they simply don't get along;/nothers say they aren't really a family at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/032: I don't think they're really a family./nFor one thing, I've never seen the couple/nholding hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/033: Is there nothing in the empire that can replace/nthe old imperial family?!/nHow can the empire rise again like this?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/034: Forgive me. I got a little carried away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/035: Have you seen the talking frog in the tavern corner?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/036: When it first arrived, everyone in the village/ntried to drive it away./30d/nIt's a monster, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/037: But would you believe it? The frog could talk!/nIt lamented its fate so pitifully that we let it stay.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/038: I agree with those who say Lucia's family is simply/na little unconventional.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/039: People have a strange habit of dismissing/nor rejecting what they don't understand./nLucia's family is just a little unusual.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/040: Legend says that when Kars drew that sword,/neven beasts that knew no fear/ntrembled at its murderous aura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/041: A fine sword alone won't make a great swordsman,/nbut Kars's sword would certainly help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/042: He was a man./nI kept thinking of him,/nbut to him, I was only a childhood friend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/045: I'm traveling as part of my training as a knight./nOn this journey, I intend to obtain/nGeneral Kars's Gigadeth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/046: When I heard the sword was nearby,/nI hurried here./30d/nSome strange fellow may have taken the Black Prince's Asura/nfrom Storm Island,/10d but I won't let that happen to this one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/047: Will you help me?/10d/nOnce I have the sword, I'll reward you handsomely.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/048: Have you spoken to the youngster staying inside?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/049: Why does that child talk like that?/20d/nOh.../10d how insolent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/050: I don't know what grand family he thinks he's descended from.../nHe actually asked me, 'Are you a serving woman?'/nUgh...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/051: Heh, you're not after General Kars's/nGigadeth too, are you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/052: That sword is waiting for me./nAs the heir to General Kars's family, only I am worthy of it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/053: I doubt that sword would answer even if you called to it./20d/nHahaha!/10d Stop dreaming and look elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/055: Everyone here is talking about Lucia's newly arrived family/nand General Kars's sword, which has suddenly drawn so many seekers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/057: Are you searching for the magic sword, too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/058: Croak. That sword is cursed. Croak.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/060: I have been waiting for him for three years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/061: He said he'd return when the spring snow fell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/062: We're Lucia's family, the people everyone's talking about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/063: We're not as strange as the rumors say./nWe just come from somewhere with a different culture.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/064: The people in this village are strange./nWhy do they gossip so much about other people's lives?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/065: We expected some of this when we moved/nto a country village.../nBut I think it's gone too far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/066: What have our parents done to deserve such abuse?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/067: The people in this village seem rather strange.../nTheir extraordinary devotion to the Church of the Lord God is unsettling.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/068: Could there be something sinister behind all this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/069: What's this taste? This drink is different from the others!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/070: Could something be wrong with my sense of taste lately?/nEverything I eat tastes bitter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/071: [Grandpa Jack]/nHo ho ho... Welcome to my shop./nWhat are you looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/073: Ho ho ho... Farewell./nI hope you'll visit again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/077: You're a nuisance. Stop coming here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/088: There's something strange/nabout the frog living in our village tavern.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/091: [Benson]/nAh... I've collected many weapons on my travels.../nMoney's tight lately, so I'm selling a few./nWould you like a look?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/093: These are fine pieces I've collected over decades.../nYou can rely on their quality.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/000_3: It wasn't long ago that a frog came to our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/001_3: These lands once belonged to the Bernsteins, honored above all others for their service to the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/007_3: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/008_3: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/011_3: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/012_3: I hear Sharn Hoiste has been seen around here, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/015_3: The imperial line effectively ended with the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/016_3: They say Tuer science and technology are beyond anything we can imagine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/017_3: A humming sound... Like wind rustling through grass.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/021_3: A friend and I went to where the sound came from. Strangely, there was nothing there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/026_3: Welcome to the Bordeaux Inn. Would you like a room?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/028_3: Honestly... If you didn't want a room, why bother me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/030_3: Lucia's family? They're an odd lot. How can people in one family be so distant? It's suspicious...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/031_3: People are evenly divided. Some say Lucia's family simply doesn't get along; others say they aren't really a family at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/032_3: I don't think they're really a family. For one thing, I've never seen the couple holding hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/033_3: Is there no one in the empire who can take the old royal family's place?! How can the empire ever rise again like this?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/035_3: Have you seen the strange frog at the edge of the village?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/036_3: When it first arrived, the whole village tried to drive it away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/037_3: But then, of all things, the frog spoke! It lamented its misfortunes so pitifully that we let it stay.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/038_3: I agree with those who say Lucia's family is simply a little unconventional.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/039_3: People have a strange habit of dismissing or rejecting what they don't understand. Lucia's family is just a little unusual.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/040_3: Legend says all his enemies trembled whenever Lord Kars appeared with that sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/041_3: A fine sword alone won't make you a great warrior, but Lord Kars's sword would certainly help a swordsman like you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/042_3: He was a man... I thought of him constantly, but he saw me only as a childhood friend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/045_3: I'm traveling as part of my knightly training. Before my journey ends, I intend to obtain Lord Kars's Gigadeth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/046_3: I heard the sword was nearby, so I hurried here. Some strange fellow took the Black Prince's Asura from Storm Island, but I won't let that happen to this sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/047_3: Will you help me? I'll reward you handsomely once the sword is mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/049_3: How can a child speak like that? Honestly... Such arrogance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/050_3: I don't know what grand family he comes from, but he makes me sick... He actually asked me, "Are you a servant?" Ugh...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/051_3: Heh. Are you after Kars's Gigadeth as well?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/052_3: That sword is meant for me. As heir to Kars's line, I alone have the right to wield it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/053_3: I doubt it would even answer if you called it. Ha ha ha! Stop dreaming and look elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/055_3: Everyone here is talking about Lucia's newly arrived family and Lord Kars's sword, which has suddenly drawn so many seekers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/057_3: Are you searching for the magic sword, too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/062_3: We're Lucia's family, the people everyone's talking about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/063_3: We're not as strange as the rumors suggest. We simply come from a place with a different culture.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/068_3: Could there be something sinister behind all this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/069_3: What's this taste...? Does this drink taste different from the others?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/071_3: [Grandpa Jack]/nHo ho ho... Welcome to my shop. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo01/078_3: [The Frog Prince]/nSuch a nuisance... Stop coming here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri03/000: You cannot see the lord without an appointment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri03/001: This/20d is Lady Esther Dodd's mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s09/000: When I came to my senses in the cell,/40d I felt as though I'd been dreaming.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s09/001: Not only had the pain that tormented me for years/30d vanished completely,/40d/nbut the sulfur fumes/20d seemed to give me strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s09/002: Above all,/25d/nknowing that wherever I was or whatever I did,/20d Deimos's soul would protect me/45d/ngave me great strength of mind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s09/003: And that day.../40d/nWithout his help,/35d I'd still be/20d wandering through/20d that hell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s09/005: And now.../60d/nMy journey to gain the power Deimos spoke of/45d was just/25d about to begin.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss01/000: << Operation Dragon Strike >>/n/nInfiltrate behind enemy lines and cut off their supply route!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss01/001: I've come to supply you on Clausewitz's orders. Of course, it won't be free.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss01/003: For the glory of the Empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr99/000: They said there's a torture chamber underground./nEsmeralda should be here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/002: Fortunately, the wound doesn't seem fatal./40d/nHe must have twisted instinctively/25d at the crucial moment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/004: By the way.../55d/nyour swordsmanship.../45d it's rather unusual, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/005: What about you?/15d You call yourself an heir of the Black Shadow,/40d yet you use Pendragon swordsmanship. Why?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/006: Heh.../35d It seems we both have plenty to hide.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/010: You suddenly ran off.../35d What happened?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/012: We haven't secured the whole mansion yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/013: Esmeralda is treating the wounded,/35d/nand Kana has gone to support another unit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/014: I'm going into the mansion./50d/nRuben will be waiting for me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/016: Look after Meditch./35d His wound isn't fatal,/25d/nbut he hasn't regained consciousness. Keep an eye on him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/017: Will you be all right.../40d going alone?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/018: Ruben and I/15d have something we must settle between ourselves.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/022: I have to settle things with Ruben.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl08_te1/023: [Zephyr Falcon Supply Soldier]/nI'll provide whatever supplies you need.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/001: Thank you./45d/nYour help made it possible for me to obtain Asura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/002: There's no need to thank me./50d/nEverything/30d happened through fate...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/003: Asura/20d has acknowledged you as its master,/40d/nso you should be able to wield its power.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/004: But Asura/30d requires its wielder's Vigor/20d/nto reach its absolute peak/35d before it will manifest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/005: Even when summoned,/20d it can only be used briefly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/006: Furthermore,/30d at your current level,/35d you won't be able to use the Black Prince's secret technique,/25d/n'Asura: Sky-Shattering Dance,'/15d either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/007: You'll probably.../35d need a great deal of training.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/009: The Black Prince,/15d in his final moments,/35d went beyond 'Asura: Sky-Shattering Dance'/30d/nand reached a new level.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/010: Whether you/30d can reach that same level/25d remains to be seen.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/014: It was the cloak he wore./50d/nNow that you're Asura's master,/30d it should suit you./65d/nWill you/30d treasure it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/016: And/30d your kindness.../45d/nI'll never/25d forget it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/017: Then,/30d please take care of yourself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/019: By any chance.../45d/nhave we/15d met before, long ago?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/022: Somehow.../50d/nI feel as though I've seen you several times before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/024: Sometimes.../50d along with a feeling that the blood in my veins is burning...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/026: Never mind./35d/nI'm sorry/20d to bring up something so strange out of the blue.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/027: Revenge that calls for blood/35d/nwill ultimately/20d lead to your own destruction.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/028: I believe you/40d can free yourself from the chains/25d/nof revenge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s01/029: But/nI/55d can never forgive them./80d/nWhatever happens,/55d they must pay for their crimes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro04/000: West - Ron City/nRebel activity to the south. No civilian access.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka09a/000: Northeast - Libreville Region/nNorthwest - Pretoria Region/nSouth - Geysir City
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka09a/001: The Libreville region/25d lies northeast of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s01/001: Then,/30d let's begin the strategy meeting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s01/002: Everyone,/25d please look at the map.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcprh2/000: We can't go down this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/003: Hey!/40d/nWhy don't you stop hiding and come out?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/004: Hehe.../25d You caught me after all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/005: I told you we have nothing more to do with each other.../50d/nWhy are you creeping after me like a stray cat?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/006: Following you? What do you mean?/40d/nUm.../20d I... just...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/008: No,/20d well.../30d/nI'm just.../25d going my own way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/011: Could you stop looking at me so coldly?/55d/nOnly a moment ago,/20d we were fighting side by side!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/012: We traveled together because our goals matched./40d I'm not interested in your affairs./55d/nI'd appreciate it if you'd stop bothering me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/014: Calling me a nuisance is too much!/50d/nUgh.../15d Why should I endure this humiliation...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/018: What's wrong all of a sudden?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/028: You can run, but you won't get far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/030: What should we do/15d with the children?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/031: Children?/35d/nDoes treason distinguish between adults and children?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/037: Please.../50d/nThis is your mother's last request...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s01/042: Has the empire sunk this low?/60d/nI'll never forgive this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss23/000: Maze Forest/n1. Never turn back the way you came./n2. Always walk toward the sun./n/nLargo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/000: To cross the desert, you need someone to keep watch/nwhile you sleep./nWould you like to rest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/001: Sleep well. We'll keep watch over you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/002: Oh dear... If you cross the desert without sleeping,/nonly death awaits you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/003: Did you sleep well? Until next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/004: Welcome. You'll need plenty of equipment to cross the desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/007: Welcome. You'll need plenty of equipment to cross the desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/010: You'll need plenty of weapons and courage to cross the desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/012: Travel safely. Stay alive out there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/000_3: To rest in the desert, you need someone to keep watch/nwhile you sleep./nWould you like to stay? Our inn charges 1,500 ELD.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/002_3: Oh dear... Are you sure you don't need sleep?/nPush on when you're exhausted and you'll risk your life...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/003_3: Travel safely. Stay alive out there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/006_3: Then good luck... in this desert of death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/013: Looking for Lake Cerepus?/n/20dLake Cerepus is only a short distance/nsoutheast of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/014: Go straight west for Caracas Forest, or southeast/nfor Cerepus or Lake Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes04/015: I hear the underwater city, one of the Seven Wonders,/nlies beneath Lake Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21d/000: [Cesare]/nWith the God of Destruction's power,/45d I am no longer human./45d I am a god!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21d/001: [Cesare]/nThose who oppose me.../60d/nThose who profane the divine/35d shall atone with their deaths!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat21/000: So you've all been imprisoned here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat21/001: Ah!/20d You've come to rescue us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcat21/003: All right,/25d everyone, we're getting out of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga03a/000: North - Geysir City/nSouth - Nicosia, Memphis Region
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/001: This is Paro Village./nWe're fairly close to Geysir City,/nbut our cultures are very different.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/002: Unlike the noisy world outside,/nour village is quiet and peaceful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/003: It's terrible./nThe most handsome man in the village has fallen mentally ill.../nAnd he has a fiancee, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/004: We're rather remote, so we don't get many visitors.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/005: But a chef moved here from elsewhere recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/006: He's looking for fresh ingredients for fine cuisine,/nand apparently liked how clean this place is.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/007: I was once invited to Geysir City and went to visit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/008: Dazzlingly broad streets, beautiful buildings,/nand stylish people... That's what it was like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/009: It must be so much nicer than living in a village like this./nLife in the city...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/010: In a village as small as ours,/nbandit attacks are the greater worry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/011: It's all because of the Silver Arrow,/nwho brought down our Geysir Empire./nIf only they hadn't ended our imperial bloodline.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/012: It may be late, but shouldn't we form a single nation/nor alliance now?/nHow long can we remain in this chaos?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/013: I knew it! I've always said/nDan Waring isn't in his right mind!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/014: Brian is handsome and rich,/nclever and athletic... How can he be so wonderful?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/015: Ah... I really envy Diana./nThey must be happy together...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/016: Our lord seems very fond of children./nThere are so many in his house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/017: But strangely enough, they're all girls.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/018: The lord loves flowers too,/nand I hear his garden is full of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/019: I've seen Sharon perform./nShe danced so well, and she was beautiful and stylish.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/020: I really wanted her autograph.../nbut those older boys cut in line, so I couldn't get one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/021: If you meet Sharon,/ncould you get her autograph for me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/022: [Dan Waring]/nOur family is cursed./15d/nI was opposed to my son's marriage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/023: [Dan Waring]/nAfter these recent events, my son/nseems to understand our family's blood at last./10d Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/024: [Dan Waring]/nNow this cursed family line will end.../n/10dHehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/025: [Brian Waring]/nI'm finished. To have done such a terrible thing with my own hands.../20d/nMarriage?/10d I was a fool to hope for that!/15d Hahaha!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/026: [Brian Waring]/nI don't need your comfort./nDon't try to persuade me./20d/nAll that's left for me is death...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/028: [Diana] /nSomething is wrong here.../20d/nBrian has misunderstood something!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/030: [Haisen]/nAh, Cyrano./nI'm doing well./nOh, Brian and Diana asked me to give you their regards.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/031: [Haisen]/nThat fellow Dan.../nHe wasn't so strange as a child./nHe was cheerful, clever, and good at every sport...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/032: [Haisen]/nLooking back now, it's truly a pity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/033: Shouldn't we build one united nation too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/034: With the current power vacuum,/nnothing that happens would surprise me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/035: What's even more shocking is that those fragments/nwere found in a sack in Hugh's room.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/036: Welcome./nWhatever else you might say, we serve generous portions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/037: Where could Rashid III, first in line for Pendragon's throne,/nhave disappeared to?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/038: Well, King Rashid is still in excellent health,/nso he won't inherit the throne any time soon.../nBut if he ever visits us,/nI'd gladly serve him plenty of free snacks...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/039: My younger brother Karg runs a restaurant/nin nearby Caracas.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/040: He's skilled,/nbut far too much of a perfectionist.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/041: Whenever he gets the chance, he pesters me for fine ingredients./nHo ho...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/042: Ho ho ho.../nDo you really think a ruler capable of seizing the empire/nwill emerge any time soon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/043: To become master of the empire,/nwouldn't one need a force strong enough/nto defeat Cesare Borgia?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/044: They say someone has drawn Asura,/nthe sword that decides who will rule the empire.../nBut rumors are only rumors, aren't they? Ho ho ho.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/046: I got Sharon's autograph at her last performance./nHehehe... I'm the only person in our village who has it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/047: I wouldn't sell it for any amount of money./15d/nI'll pass it down as a family heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/048: Hmm.../nI'd consider it if you brought me something truly special.../nFragments of Asmod, for instance...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/049: Diana is the village's most beautiful woman./nEvery man here admires her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/050: When she announced her marriage to Brian,/nwho was just as admired by every woman in the village,/nthere was no end to the gossip...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/051: In a way, no one welcomed the engagement./nExcept the two of them.../20d/nEveryone else was jealous...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/054: Thank you for visiting our shop./nGoodbye.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/056: You're giving this to me, right?/nThank you so much! I'm so happy!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/057: I'll give you something in return!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/059: This is a ring I found in the forest! Isn't it pretty?/nThank you so much for the autograph!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/060: This is Love Herb, which I found recently/nin the forest near Caracas./nIt's a flower that only blooms where true love has taken root.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/061: It's a very rare herb,/nso would you keep it safe and take it to my younger brother?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/063: Would you like to rest? Our master/noffers hospitality to guests who visit the house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/069: I'll have more fine goods for you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/070: Wanted: Roberto de Meditch/nCharges: Arson, murder./nBounty: 1,000,000 ELD
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/071: Will you agree to get Sharon's autograph for the girl?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/072: If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/074: All right. If I meet Sharon, I'll get her autograph for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/075: Really? Then it's a promise! You mustn't forget!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/077: Besides, an autograph means more if you get it yourself./nWhy don't you try finding Sharon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/078: I know, but.../nI'm still too young to travel. Hmph...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/079: Thank you!/nDon't forget your promise to get her autograph for me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/081: It may not be glamorous, but we pride ourselves/non living quiet, peaceful lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/082: [Brian Waring]/nMove! Go away!/nPlease, just leave me alone!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/083: Has she given up, or is there some other reason...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/084: [Brian Waring]/nThe symptoms first appeared last autumn./nOn the night of the village festival, I got terribly drunk./10d/nAfter eating and drinking without thinking, I came to my senses at home./10d/nI went to the washroom to soothe my aching, hungover head,/nand there was blood on my hands...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/085: [Brian Waring]/nThinking I must have been hurt,/nI checked myself all over, but found no injury./nThe next day, I heard a wolf had entered a village farm,/nkilled chickens and livestock, then fled./n/10dBut... but I knew instinctively that it hadn't/nbeen a wolf.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/086: [Brian Waring]/nAt first, I told myself I'd simply had/na frightening dream./nBut the symptoms kept returning.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/087: [Brian Waring]/nNow I'm afraid to wake up./nWhen I find my room in disarray/nor my hands stained with blood,/nI become truly, truly afraid of myself./n/10dI'm scared.../10d So scared.../nNow I'm afraid even to sleep.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/088: [Brian Waring]/nMarriage! Ha, hahaha! What if I woke up one day,/nand with my own hands, my darling Diana.../nNo, no! Never that! I cannot marry./10d/nNot while this cursed blood flows through my veins. Never./nHeh... hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/089: [Dan Waring]/n...Mental illness has run in our family for generations./nIt's the price of preserving our bloodline through marriages between relatives.../nA line like ours should vanish from the world. Don't you agree?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/090: [Diana]/nBrian is mad?/nThat's absurd!/nThere was absolutely nothing wrong with him a year ago!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/091: [Diana]/nWe first met at Geysir Academy./nI happened to be looking for a quiet country village,/nso I moved here./nWe became engaged about a year after I arrived.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/092: [Haisen]/nBut, Diana.../nA person who is mad isn't always like that./nThe attacks come and go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/093: [Diana]/nNo, no! If he really,/nreally isn't well,/nwhy won't he even see a doctor?/nIf it's an illness, can't it be treated?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/094: [Haisen]/nIt's not an illness that can be cured./nIt's inherited in that family... Diana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/095: [Diana]/nNo, that's not true./nIt can't be!/nI... I'll cure him./nWhatever it takes, I will!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/096: The Warings?/nThat family has been cursed for generations./nNot one of them has died a normal death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/097: For instance, Dan's parents disappeared,/nand his wife died while they were enjoying themselves on the water,/nwhen their boat capsized/nin an accident, didn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/098: When Dan's wife died,/na rumor spread through the village/nthat he had pushed her into the lake.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/099: And now it's his son's turn? Poor boy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/100: So that family really does seem to have/nsome hereditary problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/101: You could say that./nBut perhaps the real reason is/nthat the family is so wealthy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/102: You're saying they became mentally ill/nbecause they're too wealthy?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/103: Not exactly.../nFor generations, that family has been full of plots/nover inheritances and succession rights. Perhaps that's what/nhas made them so strange.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/104: Come to think of it, wasn't there once doubt/nabout whether Brian was really Dan's son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/106: So they married relatives to reduce disputes,/nand hereditary mental illness resulted...?/nPerhaps having money isn't always a good thing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/107: [Dan Waring]/nI opposed my son's marriage from the start./nIt was out of the question. Hehehe...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/108: Excuse me./nI'm going to visit Dan,/nand I'd like to bring him something./nWhat would you suggest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/109: A family full of plots.../nI'd like to learn a little more about them./nPerhaps someone else can explain?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/110: [Pharmacy Owner]/nAh, Dan Waring?/nHe says his eyesight has been poor lately,/nand he's taking medicine made from datura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/111: [Pharmacy Owner]/nPerhaps he's been distracted by his son's troubles,/nbut it's time for more medicine and he hasn't come./nIt would be kind of you to take him some.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/112: Datura.../nIsn't that a very dangerous poison?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/113: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIt's all right./nHe's been taking that medicine for a long time,/nso he knows the dosage well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/117: So... he was behind all this./nLet's go to the Warings' house.../nWe must resolve this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/118: Excuse me./nDo you know anything about the Waring family?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/119: The Warings? Of course! That family has had no end/nof trouble for years./nI knew it ever since Rachel married into the family./nTheir marriages always leave me uneasy./nEven this one...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/120: (If I let her go on, she'll never stop.)/nAh... Who is Rachel, ma'am?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/121: Rachel? She was Dan's wife./nHaisen was in love with her too./nWhen Dan and Rachel married, the heartbroken Haisen/nleft on a long journey./nHe only returned recently./nBut not long after he'd left,/ntrouble began.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/123: Rachel gave birth to Brian,/nbut he arrived a little earlier than expected. People/nwhispered about whether he was really Dan's son./nLater, Dan publicly stated that he was...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/124: People suspected a relationship between Rachel and Haisen,/nbut since Haisen himself was away,/nthe matter eventually died down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/125: Well, I don't mean it's certain... Only that it's possible./nOh dear, oh dear. Listen to me gossiping like this/nto someone I've only just met... Well, then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/126: Interesting. A family touched by madness, with such a tangled history.../nNow the father seems suspicious./nLet's investigate further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/127: [Brian Waring]/nDo you have business with this madman?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/128: Madness.../nIn a way, is anyone in this world truly sane?/nBut you are.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/129: [Brian Waring]/nWhat... What do you mean, I'm sane?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/131: [Pharmacy Owner]/nWelcome. What can I get you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/132: This is the village pharmacy./nIf someone deliberately caused Brian Waring's condition,/nperhaps we can find a clue here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/134: I haven't seen you before./nYou're new to our village, aren't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/138: [Diana]/nIt's true that he grew more depressed about a year ago,/nand eventually began saying stranger and stranger things./nBut to me, he's perfectly normal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/140: Ask about the background of the incident.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/141: Are you saying Brian Waring/nmight not be Dan Waring's son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/142: What's the problem?/nI'll help however I can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/144: Ask who has bought potent poisons recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/145: Ask what gift Dan Waring would like.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/146: I know this is an imposition,/nbut could I have a list of people who've recently bought potent poisons?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/147: [Pharmacy Owner]/n...Are you looking down on us because we're only/na small village pharmacy?/nWe have business ethics too./nDo you think we'd show such a list/nto a complete stranger?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/148: [Pharmacy Owner]/nIf that's all you mean to ask, get out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/150: Oh dear... They're treating me coldly because I'm an outsider.../nThen again, why am I meddling in someone else's affairs?/nI should get on with my own business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/151: [Mr. Haisen]/nDiana, you mustn't do this. Let's go home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/152: No, this is actually fortunate./nPlease listen to what I have to say,/nHaisen, and Diana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/153: First, we must establish that Brian Waring/nis not mentally ill./nHe is not mad./nHe's simply fallen into a trap laid by someone/nwho wanted to make him appear that way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/155: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you talking about?!/nMy son needs complete rest!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/157: I hear you've spent a long time traveling, Haisen./nYou must have heard of the plant datura/non your journeys, haven't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/158: [Mr. Haisen]/nDatura?/nIsn't that a deadly poison that causes hallucinations?/nOne that can kill if too much is taken...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/159: [Brian Waring]/nI can't taste anything I eat or drink anymore./nMy head always feels heavy, and everything tastes bitter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/160: Exactly. Datura has a bitter taste,/nand headaches and dizziness persist even after the hallucinations fade./nHasn't Brian Waring been complaining lately/nof a bitter taste and dizziness?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/162: And Dan Waring,/nhaven't you been taking medicine made from datura lately?!
