Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/166: [Dan Waring]/nWhat are you saying...?/nYes, I take medicine made from datura,/nbut why would I want to harm my son...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/167: Even if he isn't your son?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/168: [Brian Waring]/nWhat are you saying...?!/nHe is my father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/169: I think Haisen knows the answer to that better than anyone./nDon't you, Haisen?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/173: [Dan Waring]/nWhy... why do you call me Father?/nWhen Rachel... when Rachel said she was pregnant,/nwho could understand my shock and rage?!/nI was unable to father a child...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/175: [Dan Waring]/nYour mother... Your mother, by the lake, with these hands I.../nNo, no! It wasn't me!/nShe jumped in! Yes, she jumped in!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/176: So your resentment led you to poison your son, make him hallucinate, and stage all this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/177: Haisen, aren't you Brian's real father?/nOut of jealousy, Dan gave Brian/ndatura to make him hallucinate,/nthen staged things to make him appear mad./nHis mother's death probably wasn't a simple accident either./nIsn't that right, Dan Waring?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/178: [Dan Waring]/nDamn it, my head hurts!/nI'd better go buy some medicine at the pharmacy!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/181: Dan Waring.../nhas gone to find his own solution./nDon't follow him...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/182: Then will you leave this place, Brian?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/183: [Brian Waring]/nYes. I'd like to travel for a while and clear my head./nWith my darling Diana, of course.../nOh, just a moment. Would you come over here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/184: [Brian Waring]/nThis is our family heirloom./nIt holds sad memories for us,/nbut I believe it could bring you happy ones./nI'd be grateful if you accepted it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/187: Diana's house./nShe must be away traveling now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/188: The Waring house./nThey must be away traveling now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/189: Do you know anything about Diana?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/190: Diana?/nShe followed Brian here about two years ago,/nafter he'd gone to study in Geysir./nShe seems to be someone he met during his studies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/191: But with her natural beauty/nand bright, outgoing personality,/nshe drew every man's attention as soon as she arrived./nWell, they weren't engaged then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/192: Hmph.../nIt wouldn't be an exaggeration to say every young man/nin the village courted her. Men, honestly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/193: [Tavern Owner]/nBut isn't it strange that nobody knows/nanything about Diana's background?/nShe still lives alone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/194: Come to think of it, I heard a rumor that a young man/ncourted her behind the party venue and was rejected/nvery coldly./n'I don't want anything to do with a fellow who has neither power nor money!'/nWasn't that what she supposedly said?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/195: As I heard it,/nhe tried to drag her away by force,/nso she pushed him away./nThe rumor simply got twisted as it spread.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/196: [Tavern Owner]/nWho can know?/nWhat's in a woman's heart...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/197: I'd like to hear about Brian Waring's/nbroken engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/198: That incident?/nDiana and Brian had been engaged for about a year./nThen recently, Brian suddenly called it off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/199: He said it was because of his mental illness!/nIt caused quite a sensation in the village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/200: [Tavern Owner]/nHonestly, no one welcomed the engagement except the couple./nHis father's madness is notorious,/nand nobody here wanted the Waring fortune/nto pass to an outsider, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/201: But has Brian really become mentally ill?/nHis behavior has certainly been strange lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/202: It's true that livestock on the farms/nhave been killed frequently lately,/nand they say Brian did all of it./nWould a sane person do that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/203: [Tavern Owner]/nIt's true that something doesn't quite add up, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/204: Then Brian Waring and his father Dan Waring/nhave always been a little strange?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/205: [Brian Waring]/nPerhaps we'll meet again on our travels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/206: It's really shocking./nTo think Dan Waring was the culprit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/207: Now, a toast to Diana's newfound happiness...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/208: Welcome. At Diana's request,/nguests in this house may stay free of charge./nWould you like to rest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/210: You're looking for fine ingredients at Chef Karg's request?/nActually, I'm his older brother.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/211: The Waring house... The door is locked./nBrian, its owner, seems to have gone traveling with Diana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltfa01_/212: Thank you so, so much for getting her autograph!/nI'll treasure it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwri11/002: We need to meet the lord of Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldin07a/000: At last, I've found Deimos' cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/013: Three years later, Inferno Underground Prison
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/016: Hehehe.../60d All I've gained in three years/60d/nis despair and a ruined body.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/017: Why.../50d/nmust I cling to life in this hellish place/30d at all?/50d/nSuffering like this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/018: Must I live like a worm.../50d/nfor the rest of my life...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/021: Damn.../60d Why can't I forget her?/75d/nThe woman who betrayed me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/028: If you don't want to die,/10d get up now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/029: Get to the underground mine/15d and start working!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/031: Damn it./30d/nWhen you drag your feet,/20d I'm the one who gets an earful!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/032: Tsk.../20d You stubborn wretch./30d/nYou're still alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s02/033: If that unpleasant fellow were gone,/35d my life would be easier...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/000: Well,/35d have you changed your mind yet,/45d Esmeralda?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/002: You won't even answer me now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/003: Listen,/35d just obey me/30d and you can live in luxury,/nwith wealth and glory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/004: A man of my standing/15d is offering to love you./40d/nWhy do you keep refusing?/40d Well?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/007: You're/40d a pitiful man.../65d/nDo you think a person's heart/30d can be bought with money?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/008: You.../45d how insolent.../50d/nHow dare you speak to me like that...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl07_s04/009: Say one more careless word,/50d/nand I'll make sure you never speak again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/000: In the mountains north of here/nlies the famous Zephyr Falcon's base.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/001: Esmeralda, the famous doctor, lives in our village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/002: This is a mountain village on the western side of the imperial territory of Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/003: Ah,/10d honestly!/30d What did you say?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/005: So this is Nicosia./45d/nWhy would the Church build a fortress in a village like this?/45d What are they planning?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/006: It's a lovely, quiet place, isn't it?/40d/nMy hometown is nearby.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/007: Kana, a girl from the south?/20d That's a surprise.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/008: Southern girls/20d are usually so reserved.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/009: Hehe,/35d I'm sure he means you're lively,/15d Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/010: Hahaha!/50d/nAnyway,/20d according to Clausewitz's information,/30d the Church fortress is east of the village./35d/nLet's be careful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/014: I hate it when the priests come down here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/015: Whenever that day comes, Mom keeps me shut inside./nShe says I could be taken away if I went out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/017: I've been ill since I was little, so I've had to stay at home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/018: Mother always looks sad when she sees me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/020: We definitely agreed to meet Rodriguez somewhere around here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/021: Our village belongs to the Church's territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/023: I've traveled to many places,/nbut much as I dislike the priests, there's no place like home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/025: [Sharon]/nI'm tired of it. I don't want to sing anymore./nI really don't...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/026: [Mr. Edward]/nWelcome./nOur inn charges 90 ELD a night./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/027: Thank you. Have a restful night.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/028: Please stay with us next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/029: Thank you for staying with us./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/030: We use the finest ingredients/nto serve the best drinks and food.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/031: Ho ho ho... The landlady here is kind/nand a fine cook, so I'm a regular.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/032: [Sharon]/nSharon... Yes, that's my name,/nbut I'm no longer a singer,/nso you can't call me Sharon the singer anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/034: [Sharon]/nAn autograph... Why are people so desperate/nfor famous people's signatures?/nI don't understand.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/035: Could you be Sharon, the singer?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/036: [Uncle Shen] Is there anything you need?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/038: Thank you for visiting. See you next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/039: They say there's no place like home, don't they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/040: Did you know it no longer rains or snows/nhere in Geysir territory?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/041: It snowed once fifteen years ago, but not since.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/042: Yet the rivers keep flowing. Strange, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/044: After every argument, they ask me who's right./nIt's really hard on me...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/045: Excuse me, you can't enter that way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/046: [Sharon]/nEverywhere I look, people see Sharon the singer, not me... Autographs are no different./nThey only want Sharon, singing/nonstage and dancing!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/047: ...Yes. That's exactly what people want./n/30dBut.../20d but don't you understand how fortunate/nyou are to have something/nthat people want from you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/048: Wherever you go, you can find people who need you/nand meet people who value you./nWhen someone wants something from you,/nespecially the joy you give them,/nisn't that a divine blessing?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/049: [Sharon]/n...People who need me.../nYes. There are people like that...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/050: [Sharon]/nYes. I'm Sharon, Sharon Indricka./nThe people's idol. The enchantress of the stage./nThat's who I am, nothing else.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/051: [Sharon]/nYou... wanted an autograph, didn't you?/nI'll sign it. Give me the autograph book...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/053: Thank you so much./nThe little girl who asked for this autograph will be delighted.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/054: [Sharon]/nYes... I need my fans, and they need me.../nI'm the one who should thank you. Farewell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltni01/055: [Sharon]/nYes... I'm Sharon, the 'Sharon' called for/nby the people who love my songs./nI'll find the courage to try again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflck01/000: There's no need to return to the village./nLet's find an exit that leads into the mansion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/000: To reach Nicosia, pass through Caracas Forest and Geysir City, then continue south.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/001: Pretoria lies east of here,/nand Caracas lies further east.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/002: Head north from Caracas Forest to reach Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/003: Caracas Forest is a major crossroads, connecting Libreville, Geysir City, Paro, and Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/004: To reach Memphis, Bordeaux, Ron, and the other places in the south, you must pass through Geysir City.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/002_3: This is Zephyr Falcon's main base. It may look like an ordinary cave from outside, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy00/003_3: Few people venture into these woods near Pretoria, thanks to all the strange rumors about them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s04/000: Th... this is the God of Destruction...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s04/002: Attack without hitting the center, where Christina is!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s04/003: We did it!! It shouldn't be able to attack now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nWith my own life, I beg you... Awaken, Christina!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl28_s04/009: That should have rendered the God of Destruction/npowerless...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst03/000: Ugh... Where am I?/nAnd... how did these things get into my pockets?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr17/000: Do you know true courage?/nIt is not for the strong to face the weak, certain of victory./nNor is it to deceive yourself for fear of the world's judgment./nEven knowing you will lose,/neven prepared to endure the world's ridicule,/na true man follows the path he believes is right./n/nMay I live without a shred of shame until my dying day.../n- Imperial Knight Kars
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/019: Hehe.../20d So this is the fellow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/020: Yes,/20d the noble fool who worshipped the devil/30d/nand was abandoned by his lover.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/021: I heard she married another man/25d/nwithin a month, didn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/022: And Lord Frederick, of all people./45d/nThat woman is quite something, isn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/023: Hey, watch your tongue./35d/nShe's the Cardinal's daughter, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/025: Ah,/25d this priest of the devil seems to know nothing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/026: Your beloved fiancee/35d has already married/nLord Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/027: To propose to another man the moment her fiance was imprisoned./50d/nImagine that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/028: I hear Lord Frederick/25d has immense wealth/nand power...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/029: Even the Cardinal's daughter is no different./50d Tsk, tsk...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/031: By the way,/30d aren't they transferring this fellow to the sulfur caverns?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/032: Hey,/35d rather than go to that hell,/30d/nyou'd be better off biting your tongue and killing yourself right here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/034: Come on,/20d we don't have time for this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s01/035: Oh,/30d is it time to change shifts already?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/000: Lord Deimos,/35d have you been well?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/001: [Deimos]/nYou've come.../30d I've been waiting for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/002: About what you told me last time,/50d/nand about you, Lord Deimos.../40d/nI've come to ask/30d a few questions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/004: Yes,/35d according to the Secret Records of the Creation War...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/005: First,/30d I questioned Deimos about the truth of the Creation War./60d/nI needed to put my fading recollections in order.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/006: ...About half a century ago,/45d there was a man who harbored dark ambitions./50d/nThe Geysir Empire's former chancellor,/30d Beladin.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/007: Beladin/15d was a close friend of the Black Prince, heir to the Geysir Empire,/50d/nand sought to exploit that friendship to fulfill his ambitions./75d/nYet/25d the man who thwarted him/35d was, ironically, the Black Prince Carl Steiner.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/008: And/15d Rashid Pendragon, King of Pendragon,/50d/nhelped the Black Prince defeat Beladin's plot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/009: The eastern alliance centered on Pendragon,/20d with Astania,/20d Dagar/20d and Curtis:/30d the four-nation Silver Arrow./60d/nAnd Geysir,/20d Trisis/20d and Galad:/20d the three-nation western alliance, Dark Armor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/010: Under the banners of Silver Arrow and Dark Armor,/40d/nthe two heroes/20d fought a desperate war against the gods,/45d/nand ultimately saved Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/012: Then I/20d began to unravel how the Dark God Deimos had been sealed again,/55d who had led it,/40d/nand/20d why.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/013: I learned that the Dark Gods who survived the Creation War,/30d namely Eustacia of Destruction/40d/nand/15d Diablo of the Moon,/30d had sealed Deimos/30d/nto carry out some plan.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/014: But/15d I couldn't discover what that plan was./40d/nI could only/15d guess that it would not bode well for humanity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/015: Deimos/15d preferred hearing my story/25d to speaking of his own past./40d/nBut/20d it gave me no pleasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/016: The fierce anger that rose whenever I recalled the past,/60d/nand/20d the despair that always engulfed me in the end...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/017: The more I longed to know the truth of my sudden separation from Mercedes,/15d the more clearly/60d/nI felt the reality that I could not/30d escape this hell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/018: .../45dMy past holds nothing but pain./55d/nPain so terrible I don't even want to remember...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/019: [Deimos]/nWill you turn away from the truth/20d to avoid pain?/50d/nBut/30d some truths can only be understood by facing that pain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/020: Tell me,/10d Lord Deimos./40d/nI/35d no longer understand anything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/021: I've learned that goodness/40d isn't always found in the light.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/022: But.../35d beyond that, I know nothing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/023: [Deimos]/nWhat is good,/30d and what is evil...?/40d/nIn this changing world,/25d finding the right answer/25d/nis no easy task.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/024: [Deimos]/nBut/25d if you keep searching,/35d/nsomething unchanging will remain in your hands./60d/nAnd/30d it will lead you to the truth...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/025: [Deimos]/nTo do that,/25d you must first overcome the pain in your heart./35d/nThat is where you begin.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s06/026: [Deimos]/nTrace the wounds you've turned away from./50d/nBegin with your most beautiful memory,/50d then follow it like the loose end/nof a tangled thread./50d You will see something.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/000: At last, I've reached the imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/001: What are you going to do next?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/002: I'll need to find out how things have changed in the empire since I left.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/003: If I remember correctly, this is the Caracas region...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/005: Heh heh heh... I've been waiting for you, Kana Milanovich!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/006: A Zephyr Falcon unit commander! A bigger catch than I'd expected!/30d Now surrender without a fight!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/007: Damn, so it was a trap after all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/008: But this is the only road to the duke's lands...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/009: Hey! Over here, over here! Hit them in the flank!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/010: What?! More of them over there!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/011: Good! Don't let them escape either! We'll wipe them all out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/012: What's that girl playing at?!/20d Dragging innocent bystanders into this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/013: Heh. That girl certainly takes risks.../20d But if the soldiers are blocking our way, there's no reason to avoid a fight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/014: I'm sorry for dragging you into this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/015: Hmph, you might as well stab someone first and then say sorry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/016: Is that all the soldiers dealt with, then?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/017: Thank you so much for your help, but I'm in a hurry. I have to go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/020: Well, I'll take it as a welcome home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/021: Now, there should be a small village nearby./30d Let's stay there tonight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_xx/023: Tsk! They were lying in ambush!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/000: Still a little time before dawn...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/001: So,/30d you do keep your promises.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/003: If I asked now why you challenged me to a duel,/45d/nyou wouldn't answer, would you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/004: You understand./50d/nIf you have a suspicion,/30d that is your answer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/005: Then/40d there's no need for more words!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/006: .../80dYou live up to your reputation./55d The empire's finest swordsman indeed...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/008: You said you wanted my life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/009: ...There's one thing I want to ask you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/010: Fifteen years ago,/45d a man named Luke Bernstein/40d died in a duel with you. Do you remember him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/012: .../40dI remember./40d/nI believe the charges/30d were devil worship and rebellion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/013: Have you ever regretted killing him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/014: Regret...?/55d/nThe charges against him/25d were plainly false, but/50d I have never/20d regretted what I did./45d/nThat/40d was no mere duel./40d It was war.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/015: And/40d the man responsible for that war/35d was Luke Bernstein./55d/nWhat I did/35d was justified, to reduce the casualties.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/016: I have no regrets/50d about that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/018: .../50dSo you/45d wanted my life/50d in payment for Luke Bernstein's death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/020: I'm sorry,/45d but my view hasn't changed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/021: Have you nothing left to live for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/022: Is there anyone who can face death without regrets/45d in this world?/60d/nThinking of my wife and daughter's grief,/45d I might lose my dignity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/029: A god gave love to the world,/75d and a devil/35d grew jealous of it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/031: You have no reason to pay for their sins./80d/nGo down the mountain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/032: I'd better check my weapons before the duel...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/033: ...Perhaps I should check my equipment before the duel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/037: Frederick is no opponent to face unprepared./30d/nI'd better check my equipment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/039: I'm not ready yet. Check again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s02/041: I'm fully prepared. Come whenever you're ready, Frederick!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl22_s3t/000: [Iscariot]/nThis is the mighty power of Grima!/60d/nNow,/10d come at me,/20d Cyrano Bernstein!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/003: This way has been sealed off. Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/005: It's sealed off here!/30d Let's find another exit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/007: ...Let's hurry and get out of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/009: Thank goodness!/25d We can get out this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/012: Oh.../5d oh no!/25d Was it a trap?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/017: My name is/15d Iscariot./50d/nCyrano Bernstein over there/45d is an old friend of mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/018: Iscariot,/30d the dean of the Imperial Academy!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/019: What do you intend to do with us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/020: Hand him over without a fight,/55d and I/25d will guarantee your lives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/024: (No!/20d We'd be better off fighting together...)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/025: (Cyrano is in danger./25d/nTake him and get out of here!)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/027: (Don't worry,/20d I won't overdo it./30d/nI'll follow soon, so go ahead.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/028: (...All right./35d/nYou must come back./35d I'll be waiting!)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/030: That doesn't seem a very wise choice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01b/032: Once I give my word, I keep it to the end./65d/nI'm only keeping my promise to be of help to him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst01/002: Is Lee Joo Hwan an idiot?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst01/005: I should have explored enough by now.../15d I'd better return for the second stage of training before going any further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx04/000: Libreville/25d lies north of Caracas Forest, which is east of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo02/000: Welcome, Cyrano. Lady Eoline has ordered us to keep a bed ready for you at all times. Would you like to rest?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo02/001: Rest well. Training on Storm Island requires plenty of rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo02/002: Don't push yourself too hard in training.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo02/003: Did you sleep well? Another fine day awaits. Come back whenever you're tired.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/002: Come again! For the glory of Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/003: [Aunt An]/nWelcome! You've been working hard. What are you looking for?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/005: Goodbye, and stay safe on your mission...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/006: Let's see... Have we got anything good today...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/007: These are the officers' quarters, reserved for unit commanders.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/008: Prices at our Zephyr Falcon shops are very low. Not that there's much you need to buy, since basic supplies are issued to us...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/009: If you can sell things for more elsewhere, couldn't you make a tidy profit by buying here and reselling them?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/010: Zephyr Falcon owes much of its success to rallying the people. Clausewitz's propaganda tactics have certainly paid off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/011: The people are suffering, but unless someone opens their eyes, they can even forget how badly they're being treated.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltzy02/013: Take care! I'll find some more good stock for you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldri13/000: << Thunder Nightmare >>/n/nIn the beginning was chaos./nA single flash of lightning pierced it.../nHere is sealed the demon king who governs lightning./n/nYear 705 of the Esghar calendar, Adventurer King Yggd Fein
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro10/000: << Warning >>/nThis dungeon is extremely dangerous. Civilians are forbidden to enter./n- Lord of Ron
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s3t/000: [Iscariot]/nThis is the mighty power of Grima!/60d/nNow,/10d come at me,/25d Cyrano Bernstein!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01b/001: This is our only chance./45d We must reach Geysir Cathedral.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga01b/002: The cathedral is in the eastern part of the city./60d Cesare/30d should be there!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcpr100/001: No... You can't be...!/30d Hey! What are you waiting for? Seize him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/002: Leave the center, where Christina is, untouched! Attack the parts it's using to strike at us!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/003: We did it!! We've destroyed every part it can attack with!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/008: [Mercedes]/nWith my own life, I beg you... Awaken, Christina!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/011: [Cyrano]/nHow... How could you do something so foolish...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy... Why are you apologizing to me, Mercedes...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/020: Even at the end... all I do... is stand... in your way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/023: Cyrano!! The God of Destruction is moving again!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s04/025: Your wishes/35d will never be in vain...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga05/000: Is this the garden from all those years ago...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/000: I've been waiting,/15d Cyrano./20d/nAnd/20d all of you in the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/001: You.../25d how did you get here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/002: More importantly,/20d you must hurry down to the altar/25d/nand change Christina's mind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/003: We must/25d stop the ritual at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/006: I can't believe it./35d Using even his own granddaughter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/007: Cesare wouldn't hesitate to do such a thing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/008: If the God of Destruction is resurrected,/40d/nwe won't be able to thwart Cesare's ambitions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/009: Sharn Hoiste,/35d fight alongside Cyrano in my place./50d/nI think/10d you can help him more than I can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/010: Understood./40d I'll join you all/25d in stopping Cesare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/014: [Isabele]/nI'll keep watch, so rest and recover your strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/015: Then relax, and get some proper rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/016: Hurry to the lowest level./nPlease stop the God of Destruction's resurrection.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/017: I'll stay here and secure our escape route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn31/018: She seems/30d to have volunteered as the sacrifice/35d/nfor the God of Destruction's resurrection, intending to take revenge herself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/001: This/10d is the Bifrost army's supply base/30d that Clausewitz told us about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/005: [Bifrost Officer]/nDamn.../20d The enemy has reached even here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/007: Come on,/30d let's seize this place!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/008: Does that settle matters here, then?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/009: Yes./nThe enemy seems to have fully retreated.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/011: A message has arrived from Clausewitz.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/012: Rhidelhard and Meditch's unexpected actions have allowed the Bifrost army to occupy our supply route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/013: He asks Cyrano and his companions to return to our camp as quickly as possible and retake the supply route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/015: Don't tell me Meditch and Rhidelhard have...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/016: Please retake our supply route as quickly as possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss41/018: [Jackson]/nI'm Jackson. Clausewitz put me in charge of supplying weapons. What do you need?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl25_s03/000: [Diablo]/nYou have made me reveal my true form after centuries,/35d and for that/75d/nnone of you will leave alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/003: Hmm.../30d Has he still not arrived?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/004: Well,/20d Meditch would never turn up on time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/005: Still,/20d what could he suddenly want in a place like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/006: Surrounded by these beautiful flowers,/40d/nyou're lovelier than ever,/35d Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/007: Meditch,/20d are you starting again?/30d/nIf you're sorry enough to flatter me like that,/25d try arriving on time!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/008: Flattery?/5d That's harsh./40d/nI'm always sincere with you, Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/009: If you keep joking, I won't speak to you./50d/nStop fooling around and tell me what this is about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/010: If you insist/25d on taking my words lightly,/20d very well./45d/nI/20d won't speak as though I'm joking anymore.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/011: It's time I/30d made my feelings for you/nclear,/15d Kana.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/013: Stop, stop!/20d That's enough!/25d Please stop!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/014: I'll pretend I didn't hear that./45d/nIf there's nothing else, I'll leave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/015: Kana!/30d This isn't a joke./20d I'm serious./40d/nDo you still not understand how I feel?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/016: .../55dI/15d like you too./30d/nI respect you.../30d and rely on you like a real older brother./40d But...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/017: But.../50d we can't be lovers?/45d/nAm I/20d not worthy/30d of your love?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/019: ...And I/55d already have someone I love./35d/nThough/15d he hasn't accepted me yet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/021: Meditch,/20d please stop./30d/nI don't want something like this to come between us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/022: What.../30d do you see in him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/023: ...Yes,/15d he's strong.../25d/nStronger than me.../15d No,/30d stronger than anyone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/024: [Kana]/nYou're such an idiot!/35d/nI won't speak to you anymore!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/031: You must be fond of flowers./45d/nYou've come to my garden/15d instead of sleeping,/45d even at this late hour.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/036: What?/30d Ah.../40d/nYou mean our coming to help you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/039: Actually,/50d I visit this garden at the same time every day,/35d/nand look over/35d the flowers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/040: And thanks to that habit,/40d here I am,/30d alone with you, Meditch,/30d/nin the middle of the night...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/042: Oh,/15d I'm sorry./35d/nHave I offended you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/043: Ah,/15d no./20d Not at all./25d/nYour joke, Lady Esther,/20d has actually cheered me up.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/048: I've admired you,/45d I have./50d/nMeditch,/50d you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/050: I know.../55d/nYou/25d think I'm a frivolous woman, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/052: Yes./30d Confessing like this to someone/35d I've only met today.../45d/nI can't blame you for thinking me foolish.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/053: But,/25d Meditch./35d Seeing you here before me,/45d/nI can't contain my feelings...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/057: Will you.../45d escort me/20d back to my room...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s06/059: I don't want to spoil our.../35d/nthe good relationship we all share.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro12/000: Twelve years since I first took up a sword as a child,/nthe martial path remains long and arduous./nYet every path lies within the heart./nCleave doubt with a single stroke, and all becomes clear./n/nCarl Steiner found the way of the sword here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltme02/000: This seems to be a dead end.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma14a/000: Mount Mantigoa.../50d The summit is in sight now./50d/nLet's attack the enemy headquarters up there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma14a/001: Cesare is fleeing toward the summit!/45d We must pursue him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga04a/002: The Fire Dragon Cave is just ahead!/25d/nAll right,/15d let's go!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwga04a/003: We're here to find treasure./35d/nWe must go to the Fire Dragon Cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/000: Well, well... Why is the man of the hour/nwandering around in a place like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/001: I wish you well with Mercedes./15d/nHeh... Every son of a prominent Geysir family/nmust have thought of her at least once.../nYou're a lucky man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/002: If you ever make her cry,/nyou'll answer to me./nUnderstand?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/003: Ah, Cyrano./nI'm very interested in the kidnapping of a boy named Sid,/nwhich I heard about at your home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/004: Why did they abduct the boy, keep him for three days,/nand do nothing more?/nAnd why did they drug him so that he's still unconscious?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/005: The whole affair is full of questions./nAbove all, the motive is suspicious./nWhy...? There's something behind this,/nbut I don't know what.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/007: Around the corner, waiting still,/nA new road and a secret door./nThough I have often passed them by,/nOne day, when the time has come,/nWest of the moon, east of the sun,/nI'll walk that hidden path.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/008: /nA Elbereth Gilthoniel!/nSilivren penna miriel/nO menel aglar elenath!/nGilthoniel, A! Elbereth!/nWe remember,/nThough we dwell far away beneath the trees,/nThe starlight upon the western sea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber08/009: Sid... Was he reading this book?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/001: [Soldier]/nMake way for the lord!/35d Clear the road!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/005: I'll never forget that face, even in death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/006: You must be from out of town./80d/nYou don't know the famous Duke Ruben Bernstein?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/007: Excuse me,/35d who was that in the carriage?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/010: No, let's watch a little longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/011: Cyrano,/25d I think it's too late to follow the carriage./20d/nI can't see where it went.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/012: Damn.../40d There's nothing we can do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/013: They said there's a burning at the stake tomorrow,/40d so we'll look for an opportunity then./70d/nFor now,/20d let's find somewhere to stay tonight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/015: He's notorious for his cruelty./50d He's come here/30d/nto preside over tomorrow's burning at the stake.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/016: Ruben Bernstein...?!/50d That wretch is a duke?/40d/nAnd on top of that,/20d he's using the Bernstein name?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl06_s02/021: Why not/15d wait for tomorrow's burning?/30d/nThey said the lord would be there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka03a/000: North - Caracas Region/nSouth - Paro Region/nWest - Geysir City, Pretoria Region
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/000: Sid briefly regained consciousness after he returned./nHe said he had a message for you, young master, and told me this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/002: He must have been having a nightmare./nThat's how much he cares about you, young master./nSuch a good boy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/003: Sid was terribly excited just before he was kidnapped./nHe seemed angry too.../nHe said he'd discovered something extraordinary...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/004: He said he'd tell me once he had solid evidence./nBut he was kidnapped that very day,/nand he's still in a coma.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/006: Sid is my age, but he knows a great deal./nStill, he has a rather unrealistic dream.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/007: He dreams of becoming a scholar at the Imperial Academy/nlike you, Master Cyrano. Heh... Someone of his station.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber11/008: Perhaps it was his curiosity/nthat put him in danger this time?/nSid loves uncovering secrets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/003: Yes./30d Fortunately, we suffered no losses./30d/nMost injuries are minor.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/004: Haha,/45d the operation was a success.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/005: Then, as planned,/15d disperse here/30d/nand proceed to the second rendezvous point!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/009: You were late, so I was worried.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/010: Hehe,/40d doesn't that happen all the time?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/011: What/15d do you intend to do now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/012: If you have no other plans,/30d/nwhy not join our Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/013: I'm sorry./40d There's something I must do now./40d/nSomething very important...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/014: I see,/30d then it can't be helped.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/016: Captain Meditch.../15d was that your name?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/018: I'll never forget/35d this kindness as long as I live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/019: Haha!/45d I appreciate that,/25d/nbut I only did what any member of the Zephyr Falcon should.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/020: Still, while we're here,/30d let's exchange names./50d/nI'm the Zephyr Falcon's First Unit captain,/40d Roberto de Meditch!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/021: I see./30d/nCyrano,/25d I wish you luck.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/023: The sky... for the first time in 13 years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/024: This beautiful night sky/45d is unchanged since then, and yet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s08/028: We oppose the Church's forces, steeped in corruption,/50d/nand set the world right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/000: Ruben's mother had long enjoyed the master's favor...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/001: Come to think of it, the former mistress was a kind woman.../nEven knowing what happened...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/002: Oh, dear... What a loose tongue I have. Hee hee hee...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/003: You know Sid, Jean's son?/nI hear he was kidnapped on his way back/nfrom a neighboring village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/004: The police found him three days after his kidnapping and brought him back,/nbut the strange thing is that during those three days,/nthe kidnappers never contacted anyone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/005: Isn't it strange?/nSid was definitely kidnapped,/nso why did the kidnappers make no demands?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber06/005_3: Isn't it strange?/nSid was definitely kidnapped,/nso why did the kidnappers make no demands?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma11/000: << Crystal Unicorn >>/n/nThe celestial unicorn is a symbol of purity./nOnly one with the purest and noblest soul can win its heart./n/nAdventurer Largo
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/002: So they were secretly building a magic machine here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/003: Thank goodness we found it before it was finished!/35d/nDestroy it right now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/004: The Church is even building magic machines...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/005: As I thought,/25d Cardinal Cesare/20d/nseems to be planning something big.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/006: Everyone,/20d please./35d/nLet me join the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/007: Huh?/25d/nYou can't/15d spring something like that on us...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/008: But,/30d why do you want to join our cause?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/009: It's difficult to explain in detail.../45d/nBut I wholeheartedly share your ideals./40d/nPlease let me/10d join the Zephyr Falcon!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/010: Hmm.../35d Still,/20d we can't decide on our own...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni12/011: For now,/20d let's return to base together/15d and consult our strategist./30d/nWould that be all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/004: Please.../35d don't look at me like that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/006: But/35d your beauty/25d/nisn't just in your appearance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/007: You/25d always grieve over others' misfortunes/35d/nas though they were your own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/008: Do you know how that beautiful heart/45d/nmakes you/15d even more lovable?/35d/nMercedes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/010: I know how much your father's affairs.../40d/nhave always hurt you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/011: But now/40d/nI'll share your hardships,/20d your sorrows,/35d all of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/013: No one/30d understands how I feel./45d/nNot even Father...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/014: If I could stay forever with you, who understands me so well,/45d/njust as we are today...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/015: Don't worry, Mercedes./45d/nNot even death/30d could separate us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/016: I promise to love you forever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/017: Will you trust me/45d and come with me?/30d Mercedes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/018: Cyrano,/45d you're all I have./60d/nPlease stay/35d by my side forever.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/019: Yes,/40d let's stay together forever./50d/nWhatever happens...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl00_s09/023: [Butler]/nThe engagement ceremony/15d is about to begin./35d Everyone is/nwaiting for you both,/30d so please come into the hall.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmro01/002: To reach Bordeaux,/25d go through Ron City, west of here,/30d then head north.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/001: This is a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/002: They say Geysir City lies to the south.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword?/nSuch tremendous force!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/011: David?/nI hear he was caught hiding an evil demon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/012: David was a fool to shelter Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/013: Perhaps having the Church here would be better./nRuben seems to do whatever he pleases now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/015: Why is there no church in our village?/nBecause Lord Ruben opposed building one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/016: We follow the faith of the Church of the Lord God here too./nBut Lord Ruben said we could each believe as we pleased,/nand had no need for a church.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/017: Lord Ruben presides over the religious trials himself, of course.../nPoor David...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/019: Refinement and romance/nare the true pleasures of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/020: I don't share Ruben's hobby/nof building secret passages everywhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/022: I hear the sun stays up so long in the desert/nthat it seems fixed in one place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01a/023: Ramon, lord of Pretoria, is notorious for his strange behavior./nBut Duke Ruben here is no better...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/002: Argh,/20d this is infuriating!/35d/nHow can a frog be so quick?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/003: If I can't catch that frog...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/006: What's wrong?/15d You suddenly ran off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/009: Oh no.../50d We've completely lost it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/011: You're/20d really slow on the uptake./40d/nCheck your pockets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/014: Aah!/20d The equipment I only just bought yesterday/15d is all...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/016: It's probably in that frog's belly.../40d I think.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/018: I'd heard rumors of a frog/15d that steals things and sells them,/50d/nbut I never thought it was real...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/021: I went through so much trouble/20d to buy those mithril rounds.../30d/nUgh!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/024: Don't worry!/30d/nOnce we find the treasure,/25d a few bullets will be nothing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/026: Haha!/50d Forget the theft, Kana./35d/nLet's find the treasure and make up for it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/027: According to the treasure map,/30d/nthe treasure/20d should be in the Fire Dragon Cave, in the heart of Geysir Forest...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/028: Argh!/20d After this,/15d I'll find that treasure as fast as I can!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s03/029: First,/25d we must go through Geysir City to reach the forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/000: Not just anyone can enter the cathedral!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/001: Entry to the cathedral is restricted at present.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/002: The cathedral is sacred ground. It is certainly not a place just anyone can enter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/003: Dear me... The trouble with people these days is that their faith is so weak.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/004: Divine power must manifest itself strongly, so that their faith grows stronger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/005: Anyone who doubts the faith proves they have none! They have already been led astray by evil!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/006: Unconditional faith is true love for God! You must believe!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltga03/002_3: The cathedral is sacred ground. It is certainly not a place just anyone can enter.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/011: [Cyrano]/nWhy would you.../40d do something so foolish...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/013: [Cyrano]/nWhy.../45d why are you apologizing to me...?/15d/nMercedes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/018: My father.../55d please forgive my father...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/019: [Cyrano]/n.../45dAll right, Mercedes.../55d I will/15d forgive him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/020: Even at the end.../55d all I do.../55d is get.../20d in your way...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/023: Cyrano!/20d The God of Destruction is moving again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/024: You just won't stay down...!/60d This time, I'll finish you for good!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/026: [Cyrano]/nMercedes.../55d The more I think of you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl23_s05/027: [Cyrano]/nHow could I forgive Cesare/50d/nfor causing you such pain...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/001: Damn, how did I end up like this?/nSuffering all this over taxes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/002: Cardinal Cesare has gone too far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/003: Oh... It's an honor to meet you, Esmeralda.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/005: Such a handsome boy, with the courage to stand against the Church.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/006: Chris is so handsome./nI wonder if he has a sweetheart? Hee hee hee...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/007: It's a relief to have Esmeralda here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/008: You don't know Saint Esmeralda...?/nYou've still got plenty to learn, Chris! Hehe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/009: [Esmeralda]/nLeave this to me, and hurry to the Church fortress...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/010: [Esmeralda]/nThese poor people.../50d How much must they have suffered?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/011: Strange.../45d There are no enemies here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/014: [???]/nBy the look of you,/30d you're not with the Church...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/023: Be good.../35d Just bear with it a little longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/031: She's/15d the empire's finest doctor,/25d/na helper of the poor,/30d/nSaint Esmeralda!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/033: Now,/30d don't overexert yourself, all right?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/036: Oh,/10d honestly!/20d/nI was about to say we're the Zephyr Falcon,/25d but you interrupted me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/039: Who are you?/45d/nAnd the people behind you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/041: We were imprisoned beneath the church,/50d/nand this boy, Chris, rescued us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/042: The Church has gone so far/25d as to demand a toll at the village/nentrance. We all came to protest,/25d and then...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/043: I know it's rude to ask so suddenly,/30d but please!/35d/nWould you fight alongside me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/044: Why do you want to fight the Church's forces?/50d/nYou seem too young to concern yourself with the world's affairs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/045: Age doesn't matter!/20d/nBut.../40d I can't tell you my reason yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/046: Well,/15d suit yourself./30d/nJust/15d stay out of the way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/047: I/15d will stay here a while and care for these people.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/048: Some of them still seem to need treatment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/049: Then,/35d we'll leave this in your care.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/051: Let's go!/35d/nI have the key to the western building.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcni08/057: [Esmeralda]/nI wish there were something I could do to help besides healing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/001: Foolish./45d/nTo dare challenge me/30d with skills like those.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/007: Oh,/25d are you with that weakling too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/011: Deimos,/20d and the Black Prince's aura too.../80d/nWho in the world are you?!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/012: No,/30d fists speak louder than words./75d/nCome at me./30d I'll uncover your identity myself!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/013: Cyrano Bernstein.../45d/nSo the rumors that you're alive were true.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/014: Lord Irus,/20d he's no ordinary man./30d/nYou should be careful...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/001_3: Fool. You dare come against me...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/011_3: Hehehe... Deimos./nSo this is how you intend to oppose me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/012_3: Then... I'll show you my true form!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/013_3: Cyrano... So the rumors were true. You're alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka03b/014_3: Lord Irus, he's no ordinary human. You should take some care...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/000: Clausewitz,/40d why did you ask us to meet here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/001: What do you mean?/40d/nDidn't you,/20d Cyrano, ask us to join you here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/002: You weren't the one/50d who changed the meeting place...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/003: Ah.../55d No wonder I had a bad feeling...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/005: To fall for such a childish trick...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s07/010: We'll/20d be easy targets here!/30d/nTake cover, quickly!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp104/000: These stairs lead to the second floor./nWe should search the basement first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcp104/002: Who are you to cause a disturbance in this lord's mansion?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/001: This is a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/002: Have you visited Geysir City, to the south?/nI've been once. It's wonderful!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/003: Our tavern's chef, Karg, is a little strange./n/15dHe travels all over in search of ingredients/nfor new dishes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/004: General Kars of the old empire defeated the strongest Dark Dragon/nand earned the title Dragon Slayer, didn't he?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/008: It's easy to lose your way in the desert, but hard to find it again./nEspecially without a good guide...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/009: Have you ever seen Lord Irus wield a sword?/nSuch tremendous force!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/010: Oh? I haven't seen you before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/011: David?/nI hear he was caught hiding an evil demon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/012: The dungeons scattered across the old Geysir lands/ncontain many treasures hidden by nobles long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/013: Perhaps having the Church here would be better./nRuben seems to do whatever he pleases now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/015: Churches aren't usually built near villages./nInstead, they build monasteries deep in the mountains.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/016: What good does that do?/nMost of the clergy still come to the village and meddle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/017: Shh... Get on the Church's bad side, and you won't survive...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/019: Refinement and romance are the true joys/nof life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/020: Ruben's men are all cowards./nThey attack whoever has the lowest HP first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/021: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/022: I hear the sun stays up so long in the desert/nthat it seems fixed in one place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/023: Ramon, lord of Pretoria,/nis notorious for his strange behavior./nBut Duke Ruben here is no better...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/025: So he's often away from the shop./nBut his cooking really is delicious.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/026: [Chef Karg]/nTrue cuisine comes from good ingredients, the chef's skill,/nand care./nBring me fine ingredients and I'll reward you generously.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/027: [Chef Karg] /nWithout good ingredients,/neven the finest cooking skills/nare useless.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/029: [Chef Karg]/nWe come from a family of chefs./nMy brothers are scattered far and wide./nIf you meet them, give them my regards.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/030: Isn't it incredible?/nTo kill a Dark Dragon with just one sword!!/n/20dI'll study swordsmanship hard, and one day/nbecome a great swordsman like General Kars!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/031: But.../ndon't dragons hoard magnificent gems?/n/20dI wonder if General Kars found those gems.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/032: My father's a traveling merchant,/nso I visit all sorts of places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/033: Keep heading northeast and you'll reach Libreville./nIt's a very strange city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/034: Hehehe... Did you know?/nI once found an incredible treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/035: But after going there once, I could never get back!/n/15dWhat do I do?/5d What do I do?/5d What do I do?/5d My treasure!/5d My treasure!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/036: I'm sure,/10d I'm sure,/10d/nit was somewhere around here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/037: Trust yourself in the desert./n/10dOnce you start doubting yourself,/nyou won't survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/039: [Jane]/nAh... I hate being nagged.../nDespite appearances, I do what needs doing. Don't worry...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/040: [Jane]/nShh! Looks like there may be a good opportunity today...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/041: [Jane]/nWho are you?/nIf you're here to lecture me about where I should go, get lost!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/042: Jane? She used to be a good girl,/nbut she's been like this since her mother disappeared./nPoor thing...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/043: They say entering the cave means risking your life.../nIt's very dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/044: What's truly frightening isn't the enemies in a dungeon,/nbut running out of equipment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/050: Catalina, the swordswoman from Bifrost, is a distant relative of ours.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/053: Bring me something good, and I'll give you something good in return.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/054: I only trade one item for one item.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/055: The forest near our village leads to many other villages.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/056: There's even a route across the desert to Cerepus./nBut stay out of the desert. It's an easy place to die.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/057: Libreville is strange./nDespite being so far north, its weather is always mild.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/059: Welcome to the Caracas Inn./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/060: Thank you. Enjoy a restful stay...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/061: Why talk to me if you're not going to stay?/nAre you interested in me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/062: Thank you for staying with us./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/063: Oh... the Ultimate Mushroom!/nThe one that only grows deep in caves untouched by human hands!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/064: Thank you, thank you so much./nNow, I should give you something in return...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/068: [Chef Karg]/nOh... isn't this Love Herb?!/nThat precious spice that draws its essence/nfrom places where true love has blossomed!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/069: [Chef Karg]/nThank you, thank you so much!/nPlease take this in return!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/070: Gasp! This is... the ultimate spice, Higashi!/nThe legendary spice of the Tuer.../nWhere did you find something so precious?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/071: Thank you so much for finding it.../nI should give you something in return...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/072: Plenty of edible fruit grows around here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/073: John gathered a strange mushroom recently./nHe says it came from deep in the cave near our village.../nIt smelled wonderful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/074: We should find somewhere to stay first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/076: [Miss Moncrief]/nWelcome, and thank you for visiting our inn./nWould you like to stay? A room costs 80 ELD.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/078: Oh... Please stay with us another time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/079: Thank you for staying at our inn./nPlease visit us again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/080: [Elgi]/nWelcome. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/082: Thank you for visiting our shop./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/083: [Mr. Joseph]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/086: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome. Our specialty is the Swordbreaker./nIt's excellent value for money,/nso be sure to buy at least one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/087: One Thousand and One Nights Weapon Shop
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/088: A good weapon is essential to a warrior. Thank you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/089: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our shop./nFor spears and swords, please speak to my wife.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/090: One Thousand and One Nights Weapon Shop
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/091: You can rely on our wares. Come again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/092: Is there anything else to eat?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/094: [Arena Owner]/nHahaha! A man must build his strength!/nGive our arena a try!/nBut this is real combat. If you die, I take no responsibility.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/096: All the goods we have for sale/nhave been moved to the accessory shop.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/097: [Mr. Hercule]/nHahaha!/nOur village arena is ideal for combat training!/nA man needs strength, doesn't he?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/099: Thank you! If you get the chance, visit the arena/nmy older brother runs in Ron!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/101: Give your ticket to that fellow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/102: A single-use pass. Go right in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/103: A lifetime pass. Go right in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/104: As Vigor (XP) rises, a character's Attack and Defense rise together. Defending also builds XP, so if you're at a disadvantage, defend and hold on./n- Tactical Research Society of Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/105: Weapons can break easily, depending on their properties. Always carry spares./n- Tactical Research Society of Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/106: Maps of the former imperial lands are inaccurate. Make your own maps when traveling through forests or mountain paths./n- Imperial Geographical Society of Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/107: Poor David... He's the one left to suffer./nTo be burned at the stake...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/108: David is to be burned at the stake/non charges of sheltering the Zephyr Falcon. Poor man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/112: You can't enter without a ticket.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/113: Your ticket, please. No ticket, no entry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/114: Weapon information is explained below./nWeapon Durability: The weapon's durability. When damage exceeds its Weapon Limit, its Durability drops by 1. At 0 Durability, the weapon breaks. Repairs restore Weapon Durability.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/115: Attack: The weapon's attack power. A character's Attack is determined by the weapon's Attack and the character's Strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/116: Defense: When the weapon blocks an attack, it reduces the damage by this percentage. Remember, it's a percentage, not a fixed amount!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/117: Did that fellow explain the preceding information?/nThen I'll explain the next value./nWeapon Limit is the maximum damage a weapon can withstand without losing Durability. Defense, Weapon Limit and Weapon Durability together determine how long a weapon lasts.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/118: Next is Hit Rate, the weapon's chance to land an attack. Weapons also have a hidden Block Rate, so their chances of blocking differ. A block makes the weapon take the damage, so weapons with high Block Rate can break more easily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/119: Our branch of Geysir Academy's Sword Research Society/nis in western Caracas./nPay us a visit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/120: What a pleasant village./45d/nFirst,/20d let's hear what the villagers have to say.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/121: Hmph... Ruben's men are all cowardly scum.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/122: In battle, they target the weakest members of our party./nCowardly, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/123: Though you can turn that against them and beat them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/001_3: This is a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/002_3: Have you visited Geysir City, to the south?/nI've been once. It's beautiful!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/003_3: Our tavern's chef, Karg, is a little strange./nHe travels all over in search of ingredients/nfor new dishes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/004_3: Have you heard that Kars/nonce killed a dragon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/007_3: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/008_3: It's easy to lose your way in the desert, but hard to find it again./nEspecially without a good guide...

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/019_3: Refinement and romance/nare the true pleasures of life here in Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/021_3: I came here from Pretoria on business.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/023_3: Ramon, lord of Pretoria,/nis notorious for his strange behavior./nBut Duke Ruben here is no better...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/030_3: Isn't it incredible? To kill a dragon!!/nI'll study swordsmanship hard and become a great swordsman like Kars someday!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/032_3: My father's a traveling merchant,/nso I visit all sorts of places.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/033_3: Keep heading northeast and you'll reach Libreville./nIt's a very strange city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/034_3: Hehehe... Did you know?/nI once found an incredible treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/035_3: But after going there once, I could never get back!/nWhat do I do? What do I do? What do I do? My treasure! My treasure!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/036_3: I'm sure... I'm sure it was somewhere near here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/037_3: Trust yourself in the desert./nOnce you start doubting yourself, you won't survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/043_3: You'd have to risk your life to enter that cave.../nIt's very dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/057_3: Libreville is strange./nIt's so far north, yet so warm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/068_3: Oh... isn't this Love Herb?!/nThat precious spice that draws its essence/nfrom places where true love has blossomed!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/069_3: Thank you, thank you so much!/nPlease take this in return!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/076_3: [Miss Moncrief]/nWelcome, and thank you for visiting our inn./nWould you like to stay? A room costs 80 ELD.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/080_3: [Elgi]/nWelcome. Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/086_3: [Mrs. Simpson]/nWelcome. Choose any weapon you like./nWe offer fine weapons at low prices.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/089_3: [Mr. Simpson]/nWelcome to our shop./nTake your time choosing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01/091_3: You can rely on our wares. Come again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/001: The only God of Destruction left on the surface is sealed in this underwater city. You're very lucky.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/002: Hehe, calling it luck is a bit much. You have no idea how much effort I put into finding this God of Destruction.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/003: But be careful. The God of Destruction has immense power, and even we can't control it properly. One mistake, and we could become its victims.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/004: That's why I'm here, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/006: Still, I really didn't expect you to agree to my request so readily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/007: I'll do anything if it lets me kill that enemy of mine, Cyrano, with my own hands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/008: I don't want to waste another moment. Let's begin the ritual at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl17_s04/009: That's the spirit. Shall we begin?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/000: After that,/25d I spent over a year/25d learning Pendragon swordsmanship from her./60d/nEoline Pendragon, a great swordswoman of her age,/40d taught me not only the kingdom's sword techniques,/45d/nbut many spells and skills as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/001: Well, are you ready to begin your training?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/005: [Eoline]/nYou haven't trained enough for the next lesson yet./nGo farther afield and return.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/006: [Eoline]/nVenture farther on your training journeys./nThe farther you go from here, the more you'll learn.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/007: [Eoline]/nI've told the child in the house,/nso go inside and rest when you're tired.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/010: Lesson 1: Sword Types and Combat Basics
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/011: [Eoline]/nToday, I'll begin teaching you about tactics.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/012: [Eoline]/nMy teaching alone won't solve everything,/nbut you mustn't ignore theory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/013: [Eoline]/nFirst, I'll briefly explain how swords are classified.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/014: [Eoline]/nSwords fall into four types: rapiers, heavy swords, longswords and greatswords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/015: [Eoline]/nRapiers are light, sharp and slender. Heavy swords are short,/nthick and weighty. Longswords are the common long blades. Greatswords/nare, as the name suggests, large swords with long, broad blades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/016: [Eoline]/nOrdinary longswords are the easiest to handle,/nbut rapiers and heavy swords matter more tactically.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/017: [Eoline]/nA greatsword is the strongest sword if you can wield it,/nbut finding a good one won't be easy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/018: [Eoline]/nRapiers and heavy swords are tactically important because of their/ndistinctive properties: rapiers excel in attack, heavy swords in defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/019: [Eoline]/nThat's enough about sword classes for now./nI'll explain rapiers and heavy swords in more detail later.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/020: [Eoline]/nI'll finish today's lesson with a few things/nto remember in actual combat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/021: [Eoline]/nFirst, always consider the enemy's distance and direction. That applies to every fighting method, not just swordsmanship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/022: [Eoline]/nAlways watch your distance from your opponent, and never turn your back on them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/023: [Eoline]/nIf an opponent attacks as expected, you may even evade a strike from behind. But a true swordsman should fight every moment as though facing someone stronger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/024: [Eoline]/nChivalry may forbid the cowardice of striking an opponent from behind,/nbut if survival comes first, it's a tactic you cannot overlook.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/025: [Eoline]/nSecond, know your enemy's strengths and weaknesses./nIt sounds simple, but putting it into practice in battle is difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/026: [Eoline]/nKnowing an enemy's strengths lets you choose the right defense/nand improve your chance of blocking. Knowing their weaknesses improves your chance of landing an attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/027: [Eoline]/nFor example, mages resist magic well,/nso ordinary spells have difficulty defeating them,/nbut they are vulnerable to swords and bullets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/028: [Eoline]/nMarksmen use guns, giving them long range and high Attack. But their Defense is little better than a mage's, and they're extremely vulnerable to magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/029: [Eoline]/nWeaknesses take many other forms too,/nso you'll need to study them through combat experience.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/030: [Eoline]/nRemember these two points./nNext time, I'll explain combat techniques in more detail.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/031: [Eoline]/nGain some combat experience and return./nThen I'll teach you about magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/032: [Eoline]/nDon't try to do too much at first./nBuild your experience a little at a time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/033: [Eoline]/nOh, and I'll give you a map.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/034: [Eoline]/nIt's a map of the continent of Antalya./nStorm Island is on it too, so it should help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/036: [Eoline]/nAnd here's a dagger for you./nDon't forget to equip it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/041: [Eoline]/nYou've gained a little combat experience,/nso now I'll explain magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/042: [Eoline]/nI mentioned weaknesses earlier,/nbut learning varied methods of attack/nis just as important as mastering one technique.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/043: [Eoline]/nYou seem to know some magic already.../nWhat spells can you use?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/044: I know a little dark magic, taught to me by Deimos.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/045: [Eoline]/nThen learning my magic shouldn't be difficult./nI'll teach you Ice magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/046: [Eoline]/nBefore teaching you, I'll explain the schools of magic/nthat exist in this land.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/047: [Eoline]/nMagic has six main schools. Fire, Ice and Lightning are known as the three elemental schools.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/048: [Eoline]/nThen there's Dark magic, said to draw on the Dark God's power,/nHoly magic, said to draw on the Lord God's power,/nand Support magic, believed to derive from Holy magic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/049: [Eoline]/nThe three elemental schools counter one another:/nFire is weak against Ice, Ice against Lightning,/nand Lightning against Fire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/050: [Eoline]/nDark and Holy magic oppose each other independently of the three elements. In that matchup, whoever attacks first has the advantage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/051: [Eoline]/nSupport magic manipulates time and space./nIt has no affinity relationship with the other five schools.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/052: [Eoline]/nThese schools appear not only in magic,/nbut sometimes as properties of other things,/nso be sure to remember them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/053: [Eoline]/nMonster affinities are the most common example.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/054: [Eoline]/nFor example, attack a Fire monster/nwith Ice magic or an Ice weapon,/nand you can deal twice the damage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/055: [Eoline]/nAttack it with Fire instead, and it won't take damage:/nit will absorb the attack and recover. Lightning is weak against Fire and does little damage, so be careful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/056: [Eoline]/nNow I'll teach you Ice magic./nPut it to good use in battle./nThe next lesson will cover rapiers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/061: [Eoline]/nThis time, I'll explain sword attacks and rapiers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/062: [Eoline]/nLast time, I briefly explained rapiers and heavy swords./nDo you remember what distinguishes a rapier?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/063: You said it was a light sword focused on attack,/nbut weak in defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/064: [Eoline]/nYes. It's light, easy to handle and powerful,/nwith a high Critical Rate. But it's too slender and/nlight to block damage well, and it breaks easily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/065: Then it might be better not to block at all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/066: [Eoline]/nPut bluntly, yes. But its Attack is so high that a successful first strike can win the battle before the enemy/ncan properly counterattack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/067: [Eoline]/nIt's a gamble, but rapiers offer excellent Attack for their price. If you have enough money, carrying plenty and using them like consumables can be a sound tactic.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/069: [Eoline]/nI'll explain switching weapons in more detail next time./nFor now, use this Assault Sword to practice/nbasic rapier tactics.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/076: [Eoline]/nHow did you find the rapier? Was it useful?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/077: It was very powerful,/nbut it broke so easily that I couldn't use it for long.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/078: [Eoline]/nYes. That's because of what we call a 'breakthrough.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/080: [Eoline]/nWhen an enemy attacks, the defender instinctively tries to block. No one can block every attack,/nbut let's assume for now that the defender can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/081: [Eoline]/nThe attack first meets the defender's weapon./nIn other words, the weapon serves as the first barrier/nagainst an enemy's attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/082: [Eoline]/nBut, as with everything,/nthe outcome depends on which side is stronger.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/084: [Eoline]/nExactly. The greatest attack a weapon can withstand/nis called its Weapon Limit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/085: [Eoline]/nIf you block an attack above your Weapon Limit,/nyou take the excess damage,/nand the weapon is damaged.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/086: [Eoline]/nAn attack that gets through the defender's weapon to deal damage/nis called a 'breakthrough.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/087: [Eoline]/nEach breakthrough reduces Weapon Durability by 1. If it reaches 0, the weapon becomes unusable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/088: [Eoline]/nRapiers maximize Attack, but their Weapon Limit/nis extremely low, and they have only 1 or 2 points of Weapon Durability./nThat's why they break so easily in battle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/089: [Eoline]/nFortunately, a weapon can be repaired even after it breaks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/090: Then are rapiers useless in battle?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/091: [Eoline]/nNo./nRapiers are chiefly useful for attacks at long range.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/092: [Eoline]/nThey're especially useful when several allies fight together and divide/ntheir roles. But they're less suitable when you face/nseveral enemies alone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/093: [Eoline]/nDo you understand defense now?/nThen put what you've learned into practice./nYou'll need to venture a little farther this time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/094: [Eoline]/nNext time, I'll explain heavy swords, the opposite of rapiers,/nand teach you more advanced defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/101: [Eoline]/nYour swordsmanship has reached at least an intermediate level./nNow let's review the theory of heavy swords and defense.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/102: [Eoline]/nWhen explaining breakthroughs, I assumed that 'the defender blocks the attacker's strike perfectly.'/nIn a real battle, though, you can't block every attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/103: Yes. I couldn't block every attack.
