Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/104: [Eoline]/nYour chance of blocking depends on your weapon type/nand your Agility.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/105: [Eoline]/nRapiers aren't suited to defense,/nso they can't block many attacks. Heavy swords have properties/nthat increase your chance of blocking.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/106: [Eoline]/nWeapons also have a property called Defense./nWhen you block, the weapon's Defense reduces/nthe enemy's attack by a certain percentage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/107: [Eoline]/nRapiers have low Defense, while heavy swords have high Defense./nAgainst the same attack, a heavy-sword user takes/nless damage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/108: Then is it wiser to use a heavy sword?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/109: [Eoline]/nRapiers and heavy swords aren't the only types,/nbut that's generally true.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/110: [Eoline]/nA heavy sword gives you an advantage when facing several enemies alone/nor fighting in confined spaces.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/111: [Eoline]/nNow I'll explain the defensive stance. When enemy attacks focus on you,/nit helps you wait for your allies' support/nor draw the enemy's attention.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/112: [Eoline]/nA defensive stance doubles your chance/nof blocking an enemy attack. If you hold a heavy sword,/nit will make you safer still.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/114: [Eoline]/nThat brings us near the end of the lesson. Why not enter the cave this time?/nRemember what you've learned./nAs for a sword... use this.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/117: [Eoline]/nIt's a basic heavy sword, but it should block attacks from the creatures in the cave. Next time, I'll explain tactics for fighting with companions/nand switching weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/121: [Eoline]/nYou seem to have a feel for fighting alone now. But wars involve many people. In time, you'll fight alongside companions too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/122: [Eoline]/nWhen fighting with companions, it's important to divide your roles.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/123: [Eoline]/nSend a companion with a heavy sword into the enemy ranks/nto block attacks and draw their attention,/ngiving your other allies an opening.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/124: [Eoline]/nMeanwhile, allies with rapiers or other swords with high Attack,/nand those using magic or guns, can strike from the rear/nwhile the companion in front draws the enemy's attention,/nand wipe them out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/125: Won't the one charging ahead be in danger?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/126: [Eoline]/nHeavy swords have strong Defense, so unless the enemy is overwhelmingly/npowerful, it won't be too dangerous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/127: [Eoline]/nBut it's difficult to deal damage with a heavy sword, so to 'win' a battle, you'll need your companions'/nhelp.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/129: [Eoline]/nNow, equipment switching. Besides what you hold in your hands,/nyou can carry two pieces of reserve equipment. You know that, don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/130: [Eoline]/nYou can exchange held weapons and reserve equipment even during battle. Usually, they're 'backups' in case a weapon breaks,/nbut switching lets you fight alone/nwith the effect of several allies working together.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/131: So it's a way to use two or more weapons/nwith different properties together.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/132: [Eoline]/nExactly. Carry a heavy sword and a rapier together./nUse the rapier when enemies are few or far away,/nand switch to the heavy sword when you must close in/nand fight.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/133: [Eoline]/nYou can still move and attack after switching swords, making this a useful/ntactic. Rapiers are especially good for finishing enemies/noff once you've subdued them somewhat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/134: [Eoline]/nBut remember, when wielding a heavy sword,/nmagic may sometimes be more effective than a sword attack.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/135: [Eoline]/nThat completes the explanation of ordinary attacks./nOnly special moves remain:/nthe ultimate techniques of swordsmanship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/136: [Eoline]/nUse special moves properly and you'll find that even powerful enemies/nare no match for you./nThis time, venture deep into the cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/141: [Eoline]/nThere are two main traditions/nof swordsmanship in Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/142: [Eoline]/nOne centers on the Kingdom of Pendragon, the other on the Geysir Empire./nThey're called the Kingdom and Imperial styles./nThe Kingdom style emphasizes speed; the Imperial style, strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/143: [Eoline]/nImperial special moves use force to break through the enemy's guard/nand aim for a single killing blow. Kingdom special moves overwhelm/nthe enemy with unexpected, rapid attacks in succession.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/144: [Eoline]/nAs a former scholar, you're better suited to the Kingdom style, which values technique over strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/145: [Eoline]/nLet's take Vacuum Shura Blade, a basic Kingdom special move, as an example.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/146: [Eoline]/nVacuum Shura Blade and other special moves/nrequire a corresponding amount of Vigor (XP).
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/147: [Eoline]/nVigor is a little like the mana used for spells, but rises whenever you defeat an enemy. Your Attack and Defense rise in proportion to it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/148: [Eoline]/nSpecial moves don't consume Vigor,/nbut your body can't sustain full Vigor for long,/nso it naturally dissipates after a certain time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/149: [Eoline]/nDifferent special moves require different amounts of Vigor./nLearn the others through experience in battle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/150: [Eoline]/nAnd... this is a sword I once used./nIt should help you someday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/153: [Eoline]/nThat's all the theory I can teach you. The rest must come from practice in battle.../nTrain hard, and overcome Asura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/155: Begin Eoline's swordsmanship training?/nSkipping counts as completion and still grants the EXP, items and other rewards available during training.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfliyo01/158: Eoline's instruction granted <color=#FFDE5A>300 EXP</color>./nReceived <color=#6EFDFF>Old Excalibur</color> from Eoline./nReceived <color=#6EFDFF>Old Excalibur</color> from Eoline./nReceived <color=#6EFDFF>Old Excalibur</color> from Eoline./nReceived <color=#6EFDFF>Old Excalibur</color> from Eoline.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst15/000: I don't know whether coming this far is enough training./15d But I'd better return for the third stage before going any further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/000: But in recent years,/nno major forces have headed toward Bifrost,/nso our days have been peaceful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/001: Historically, Antananarivo lay/nnear Bifrost's border,/nand never had a peaceful day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral/nwas built over ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/003: But now... Bifrost itself/nseems intent on expanding outward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/005: I hear there are groups that exaggerate/nthe misconduct of a few clergy members/ninto a problem with all of them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/007: Bands of brigands have been running wild in the desert lately./nI nearly died several times on this trip myself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/009: This is Libreville./nIf Frederick is the lord with the greatest military strength,/nthen Libreville is the best place to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/010: But nowhere seems able to navigate this troubled age/nwithout difficulty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/011: Do you know of the sword Kars is said to have left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/012: There are rumors Sharn Hoiste has appeared nearby.../nWho is that phantom thief, really?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/013: Isn't Sharn Hoiste just a common thief,/nlike the Zephyr Falcon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/015: Perhaps it's only natural/nthat they have fine weapons.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/016: I was once a prisoner of the Tuer/nand saw how they lived./nTheir advanced civilization allowed them/nto build and use/nall sorts of convenient machines.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/017: I'm a devout follower of the Church.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/018: Heh. I'm simply an idle nobleman enjoying the romance of middle age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/019: Cesare seems too intent on doing things his own way/nto achieve imperial unity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/020: That way demands far too many sacrifices...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/021: If my mother isn't my real mother... Could my own younger sibling/nbe living somewhere else, unaware of me?/nAh... how romantic...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/023: They say he won't sell the mirror for money,/nbut only to someone the mirror chooses./nWhat a strange old man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/025: Most monks aren't as corrupt/nas the rumors claim./nOnly a few clergy members are the problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/026: The strongest things often break most easily./nThere's more than one way to solve a problem.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/027: I once saw an old man/nselling an interesting mirror...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/028: It was a mirror that showed you/nwhat you longed for most...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/029: I hate my mom!/nAll she ever does is scold me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/030: I'm sure my mom isn't my real mother./nWhere could my real mother be?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/031: Disguised as a man, Awen crossed the battlefields/nwith the gem's help. Its mysterious power protected her/nas she searched for Al./nHer countless adventures under the name 'Kane'/nmade her famous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/032: In time, Awen discovered/nwhich battlefield Al was on./nShe raced there like the wind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/033: You can hear the next part in Ron./nYou've heard part one at the tavern, part two from the child,/nand part three from me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/034: Bifrost is such an unimpressive country./nI visited once. It was terribly provincial!/nThe countryside through and through!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/035: And why are the people so narrow-minded?/nI simply can't understand them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/036: My mother once told me that the Chaos Cube/nis extremely precious.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/037: Mother says the Chaos Cube's power/nis called a divine gift./nThat's what she says...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/038: Our family has a Chaos Cube passed down as an heirloom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/039: Isn't it thanks to the Chaos Cube/nthat our family can live this well even in times like these?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/040: Isn't Libreville the best place to live/nin the whole empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/041: I've heard that Lord Frederick of Ron/nhas remarkable abilities, but...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/042: They may have military strength,/nbut life is better here...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/043: You think I look like Nicole Kidman in 'Far and Away'?/nOh... Thank you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/044: But you don't look like Tom Cruise, do you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/045: Our family used to live in Pretoria./nBut we fled here because of its lord.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/046: Our lives are fairly stable now,/nbut those memories are a nightmare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/047: Recently, I met children in the same situation as me,/nand I've taken them into my care.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/048: At the bottom of the lake, Awen found/na strangely glowing gem and retrieved it./nThen the star's voice spoke again:/n'With that gem, he will be safe.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/049: Thank you so much for what you did last time./nFor saving our lives... and avenging us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/050: My younger sibling hasn't spoken since the shock of that day.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/051: But I will never, never/nforgive those lords. Never.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/052: All he does is drink, drink, drink!/nI don't know how much longer/nI can put up with this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/053: How can he ever expect to succeed like this?!/nWhy, why, why does he act this way?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/054: I wouldn't have married him if I'd known it would be like this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/055: [Mr. Jones]/nAh... Drink is life's joy and pleasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/056: [Mr. Jones]/nWithout drink,/nI'd have no reason to live.../nWhatever my wife says, I can't help it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/057: [Mr. Jones]/nBesides, I don't even drink that much.../nI don't understand why she hates it so.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/059: To whoever reads this letter:/nWhile clearing out my shop's basement,/nI found a passage to a strange cave./nIt's an extremely complex cave. This time, I intend to prepare/nproperly before entering.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/060: A letter and a key lie on the desk.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/061: There doesn't seem to be anyone in this house.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/062: Is this the arena owner's house the weapons dealer mentioned?/nStrange. The door seems to be open.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/063: [Mr. Jones]/nYou know the tavern down there?/nSave a dying man's life and buy me a drink./nMy wife won't let me go there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/064: Oh, dear... Must you go to such lengths for a drink?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/065: [Mr. Jones]/nCome now... I'll reward you separately./nTake this Brass Gem to the tavern keeper/nand get me a drink.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/068: [Mrs. Jones] Dear! You're not sending someone out for drinks again, are you?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/069: [Mr. Jones]/nNo! Of course not!/n(whispering) Hurry and get it. Hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/070: [Mr. Jones]/nThief! What did you do with my Brass Gem?!/nYou thief!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/071: [Mr. Jones]/nThank you so much.../nIt's not much, but here's your reward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/074: This key looks as though it will fit the arena door.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/075: But Al had already left for the battlefield./nAwen took the gem and, with only a sword to rely on,/nraced to the battlefield where he was fighting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/076: This is the second part./nSomeone else will tell you what happens next./nThe young woman at the tavern told you part one, didn't she?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/078: You... have learned every part of the Chaos Cube's legend./nThen you are worthy of receiving it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/081: There's a beautiful legend about the Chaos Cube...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/082: I love that legend./nBut I only know it from the middle onward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/083: I could tell you if you've heard what came before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/084: Even so, this is a fine place to live!/nOur city's water is excellent!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/085: Well, whichever side it is, I doubt it matters/nto someone as poor as me./nWhat if the rich lose a little money?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/086: We need weapons like that to protect ourselves.../nOh, our village weapons dealer has quite good stock./nIt couldn't hurt to take a look, could it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/087: More shocking still, the people there don't even know/nwhat chocolate is! Chocolate!/nEven if it is a new food brought by the Tuer./nHonestly, I'm speechless...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/088: Mother has never even shown it to me./nShe says I won't be worthy of seeing it until I'm an adult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/089: A saying passed down in our family tells us/nto give the gem to anyone who knows/nevery part of the Chaos Cube's legend./nHave you heard it all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/090: Ho ho ho!/nBut you do look a little like Bruce Willis!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/092: Did you see the great bridge on your way here?/nThat's Libreville Bridge, said to be the most beautiful/nbridge in the old imperial lands.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/093: There's a legend about its construction./nWhenever work was about to begin, heavy rain/nand floods prevented any progress./nA shamaness said, 'The river's guardian spirit will not permit this bridge.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/094: People tried every means of appeasing the river's guardian spirit,/nbut nothing worked./nAt last, they turned to human sacrifice...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/095: Would you like the next part of the bridge's legend?/nPeople sought a maiden to sacrifice for the bridge,/nbut no such girl could be found./nOne day, while construction remained delayed,/na young girl came to the site.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/096: The girl said,/n'I'll make it possible for work to proceed./nIn return, give me this bridge.'/nPeople were puzzled./nThey thought she meant to offer herself to the river god,/nso how could she own the bridge?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/097: After discussing it, the people agreed/nto give her ownership of the bridge./nThe girl laughed in a high voice,/nthen leapt into the river!/nAsk someone else for the next part!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/098: I love legends./nWould you tell me any old stories you know?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/099: Oh... I suppose you'd like to hear the rest of the bridge's story?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/100: Here's what happened next./nThe girl who jumped into the river became a dragon/nand fought the river god./nThe people, who had assumed she would become a sacrifice,/nwatched the battle in terror.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/101: The battle lasted three days and three nights./nDuring that time, earth and sky grew dark,/nand the people could see no light.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/102: When dawn finally came, people saw/nthe girl standing on the riverbank./nAs they approached, she said,/n'From now on, this river belongs to me. Building a bridge would break the former god's spell. I drove the god away so that you could build it.'
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/103: "But you must make this bridge the strongest and most beautiful in the world. It will be the symbol of my ownership of the river, and my spell. If it breaks, I will die, as will you who built it, or your descendants."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/104: Then the girl vanished as though she'd never been there./nThe people worked like mad to build the bridge,/nand the result is the bridge you saw./nWell, did you enjoy the story?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/105: This area lies lower than the surrounding regions/nand is at risk of flooding./nGeysir Geographical Society
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/107: You enjoy stories too, don't you?/nHere, take this./nI found it recently, but it doesn't fit me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/031_3: A friend of mine lives in Paro,/nand says something strange has happened there recently.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/032_3: The son of a powerful family planned to marry someone of another faith,/ndespite the Church's opposition, but suddenly broke off the engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/033_3: Good heavens, can't they even marry if the Church objects?/nHow do those country people put up with such treatment?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/055_3: Ah... drink is one of life's joys and pleasures.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/056_3: Without drink, I'd have no reason to live.../nWhatever my wife says, I can't help it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltri02/057_3: Besides, I don't even drink that much.../nI don't understand why she hates it so.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/000: [Kana]/nCyrano!/35d How could you do this...?/35d/nWhy.../30d why did you kill Christina too...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/001: [Esmeralda]/nI could understand your inability to forgive Esther,/25d up to a/npoint.../50d But Christina/30d was the woman you loved's...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/002: [Silver]/nYou can all afford to talk like that!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/003: [Silver]/nWe were facing the God of Destruction!/45d/nOne wrong move and we'd have been killed!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/004: [Clausewitz]/nCyrano,/40d everyone's faith in you is wavering./50d/nEven I was shocked/35d that you didn't save Christina.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/008: If you're so dissatisfied,/60d why not stop following me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/010: You've gone too far./45d We lost two unit captains because of you./60d/nAnd yet/30d you speak so irresponsibly...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/011: Let me make this clear./65d/nAnyone who questions my actions again/50d will be eliminated.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/014: Esmeralda/50d seems to think my actions were wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/015: ...I'm sorry./40d It seems we/15d pushed you to this point./45d That was my failure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/016: But/30d we have a cause./50d/nYour actions now/30d do not serve the Zephyr Falcon's ideals.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/017: From now on, the Zephyr Falcon/45d will act independently of you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/018: Cyrano.../45d now.../30d I can't trust you anymore...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/019: I've never wanted anyone's trust./75d/nTrust/30d only gets in the way of my revenge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/020: You all heard that?/40d We don't need objections./50d/nWell?/20d Who still wants to follow us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s01/023: Enough, Silver./45d There's no reason to delay./45d/nWe're going after Cesare.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/000: Did you enjoy your meal?/50d/nI hope the food was to your liking.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/001: With you as our host,/25d how could it be anything but excellent?/30d/nThank you for a wonderful meal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/002: What a relief./60d/nI'm glad you enjoyed it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/003: I don't think we have time to sit back and relax./60d I'd like to hear why we're here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/008: That was rather abrupt,/20d and I fear it put you on the spot./40d/nPlease understand that we only want to help you as soon as possible, Esther./25d We mean well./30d/nNow,/30d please feel free to tell us what's troubling you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/009: Yes,/30d hearing that puts me at ease.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/010: Then/20d let me explain/25d/nwhy I invited you here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/012: As you know,/25d Libreville/20d is considered one of the finest/30d/nplaces to live in the Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/013: Of course!/35d/nYou could even call it the best place in the Empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/016: The previous lord and the townspeople/30d cleared the mountains/30d and carved roads through/nthis barren land./50d In time,/20d it became a trading hub for Bifrost to the north/20d/nand for Curtis.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/017: This land/25d is the fruit of our blood and sweat.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/018: But.../20d About a year ago, something happened.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/019: Along the road east of town leading to Curtis,/25d the plateau to its north/40d/nwas made into a separate estate, and a new village was built there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/020: Do you mean/20d the division of your estate is the problem?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/021: That isn't the issue./40d The problem is/20d that the road is Libreville's very lifeline./55d That village/15d seized it as though it belonged to them/10d/nand started charging tolls.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/023: But/25d territorial disputes like that/35d happen all over the Empire./55d/nSurely/30d you haven't asked for our help over that alone?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/024: Miss Isabele,/30d I don't think she's finished./30d/nLet's hear her out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/025: Yes,/40d if it were only a matter of tolls,/40d/nI would have tried to settle it between the lords...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/028: People from Libreville who took that road to work/50d/nstarted failing to return, one after another...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/031: Are you suggesting they were abducted?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/032: I/30d don't want to believe it has come to that./45d/nBut/25d when our people fail to return,/30d/nI can't simply stand by and watch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/033: But.../20d Why don't you fight them yourselves?/40d/nLibreville is larger and more developed, isn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/034: That's.../45d because their village is no ordinary village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/036: They seem to have considerable firepower as well.../55d/nAnd they/20d use monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/037: Monsters...?/45d There really is something going on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/038: A lord who hides his face/15d and uses monsters to abduct people...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/039: So,/20d what would you like us to do?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/040: Obviously, you want this spear/20d to make short work of them!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/041: We in Zephyr Falcon/25d can't let anyone prey on innocent people!/50d/nEven if you hadn't asked us,/25d/nwe wouldn't have stood by if we'd known about this!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/043: One moment, Esther./30d/nSurely/20d you don't expect our help/25d without offering anything in return?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/045: What are you saying?!/50d We can't impose on our host like that...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/046: As the old saying goes,/30d one should never turn down kindness./30d/nEsther,/30d may I ask what you have in mind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/047: Their lord/25d never appears in public,/40d/nand our letters have gone unanswered.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/048: I pledge one million Eld a year in support,/40d along with/15d protection for the standing of Zephyr Falcon's officers./25d/nYou may also use my mansion freely./50d It is/25d at your/n disposal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/050: Such generosity/35d befits a truly outstanding lord./45d/nWe gratefully accept your offer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/051: I have long/25d admired the deeds/20d of Zephyr Falcon./n/45dIf I can be of help,/20d even in some small way,/25d/nI'll do everything I can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/052: I'll give you/25d five hundred thousand Eld up front,/35d/nso I'm counting on you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/053: Thank you so much,/40d Lady Esther Dodd!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/054: From now on,/35d please call me Esther,/35d Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s05/056: It isn't much,/45d/nbut I hope you'll accept it as a token of my goodwill.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/003: [Organization Member]/nHeh heh heh... Sorry, but we'll be taking that sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/004: [Organization Member]/nThat's the demon sword of Kars, the legendary swordsman!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw16/005: [Organization Member]/nIt's the sword "that person" has been searching so desperately for.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/000: This is Caracas, a village on the edge of the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/001: Do you know General Kars?/nHe was the finest swordsman in the Empire.../nHe's my idol.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/002: I heard General Kars's sword is still out there somewhere.../20d/nAnni.../10d Something about hell.../10d A sword...?/15dWhatever it was, the name sounded frightening.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/004: They say General Kars had an incredible finishing move.../nIt had such a great name, too./20d Sky-Shattering... Some kind of Dance, wasn't it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/005: Have you met Chef Karg at the tavern?/nHe's eccentric, but I'd call him the best cook in the former Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/006: Caracas borders quite a few regions./nThe roads around here are well signposted, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/007: Plenty of travelers stop here/non their way elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/009: Have you ever been to one of Sharon's performances?/nEverything about her is the best! The best!/15d/nI'm a huge fan.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/010: ...I'm no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/011: Well... It was in keeping with my ideals,/nbut it was so dangerous... I was afraid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/012: Oh, did you know there's a passage inside Zephyr Falcon headquarters/nthat leads to a strange cave?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/013: Many say His Majesty the Black Prince was the Empire's greatest swordsman,/nbut calling him merely a swordsman is a little.../30d/nIf we're talking purely about swordsmanship, it has to be General Kars.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/014: Someday, I'll go to the Demon Sword Forest and pull out that legendary blade./nThe one General Kars used...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/015: They do say that Gigadeth, the sword General Kars used,/nis embedded in the Demon Sword Forest/nnear Bordeaux.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/016: But I've never met anyone/nwho has actually seen it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/017: People tend to think of Sharon/nas just another idol singer...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/018: In fact, Sharon has an extraordinary voice./nIt's just that her other charms/noutshine even her singing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/019: Sharon is always moving from place to place.../nI don't know where she is now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/020: I doubt anyone knows the forests around here/nbetter than I do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/021: I found a beautiful mushroom deep in a cave not long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/025: Well? Isn't it pretty? It's so beautiful,/nand it smells so good, it seems a shame to eat it./nI wonder how Mr. Karg would cook it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/026: Would you take this mushroom to Mr. Karg?/nI think a rare mushroom like this deserves a fine cook.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/027: Oh... I haven't seen you before.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/028: Have you heard of Love Herb?/nThey say it blooms only where true love has blossomed./nIts wonderful fragrance makes it a highly prized ingredient.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/029: Oh... I can sense the desert about you./nHave you crossed one recently?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/030: It's best to avoid crossing the desert if you can.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/031: They say that in the desert, it's important/nto believe you're following the right path.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/032: Trust people too easily and you'll get badly hurt!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/033: When I served in the Imperial Army unit directly under His Majesty the Black Prince,/nI had the honor of serving at General Kars's side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/034: The story that the general's sword lies buried in the forest near Ron/nis well known./30d/nWhether it's true, I couldn't say.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/036: Heh, a traveler passing through recently told me/nthat someone found Love Herb around here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/037: Heh, I'll never tell you that the person lives/nin Pretoria. Not even on pain of death./nWouldn't Chef Karg like to know?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/038: My grandson is so frail. I'm terribly worried.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/039: Isn't there anything that could improve the boy's health? Anything at all?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/040: Isn't this Higashi?/nIt's famous as a cooking spice,/nand as an invigorating tonic, too!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/041: Would you sell it to me?/nIt would make a fine tonic for my grandson./nI'll pay you well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/042: Well, since it's for your grandson... I'll give it to you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/043: I'm sorry./nI'm getting this for someone else...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/044: There are many caves in the mountains near Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/045: The caves near Pretoria are no ordinary caves...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/046: It's an open secret that a legendary spear is buried there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/048: My father isn't here. I don't remember him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/049: I'd like to see Father, even just once...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/051: My wife said she couldn't live here any longer/nand left with the children.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/052: She writes from time to time,/nbut I miss her and the children terribly./nI'm thinking of joining them once I've settled things here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/053: Shh! I'm an assassin, and I'm on a mission./nI can't tell you who my target is.../nHeheheh.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/054: It's hard to make a living these days, even doing this.../nThere has to be demand, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/055: Want a useful tip?/nRuben's men are cowards:/nthey attack whoever has the lowest HP first./nHeheheh.../30d That's how they got our companions.../nSo it's probably accurate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/056: Oh, they say Ruben's men go after weakened/nenemies first... Did you know that?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/060: Swords fall into four broad categories: rapiers, longswords, heavy swords, and greatswords./nUnlike the old classification by size,/nwe classify them by performance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/061: Rapiers have long, slender blades. They offer very high Attack, a low price, and a high Critical Rate, but low Defense and Block Rate, a very low Weapon Limit, and only 1 point of Weapon Durability, so they break easily. That makes them expensive to maintain.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/062: Rapiers include Stiletto, Saber, Rapier, Estoc, Cassandra,/nand Gramr. They're good for anyone who prioritizes Attack,/nbut at low levels their poor Defense/ncould put your life at risk.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/063: Heavy swords are very large, broad blades. They have low Attack and Hit Rate, but high Defense, Block Rate, Weapon Durability, and Weapon Limit./nThat gives them a tremendous defensive advantage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/064: A character with a heavy sword gains very high Defense and Block Rate./nSince heavy swords rarely break, they also save/nmoney. But their low Attack makes battles last longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/065: Heavy swords include Gladius, Swordbreaker, Heavy Sword,/nChrysaor Girium, and Bastard Sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/066: Longswords are ordinary swords that fall between heavy swords and rapiers. They're well balanced, but have no distinctive strengths,/nso renowned swordsmen tend not to use them./nThey prefer a style of their own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/067: Greatswords are also called holy swords. Great Sword, Durandal,/nand Claymore are among these legendary blades.../nThey have high Attack and Defense, but are very expensive./nMany aren't even available on the market.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/068: Our Sword Research Association collects swords/nfrom all over and buys and sells them./nWould you like to browse?/nAll proceeds go toward our research.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/069: Swordsmanship Research Association Shop, Geysir Academy
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/070: Take care,/nand sell us any fine swords you find...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/071: - Swordsmanship Research Association, Geysir Academy, Caracas Branch -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/072: There's a branch of the Imperial Geographical Society in Pretoria./nYou can learn a great deal about geography there./nWhy not visit?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/073: Put characters with defensive heavy swords in front/nto form a barricade, and use offensive rapier wielders/nfor ranged attacks. Characters behind them/nprovide support with magic and guns./nThis is the strongest tactic currently known./n- Tactical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/074: Magic is the ultimate form of attack. Those who can wield it/nshould develop their skills to the utmost./nFor attack is the best defense./n- Head of Offensive Magic, Magic Research Association, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/075: Some swords have elemental attributes./nThe Dark Sword has Dark, and the Silver Sword has Light./nThe Flame Sword, Lightning Sword, and Ice Sword have Fire,/nLightning, and Water respectively.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/076: Have you heard of Stardust, the sword we've just acquired?/nMade entirely of diamond, it's the ultimate defensive sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/077: Depending on the enemy, these attributes can be a tremendous advantage/nor a serious handicap...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/078: The so-called "holy swords" in particular tend to have affinities of their own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/079: Its signature finishing move, Stardust,/nsends fragments of the sword flying.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/080: Of course, being made of diamond rather than metal, it has only 1 point of Weapon Durability,/nbut I doubt it could ever break./nIt's the sword our legendary member, Mr. Paz, searched so desperately for...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/002_3: I hear General Kars' sword is still hidden somewhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/004_3: An underground waterway connects to the northern outskirts of this village. Once you enter, there's no way out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/005_3: Have you met Karg, the chef at the tavern? He's eccentric, but I'd say his cooking is the best in the former imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/006_3: Caracas borders quite a few regions.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/007_3: Many travelers stop here on their way elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/009_3: Have you been to one of Sharon's performances? Everything about her is wonderful, just wonderful! I'm such a fan!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/010_3: ...I'm no longer a member of the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/011_3: Well... Their cause matched my ideals, but it was too dangerous... I was afraid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/012_3: Did you know there's a passage to a strange cave inside our headquarters?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/013_3: I'm training hard with the sword so I can be like General Kars.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/014_3: One day, I'll go to Demon Sword Forest and pull out that legendary sword... the one Kars used.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/016_3: But I haven't heard of anyone actually pulling the sword out.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/018_3: In fact, she has an incredible singing voice. It's just that her other charms shine even more brightly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/019_3: She's always traveling... I don't know where she is now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/020_3: I doubt anyone knows the forests around here better than I do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/033_3: When I served in an imperial army unit directly under the Black Prince, I attended Kars.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/034_3: It's an old legend that Kars' sword lies buried in a forest near Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/044_3: The cave where the Zephyr Falcon are based hides many secrets.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/046_3: It's an open secret that a legendary spear is buried there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/048_3: My father isn't here. I don't remember him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/051_3: She said she could no longer live here, so she took the children away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/054_3: It's hard to make a living these days, even in this line of work... You need demand, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02/055_3: Want some useful information? Ruben's men are cowards. They attack whoever has the lowest HP first. Heh heh... That's how our companions fell, so it's probably accurate.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/000: Wait,/5d Cesare.../35d There's nowhere left to run...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/005: I'm sorry,/5d Cyrano./35d We can no longer/20d stand by and watch your rampage./50d/nPut away your sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/006: Ha,/45d you've even joined forces/30d with Bifrost to stop me?/50d/nHeh.../45d How laughable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/007: Come on, /40d stop me if you can!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/009: What are you saying, Silver?/45d With the two of us,/30d they can't stop us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/010: But if you delay here, /20d/nyour long-cherished wish may not come true.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/011: You mean Cesare could get away?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/012: You've come this far./25d I won't let it be for nothing./25d/nGo after Cesare. Hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/014: Your deepest wish is mine as well./40d/nIf you can find satisfaction,/30d I could ask for nothing more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/016: How long are you going to keep whispering?!/50d/nIf you won't lay down your swords,/40d prepare to die!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/017: Cyrano has no time to waste on the likes of you./55d/nI/25d am more than enough to handle you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/018: Heh,/60d so you mean to fight to the bitter end!/60d/nVery well./45d Let's see how long you last!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/019: Come on!/30d You may kill me,/30d but you'll never stop Cyrano!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s02/020: I warned you I'd destroy/15d anyone who stood in my way./60d/nYou've left me no choice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/001: Urgent news./30d/nCardinal Cesare/30d has once again/15d mobilized the Bifrost army.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/002: Those fools/25d still haven't learned their lesson./40d This time we'll crush them...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/003: This invasion/15d won't be so easy to repel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/004: They intend to deploy/10d the recently unearthed/25d first-class magic machine,/20d Ascalon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/006: A first-class magic machine/35d has a decisive effect on an army's/25d/nmorale and fighting strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/007: Conventional tactics/30d won't work against such an opponent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/009: I propose we march on Mount Mantigoa,/35d where the enemy's main force is stationed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/011: If we form a small elite unit/35d and overwhelm their headquarters in one stroke,/30d/nwe have a good chance of victory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/012: Even so.../35dWho will deal with Ascalon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/013: You needn't worry/25d about that./45d/nI've already prepared several alternatives.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/014: And this operation/45d will be Zephyr Falcon's/20d last.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/016: To the very end.../40d I ask you to give this fight your all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/017: Everyone,/35d in our last battle/50d we lost far too many comrades.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/019: Oh,/35d and I have a sword/30d for Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/022: "Armada"?/25dIsn't that the next-generation standard sword/30d Pendragon is testing in secret?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s01/023: That's right./35dThis is Chrysaor's new sword,/35d/na contender to succeed the "Blitz" you received earlier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldes01/000: The entrance to the underwater city, one of the Seven Wonders of antiquity,/55d lies beyond the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwtn32/000: So I have to press this switch, then step on it to activate it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltbo03/000: Who are you?!/nIf you have no business with the lord, get out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst09/000: I've come quite a way./15d I'd better complete the fourth stage of training before going any further.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/000: Cyrano will be coming up here soon./45d/nYou should flee at once...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/001: There's no need./45d My plan is as good as accomplished.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/002: You mean the reunification of the Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/003: Yes./30d Now that Cyrano has pursued me this far,/50d the court must realize he threatens/25d Bifrost as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/004: Before long,/30d the imperial lords,/30d Zephyr Falcon,/30d/nand even Bifrost will join forces/20d to eliminate him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/005: But, Your Eminence,/50d Cyrano is a dangerous man./45d/nWouldn't it be wiser to take shelter first?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/006: Your Eminence/30d must remain safe to lead the reunited Empire/30d/nin the days to come.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/007: Heh,/60d do you think he can defeat me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/008: The God of Destruction's power/30d has given me a god's body./55d/nYes,/20d I am immortal!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/010: I'll find out whether you're immortal/45d with my sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/011: Ha,/40d such remarkable persistence./45d/nIn that respect,/15d perhaps we're alike.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/012: Don't compare me to the likes of you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/013: Ah,/10d forgive me./30d You've killed even your comrades with those hands./30d/nThey're far dirtier than mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/014: I have no intention of talking at length./50d/nI want your life./40d That's all!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/015: Do you think you can take my life,/30d Cyrano?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/016: The hero who will unite the Empire!/60d I/45d am a god!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s03/031: At last.../55d Cesare is dead.../100d At last...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/001: This is/20d Pendragon's ferry/20d to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/002: I'm sorry,/15d but you can't board.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/003: (This is the ferry to Storm Island... What do I do now?)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/007: How are the preparations for departure coming along?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/008: Yes,/20d we're almost ready./30d/nWe can sail at dawn tomorrow as planned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/009: Good./30d Well done, all of you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/010: By the way,/20d have you eaten?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/012: I'll treat you to celebrate our departure,/45d so let's go to the tavern.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/014: Haha,/35d no one would want to go to Storm Island!/60d/nDon't worry. Let's go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/016: (This is the ferry to Storm Island.../50d/nWhat do I do now?)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/018: Explain the situation to the crew.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/019: Hide and wait for a chance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/020: I've no other choice.../40d If I explain my situation to the crew, perhaps they'll let me aboard.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/021: Excuse me,/35d could you take me to Storm Island?/40d/nI/15d simply have to get there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/022: Huh?/30d You want to take this ship?/40d/nNo,/25d this ship serves someone on Storm Island...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/023: Wait./35d We're bored anyway./25d/nLet's give this fellow a chance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/024: A chance?/20d What do you mean?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/025: I'll ask a few questions. /20d Can you try to answer them? /40d/nIf you answer correctly, I will take you to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/026: I don't have any other choice, right? /45d/nAs long as you can take me there, /30dI am willing to try anything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/027: Hmm.../30d This is a good idea!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/028: All right,/25d answer our questions correctly,/25d and the two of us will make sure/25d/nyou get to Storm Island!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/029: Then/25d let's begin!/25d Listen carefully and answer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/030: During the Creation War, what was the alliance of the four eastern nations,/nPendragon, Astania, Dagar, and Curtis, called?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/033: I'll ask/15d the second question./25d Choose one of the three answers.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/034: Beladin, who brought about the Creation War, was a Dark God's heir./nDo you know what that Dark God governed?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/038: Oh dear,/15d that's wrong./35d Dark Armor was the imperial alliance of/20d Geysir,/20d Trisis,/20d/nand Galad,/15d the three western nations./15d It was/50d/nalso called the Black Flag.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/039: The four eastern nations formed/30d Silver Arrow,/30d/nan alliance centered on Pendragon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/040: That's common knowledge, but you didn't know it./45d/nThink carefully before answering the next question.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/041: You got it right./45d Well,/15d it was an easy question.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/042: Of course you also know that Dark Armor/20d was the imperial alliance of Geysir,/20d Trisis,/20d and Galad,/10d the three/10d/nwestern nations,/30d don't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/043: From the second question on,/30d we'll have to make things a little harder.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/044: Oh,/20d right on the first try!/30d/nYes,/20d Beladin was the heir of the Dark God,/35d Beramode of Conspiracy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/045: Was that question a little difficult?/40d The Dark God who governs destruction/30d/nis Eustacia of Destruction./35d Eustacia has nothing to do with Beladin.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/046: The next question/15d will be easier.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/047: Oh dear,/30d the deity who governs war is/30d the goddess Shakbari of War./35d/nShe isn't even a Dark God.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/049: This time,/20d the question is about Curtis.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/050: Curtis is the continent's only republic./nDo you know the name of its first president?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/055: Hmm, you know your history. Curtis's first president was Arcia./20d Ariana and Ariana Jr. supported him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/056: Ariana/25d was known as the Divine Archer./45d/nHe did lay the foundations of the Republic of Curtis,/60d/nbut he never became president.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/057: I thought modern history would be easy,/35d but did you get confused?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/058: Ariana Jr./30d was the son of Ariana, the Divine Archer,/30d/nand a key figure in Curtis's republican government./40d/nBut he was still a child when the republic was founded.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/060: Hahaha,/40d I never thought you'd fall/20d for that trick!/50d/nThere's no such person as Arcia Jr.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/061: You seem to have mixed things up,/25d but either way, that's wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/062: If you don't know this one,/30d I'd hesitate to take you/nto Storm Island./40d Make sure you get it right!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/063: Do you know how Lady Eoline, who lives on Storm Island,/nis related to His Majesty Rashid of Pendragon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/068: You got it right./50d Well,/30d few people don't know that Eoline/15d is His Majesty Rashid's elder sister.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/069: Now,/15d then,/10d do your best on the final question.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/070: Oh dear,/40d His Majesty Rashid's daughter/25d could hardly have been living on Storm Island for fifty years./25d/n/50dHis eldest daughter/30d isn't even forty yet.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/071: You know so little about Lady Eoline.../45d/nIt makes me hesitate to take you to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/072: Oh dear.../55d Both of His Majesty Rashid's parents/50d/nfell early in the Creation War,/25d at the Battle of Glates./40d/nThey couldn't still be alive today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/074: Correct./40d Arcia/15d was the first president of the Republic of Curtis./50d/nAriana and Ariana Jr./30d were the men/nwho supported him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/075: You know modern history better than I expected.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/076: Hmm.../30d They are indeed brother and sister,/35d/nbut Eoline is the older one.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/078: This is the last question./30d It won't be easy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/079: During the Creation War,/40d four swordsmen were hailed/35d/nas the strongest on the continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/080: The Black Prince of the Geysir Empire,/45d/nRashid Pendragon of the Pendragon Kingdom,/45d/nGeneral Kars, one of the Empire's Seven Warriors/30d and Four Heavenly Kings,/50d/nand Crow, the wandering swordsman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/081: For these four,/30d people began/15d using titles that reflected/30d their personalities and swordsmanship./55d Now,/10d here's/10d the question!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/082: What was General Kars's title among the four great swordsmen of the Creation War?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/087: Goodness,/45d Sword Emperor/30d referred to the Overlord, the Black Prince./50d/nGeneral Kars/30d was his pupil and subordinate./35d/nCould someone who served a monarch/30d be called an emperor?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/089: Sword Ghost.../30d No, that's wrong./40d/nSword Ghost/30d referred to the uncanny wandering swordsman,/35d Crow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/090: Unfortunately,/30d you got the final question wrong.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/091: Oh dear,/25d surely Sword Saint/30d was a title made for His Majesty Rashid,/nour Holy King.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/092: Kars was a great swordsman,/40d but he was never called a saint./n/45dIf anything, he had a darker side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/093: Sword Demon!/30d Yes,/10d that's right!/25d Kars had gone beyond the realm of a human blade/45d/nand entered that of a demon sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/094: Even his sword/30d had a fearsome name:/35d/nGigadeth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/095: It wasn't just the name./40d/nThey say it was a legendary demon sword,/30d alongside the Black Prince's Asura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/096: Anyway,/20d you got the final question right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/097: Well,/10d then,/25d you've answered at least three questions correctly./30d/nWe'll let you aboard as promised.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/098: We'll take responsibility for what comes next!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/100: No need to thank us./35d We enjoyed ourselves, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/101: Now,/20d hurry into the hold./30d/nBefore our captain gets back.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/102: Sigh.../20d Goodness./45d/nYou couldn't even get three/15d general-knowledge questions right,/15d could you...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/106: You seem to have your reasons.../65d/nAnd you helped us pass the time,/25d/nso why not give you a ride in return?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/107: I agree./60d It's not as though we can't take him,/30d/nso a few wrong answers needn't change anything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/108: Life/30d isn't judged by a score.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/109: Thank you so much/30d for letting me aboard.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/110: Now, now,/30d leave the rest to us/25d/nand hurry into the hold before the captain returns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s06/112: (Rather than/20d confronting them directly,/30d/nI'd better take advantage of a lapse in the watch.)
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr18/000: Is this... the fire dragon...?/nIt's sealed away.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr18/001: Swordlight shakes heaven and earth,/nDragonfire purifies the soul./n/nHere Kars sealed the dragon./nYear 1205 of the Esghar calendar.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr18/002: Also.../15dWho would erect a stone monument in a place like this?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflddr18/006: The fire dragon is sealed here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/001: E.../40d Esther.../40d/nEsther/30d did this to Rhidelhard...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/003: [Esther]/nOh my,/45d are you blaming me?/50d/nHohoho.../45d Weren't you the one who sowed all these seeds?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/004: [Esther]/nThe moment you turned your back on your comrades,/40d/nall of this became inevitable./45d/nThe fool.../25d is you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/013: .../50dHow could I stand by and watch/40d the man who saved my life die before my eyes?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/015: Three years ago,/45d on the day Zephyr Falcon attacked Inferno Prison.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/016: Do you remember the prisoner/35d who escaped that hell alongside you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/019: Roberto de Meditch,/55d your eyes shone then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/020: But now you're bewitched by that sorceress,/20d and their light is fading./40d/nLook at yourself!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/024: You'd throw yourself in harm's way for a coward like him?/45d/nCyrano,/20d you're a fool as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/025: Esther,/35d it's not too late./35d/nAsk his forgiveness,/35d and I'll forgive you too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/026: What?/30d Beg forgiveness?/45d/nThere's a limit to how absurd you can be!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/027: Lord Diablo will protect me!/40d/nYou should be the ones/20d begging forgiveness!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/030: Diablo,/40d and Cesare Borgia!/40d/nTo meet both my enemy and my master's enemy/25d in the same place...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/032: Calling the man who saved your life your enemy.../55d/nWhen you were about to be roasted alive,/40d didn't I at least spare your life?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/033: And/30d how dare you speak that way/15d to Lord Diablo!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/035: If my senses/20d are right.../60d/nthe aura rising from his body/35d is Deimos's.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/036: I wondered why/25d I hadn't sensed Deimos's aura for years./70d/nSo he had merged with you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/037: Has the time/40d to fulfill my mission finally come...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/038: Enough talk./55d/nHand over Christina,/45d and I'll grant you a painless death.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/039: Ha,/30d who are you/25d to demand that I hand over Christina?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/040: Lord Diablo,/25d/nhe drank poison and has little time left./45d/nPay him no mind. Continue the ritual.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/041: Let's see how long you can keep spouting nonsense./65d/nPrepare yourself,/5d Cesare!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/043: It's too late!/30d The God of Destruction.../25d is coming back to life!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/045: No...! /20dChristina's breathing is getting weaker and weaker...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/046: Esmeralda risked her life to save her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/049: The underwater city is collapsing!/35d/nWe have to get out of here now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/050: Christina/15d will die before we can get out!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/051: There's no other way./30d/nChristina.../15d I'll get her out somehow!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/055: Only now.../55d I think I finally/25d understand how you feel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/057: I have a favor to ask of you, /10dSharn Hoiste.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/059: Please/55d take care of my Asura.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/060: Cyrano,/40d I am not qualified to accept this sword.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/061: No,/45d you're the only one/45d I can entrust this sword to./75d/nYou use the same swordsmanship as my master./65d I know/45d I can trust you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/062: ...Very well./55d You seem to know who I really am./40d/nIn honor of the trust you place in me,/55d I'll keep it safe.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/065: Deimos!!/50d Please grant your life/40d to this child!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/066: The rest.../50d I leave to you...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/072: He gave his own life/55d for Christina...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/074: Kana!/25d The collapse is getting worse./25d/nI'll take Christina,/35d so let's get out of here now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/076: I want to stay here, /30d with Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/078: All his life.../35d he was a lonely man, chasing only the shadow/45d/nof the person he loved.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/079: Only now,/40d has he finally found his resting place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/080: ...I want to remain at his side./50d Forever...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/081: .../65dI understand./50d/nIf that's where your happiness lies,/50d I have no right to stop you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl18_s01/084: Christina is alive./55d/nThere's nothing more.../15d for you to worry about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/000: [Catalina]/nHeh,/60d you've certainly managed/30d to humiliate me until now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/001: [Catalina]/nBut/30d not this time./45d/nKneel before/40d the might of Bifrost!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/002: Ah,/30d it should be arriving about now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/004: What I ordered should be arriving,/40d/nso please excuse me for a moment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/005: Wait,/5d Clausewitz!/25d/nWhat are you talking about? We're in the middle of a battle!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/010: This is my true appearance./50d/nI'll explain everything/30d once we've defeated Ascalon./45d/nFor now,/25d let's focus on what we have to do!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/011: [Catalina]/nDamn it!/60d Why won't this magic machine/20d do what I want?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmma21b/012: .../45dIs that monster really too much for us/30d/nto defeat on our own...?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/001: A pleasure to meet you./30d/nI am Esther Dodd,/35d the ruler of Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/002: I'm the one who should thank you./25d You've come here at my request,/40d/nand I hardly know how to express my gratitude...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/003: You are famed throughout the Empire for your wise rule, Lady Esther./45d/nWe are honored/15d by your invitation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/004: However,/40d I hear you've been having some difficulties lately.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/005: Yes.../35d Libreville/30d/nis in a very difficult situation right now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/006: [Meditch]/nWhat trouble could possibly/15d make such a beauty/25d/nsigh?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/010: Mr. Meditch?/35d So you're Mr. Meditch!/40d/nI'm delighted to meet you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/012: On my way here,/25d I looked around your lands, Lady Esther./40d Libreville truly is/20d a peaceful, pleasant place to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/013: Meditch,/20d it's rude to arrive this late when you've been invited!/50d/nAnd now you're interrupting!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/014: No,/35d I don't mind./30d/nPlease don't scold him so.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/015: I/20d am thrilled/25d just to meet Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/016: Hahaha,/45d you leave me quite at a loss.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/019: You must all be tired from your journey,/40d so we'll show you to your/nguest rooms first./40d I'll see you again in the salon after dinner.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/020: Now,/25d please excuse me./35d/nDo make yourselves comfortable.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/021: I'll show you to your rooms./50d/nThis way, please.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s04/026: Still,/20d I owe you a proper apology for keeping you waiting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka04a/000: This leads to the Trisis Desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka04a/001: This way doesn't lead to Pretoria.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/000: It's been a long time,/35d Lady Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/001: Prince Rashid.../45d Has it been three years?/45d/nHow time flies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/002: You seem to be leading the Empire admirably./60d/nI'm truly impressed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/003: It would have been difficult/25d without Sir Meditch's help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/004: Ah,/30d Sir Meditch.../60d He seems to be/25d working hard as well./50d/nAnd Mrs. Meditch/35d is well, I trust?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/005: Isabele is doing well, too./40d/nShe/30d has been a great source of support.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/006: The Frederick family/30d and the Meditch family.../55d/nNow/30d the imperial lands seem to be settling into stability./40d/nThat puts my mind at ease.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/007: It was you, Prince Rashid,/40d who laid the foundations for this peace./40d/nI am sincerely/15d grateful.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/008: I'm glad to hear you say that,/55d/nbut I/30d only lent a little help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/009: The person we must truly/20d remember/35d and thank is...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/011: Yes,/35d Cyrano Bernstein./70d/nHe/30d made the Empire we have today possible./55d/nAnd he/25d opened our eyes...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/012: Yes./45d Without his sacrifice.../60d/nWe could never forget him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/014: When/30d will you return to Pendragon?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/015: I have no plans/20d to return for a while./55d Before the flames of war/25d/nflare up again,/30d I intend to visit my homeland.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/018: Yes./45d I haven't been back/20d for about fifteen years./40d/nWhen I left,/30d the war was still raging.../45d/nBy now,/40d it must have changed a great deal.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/019: Then/35d it may be several years/30d before we meet again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/020: I can't say/35d how many years it will be.../55d/nBut I hold/15d the demon sword Asura,/30d/nwhich originally belonged to the Empire./35d So someday,/30d we will certainly meet again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/021: In the meantime,/40d I/5d will work to make the Empire stronger/40d and more prosperous./15d/n/70dYou'll see.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/022: From Christina Frederick,/45d/nI would expect/25d nothing less.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/025: Four Years Later, Underwater City Entrance
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl20_s02/034: And I promised him/30d I'd take care of you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka11a/000: This way leads to Libreville./nNicosia lies in the south of the continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka11a/001: This leads to Libreville. /nPretoria is to the west.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/001: Ah.../40d/nEven so,/30d holding off a hundred and thirty thousand with twenty thousand/35d seems impossible...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/002: Your task is only to hold them in check./30d You must never/20d engage the enemy head-on./40d/nUsing Inferno's terrain/25d to slow their advance will be enough.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/003: All right,/20d that much should be possible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/004: Timing is crucial./45d/nCoordinate your attack with Cyrano/30d to throw the enemy into confusion.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/005: Tsk.../30d Everyone else gets to fight,/35d and I have to watch from the rear.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/006: Not at all./40d/nIf our supply lines are cut,/35d the situation/30d will turn sharply against us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/007: Remember/40d that you, Rhidelhard,/25d have the most important role in this operation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/009: We call this operation/40d Dragon Strike.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/010: The fate of the Empire rests/30d on this crucial operation./45d/nEveryone,/25d give it your all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/011: I'll give you the details/30d individually afterward.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/012: As expected/25d of Clausewitz the Wise./50d/nTo devise such a plan.../35d It's excellent strategy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/013: Miss Isabele,/30d you seem to have something to say.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/014: You flatter me./45d/nI merely/20d studied the Black Prince's oblique formation/25d and adapted it in my own way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl14_s02/018: Everyone,/30d please excuse me for a moment.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcka16/000: There seems to be no one here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s02/004: Navigator,/15d what's the matter?/30d/nThe weather is fine today...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s02/011: ...A storm on the way to Storm Island,/55d and pirates on the way back...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s02/012: I can't just pretend not to notice.../55d What a nuisance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/000: Didn't our lord personally set out to suppress the Zephyr Falcon for the sake of peace elsewhere? As people of Ron, we should gladly join the campaign.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/001: Ron will become the center of the imperial territories. We can't have thieves like the Zephyr Falcon running wild everywhere, can we?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/003: Grandfather is still very vigorous, despite his age.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/005: No... How could a woman be the first to say it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/009: They say our lord received his lightsaber from a Tuer knight!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/010: Father says the Zephyr Falcon are a band of violent thieves.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/012: They say Sharn Hoiste, the phantom thief, is remarkable. He's never failed to steal something he set his sights on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/013: His disguises are extraordinary too. One lord was fooled when he disguised himself as the butler who had served that lord for thirty years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/014: What does he look like? I'd like to see his face, just once...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/016: No, too ordinary. "Would you spend your life with me?" Hmm... That's no good either.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/017: Why won't that foolish man propose? He always loses his nerve at the crucial moment...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/018: My son visited Libreville not long ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/019: He wouldn't stop praising the beauty of Lady Esther Dodd, Libreville's ruler. Heh heh... If only I were ten years younger...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/020: Don't believe me? Don't underestimate the man they called the "Prince of the Wind" in his youth!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/023: Do you know the musician Nikacha? He's very popular in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/026: I love you. Please marry me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/028: If there's a problem, it's that he's a little too vigorous...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/029: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon's swordmaking is highly advanced. The knights' SP-7 "Blitz" and PSX-9 "Armada" are magnificent blades. But obtaining these standard-issue swords in the empire is all but impossible.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro03/030: [Member of the Swordsmanship Research Association]/nPendragon strictly forbids taking its standard-issue swords out of the kingdom.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/002: You can't intend to simply swallow the humiliation of your last campaign/50d/nand let it go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/003: This is/25d an excellent chance to wipe out the rebels/10d and the lords who support them./30d/nAll of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/005: Besides,/25d we successfully unearthed/25d the magic machine Ascalon./50d/nShouldn't we test its capabilities?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/006: Haha,/25d how impressive./35d/nThat information/20d is supposed to be top secret.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/007: What are you still hesitating about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/008: If you help/15d me unite the Empire,/50d/nI will grant you/25d half its territory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/011: We've come this far. There's no choice now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/012: Indeed,/30d Cardinal Cesare,/20d you know precisely what matters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/014: Once again,/15d I will mobilize our Bifrost army/30d/nand Ascalon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/015: I/25d will send an envoy to Pendragon/25d/nwith a letter stating that the rebels/35d have thrown the Empire into chaos/35d/nand that we have asked your country for help.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/016: Even Pendragon/40d/ncan't intervene lightly/25d in an internal affair.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl19_s02/017: Besides, Pendragon/45d seems preoccupied with its war against the Tuer people./20d/n/40dThey'll have little choice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/001: The rumors about strange goods being sold in this rebel village aren't true.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/002: You can't go in. Mother's having a baby... My little brother or sister!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/003: What should I do for the baby...? Braid their hair, give them flower hairpins...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/004: We were driven out of our village, but thanks to Zephyr Falcon, we can still sell our goods here. Welcome!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/005: Hello! Are you looking for anything in particular?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/010: I may not look like much, but I've plenty of fine goods. Take your time browsing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/012: Take care. Come and see me again...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/013: Oh... Welcome! We've got everything, except what we haven't got!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/014: Thank you very much. Good luck on your travels.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/015: May blessings accompany you on your journey...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/016: This is an unusual place: a rebel village that sprang up on its own.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwro10/017: As you can see, it's small enough to escape notice... Neither Zephyr Falcon nor the lords pay it much attention.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/000: Strange.../40d/nThis should be the meeting place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/001: That is strange./35d/nI could understand Meditch being late,/25d but our strategist is always punctual.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/007: [Bors]/nAt Clausewitz's request,/30d/neveryone has headed for the summit of Mount Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/009: [Bors]/nI don't know the details,/30d but General Frederick/15d/nis said to be near Mount Ron./25d Perhaps that's connected?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/012: Hmm.../55d/nThen/25d we should head for Mount Ron as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl11_s04/014: Hmm.../30d You all go ahead./30d/nThere's somewhere I need to stop first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka15a/001: To reach Nicosia,/25d we have to pass through Geysir City./35d/nLet's head there first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/005: To have come... this far.../nyou must be... no ordinary human...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/009: And yet... within you.../nI sense... two souls...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/011: One... is a human.../nwith a powerful will...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/021: Call upon me.../nand whenever you need me... I will lend you my strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/022: This is... a place of bitter cold... where even the air you breathe... freezes.../nNow... leave this place...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldma20/023: This place... is filled with terrible cold.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/002: [??]/nHmph,/25d is that him?/20d The one who's supposed to be so skilled?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/004: My name is Silver./35d/nIt seems/25d you've taken good care of my crew.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/005: Boss,/15d what do you mean, taken care of us?!/30d We've been through...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/007: He went easy on you. That's why you're still alive!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/010: [Silver]/nNow,/30d let's see what you can do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/012: I don't want to fight you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/014: Couldn't you just take me to Cerepus?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/015: Hahaha!/40d You've got nerve./35d/nI like that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/016: If you beat me,/40d I'll take you to Cerepus, or anywhere else.../50d/nAnd I'll serve you for the rest of my life!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/029: As promised.../50d/nI'll take you to Cerepus...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl05_s03/030: Whatever you do,/35d I will lend you my strength.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/000: This painting depicts my great-uncle and the Black Prince as they gallop across the continent together.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/001: This landscape painting depicts the Dark City reflected in the Black Lake.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/002: Young master, follow me if you wish to go down to the basement.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/003: Young master, the master is waiting in the banquet hall.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/004: These are magnificent paintings./nSuch elegant detail, balanced composition, and skillful use of color./nEvery one is flawless.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/005: Oh... Cyrano./10d/nHow fortunate, to be engaged to Miss Mercedes, such a renowned beauty...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/006: Ruben has been acting strangely lately./nHe goes off somewhere on his own every day...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/007: Please, go into the banquet hall.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/008: Have you visited the new cathedral?/nIt's magnificent!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/009: Haha... Engaged already.../nHow quickly the years pass.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/010: I'm delighted to meet you, young Cyrano Bernstein./15d/nYour father is a dear friend of mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/011: The basement is down there./nDo you need something?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/012: Heh, it seems like only yesterday you were born,/nand now you're getting engaged...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/013: Enter the mansion's banquet hall now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/015: No, I'll look around the mansion a little longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/016: There's still some time before the engagement ceremony.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/017: Everyone agrees that Ruben and the young master/naren't as close as they used to be./20d/nOnce, they were inseparable...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/018: Ruben and the young master began drifting apart/nafter that incident...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/019: Congratulations on your engagement, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/020: When the young master marries,/nour Bernstein family will become/nthe most powerful noble house in the Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/021: We've prepared a modest gift for you/nafter the engagement ceremony./nPlease be sure to come and see us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/022: Have you heard of Frederick of Ron,/nwho has recently earned a name/nas a military commander?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/023: He equips his troops with firearms imported from the Tuer Empire./nThey say these weapons called guns/npossess tremendous firepower.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/024: This is the church our Bernstein family has donated the most to./nDoesn't it seem all the finer for it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/025: I hear Cardinal Cesare was delighted, too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/026: Only the finest works, worthy of the Bernstein name,/nhang here./nCyrano, my heartfelt congratulations on your engagement.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/027: Hoho... So Geysir City's two most eligible/nmarriage prospects are leaving the field together?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/028: There won't be a single unmarried man or woman in Geysir City/nwho isn't saddened by this news.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/029: Your engagement is a little early, admittedly./nLord Cesare was very eager for it,/nbut for our Bernstein family, this marriage...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/030: Hahaha... Whatever the case, you really do/nresemble our uncle in his younger days!/nI knew from your childhood that you'd achieve great things!
