Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/031: Once, on a ship from Cerepus to Dakama,/nwe encountered pirates and each saved/nthe other's life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/032: Ever since, we've shared a bond deeper than that of blood brothers./nBut I only returned from my voyage to the East/nrecently, so...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/033: The captain upstairs is said to have been/na close childhood friend of our master./nThis is their first meeting in almost twelve years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/034: They say the captain spent twelve years on the eastern sea routes/nwithout being able to return home.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/035: As a ship's captain in the Pendragon navy,/nhe seems to have led something like a mercenary's life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/036: I know that captain well./nHe was a close friend of Luke's in their younger days./nA remarkable man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/037: He argued that all Antalya must stand together/nagainst the Tuer Empire's invasion, and volunteered for the navy/nof Pendragon, once an enemy nation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/038: After many difficulties, he joined the Pendragon navy and endured all manner of hardship./nIn the end, he rose to officer rank and returned with his abilities recognized./nA truly remarkable man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/039: There have always been strange legends about the basement.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/040: The most famous tale is of Medusa's Belt./nA belt she once wore lies in the Bernstein basement./nThey say anyone who sees it turns to stone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/041: Oh... the young master is even more handsome today.../nLove can indeed make people beautiful...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/042: I'd love a passionate romance with a man/nas fine as the young master./nIsn't that every woman's dream?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/043: Miss Mercedes is the one I envy most./nBeauty, a fine family, a kind heart,/nand now such a splendid bridegroom...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/044: We have a relative named Louis,/nbut his temperament is rather odd. He's quite contrary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/045: He says all the nobles' property should be confiscated/nand distributed free of charge./nHe goes around saying the strangest things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/000_3: A portrait of my uncle with the Black Prince,/nriding across the continent.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/003_3: Young master, the master is waiting for you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/004_3: Splendid paintings. Such elegant detail, such fine composition and color... Every one is flawless.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/005_3: Oh... Cyrano. How lucky you are to be engaged to Miss Mercedes, such a celebrated beauty...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/006_3: Ruben has been acting strangely lately./nHe goes off somewhere on his own every day...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/008_3: Have you visited the new cathedral?/nIt's magnificent!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/010_3: It's a pleasure to meet you, Cyrano Bernstein. Your father is a dear friend of mine.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/013_3: Enter the mansion's banquet hall now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/015_3: No, I'll look around the mansion a little longer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/016_3: There's still some time before the engagement ceremony.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/017_3: Everyone says you and Ruben have grown distant lately. You used to be inseparable...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/018_3: You and Ruben started drifting apart after that incident...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/019_3: Congratulations on your engagement, young master.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/020_3: Once you're married, the Bernsteins will be one of the most powerful noble families in the imperial territories.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/021_3: We've prepared a small gift for you after the ceremony. Please stay.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/022_3: Have you heard of Frederick? He's been making quite a name for himself as a military commander.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/029_3: Your engagement is rather early, I must say. Lord Cesare was eager to arrange it, of course, but for the Bernsteins, this marriage...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/030_3: Ha ha! Whatever the case, you're the very image of your late uncle! I knew you'd go far, even when you were a child!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/031_3: We met pirates on a voyage from Cerepus to Dakama and each saved the other's life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/032_3: Since then, we've shared a bond stronger than blood. I've only just returned from a voyage to the east...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/033_3: That captain? He's an old friend of the master's. I believe they haven't seen each other in nearly twelve years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/036_3: I know the captain well. He was a close friend of Luke's in their younger days. A remarkable man.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/038_3: He overcame countless obstacles to join the Pendragon navy, endured every hardship, and earned promotion to officer before returning home with his talents recognized. A fine man indeed.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/040_3: The most famous is the tale of Medusa's Belt. A belt she once wore lies in the Bernstein basement. They say anyone who sees it turns to stone...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/044_3: There's a relative of ours named Louis. He's rather odd... quite a contrarian.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber01/045_3: He says all the nobles' wealth should be confiscated and handed out for free. What a strange idea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/002: Why/40d is Deimos, leader of the Dark Gods,/40d/nhere beneath Inferno...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/003: Can a human really cast a dark barrier/40d/npowerful enough to nullify a god's power?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/004: .../35dA human?/35d No,/20d perhaps not a human.../45d/nCome to think of it,/30d wasn't there a god who survived/45d/nthe Creation War...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/006: Sigh,/55d I can't remember any more.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/007: Fortunately, the guards/15d seem unaware of him./50d/nI should find a chance to meet him again...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/010: Damn.../50d I don't think I have/45d/nmuch time left...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s05/011: Tomorrow.../60d I'll return to where he is tomorrow.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw09/000: Heh... Have you heard of a man named Largo?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw09/001: I'm Penello, a close friend of his.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwsw09/002: In his later years, Largo was searching for something here in the empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s04/001: The song/40d I gave you for your birthday...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s04/002: Ours.../15d/nYes, this song belongs to you and me alone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s04/003: Whatever lies ahead, let's live like this song, helping and cherishing each other./30d/nForever...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/001: So it was you,/25d Cyrano Bernstein.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/002: The one who destroyed our supply base/40d/nand disrupted our forces from the rear.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/003: Heheheh.../45d/nBut Lady Luck/45d is on my side.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/004: This bridge/15d is Zephyr Falcon's lifeline./75d/nIf we seize it,/35d victory is ours!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/005: Now,/20d let's settle this again./45d/nI'll repay the humiliation of our last encounter!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmiss71/010: Do not run on the bridge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmpx19/001: Our objective/35d is to rescue the prisoners held in the lords' mansions in Pretoria,/15d Memphis,/25d and Bordeaux./20d
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s03/000: Are you from Zephyr Falcon?/55d/nWe've been expecting you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s03/002: Yes,/35d they've arrived and are waiting.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s03/004: Clausewitz!/30d You've been waiting for us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s03/005: As usual, /40d everyone is here except Mr. Meditch.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl10_s03/010: Mr. Meditch may take/15d some time to arrive,/35d/nso let's hear what Lady Esther has to say first.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s01/001: [???]/nTsk, tsk.../40d Yesterday's storm/25d damaged so many trees.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s01/002: [???]/nStill.../35d I'm worried about the ferry./40d/nI hope it wasn't caught in the storm.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s01/004: [???]/nSomeone here.../30d Caught in the storm, perhaps...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s01/010: [???]/nWith injuries like these,/30d it's a wonder you're alive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl04_s01/013: [???]/nHold on a little longer./45d My house is just ahead.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/005: How did I get all the way to Cerepus...?/45d/nUgh...!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/007: [?????]/nJust a moment.../30d/nCalm yourself/30d and close your eyes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/008: [?????]/nMerciful Abydos.../40d/nThrough my prayer,/15d grant a miracle...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/010: [?????]/nThere,/25d you should be fine now, as long as you don't overexert yourself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/011: It was you.../60d who saved me in the desert...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/012: [?????]/nYes,/30d fortunately,/15d you had collapsed not far/15d/nfrom the town.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/014: Thank you for saving me./45d/nMy name is Cyrano./40d May I ask yours...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/015: I have nothing to repay you with now,/45d/nbut I will/25d repay this kindness someday.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/016: Repayment?/30d Please don't worry about that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/017: I/20d have something to attend to,/20d so I must go.../35d/nPlease take care of yourself.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/019: Gotta look for a boat bound for Dakama Port...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/021: Storm Island/45d lies far to the south/15d of the eastern mainland./45d/nThere won't be a ship going straight there from here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/023: Then, /20d I'll take my leave now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/024: Excuse me./15dDo you know how to get to Storm Island from here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl03_s05/025: First,/15d go to Dakama Port,/30d then transfer to another ship.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldri03/000: The road lies beneath your feet./n       Largo, adventurer
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/002: Hehe,/35d you haven't changed either,/25d my learned friend.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/003: Lord Cesare certainly has an eye for talent. /30dTo think he could take/55d an ordinary farmer's/15d daughter/35d and make her what she is today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/004: Hmph. /30dThis is simply a deal that benefits us both.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/005: You /10d get what you want, /50d/n I get what I want, that's all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/007: Don't worry. /30d The Grand Duke has made up his mind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/008: Oh,/55d so he'll send troops to the Empire?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/009: The Grand Duke/30d suffered humiliation at the Empire's hands in his youth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/010: The old senators' conservatism/20d held him back,/50d/nso he endured it until now./55d But the assassins you sent/30d/nhave eliminated the senior senators./50d Nothing stands in his way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/011: Good./10d Then tomorrow's talks should be easy.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/012: I see.../45d/nAnd/35d how is that excavation you mentioned coming along?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/013: You mean Ascalon./55d/nThat's still a long way off.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/014: They seem to have roughly located it,/50d/nbut apparently the excavation will take enormous time and manpower.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/015: Well,/25d with Bifrost's great army,/35d we may not need to deploy a magic machine at all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/016: Once the Valkyries are mobilized,/30d Zephyr Falcon/25d/nor Frederick's artillery corps/35d will be easily dealt with.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/017: If anything,/30d you'll need to take care/25d/nthat they don't seize the Empire for themselves.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/018: Heh,/35d His Eminence the Cardinal/30d has already prepared a plan/25d/nfor that eventuality.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/019: Then, /30d I will take my leave now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/021: Bifrost's deployment/45d will bring about the Empire's downfall./35d/nI almost pity them for not knowing./40d Hoho...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/022: Since this deployment/30d was requested by the Cardinal,/40d/nPendragon won't be able to do anything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/023: For us, professing neutrality,/45d this is an ideal opportunity.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/024: But/35d Cardinal Cesare is not a man to underestimate./50d/nYou must be careful too, Your Majesty.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/025: Haha,/25d do you think so little of me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl12_s07/026: Shall I show you/50d whether I'm someone to laugh at?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmzy01/000: East - Pretoria Region/nNorthwest - Dragon Breath Mountains
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02b/001: The secret passage is to the north of the village. /45d/n Let's sneak into the mansion from there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02b/002: The secret passage is to the north of the village.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02b/003: All right,/30d we'll enter the mansion through the underground waterway.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka02b/006: [Rhidelhard]/nStay out of my way, you unpleasant fellow, and go rescue the prisoners!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst25/000: I think I can hold my own now. Should I try the challenge as I am?/10d Or go back for the final training...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber04/000: Young master, what brings you here?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber04/001: If you're looking for Ruben, he's not here now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber04/002: Don't you think Ruben has been acting strangely lately?/nIt seems to have started just after news/nof the young master's engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber04/002_3: Don't you think Ruben has been acting strangely lately?/nIt seems to have started just after news/nof the young master's engagement...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01_/001: It's a quiet country village surrounded by forest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01_/002: I heard that Geysir City is south of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01_/007: The desert's crawling with bandits lately. I nearly lost my life several times on this trip.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltka01_/008: People in hot climates tend to be easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/001: W-well... Congratulations on your engagement, Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/002: Oh... Cyrano, congratulations on your engagement./nYou'll be married before long.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/003: Hee hee... When you marry, I'll make a special meal for the newlyweds. Look forward to it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/004: I'll make a special meal with some very fine ingredients. Hee hee hee.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/005: Oh! Congratulations on your engagement, Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/006: You should start exercising a little, Cyrano./nYou'll need to build up your stamina, won't you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/007: Would you like me to recommend a club I know well?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/008: Heh heh... I hear you're getting engaged. What a wonderful time of life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/009: You haven't had to endure a wife's nagging yet,/nand you're dreaming of the honeymoon to come...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflber10/010: Yes, this must be the happiest time of your life./nEnjoy it to the full./nOnce youth passes, it never returns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd01/000: << Operation: Retake Inferno >>/n/nRecapture Inferno from the Bifrost army!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd01/001: Inferno.../45d Has it been three years?/40d/nIt should be north of here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd01/002: Clausewitz sent me to supply you with weapons. Choose whatever you need.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflmsd01/005: Clausewitz sent me with supplies. Choose whatever you need.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/000: What Ron is most proud of/n is of course the army commanded by Lord Frederick.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/001: Ron is surely the finest city in the former Empire./nMilitary might and a thriving economy!/nWe are the heart of the Empire's future!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/002: I hear Geysir Cathedral was built a little over ten years ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/003: Men are all overgrown children./nAlways whining and throwing tantrums.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/005: That husband of mine does nothing but gamble all day,/nand never even thinks of minding the shop!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/007: Bandits have been rampant in the desert lately./nI nearly lost my life several times on this trip because of them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/008: People who live in very hot places/ngenerally become quite easygoing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/009: Before, I saw Lord Frederick/n draw his lightsaber once, just once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/010: I couldn't sleep that night!/nHe was so magnificent!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/011: Have you heard of the sword Lord Kars left behind?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/012: Who is this bandit Sharn Hoiste, really?/nI've heard he appeared around here recently...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/013: This town and Libreville are about the only pleasant places to live./nThe imperial lands as a whole are in a terrible state.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/014: No one heard that, did they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/015: But my wife is always at my throat,/nso how am I supposed to get by?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/016: Wouldn't you agree?/nA husband like me would be a credit to anyone!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/017: Just wait until I catch him./nThis time, I'll teach him to mend his ways!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/018: Heh... Married couples quarrel, then make up./nThat's just how it goes.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/019: Seeing couples quarrel like that/nalways reminds me of my youth.../nMy wife was lovely in those days, too...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/020: Heh. For a military town,/nthe women here are remarkably forceful./nMost of the men don't dare cross them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/023: Hoho... Still, they have their endearing moments,/nor why would we keep living with them?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/027: Ugh... He makes me so angry!/nHow wonderful does he think he is, making such a fuss?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/028: Where has he gone this time? Aaargh!/nI have no idea why I ever married him!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/029: If you don't keep soothing them, they sulk./nThey're such a troublesome lot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/030: [Mr. Harold]/nWelcome! /nThis store stocks the best firearms in the country!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/032: Thank you for choosing Phaethon, the finest name in firearms./nDo come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/033: [Mrs. Harold]/nWelcome,/nThis store not only sells guns, but also high-end swords.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/035: Thank you for choosing Phaethon, the pride of Ron.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/036: There are so many good guns in our store that even Lord Frederick/n occasionally comes to take a look.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/037: My father collects guns himself,/nso he keeps some fine pieces aside that he doesn't normally sell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/038: [Miss Ellen]/nWelcome. How can I help you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/040: Thank you for shopping at August./nCome again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/041: My father went into the forest not long ago. /nThe strange thing is that he has not come back since then.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/042: Mother keeps asking after Father, but he still hasn't returned.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/043: Welcome to the Explosive Tavern, one of Ron's finest establishments!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/044: Our tavern's greatest pride/nis Rud, the strongest liquor in all Antalya.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/045: The Rud here is potent stuff. Care to try some?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/046: All the men of Ron serve in Frederick's army./nWe're elite soldiers, each worth a hundred men.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/047: The best place to live in the world/nis Ron, not Libreville.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/048: Have you visited our arena?/nWe often test a person's courage/nby how long they can last there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/049: Cowards are a disgrace to Ron. /nWe are all soldiers who are ready/nto die on the battlefield.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/050: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome to our proud town of Ron./nA night at our inn costs 110 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/051: Thank you. Have a peaceful night./nMay God's blessing watch over you!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/052: Do visit us again when you have the chance.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/053: Thank you for your custom. Come again!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/054: I'm a mercenary./nBut I've had enough of wandering,/nso I've come to settle here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/055: I thought Ron's powerful army would let me make full use/nof the skills I've learned as a mercenary.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/056: Libreville and Ron must be the two best places to live./nI've come to settle here, too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/057: Geysir City? There are dangers there you may never notice./nIt's even more dangerous than the other towns.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/058: Our arena is full of tough instructors/nwith tremendous stamina./nGo in and try it!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/059: For a man, building strength in our arena/nis the best preparation for real combat. Certainly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/060: [Winnie]/nWelcome. /nMy parents quarreled and went out again, but they will be back soon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/062: My parents aren't here, so I don't know the prices./nI'm sorry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/063: To do your part/nas a citizen, gain some experience in combat training!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/064: I'm sorry./nGuests are not allowed in that area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/065: I'm sorry, sir./nYou can't come in that way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/066: Please, you mustn't go in there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/067: I'm sorry./nGuests are not allowed in that area.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/068: Hey, come and catch me! /nCatch me and I'll give you something good!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/069: Hmph! Think you can catch me that easily?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/072: You have a membership card. Go on in.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/073: Al's battlefield had seen the fiercest fighting/nof all the battlefronts./nAwen was filled with foreboding.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/074: When Awen reached Al's unit,/nhe was absent from the people who warmly welcomed her./nAwen asked, "Where is Al?"/nOne of his comrades replied,/n"He was taken prisoner in the last battle."
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/075: Ever since, people have occasionally found/nan unfamiliar gem in that lake./nThat gem is the Chaos Cube.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/076: Hearing that Al had fallen into the hands of a cruel enemy,/nAwen could not afford to delay./nShe slipped into the enemy's castle and began searching for him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/077: Awen learned that the prisoners had been left hanging from Mount Creon's cliffs/nuntil they died./nShe rushed to the foot of the cliffs and defeated the guards, but they had destroyed the ladder leading up./nReinforcements soon poured toward the cliffs,/nand she had no way to climb them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/078: The story is nearly over now.../nSomeone living in the west will tell you the next part.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/079: My grandfather died in the war against Silver Arrow./nThey say he was a soldier serving directly under the Black Prince.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/080: When I grow up, I'll become a brave soldier/nand teach anyone who looks down on our Empire a lesson. Just you wait.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/081: The Empire must unite./nSilver Arrow's forces have been greatly weakened/nby their war with the Tuer Empire./nNow is the perfect time to restore our former glory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/082: And if we don't unite,/nthen should Silver Arrow fall to the Tuer Empire,/nour lands will be ravaged next.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/083: And Ron must naturally/nform the heart of that union./nAren't we the Empire's true strength?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/084: Welcome. I don't believe you've been to our tavern before.../nOur specialty is Rud, the strongest liquor in the imperial lands./nWould you care to try it?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/089: Ugh... This is strong.../20d My head...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/090: Wh... Where am I...?/nDid I pass out after drinking that liquor?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/095: I am you. Another you in your heart. /nBut... Have you gone too far lately?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/096: What? Too far in what way?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/097: What are you running around so frantically for?/nWhat could possibly matter more than me?/nCan't you rest now?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/098: Let the world go its own way. Let's rest./nYes? Somewhere as warm as a dream,/nas comforting as a mother's embrace,/nas though dead, in eternal peace...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/099: What should I do...? Isn't this my own voice...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/100: Follow the voice's advice and rest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/101: No! There's still so much I have to do!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/102: For a man, fitness comes first, second, and always!/nNever neglect your training!/nA relative of mine serves as a soldier in Geysir City,/nand specializes in running!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/103: Ron City. Prices are somewhat high. A stable city ruled by the renowned military lord Frederick. Its symmetrical layout reflects its military discipline, and its bridges and moats form the strongest defenses in the imperial territories. Its soldiers are reputed to be the empire's finest. Fine firearms can be purchased here. The northern exit leads to Bordeaux through the Demon Sword Forest, where a magic sword is said to lie hidden. Another legendary sword is rumored to rest in a cave on nearby Mount Ron./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/104: To survive in battle, acquire as many fine weapons and pieces of equipment as you can. You get what you pay for: a truth recognized in every land and age. The finest equipment and the strength of a great warrior are your best means of surviving these troubled times./n- Tactical Research Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/105: You are about to enter a time of war. The rush of your fate will leave you no leisure to reflect on yourself. Now, while you still have the chance, prepare thoroughly for what lies ahead./n- Last words left to someone by an elderly prophetess of Ron -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/106: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nDungeons are so dangerous that our Geographical Society/nhas never set foot in those unknown regions./nTo survive there, you must make a map as you go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/107: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nSurely you know the timeless rule that keeping to the edges/nmeans encountering fewer enemies?/nIf you enter a dungeon and make a map, pass it on to us/nfor the benefit of future generations.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/108: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nNever forget that travelers' safety throughout Geysir rests in your hands!/nAddress it to: "23 Steiner Street, Geysir City, Geysir Territory,/nDirector of Cartography, Geographical Research Society, Geysir Imperial Academy."/nThat will do!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/109: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nYou...! You've been to Thunder Nightmare Cave near Libreville!/nThat dangerous cave has claimed so many of our members! Surely you made a map?/nPlease, please tell me about its geography!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/110: The cave's geography...?/nIt's been so long since I was there, my memory is hazy...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/111: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nEven a rough idea will do. Please, tell me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/112: What should I do? Help him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/113: Take the time to help draw a map.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/115: All right. I'll help you draw a map from what I remember.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/116: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you! Thank you so much!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/117: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nThank you so much./nEvery member of our society will remember this kindness!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/118: [Member of the Geographical Society]/nPlease... please show me a map of the cave./nI'll reward you generously.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/120: What should I do? He's even given me a Silver Gem. Should I tell him?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/121: Take the time to draw a map.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/123: After all that pleading... I should help him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/124: Thank you, thank you!/nYour name will live forever/nin the history of our Imperial Geographical Society!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/125: Oh dear... When Inferno fell,/nwe all lost our jobs.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/126: At least I've found part-time work in the arena,/nbut I wonder what's become of the others...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/127: Heh heh heh... Care to try a bout with me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/128: Ron City. Prices are somewhat high. A stable city ruled by the renowned military lord Frederick. Its symmetrical layout reflects its military discipline, and its bridges and moats form the strongest defenses in the imperial territories. Its soldiers are reputed to be the empire's finest. Fine firearms can be purchased here. The northern exit leads to Bordeaux through the Demon Sword Forest, where a magic sword is said to lie hidden. Another legendary sword is rumored to rest in a cave on nearby Mount Ron./n- Imperial Geographical Society, Geysir Academy -
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/129: -- Ron City Guide --/nWeapons    Accessories/nInn        Tavern/nItems      Arena/nGeysir Academy branch: eastern district
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/037_3: My father collects guns himself,/nso he keeps some fine pieces aside that he doesn't normally sell.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/050_3: [Mr. Jeff]/nWelcome to our proud town of Ron./nA night at our inn costs 110 ELD./nWould you like to stay?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/051_3: Thank you. Have a good night's sleep.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/053_3: Thank you for staying with us./nPlease come again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/058_3: Our arena is full of lively monsters.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltro01/062_3: My parents aren't here, so I didn't know the prices./nI'm sorry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/002: You don't have to worry about this. /60d/nI will take care of it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/005: The Bifrost army is moving as expected./40d/nEverything is going according to plan.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/006: Let's see how long Frederick holds out./75d/nThis should be entertaining.../40d Heheheh.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/007: Soon,/30d not only the Empire,/20d but Bifrost,/15d Pendragon,/15d Astania...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/008: No,/30d the whole continent of Antalya/30d will be reborn as one mighty nation!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s02/010: It has been/35d thirty years since you passed away.../70d/nThe moment when our bitter longing is fulfilled/50d draws ever closer.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfldri12/000: At last, we've found the Thunder Nightmare's lair!!!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst18/000: I think I can hold my own now. Should I try the challenge as I am?/10d Or go back for the final training...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst18/001: Okay, we have arrived at the entrance of the cave. /10d should be enough. /15d Practice is almost over.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/001: [????]/n...It has been a very long time since a living human/30d ventured/35d/nhere...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/003: [????]/nSadly, it seems I am./60d/nYou/20d don't appear to serve them.../55d/nHow did you enter this place?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/004: Who/15d are you?/45d And by them.../45d/ndo you mean the Church of the Lord God?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/005: [Deimos]/nMy name is Deimos./45d/nI know nothing of this Church of the Lord God.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/006: You/45d must have been imprisoned here for a long time./60d/nYou haven't heard of the Church of the Lord God, whose power reaches across the imperial lands...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/007: Still,/40d Deimos.../50d/nI've heard that name before...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/008: [Deimos]/nDid you end up like this/30d by opposing that faction?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/009: If I'd at least resisted, I wouldn't feel so wronged./65d/nCardinal Cesare, the leader of the Church,/65d/nis my fiancee's father!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/010: [Deimos]/nSo, you must have done/30d/nsomething that was very detrimental to that cardinal...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/011: No!/45d/nI merely/35d sought to study the truth of history./50d/nHow could that harm the Church?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/013: [Deimos]/nThe truth of history.../50d/nWhat truth/20d were you trying to uncover?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/014: I only/45d studied the Secret Records of the Creation War,/30d/na history written by a sage of the old Empire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/015: [Deimos]/nHmm.../20d You studied the Creation War?/60d/nThen perhaps you already know something of me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/016: Of you...?/45d What/15d could you mean...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/019: Deimos,/40d leader of the Dark Gods?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/021: Are you really/30d Deimos, the Dark God?/60d/nI can't believe it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/022: Then/45d the Secret Records of the Creation War really were true!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/023: [Deimos]/nNever mind that./30d I'd like to hear the rest of your story.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl02_s04/025: [Deimos]/nOh.../15d It seems our time is up./40d/nIf we meet again,/20d will you tell me your story in detail?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s04/000: [Cesare]/nWith the God of Destruction's power,/45d I am no longer human./45d I am a god!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s04/001: [Cesare]/nThose who oppose me.../60d/nThose who profane the divine/30d shall atone with their lives!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl26_s04/002: Even a god/50d will find no mercy from me./50d/nYour time to die has come,/15d Cesare!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/000: Zephyr Falcon - Frederick Army Joint Headquarters
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/001: To think we'd capture/15d Inferno so easily.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/002: It was thanks to General Frederick's/20d artillery support.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/003: As you know,/30d Inferno is a natural fortress,/40d/nbut it has numerous hidden passages.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/004: With a precise knowledge of its layout,/35d and a support force to distract the enemy,/40d/ncapturing it isn't so difficult.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/005: I see.../35d/nHave your forces suffered any losses?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/006: No heavy losses,/40d but one unit hasn't returned yet...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/009: Ah.../15d Um.../20d I have something to attend to...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/013: Did you think dressing as a man/15d would stop me recognizing you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/016: Enough excuses./40d Go home at once.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/020: .../45d Your mother is very worried about you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/025: Everyone in Zephyr Falcon,/40d thank you for everything.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/026: You've heard what happened,/35d but I'm sorry it turned out that I was deceiving you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/027: I won't be able to fight beside you any longer.../60d/nBut/30d I trust Miss Kana/15d will work hard/nfor my share as well.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/029: Wait, Chris!/25d Explain yourself!/20d/nWhat's this about dressing as a man,/15d and calling him Father?!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl13_s05/031: Chris.../35d Christina.../40d/nSo she was Lord Frederick's daughter...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwst24/000: I think I've learned a fair amount of swordsmanship now. Time for my final lesson.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/000: Oh no. They say beauties die young.../nWhat if I don't live very long?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/001: To reach Geysir City from here,/nyou have to cross the desert.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/002: The desert is terrible for one's skin,/nso I can't go to Geysir. Hohoho.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/004: It would be nice if it rained occasionally.../nWhy is the weather always the same?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/005: Ah... Look at the brilliant blue sky and billowing clouds.../nThat sky, as clear as Ron's Meteor Sword, moves me to tears.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/006: Cerepus receives news from both the Empire and Pendragon/nall in one place.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/007: The Granada trading company is especially famous for its wide range of goods.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/008: They sometimes bring in unusual goods,/nbut apparently the shops don't sell them. You'll have to obtain them elsewhere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/009: It's been a long time since I last visited Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/010: That's Granada behind us, the largest shop in the empire. It's enormous.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/011: They say there's nothing Granada doesn't have,/nbut that can mean all sorts of things.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/012: I saw a very beautiful young woman a few days ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/013: Blue hair, blue eyes, fair skin...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/014: It was like seeing a picture of Ruth/nfrom younger days. Ruth's at the tavern now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/015: Huh? There's a strange mist above your head...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/016: It looks as though bad luck is hanging over you.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/017: To rid yourself of bad luck, go to Ron./nAn eccentric old fortune-teller living there/nwill read your fortune.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/018: Have you heard the legend of Treasure Island?/nThey say the legendary pirate Kidd hid his treasure there...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/019: They say the gems buried there are beyond imagining./nIf only I could reach it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/020: I hate port cities like this. So vulgar and disorderly.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/021: A friend of mine moved to Libreville,/nand sent word that it's a wonderful place to live.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/022: If Ruth, who's at the tavern now, became mayor,/ncould our city become as pleasant as Libreville?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/023: They say a band of thieves called Zephyr Falcon/nis running rampant inland.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/024: Life is hard enough already... It's worrying.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/025: If Ruth, who's in this tavern, became mayor,/nwould public safety improve a little?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/026: My friend Jane is now in Caracas,/na rural village inland.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/027: Her mother was a hunter, so she was always on her own./nI wonder how she's doing now...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/029: I once went to a place called Ron with my father.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/030: It was a very long way.../nOn the way there, in the woods near Geysir City,/nI entered a strange cave.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/031: I couldn't get past a certain point in the cave./nNext time, I'll be sure to explore the rest...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/032: I was sick last week, so I couldn't go on the outing to the underwater city.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/033: Another child told me that John/nwas planning to confess his love to me there.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/034: It's so frustrating! What a terrible shame!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/035: It's so sunny. /nIn this kind of weather, it would be no problem even to go to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/036: You've heard the legend of Storm Island, haven't you?/nThey say whoever draws the sword Asura embedded there/ncan become ruler of the Empire...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/037: But the currents around Storm Island are fierce,/nand the weather changes so violently that it's hard to approach.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/038: To get to Storm Island,/nyou must go in your own ship/nor take Pendragon's ferry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/039: Pendragon's ferry?/nWhy, of course it's bringing supplies sent by King Rashid.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/040: Legend says that if you sail beyond Storm Island,/nyou'll find a route to Treasure Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/041: I have a friend named Paz. /nIf you find him, he will definitely be able to help you a lot.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/042: He used to be a swordsman, but he's better/nat repairing swords than wielding them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/043: You look like swordsmen yourselves, so...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/044: Unless the sea routes are peaceful,/nCerepus's growth will remain limited./nIt's a real problem...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/046: This is the best tavern in Cerepus!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/047: Our drinks are so good that even the Tuer/ncould never forget this place!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/048: Not one of those sailors has any sense!/nEvery last one keeps sneaking glances at me!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/049: Hmph... Still, at least they recognize beauty when they see it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/053: Please stay with us next time.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/055: I'm planning a journey through Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/056: The woman staying in the next room/nsets my heart on fire.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/057: All sorts of people gather here in Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/058: Our inn, and its guests as well,/nsee all kinds of people come and go.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/059: My husband and I own this inn.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/061: Father is out temporarily,/nWe are looking after the store for him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/062: We know all the prices, so don't worry.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/063: Cerepus has had a famous thieves' guild for generations.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/064: Everyone is having a hard time nowadays,/nIt is also difficult for the Thieves Guild to survive.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/065: We're Tommy and Tuppence, a married couple.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/066: We are on a special mission for the Zephyr Falcon.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/067: We're posing as a married couple for a special mission.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/069: My spouse and I learned business early,/nso we could even afford to rent space in the Amigo department store.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/070: Hmph... No matter how great they think they are,/nAfter all, this store was still opened with my property.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/071: Hmph. However clever they think they are,/nthis shop was started with my capital, after all.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/072: It took a great deal of effort to get this far.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/073: At one point, I met an eccentric near the dragon's cave in Geysir Forest/nand managed to earn the capital to start trading.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/074: What's our special mission? That's a se-cret.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/075: After working on missions together for so long, I came to love him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/076: Our mission is secret. We can't tell you about it.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/077: After performing missions together for so long,/nI gradually fell in love with her. /nIn the beginning, we really had no tacit understanding...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/079: If you're having trouble with anything, leave it to us.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/080: How do we know so much?/nWe're the private detectives Tommy and Tuppence.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/081: My father and Tommy are very close.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/082: But in truth, this inn/nwas practically built by my efforts alone./nThat foolish husband of mine only opened and shut the door.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/083: But he doesn't realize it. He thinks he's wonderful./nWell, letting him believe that doesn't hurt me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/084: Our master is an odd fellow./nThe mistress does the actual work of running the inn,/nbut he takes all the credit.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/085: It is also my first time to come to Cerepus,/nBut I have never seen such a beautiful woman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/086: If I miss this chance, it won't come again, will it?/nI'll boldly approach my goddess and win her love!/nWait for me, my love!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/087: The young man staying next door seems rather appealing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/088: After this journey, I don't intend/nto return to the former imperial lands ever again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/089: What's the best way to humble their pride?/nMoney? Fame? A handsome face?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/090: In the end, it's the smallest acts of care that move a woman's heart./nHow can I show the woman I love/nsome small kindness of my own?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/091: Someone like Ruth over there should become mayor/nand lock up all those men with only one thing on their minds!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/092: The secret to a good drink is devotion./nThe devotion to sacrifice everything for the finest result!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/093: For peace in the port,/nwe must put limits/non the unrestricted free-trade zone we have now.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/094: Too much freedom makes people foolish.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/095: I am Charles, the current mayor of Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/096: I have no intention of surrendering my office to a youngster like Ruth.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/097: Are you the mayor of Cerepus?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/098: [Mayor Charles]/nI am./15d What do you want?/35d/nHave you come to compare me to the likes of Ruth/30d/nahead of the mayoral election, too?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/099: I have no interest in the election./50d/nI only want to know when the ban/25d/non ships sailing to Dakama will be lifted.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/100: [Mayor Charles]/nHeh.../45d You want to know when the sailing ban will be lifted?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/101: Are you planning to completely close the route?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/102: [Mayor Charles]/nClose the route!/40d Now there's an idea.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/103: [Mayor Charles]/nLeave now./30d/nI have nothing more to say about that route.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/104: [Ruth]/nFor the revival of the Geysir Empire!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/105: Excuse me, /30d Do you know someone named Ruth?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/106: [Ruth]/nIf it's Ruth Grant you're looking for,/30d/nit's me.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/108: [Ruth]/nHeh,/20d surprised?/40d/nThis must be your first visit to Cerepus.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/109: [Ruth]/nNow,/15d what did you want to see me about?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/110: I have to go to the port of Dakama. /45d/nBut the mayor has blocked the route.../60d/nIs there any way to lift the ban?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/111: [Ruth]/nOh,/65d I may be a candidate for mayor,/30d but I'm only a citizen./25d/nI have no such authority.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/112: No./35d/nThe hopes the townspeople place in you/ntell me otherwise.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/113: [Ruth]/nWell.../85d/nBut/25d why are you so determined to reach Dakama Port?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/118: In truth,/30d I have business with/10d/nthe demon sword Asura on Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/120: No. /40d/nI do need the power of that sword, /45d/nbut not for the pursuit of fame.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/121: [Ruth]/nMany have gone to that island/15d in search of Asura./60d/nBut they say none returned safely.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/123: [Ruth]/nThat's a fascinating story./45d/nBut/25d are you sure you should tell me such things?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/124: ...I received news that my mother/40d/n in Dakama is critically ill...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/125: [Ruth]/nHa ha ha! /55dYour lie is so obvious!/50d/nIt's written all over your face.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/126: [Ruth]/nI have no wish to speak/45d/nto dishonest people./45d/nWould you please step aside?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/127: ...Ruth,/30d I apologize for my rudeness./45d/nPlease, could you help me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/128: [Ruth]/nI have no reason to show kindness/50d/nto someone who isn't sincere.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/129: When asking for another's goodwill,/45d/nI felt I ought to be honest.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/130: [Ruth]/nHeh,/35d very well./40d/nYour sincerity has reached me,/40d so I should respond in kind.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/132: [Ruth]/nI'll help you,/30d so meet me at the docks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/134: [Ruth]/nI see.../75d/nBut/25d are you sure you should tell me such things?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/135: I've already offended you with one lie./55d/nI can't make that mistake again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/136: [Ruth]/nHeh,/65d someone who admits a mistake.../70d/nI don't dislike that.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/138: [Ruth]/nYour sincerity has reached me,/30d so I must answer sincerely too./45d/nOf course,/20d unlike a certain young gentleman,/25d I do not/ntell lies.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/142: Thank you very much for your patronage.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/146: Does anyone live in this house...?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/147: It's too soon to give up./45d/nI'll try speaking to Ruth again.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/148: It seems we should go find the person named Ruth...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/149: So this is the mayor's residence.../60d/nMayor Charles doesn't seem to have a good reputation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/150: Ruth, who's usually at the tavern,/nonce spoke of Treasure Island too.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/012_2: I saw a very beautiful young woman a few days ago.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/014_2: When I grow up, I want to be beautiful like her.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/022_2: That friend's family was rather unusual.../nIf you visit Libreville, would you pass on my regards?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/025_2: The nobles have so much money,/nyet don't they ever think of keeping people safe?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/053_2: If you're not going to stay, why even ask?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/091_2: Well, with looks like mine, it's rather a waste/nto be serving people in a place like this,/nisn't it? Hohoho.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/125_2: Ah hahaha! Your lies are too obvious! /n "I'm lying" is written on your face, how can I believe you?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/126_2: [Ruth]/nI don't like dishonest people. /nExcuse me, could you please step aside?

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/014_3: When I grow up, I want to be beautiful like her.

Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/153: [Ruth]/nSince it is not for fame,/40d/nthen why on earth do you want to take such a risk?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/155: [Ruth]/nPeople meeting me for the first time/30d/nare often surprised that the person/n/25dchallenging Mayor Charles is/20da woman.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/156: [Mayor Charles]/nThat route/10d is dangerous and plagued by pirates,/40d/nso departures are banned for the time being.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/157: [Mayor Charles]/nDakama Port's economy/15d is in a dreadful state anyway./50d/nWe have nothing to gain by trading with them.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/159: Surely you/35d/ncan find some way to help me?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/161: To do that,/30d I must take a ship from Dakama Port to Storm Island.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/162: [Ruth]/nHmm.../30d I understand./50d I'll help you./30d/nMeet me at the docks.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfltcy03/165: [Ruth]/nAre you another who would borrow the sword's power/45d/nto chase empty fame?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/000: Congratulations,/15d General Frederick./30d/nWithout your skill in commanding troops,/30d we would not have won today.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/001: Haha./70d I know today's victory/45d was not due solely to the plans/45d/nClausewitz and I devised.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/002: It was possible because we stood together.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/003: Our plans/40d merely supported that united strength, didn't they?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/004: Indeed./40d/nThis battle/20d was a success that will live on/20d in the Empire's history./30d/nHow could we not celebrate?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/005: Speaking of which,/30d where is today's hero?/65d/nThe swordsman in the gray cloak, I mean./55d I'd like to share a toast with him.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/007: Our front collapsed after a mistake by the rear units./45d But he swiftly/15d/nretook the supply route,/25d letting us recover the situation.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/009: Cyrano,/20d let's all go and celebrate!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/010: I'm sorry, but would you give me some space?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/012: Leave him be,/10d Kana./25d/nCyrano/25d has something he wants to do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/014: Cyrano,/40d you did splendidly today./65d/nI'd like to share a toast/30d to the hero of this battle.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/015: ...That wouldn't be unwelcome./55d/nBut/35d before I drink with you,/30d there's something I want to do.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/017: General Alfred Frederick,/60d I challenge you to a duel.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/022: Hahaha,/70d you take your joke too far./55d/nHow could my swordsmanship/35d match the finest swordsman in the imperial lands?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/023: You seem to have misunderstood./70d/nI don't want a practice bout./40d What I want/35d is your life.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/025: Hmm.../75d This is awkward./55d/nI don't know what grievance you bear against me,/55d/nbut we are celebrating our allied forces' victory.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/026: Even if I accept your challenge,/70d/nwe cannot duel here.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/027: Just before dawn tomorrow./60d The peak behind this valley./45d/nAnd of course,/30d come alone.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/028: I trust you won't be late.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/029: How insolent!/60d/nI will not accept/15d such a one-sided challenge!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/030: A one-sided challenge?/70d/nYou killed an innocent man in the name of a duel,/40d yet refuse one yourself?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/034: Lord Frederick/15d is coming this way.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/036: ...I don't know your reason,/55d but after what you've said, I have no choice./55d/nVery well,/40d I accept your challenge.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/037: However, /20d I accept this duel, /40d/n not because you are right.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/038: I accept your challenge only to show/40d that none of my past actions/55d/nhas given me any cause for shame!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/040: Cyrano,/35d what on earth is going on?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/041: I'm sorry, strategist./45d/nBecause of me, this alliance will face difficulties.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/042: That may be so,/35d/nbut I believe you must have/40d a reason for acting like this, Cyrano.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/043: There must be circumstances you can't tell us about.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kfl15_s01/044: We/25d trust you./40d/nYou won't let us down.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka02a/000: North - Caracas Village/nEast - Trisis Desert/nSouth - Paro Region/nWest - Pretoria Region
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflwka02a/001: It's a long way to Pretoria./35d Let's hurry!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/001: Wow.../35d There really was treasure here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/002: Incredible.../45d/nI've been a pirate for years, but I've never seen this much treasure.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/004: Good heavens.../30d there's so much of it...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/005: Hey,/15d look at this./25d/nSuch beautiful diamonds...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/006: That's Clausewitz for you./65d/nWith this much,/20d we won't have to worry about military funds for ten years.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/010: It seems.../30d we had rivals in this treasure hunt.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/011: [Organization Member]/nWho are you?!/40d/nHands off the treasure! Get out, now!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/012: Haha,/45d don't be so hostile./40d/nShouldn't good things be shared?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/013: [Organization Member]/nDamn it!/35d If words won't work, we'll have to use force!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/014: What do we do now?/25d/nIt looks like they'll keep coming...
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/015: Hmm.../40d Then we have no choice.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/016: Take as much as you can carry/20d and get out of here!
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/019: But/30d how do we take all this treasure with us?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/021: If you pass this point, you won't be able to complete the following side quests./nDo you want to continue?
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflgold21/022: Ignore the side quest and move on.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflcprh1/000: They say the torture chamber is beneath the mansion's west wing.
Lines.text.re/art_|@kflinf1f/000: Oh,/15d the door is locked!/40d I'll need a key.../45d/nThere may be one somewhere. I'd better look for it.
